% ----------------------
\subsection{Psalms}
% ----------------------
	\label{PSALMS}

	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 1} % *PSALMS-1
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-1}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 1:1} % *PSALMS-1-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-1-1}

			Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ΜΑΚΑΡΙΟΣ ἀνὴρ ὃς οὐκ ἐπορεύθη ἐν βουλῇ ἀσεβῶν, καὶ ἐν ὁδῷ ἁμαρτωλῶν οὐκ ἔστη, καὶ ἐπὶ καθέδραν λοιμῶν οὐκ ἐκάθισεν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, Nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers:
					\item[NIV] Blessed is the one who does not walk in step with the wicked or stand in the way that sinners take or sit in the company of mockers,
					\item[NRSV] Happy are those who do not follow the advice of the wicked, or take the path that sinners tread, or sit in the seat of scoffers;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 1:2} % *PSALMS-1-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-1-2}

			But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀλλ᾽ ἢ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Κυρίου τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ αὐτοῦ μελετήσει ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But his delight is in the law of Jehovah; And on his law doth he meditate day and night.
					\item[NIV] but whose delight is in the law of the LORD, and who meditates on his law day and night.
					\item[NRSV] but their delight is in the law of the LORD, and on his law they meditate day and night.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 1:3} % *PSALMS-1-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-1-3}

			And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל־פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ ׀ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἔσται ὡς τὸ ξύλον τὸ πεφυτευμένον παρὰ τὰς διεξόδους τῶν ὑδάτων, ὃ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ δώσει ἐν καιρῷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ φύλλον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἀπορρυήσεται· καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἂν ποιῇ κατευοδωθήσεται.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And he shall be like a tree planted by the streams of water, That bringeth forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also doth not wither; And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
					\item[NIV] That person is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither— whatever they do prospers.
					\item[NRSV] They are like trees planted by streams of water, which yield their fruit in its season, and their leaves do not wither. In all that they do, they prosper.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 1:4} % *PSALMS-1-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-1-4}

			The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֹא־כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐχ οὕτως οἱ ἀσεβεῖς, οὐχ οὕτως, ἀλλ᾽ ἢ ὡς ὁ χνοῦς ὃν ἐκριπτεῖ ὁ ἄνεμος ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The wicked are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
					\item[NIV] Not so the wicked! They are like chaff that the wind blows away.
					\item[NRSV] The wicked are not so, but are like chaff that the wind drives away.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 1:5} % *PSALMS-1-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-1-5}

			Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַל־כֵּ֤ן ׀ לֹא־יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἀναστήσονται οἱ ἀσεβεῖς ἐν κρίσει, οὐδὲ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἐν βουλῇ δικαίων·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
					\item[NIV] Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
					\item[NRSV] Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 1:6} % *PSALMS-1-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-1-6}

			For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι γινώσκει Κύριος ὁδὸν δικαίων, καὶ ὁδὸς ἀσεβῶν ἀπολεῖται.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For Jehovah knoweth the way of the righteous; But the way of the wicked shall perish.
					\item[NIV] For the LORD watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked leads to destruction.
					\item[NRSV] for the LORD watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 2} % *PSALMS-2
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-2}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 2:1} % *PSALMS-2-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-2-1}

			Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לָ֭מָּה רָגְשׁ֣וּ גוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים יֶהְגּוּ־רִֽיק׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἵνα τί ἐφρύαξαν ἔθνη, καὶ λαοὶ ἐμελέτησαν κενά;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate a vain thing?
					\item[NIV] Why do the nations conspire and the peoples plot in vain?
					\item[NRSV] Why do the nations conspire, and the peoples plot in vain?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 2:2} % *PSALMS-2-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-2-2}

			The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ ׀ מַלְכֵי־אֶ֗רֶץ וְרוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ־יָ֑חַד עַל־יְ֝הוָה וְעַל־מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{παρέστησαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες συνήχθησαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ κατὰ τοῦ κυρίου καὶ κατὰ τοῦ χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against Jehovah, and against his anointed, saying,
					\item[NIV] The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the LORD and against his anointed, saying,
					\item[NRSV] The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD and his anointed, saying,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 2:3} % *PSALMS-2-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-2-3}

			Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נְֽ֭נַתְּקָה אֶת־מֽוֹסְרוֹתֵ֑ימוֹ וְנַשְׁלִ֖יכָה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ עֲבֹתֵֽימוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{διαρρήξωμεν τοὺς δεσμοὺς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἀπορρίψωμεν ἀφ᾽ ἡμῶν τὸν ζυγὸν αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let us break their bonds asunder, And cast away their cords from us.
					\item[NIV] “Let us break their chains and throw off their shackles.”
					\item[NRSV] “Let us burst their bonds asunder, and cast their cords from us.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 2:4} % *PSALMS-2-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-2-4}

			He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the LORD shall have them in derision.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׂחָ֑ק אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י יִלְעַג־לָֽמוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν οὐρανοῖς ἐκγελάσεται αὐτούς, καὶ ὁ κύριος ἐκμυκτηριεῖ αὐτούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He that sitteth in the heavens will laugh: The Lord will have them in derision.
					\item[NIV] The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord scoffs at them.
					\item[NRSV] He who sits in the heavens laughs; the LORD has them in derision.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 2:5} % *PSALMS-2-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-2-5}

			Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣ימוֹ בְאַפּ֑וֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנ֥וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τότε λαλήσει πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῷ θυμῷ αὐτοῦ ταράξει αὐτούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Then will he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure:
					\item[NIV] He rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,
					\item[NRSV] Then he will speak to them in his wrath, and terrify them in his fury, saying,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 2:6} % *PSALMS-2-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-2-6}

			Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַ֭אֲנִי נָסַ֣כְתִּי מַלְכִּ֑י עַל־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן הַר־קָדְשִֽׁי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ κατεστάθην ὑπ᾽ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Σειὼν ὄρος τὸ ἅγιον αὐτοῦ,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Yet I have set my king Upon my holy hill of Zion.
					\item[NIV] “I have installed my king on Zion, my holy mountain.”
					\item[NRSV] “I have set my king on Zion, my holy hill.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 2:7} % *PSALMS-2-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-2-7}

			I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל חֹ֥ק יְֽהוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר אֵלַ֥י בְּנִ֥י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{διαγγέλλων τὸ πρόσταγμα Κυρίου. Κύριος εἶπεν πρὸς μέ Υἱός μου εἶ σύ, ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will tell of the decree: Jehovah said unto me, Thou art my son; This day have I begotten thee.
					\item[NIV] I will proclaim the LORD’s decree: He said to me, “You are my son; today I have become your father.
					\item[NRSV] I will tell of the decree of the LORD: He said to me, “You are my son; today I have begotten you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 2:8} % *PSALMS-2-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-2-8}

			Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗נִּי וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וַ֝אֲחֻזָּתְךָ֗ אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἴτησαι παρ᾽ ἐμοῦ, καὶ δώσω σοι ἔθνη τὴν κληρονομίαν σου, καὶ τὴν κατάσχεσίν σου τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Ask of me, and I will give thee the nations for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
					\item[NIV] Ask me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.
					\item[NRSV] Ask of me, and I will make the nations your heritage, and the ends of the earth your possession.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 2:9} % *PSALMS-2-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-2-9}

			Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּ֭רֹעֵם בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּכְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ποιμανεῖς αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ, ὡς σκεῦος κεραμέως συντρίψεις αὐτούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NRSV] You shall break them with a rod of iron, and dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ νῦν, βασιλεῖς, σύνετε· παιδεύθητε, πάντες οἱ κρίνοντες τὴν γῆν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{δουλεύσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν φόβῳ, καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε αὐτῷ ἐν τρόμῳ.}

					\item[NRSV] Serve the LORD with fear, with trembling

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-2-12}

			Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נַשְּׁקוּ־בַ֡ר פֶּן־יֶאֱנַ֤ף ׀ וְתֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי־יִבְעַ֣ר כִּמְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כָּל־ח֥וֹסֵי בֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{δράξασθε παιδείας, μή ποτε ὀργισθῇ Κύριος, καὶ ἀπολεῖσθε ἐξ ὁδοῦ δικαίας, ὅταν ἐκκαυθῇ ἐν τάχει ὁ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ. μακάριοι πάντες οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπ᾽ αὐτῷ.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Kiss his son, or he will be angry and your way will lead to your destruction, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.
					\item[NRSV] kiss his feet, or he will be angry, and you will perish in the way; for his wrath is quickly kindled. Happy are all who take refuge in him.
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 3:1} % *PSALMS-3-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-3-1}

			Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בְּ֝בָרְח֗וֹ מִפְּנֵ֤י ׀ אַבְשָׁל֬וֹם בְּנֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, τί ἐπληθύνθησαν οἱ θλίβοντές με; πολλοὶ ἐπανίστανται ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son. Jehovah, how are mine adversaries increased! Many are they that rise up against me.
					\item[NIV] A psalm of David. When he fled from his son Absalom. LORD, how many are my foes! How many rise up against me!
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, how many are my foes! Many are rising against me;

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

			Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְ֭הוָה מָֽה־רַבּ֣וּ צָרָ֑י רַ֝בִּ֗ים קָמִ֥ים עָלָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πολλοὶ λέγουσιν τῇ ψυχῇ μου Οὐκ ἔστιν σωτηρία ἐν τῷ θεῷ αὐτοῦ. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Many are saying of me, “God will not deliver him.”

		% % ---

			But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רַבִּים֮ אֹמְרִ֪ים לְנַ֫פְשִׁ֥י אֵ֤ין יְֽשׁוּעָ֓תָה לּ֬וֹ בֵֽאלֹהִ֬ים סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σὺ δέ, Κύριε, ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ, δόξα μου καὶ ὑψῶν τὴν κεφαλήν μου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{φωνῇ μου πρὸς Κύριον ἐκέκραξα, καὶ ἐπήκουσέν μου ἐξ ὄρους ἁγίου αὐτοῦ. διάψαλμα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ ἐκοιμήθην καὶ ὕπνωσα. ἐξηγέρθην, ὅτι Κύριος ἀντιλήμψεταί μου.}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲנִ֥י שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וָֽאִ֫ישָׁ֥נָה הֱקִיצ֑וֹתִי כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה יִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐ φοβηθήσομαι ἀπὸ μυριάδων λαοῦ τῶν κύκλῳ ἐπιτιθεμένων μοι.}

					\item[NIV] I will not fear though tens of thousands assail me on every side.

					\item[BHS] \he{לֹֽא־אִ֭ירָא מֵרִבְב֥וֹת עָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סָ֝בִ֗יב שָׁ֣תוּ עָלָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνάστα, Κύριε, σῶσόν με ὁ θεός μου· ὅτι σὺ ἐπάταξας πάντας τοὺς ἐχθραίνοντάς μοι ματαίως, ὀδόντας ἁμαρτωλῶν συνέτριψας.}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Arise, O Jehovah; Save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.
					\item[NIV] Arise, LORD! Deliver me, my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
					\item[NRSV] Rise up, O LORD! Deliver me, O my God! For you strike all my enemies on the cheek; you break the teeth of the wicked.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה ׀ הוֹשִׁ֘יעֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהַ֗י כִּֽי־הִכִּ֣יתָ אֶת־כָּל־אֹיְבַ֣י לֶ֑חִי שִׁנֵּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῦ κυρίου ἡ σωτηρία, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν σου ἡ εὐλογία σου.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] Deliverance belongs to the LORD; may your blessing be on your people! Selah

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 4} % *PSALMS-4
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-4}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 4:1} % *PSALMS-4-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-4-1}

			Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינ֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἐν τῷ ἐπικαλεῖσθαί με εἰσήκουσέν μου ὁ θεὸς τῆς δικαιοσύνης μου, ἐν θλίψει ἐπλάτυνάς μοι· οἰκτείρησόν με καὶ εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness; Thou hast set me at large when I was in distress: Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A psalm of David. Answer me when I call to you, my righteous God. Give me relief from my distress; have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
					\item[NRSV] Answer me when I call, O God of my right! You gave me room when I was in distress. Be gracious to me, and hear my prayer.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 4:2} % *PSALMS-4-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-4-2}

			O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּקָרְאִ֡י עֲנֵ֤נִי ׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צִדְקִ֗י בַּ֭צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי וּשְׁמַ֥ע תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{υἱοὶ ἀνθρώπων, ἕως πότε βαρυκάρδιοι; ἵνα τί ἀγαπᾶτε ματαιότητα καὶ ζητεῖτε ψεῦδος; διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? How long will ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? [Selah
					\item[NIV] How long will you people turn my glory into shame? How long will you love delusions and seek false gods
					\item[NRSV] How long, you people, shall my honor suffer shame? How long will you love vain words, and seek after lies? Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 4:3} % *PSALMS-4-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-4-3}

			But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד־מֶ֬ה כְבוֹדִ֣י לִ֭כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ γνῶτε ὅτι ἐθαυμάστωσεν Κύριος τὸν ὅσιον αὐτοῦ· Κύριος εἰσακούσεταί μου ἐν τῷ κεκραγέναι με πρὸς αὐτόν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But know that Jehovah hath set apart for himself him that is godly: Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.
					\item[NIV] Know that the LORD has set apart his faithful servant for himself; the LORD hears when I call to him.
					\item[NRSV] But know that the LORD has set apart the faithful for himself; the LORD hears when I call to him.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 4:4} % *PSALMS-4-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-4-4}

			Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וּדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חָסִ֣יד ל֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּקָרְאִ֥י אֵלָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὀργίζεσθε καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε· ἃ λέγετε ἐν καρδίᾳ, ἐπὶ ταῖς κοίταις ὑμῶν κατανύγητε. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Stand in awe, and sin not: Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. [Selah
					\item[NIV] Tremble and do not sin; when you are on your beds, search your hearts and be silent.
					\item[NRSV] When you are disturbed, do not sin; ponder it on your beds, and be silent. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 4:5} % *PSALMS-4-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-4-5}

			Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רִגְז֗וּ וְֽאַל־תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭לְבַבְכֶם עַֽל־מִשְׁכַּבְכֶ֗ם וְדֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{θύσατε θυσίαν δικαιοσύνης, καὶ ἐλπίσατε ἐπὶ Κύριον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Offer right sacrifices, and put your trust in the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 4:6} % *PSALMS-4-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-4-6}

			There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זִבְח֥וּ זִבְחֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וּ֝בִטְח֗וּ אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πολλοὶ λέγουσιν Τίς δείξει ἡμῖν τὰ ἀγαθά; ἐσημειώθη ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς τὸ φῶς τοῦ προσώπου σου, Κύριε·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Many there are that say, Who will show us any good? Jehovah, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
					\item[NIV] Many, LORD, are asking, “Who will bring us prosperity?” Let the light of your face shine on us.
					\item[NRSV] There are many who say, “O that we might see some good! Let the light of your face shine on us, O LORD!”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 4:7} % *PSALMS-4-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-4-7}

			Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי־יַרְאֵ֪נ֫וּ ט֥וֹב נְֽסָה־עָ֭לֵינוּ א֨וֹר פָּנֶ֬יךָ יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔδωκας εὐφροσύνην εἰς τὴν καρδίαν μου, ἀπὸ καρποῦ σίτου καὶ οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου αὐτῶν ἐπληθύνθησαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than they have when their grain and their new wine are increased.
					\item[NIV] Fill my heart with joy when their grain and new wine abound.
					\item[NRSV] You have put gladness in my heart more than when their grain and wine abound.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 4:8} % *PSALMS-4-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-4-8}

			I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְלִבִּ֑י מֵעֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖ם וְתִֽירוֹשָׁ֣ם רָֽבּוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ κοιμηθήσομαι καὶ ὑπνώσω· ὅτι σύ, Κύριε, κατὰ μόνας ἐπὶ ἐλπίδι κατῴκισάς με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety.
					\item[NIV] In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me dwell in safety.
					\item[NRSV] I will both lie down and sleep in peace; for you alone, O LORD, make me lie down in safety.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 5} % *PSALMS-5

		\label{PSALMS-5}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 5:1} % *PSALMS-5-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-1}

			Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶֽל־הַנְּחִיל֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τὰ ῥήματά μου ἐνώτισαι, Κύριε, σύνες τῆς κραυγῆς μου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; with the Nehiloth. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O Jehovah, Consider my meditation.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. For pipes. A psalm of David. Listen to my words, LORD, consider my lament.
					\item[NRSV] Give ear to my words, O LORD; give heed to my sighing.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 5:2} % *PSALMS-5-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-2}

			Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲמָרַ֖י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה ׀ יְהוָ֗ה בִּ֣ינָה הֲגִֽיגִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πρόσχες τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου, ὁ βασιλεύς μου καὶ ὁ θεός μου· ὅτι πρὸς σὲ προσεύξομαι, Κύριε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto thee do I pray.
					\item[NIV] Hear my cry for help, my King and my God, for to you I pray.
					\item[NRSV] Listen to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to you I pray.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 5:3} % *PSALMS-5-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-3}

			My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה ׀ לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי־אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὸ πρωὶ εἰσακούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς μου· τὸ πρωὶ παραστήσομαί σοι καὶ ἐπόψομαι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order my prayer unto thee, and will keep watch.
					\item[NIV] In the morning, LORD, you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait expectantly.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, in the morning you hear my voice; in the morning I plead my case to you, and watch.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 5:4} % *PSALMS-5-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-4}

			For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶר תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ־לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐχὶ θεὸς θέλων ἀνομίαν σὺ εἶ· οὐδὲ παροικήσει σοι πονηρευόμενος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: Evil shall not sojourn with thee.
					\item[NIV] For you are not a God who is pleased with wickedness; with you, evil people are not welcome.
					\item[NRSV] For you are not a God who delights in wickedness; evil will not sojourn with you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 5:5} % *PSALMS-5-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-5}

			The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י ׀ לֹ֤א אֵֽל־חָפֵ֘ץ רֶ֥שַׁע ׀ אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְךָ֣ רָֽע׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐ διαμενοῦσιν παράνομοι κατέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου· ἐμίσησας, Κύριε, πάντας τοὺς ἐργαζομένους τὴν ἀνομίαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The arrogant shall not stand in thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
					\item[NIV] The arrogant cannot stand in your presence. You hate all who do wrong;
					\item[NRSV] The boastful will not stand before your eyes; you hate all evildoers.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 5:6} % *PSALMS-5-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-6}

			Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֹֽא־יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ הֽ֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπολεῖς πάντας τοὺς λαλοῦντας τὸ ψεῦδος· ἄνδρα αἱμάτων καὶ δόλιον βδελύσσεται Κύριος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies: Jehovah abhorreth the blood-thirsty and deceitful man.
					\item[NIV] you destroy those who tell lies. The bloodthirsty and deceitful you, LORD, detest.
					\item[NRSV] You destroy those who speak lies; the LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 5:7} % *PSALMS-5-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-7}

			But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֪י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ־דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב ׀ יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν τῷ πλήθει τοῦ ἐλέου σου εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου, προσκυνήσω πρὸς ναὸν ἅγιόν σου ἐν φόβῳ σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But as for me, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness will I come into thy house: In thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
					\item[NIV] But I, by your great love, can come into your house; in reverence I bow down toward your holy temple.
					\item[NRSV] But I, through the abundance of your steadfast love, will enter your house, I will bow down toward your holy temple in awe of you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 5:8} % *PSALMS-5-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-8}

			Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַאֲנִ֗י בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל־הֵֽיכַל־קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, ὁδήγησόν με ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ἕνεκα τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου, κατεύθυνον ἐνώπιόν σου τὴν ὁδόν μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Lead me, O Jehovah, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; Make thy way straight before my face.
					\item[NIV] Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies— make your way straight before me.
					\item[NRSV] Lead me, O LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies; make your way straight before me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 5:9} % *PSALMS-5-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-9}

			For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֤ה ׀ נְחֵ֬נִי בְצִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑י הַיְשַׁ֖ר לְפָנַ֣י דַּרְכֶּֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν ἀλήθεια, ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν ματαία· τάφος ἀνεῳγμένος ὁ λάρυγξ αὐτῶν, ταῖς γλώσσαις αὐτῶν ἐδολιοῦσαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is very wickedness; Their throat is an open sepulchre; They flatter with their tongue.
					\item[NIV] Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with malice. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongues they tell lies.
					\item[NRSV] For there is no truth in their mouths; their hearts are destruction; their throats are open graves; they flatter with their tongues.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 5:10} % *PSALMS-5-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-10}

			Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּפִ֡יהוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ קִרְבָּ֪ם הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קֶֽבֶר־פָּת֥וּחַ גְּרוֹנָ֑ם לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗ם יַחֲלִֽיקוּן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κρῖνον αὐτούς, ὁ θεός· ἀποπεσάτωσαν ἀπὸ τῶν διαβουλιῶν αὐτῶν· κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἀσεβειῶν αὐτῶν ἔξωσον αὐτούς, ὅτι παρεπίκρανάν σε, Κύριε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Hold them guilty, O God; Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against thee.
					\item[NIV] Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.
					\item[NRSV] Make them bear their guilt, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; because of their many transgressions cast them out, for they have rebelled against you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 5:11} % *PSALMS-5-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-11}

			But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽאֲשִׁימֵ֨ם ׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽמֹּעֲצ֪וֹתֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּרֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑מוֹ כִּי־מָ֥רוּ בָֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ εὐφρανθήτωσαν ἐπὶ σοὶ πάντες οἱ ἐλπίζοντες ἐπὶ σέ· εἰς αἰῶνα ἀγαλλιάσονται, καὶ κατασκηνώσεις ἐν αὐτοῖς. καὶ καυχήσονται ἐπὶ σοὶ πάντες οἱ ἀγαπῶντες τὸ ὄνομά σου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But let all those that take refuge in thee rejoice, Let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: Let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
					\item[NIV] But let all who take refuge in you be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may rejoice in you.
					\item[NRSV] But let all who take refuge in you rejoice; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, so that those who love your name may exult in you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 5:12} % *PSALMS-5-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-5-12}

			For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל־ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡ךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ימוֹ וְֽיַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝ךָ֗ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι σὺ εὐλογεῖς δίκαιον. Κύριε, ὡς ὅπλῳ εὐδοκίας ἐστεφάνωσας ἡμᾶς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou wilt bless the righteous; O Jehovah, thou wilt compass him with favor as with a shield.
					\item[NIV] Surely, LORD, you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.
					\item[NRSV] For you bless the righteous, O LORD; you cover them with favor as with a shield.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 6} % *PSALMS-6
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-6}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 6:1} % *PSALMS-6-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-6-1}

			O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ בִּ֭נְגִינוֹת עַֽל־הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, μὴ τῷ θυμῷ σου ἐλέγξῃς με, μηδὲ τῇ ὀργῇ σου παιδεύσῃς με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. With stringed instruments. According to sheminith. A psalm of David. LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger, or discipline me in your wrath.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 6:2} % *PSALMS-6-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-6-2}

			Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־בְּאַפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וְֽאַל־בַּחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐλέησόν με, Κύριε, ὅτι ἀσθενής εἰμι· ἴασαί με, ὅτι ἐταράχθη τὰ ὀστᾶ μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; for I am withered away: O Jehovah, heal me; for my bones are troubled.
					\item[NIV] Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint; heal me, LORD, for my bones are in agony.
					\item[NRSV] Be gracious to me, O LORD, for I am languishing; O LORD, heal me, for my bones are shaking with terror.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 6:3} % *PSALMS-6-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-6-3}

			My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐταράχθη σφόδρα· καὶ σύ, Κύριε, ἕως πότε;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] My soul also is sore troubled: And thou, O Jehovah, how long?
					\item[NIV] My soul is in deep anguish. How long, LORD, how long?
					\item[NRSV] My soul also is struck with terror, while you, O LORD—how long?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 6:4} % *PSALMS-6-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-6-4}

			Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְאַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַד־מָתָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπίστρεψον, Κύριε, ῥῦσαι τὴν ψυχήν μου, σῶσόν με ἕνεκεν τοῦ ἐλέους σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Return, O Jehovah, deliver my soul: Save me for thy lovingkindness' sake.
					\item[NIV] Turn, LORD, and deliver me; save me because of your unfailing love.
					\item[NRSV] Turn, O LORD, save my life; deliver me for the sake of your steadfast love.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 6:5} % *PSALMS-6-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-6-5}

			For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ ὁ μνημονεύων σου· ἐν δὲ τῷ ᾅδῃ τίς ἐξομολογήσεταί σοι;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For in death there is no remembrance of thee: In Sheol who shall give thee thanks?
					\item[NIV] Among the dead no one proclaims your name. Who praises you from the grave?
					\item[NRSV] For in death there is no remembrance of you; in Sheol who can give you praise?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 6:6} % *PSALMS-6-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-6-6}

			I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּמָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה־לָּֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκοπίασα ἐν τῷ στεναγμῷ μου, λούσω καθ᾽ ἑκάστην νύκτα τὴν κλίνην μου, ἐν δάκρυσίν μου τὴν στρωμνήν μου βρέξω.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
					\item[NIV] I am worn out from my groaning. All night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
					\item[NRSV] I am weary with my moaning; every night I flood my bed with tears; I drench my couch with my weeping.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 6:7} % *PSALMS-6-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-6-7}

			Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָגַ֤עְתִּי ׀ בְּֽאַנְחָתִ֗י אַשְׂחֶ֣ה בְכָל־לַ֭יְלָה מִטָּתִ֑י בְּ֝דִמְעָתִ֗י עַרְשִׂ֥י אַמְסֶֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐταράχθη ἀπὸ θυμοῦ ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου, ἐπαλαιώθην ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Mine eye wasteth away because of grief; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.
					\item[NIV] My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.
					\item[NRSV] My eyes waste away because of grief; they grow weak because of all my foes.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-6-8}

			Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עָֽשְׁשָׁ֣ה מִכַּ֣עַס עֵינִ֑י עָֽ֝תְקָ֗ה בְּכָל־צוֹרְרָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπόστητε ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν, ὅτι εἰσήκουσεν Κύριος τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ κλαυθμοῦ μου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.
					\item[NIV] Away from me, all you who do evil, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
					\item[NRSV] Depart from me, all you workers of evil, for the LORD has heard the sound of my weeping.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 6:9} % *PSALMS-6-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-6-9}

			The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי כָּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֥ע יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰσήκουσεν Κύριος τῆς δεήσεώς μου, Κύριος τὴν προσευχήν μου προσεδέξατο.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah will receive my prayer.
					\item[NIV] The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD has heard my supplication; the LORD accepts my prayer.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 6:10} % *PSALMS-6-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-6-10}

			Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁמַ֣ע יְ֭הוָה תְּחִנָּתִ֑י יְ֝הוָ֗ה תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י יִקָּֽח׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰσχυνθείησαν καὶ ταραχθείησαν σφόδρα πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί μου, ἐπιστραφείησαν καὶ αἰσχυνθείησαν σφόδρα διὰ τάχους.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] All mine enemies shall be put to shame and sore troubled: They shall turn back, they shall be put to shame suddenly.
					\item[NIV] All my enemies will be overwhelmed with shame and anguish; they will turn back and suddenly be put to shame.
					\item[NRSV] All my enemies shall be ashamed and struck with terror; they shall turn back, and in a moment be put to shame.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 7} % *PSALMS-7
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-7}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 7:1} % *PSALMS-7-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-7-1}

			O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֥ר לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־דִּבְרֵי־כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן־יְמִינִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε ὁ θεός μου, ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισα· σῶσόν με ἐκ πάντων τῶν διωκόντων με καὶ ῥῦσαί με,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto Jehovah, concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite. O Jehovah my God, in thee do I take refuge: Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me,
					\item[NIV] A shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning Cush, a Benjamite. LORD my God, I take refuge in you; save and deliver me from all who pursue me,
					\item[NRSV] O LORD my God, in you I take refuge; save me from all my pursuers, and deliver me,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 7:2} % *PSALMS-7-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-7-2}

			Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי מִכָּל־רֹ֝דְפַ֗י וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μή ποτε ἁρπάσῃ ὡς λέων τὴν ψυχήν μου, μὴ ὄντος λυτρουμένου μηδὲ σώζοντος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Lest they tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
					\item[NIV] or they will tear me apart like a lion and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
					\item[NRSV] or like a lion they will tear me apart; they will drag me away, with no one to rescue.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 7:3} % *PSALMS-7-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-7-3}

			O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{פֶּן־יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε ὁ θεός μου, εἰ ἐποίησα τοῦτο, εἰ ἔστιν ἀδικία ἐν χερσίν μου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰ ἀνταπέδωκα τοῖς ἀνταποδιδοῦσίν μοι κακά, ἀποπέσοιμι ἄρα ἀπὸ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου κενός·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καταδιώξαι ἄρα ὁ ἐχθρὸς τὴν ψυχήν μου καὶ καταλάβοι, καὶ καταπατήσαι εἰς γῆν τὴν ζωήν μου, καὶ τὴν δόξαν μου εἰς χοῦν κατασκηνώσαι. διάψαλμα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνάστηθι, Κύριε, ἐν ὀργῇ σου, ὑψώθητι ἐν τοῖς πέρασι τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου· ἐξεγέρθητι, Κύριε ὁ θεός μου, ἐν προστάγματι ᾧ ἐνετείλω.}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 8} % *PSALMS-8
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-8}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 8:1} % *PSALMS-8-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-8-1}

			O LORD, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־הַגִּתִּ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν, ὡς θαυμαστὸν τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ· ὅτι ἐπήρθη ἡ μεγαλοπρεπία σου ὑπεράνω τῶν οὐρανῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth, Who hast set thy glory upon the heavens!
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. According to gittith. A psalm of David. LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory in the heavens.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, our Sovereign, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 8:2} % *PSALMS-8-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-8-2}

			Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָֽה־אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ עַל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκ στόματος νηπίων καὶ θηλαζόντων κατηρτίσω αἶνον ἕνεκα τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου, τοῦ καταλῦσαι ἐχθρὸν καὶ ἐκδικητήν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou established strength, Because of thine adversaries, That thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
					\item[NIV] Through the praise of children and infants you have established a stronghold against your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger.
					\item[NRSV] Out of the mouths of babes and infants you have founded a bulwark because of your foes, to silence the enemy and the avenger.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 8:3} % *PSALMS-8-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-8-3}

			When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִפִּ֤י עֽוֹלְלִ֨ים ׀ וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ὄψομαι τοὺς οὐρανούς, ἔργα τῶν δακτύλων σου, σελήνην καὶ ἀστέρας ἃ σὺ ἐθεμελίωσας·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
					\item[NIV] When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,
					\item[NRSV] When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars that you have established;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---

					Compare \hyperref[HEBREWS-2-6]{Hebrews 2:6--8}.

			What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος, ὅτι µιµνῄσκῃ αὐτοῦ, ἢ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου, ὅτι ἐπισκέπτῃ αὐτόν;}
					% \item[BSV]
					% \item[AB ]
					\item[NETS] What is man that you are mindful of him or son of man that you attend to him?
					% \item[OTR1]
					% \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?
					\item[NIV] what is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
					\item[NRSV] what are human beings that you are mindful of them, mortals that you care for them?

					% \item[OTXX*]
					% \item[OTXXX*]

					% \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% \item[OTXXXXXX*]

			For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מָֽה־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ וּבֶן־אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἠλάττωσας αὐτὸν βραχύ τι παρ’ ἀγέλους, δόξῃ καὶ τιµῇ ἐστεφάνωσας αὐτόν·}
					% \item[BSV]
					% \item[AB ]
					\item[NETS] You diminished him a little in comparison with angels; with glory and honor you crowned him.
					% \item[OTR1]
					% \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou hast made him but little lower than God, And crownest him with glory and honor.
					\item[NIV] You have made them a little lower than the angels and crowned them with glory and honor.
					\item[NRSV] Yet you have made them a little lower than God, and crowned them with glory and honor.

					% \item[OTXXX*]

					% \item[OTXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ κατέστησας αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου, πάντα ὑπέταξας ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ,}
					% \item[BSV]
					% \item[AB ]

					% \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] You made them rulers over the works of your hands; you put everything under their feet:

	\subsubsection{Psalms 9} % *PSALMS-9
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-9}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 9:1} % *PSALMS-9-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-9-1}

			I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַלְמ֥וּת לַבֵּ֗ן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἐξομολογήσομαι σοι, Κύριε, ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου, διηγήσομαι πάντα τὰ θαυμάσιά σου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to Muth-labben. A Psalm of David. I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart; I will show forth all thy marvellous works.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A psalm of David. I will give thanks to you, LORD, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.
					\item[NRSV] I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 9:2} % *PSALMS-9-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-9-2}

			I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־לִבִּ֑י אֲ֝סַפְּרָ֗ה כָּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐφρανθήσομαι καὶ ἀγαλλιάσομαι ἐν σοί, ψαλῶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου, Ὕψιστε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will be glad and exult in thee; I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High.
					\item[NIV] I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing the praises of your name, O Most High.
					\item[NRSV] I will be glad and exult in you; I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 9:3} % *PSALMS-9-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-9-3}

			When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֶשְׂמְחָ֣ה וְאֶעֶלְצָ֣ה בָ֑ךְ אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῷ ἀποστραφῆναι τὸν ἐχθρὸν μου εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω, ἀσθενήσουσιν καὶ ἀπολοῦνται ἀπὸ προσώπου σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] When mine enemies turn back, They stumble and perish at thy presence.
					\item[NIV] My enemies turn back; they stumble and perish before you.
					\item[NRSV] When my enemies turned back, they stumbled and perished before you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 9:4} % *PSALMS-9-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-9-4}

			For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּשׁוּב־אוֹיְבַ֥י אָח֑וֹר יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ וְ֝יֹאבְד֗וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐποίησας τὴν κρίσιν μου καὶ τὴν δίκην μου, ἐκάθισας ἐπὶ θρόνου, ὁ κρίνων δικαιοσύνην.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sittest in the throne judging righteously.
					\item[NIV] For you have upheld my right and my cause, sitting enthroned as the righteous judge.
					\item[NRSV] For you have maintained my just cause; you have sat on the throne giving righteous judgment.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 9:5} % *PSALMS-9-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-9-5}

			Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־עָ֭שִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י וְדִינִ֑י יָשַׁ֥בְתָּ לְ֝כִסֵּ֗א שׁוֹפֵ֥ט צֶֽדֶק׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπετίμησας ἔθνεσιν, καὶ ἀπώλετο ὁ ἀσεβής· τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ἐξήλειψας εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.
					\item[NIV] You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.
					\item[NRSV] You have rebuked the nations, you have destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name forever and ever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 9:6} % *PSALMS-9-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-9-6}

			O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גָּעַ֣רְתָּ ג֭וֹיִם אִבַּ֣דְתָּ רָשָׁ֑ע שְׁמָ֥ם מָ֝חִ֗יתָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῦ ἐχθροῦ ἐξέλιπον αἱ ῥομφαῖαι εἰς τέλος, καὶ πόλεις καθεῖλες· ἀπώλετο τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῶν μετ᾽ ἠχοῦς·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The enemy are come to an end, they are desolate for ever; And the cities which thou hast overthrown, The very remembrance of them is perished.
					\item[NIV] Endless ruin has overtaken my enemies, you have uprooted their cities; even the memory of them has perished.
					\item[NRSV] The enemies have vanished in everlasting ruins; their cities you have rooted out; the very memory of them has perished.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 9:7} % *PSALMS-9-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-9-7}

			But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הָֽאוֹיֵ֨ב ׀ תַּ֥מּוּ חֳרָב֗וֹת לָ֫נֶ֥צַח וְעָרִ֥ים נָתַ֑שְׁתָּ אָבַ֖ד זִכְרָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ὁ κύριος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα μένει· ἡτοίμασεν ἐν κρίσει τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 10} % *PSALMS-10
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-10}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 10:1} % *PSALMS-10-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-1}

			Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּרָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἵνα τί, Κύριε, ἀφέστηκας μακρόθεν; ὑπερορᾷς ἐν εὐκαιρίαις ἐν θλίψει;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Why standest thou afar off, O Jehovah? Why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
					\item[NIV] Why, LORD, do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
					\item[NRSV] Why, O LORD, do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 10:2} % *PSALMS-10-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-2}

			The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּגַאֲוַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע יִדְלַ֣ק עָנִ֑י יִתָּפְשׂ֓וּ ׀ בִּמְזִמּ֖וֹת ז֣וּ חָשָֽׁבוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῷ ὑπερηφανεύεσθαι τὸν ἀσεβῆ ἐνπυρίζεται ὁ πτωχός· συνλαμβάνονται ἐν διαβουλίοις οἷς διαλογίζονται.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] In the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued; Let them be taken in the devices that they have conceived.
					\item[NIV] In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak, who are caught in the schemes he devises.
					\item[NRSV] In arrogance the wicked persecute the poor— let them be caught in the schemes they have devised.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 10:3} % *PSALMS-10-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-3}

			For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־הִלֵּ֣ל רָ֭שָׁע עַל־תַּאֲוַ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֹצֵ֥עַ בֵּ֝רֵ֗ךְ נִ֘אֵ֥ץ ׀ יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐπαινεῖται ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς ἐν ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὁ ἀδικῶν ἐνευλογεῖται.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, And the covetous renounceth, yea, contemneth Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] He boasts about the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] For the wicked boast of the desires of their heart, those greedy for gain curse and renounce the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 10:4} % *PSALMS-10-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-4}

			The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רָשָׁ֗ע כְּגֹ֣בַהּ אַ֭פּוֹ בַּל־יִדְרֹ֑שׁ אֵ֥ין אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים כָּל־מְזִמּוֹתָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{παρώξυνεν τὸν Κύριον ὁ ἁμαρτωλός, κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐκζητήσει· οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ θεὸς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The wicked, in the pride of his countenance, saith, He will not require it. All his thoughts are, There is no God.
					\item[NIV] In his pride the wicked man does not seek him; in all his thoughts there is no room for God.
					\item[NRSV] In the pride of their countenance the wicked say, “God will not seek it out”; all their thoughts are, “There is no God.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 10:5} % *PSALMS-10-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-5}

			His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָ֘חִ֤ילוּ דְרָכָ֨יו ׀ בְּכָל־עֵ֗ת מָר֣וֹם מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּ֑וֹ כָּל־צ֝וֹרְרָ֗יו יָפִ֥יחַ בָּהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{βεβηλοῦνται αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ· ἀνταναιρεῖται τὰ κρίματά σου ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ, πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ κατακυριεύσει.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] His ways are firm at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight: As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.
					\item[NIV] His ways are always prosperous; your laws are rejected by him; he sneers at all his enemies.
					\item[NRSV] Their ways prosper at all times; your judgments are on high, out of their sight; as for their foes, they scoff at them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 10:6} % *PSALMS-10-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-6}

			He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ בַּל־אֶמּ֑וֹט לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־בְרָֽע׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἶπεν γὰρ ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ Οὐ μὴ σαλευθῶ ἀπὸ γενεᾶς εἰς γενεὰν ἄνευ κακοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; To all generations I shall not be in adversity.
					\item[NIV] He says to himself, “Nothing will ever shake me.” He swears, “No one will ever do me harm.”
					\item[NRSV] They think in their heart, “We shall not be moved; throughout all generations we shall not meet adversity.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 10:7} % *PSALMS-10-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-7}

			His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָלָ֤ה פִּ֣יהוּ מָ֭לֵא וּמִרְמ֣וֹת וָתֹ֑ךְ תַּ֥חַת לְ֝שׁוֹנ֗וֹ עָמָ֥ל וָאָֽוֶן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὗ ἀρᾶς τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ γέμει καὶ πικρίας καὶ δόλου, ὑπὸ τὴν γλῶσσαν αὐτοῦ κόπος καὶ πόνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression: Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
					\item[NIV] His mouth is full of lies and threats; trouble and evil are under his tongue.
					\item[NRSV] Their mouths are filled with cursing and deceit and oppression; under their tongues are mischief and iniquity.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 10:8} % *PSALMS-10-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-8}

			He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יֵשֵׁ֤ב ׀ בְּמַאְרַ֬ב חֲצֵרִ֗ים בַּֽ֭מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗יו לְֽחֵלְכָ֥ה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐνκάθηται ἐνέδρᾳ μετὰ πλουσίων ἐν ἀποκρύφοις ἀποκτεῖναι ἀθῷον· οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν πένητα ἀποβλέπουσιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In the secret places doth he murder the innocent; His eyes are privily set against the helpless.
					\item[NIV] He lies in wait near the villages; from ambush he murders the innocent. His eyes watch in secret for his victims;
					\item[NRSV] They sit in ambush in the villages; in hiding places they murder the innocent. Their eyes stealthily watch for the helpless;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 10:9} % *PSALMS-10-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-9}

			He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יֶאֱרֹ֬ב בַּמִּסְתָּ֨ר ׀ כְּאַרְיֵ֬ה בְסֻכֹּ֗ה יֶ֭אֱרֹב לַחֲט֣וֹף עָנִ֑י יַחְטֹ֥ף עָ֝נִ֗י בְּמָשְׁכ֥וֹ בְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐνεδρεύει ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ, ὡς λέων ἐν τῇ μάνδρᾳ αὐτοῦ· ἐνεδρεύει τοῦ ἁρπάσαι πτωχόν, ἁρπάσαι πτωχὸν ἐν τῷ ἑλκύσαι αὐτόν· ἐν τῇ παγίδι αὐτοῦ}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He lurketh in secret as a lion in his covert; He lieth in wait to catch the poor: He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him in his net.
					\item[NIV] like a lion in cover he lies in wait. He lies in wait to catch the helpless; he catches the helpless and drags them off in his net.
					\item[NRSV] they lurk in secret like a lion in its covert; they lurk that they may seize the poor; they seize the poor and drag them off in their net.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 10:10} % *PSALMS-10-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-10}

			He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִדְכֶּ֥ה יָשֹׁ֑חַ וְנָפַ֥ל בַּ֝עֲצוּמָ֗יו חֵ֣יל כָּאִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ταπεινώσει αὐτόν· κύψει καὶ πεσεῖται ἐν τῷ αὐτὸν κατακυριεῦσαι τῶν πενήτων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall by his strong ones.
					\item[NIV] His victims are crushed, they collapse; they fall under his strength.
					\item[NRSV] They stoop, they crouch, and the helpless fall by their might.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 10:11} % *PSALMS-10-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-11}

			He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ שָׁ֣כַֽח אֵ֑ל הִסְתִּ֥יר פָּ֝נָ֗יו בַּל־רָאָ֥ה לָנֶֽצַח׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἶπεν γὰρ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ Ἐπιλέλησται ὁ θεός, ἀπέστρεψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν εἰς τέλος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He saith in his heart, God hath forgotten; He hideth his face; he will never see it.
					\item[NIV] He says to himself, “God will never notice; he covers his face and never sees.”
					\item[NRSV] They think in their heart, “God has forgotten, he has hidden his face, he will never see it.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 10:12} % *PSALMS-10-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-12}

			Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֭ל נְשָׂ֣א יָדֶ֑ךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח עֲנָוִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνάστηθι, Κύριε ὁ θεός, ὑψωθήτω ἡ χείρ σου· μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ τῶν πενήτων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Arise, O Jehovah; O God, lift up thy hand: Forget not the poor.
					\item[NIV] Arise, LORD! Lift up your hand, O God. Do not forget the helpless.
					\item[NRSV] Rise up, O LORD; O God, lift up your hand; do not forget the oppressed.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 10:13} % *PSALMS-10-13
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-13}

			Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַל־מֶ֤ה ׀ נִאֵ֖ץ רָשָׁ֥ע ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָמַ֥ר בְּ֝לִבּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִּדְרֹֽשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕνεκεν τίνος παρώξυνεν ὁ ἀσεβὴς τὸν θεόν; εἶπεν γὰρ ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ Οὐ ζητήσει.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God, And say in his heart, Thou wilt not require it?
					\item[NIV] Why does the wicked man revile God? Why does he say to himself, “He won’t call me to account"?
					\item[NRSV] Why do the wicked renounce God, and say in their hearts, “You will not call us to account”?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
