		\paragraph{Psalms 10:14} % *PSALMS-10-14
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-14}

			Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רָאִ֡תָה כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה ׀ עָ֘מָ֤ל וָכַ֨עַס ׀ תַּבִּיט֮ לָתֵ֪ת בְּיָ֫דֶ֥ךָ עָ֭לֶיךָ יַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵלֶ֑כָה יָ֝ת֗וֹם אַתָּ֤ה ׀ הָיִ֬יתָ עוֹזֵֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{βλέπεις, ὅτι σὺ πόνον καὶ θυμὸν κατανοήσεις, τοῦ παραδοῦναι αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖράς σου. σοὶ οὖν ἐνκαταλέλειπται ὁ πτωχός, ὀρφανῷ σὺ ἦσθα βοηθός.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: The helpless committeth himself unto thee; Thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.
					\item[NIV] But you, God, see the trouble of the afflicted; you consider their grief and take it in hand. The victims commit themselves to you; you are the helper of the fatherless.
					\item[NRSV] But you do see! Indeed you note trouble and grief, that you may take it into your hands; the helpless commit themselves to you; you have been the helper of the orphan.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 10:15} % *PSALMS-10-15
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-15}

			Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׁ֭בֹר זְר֣וֹעַ רָשָׁ֑ע וָ֝רָ֗ע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ־רִשְׁע֥וֹ בַל־תִּמְצָֽא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σύντριψον τὸν βραχίονα τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ καὶ πονηροῦ· ζητηθήσεται ἡ ἁμαρτία αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐ μὴ εὑρεθῇ δι᾽ αὐτήν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Break thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
					\item[NIV] Break the arm of the wicked man; call the evildoer to account for his wickedness that would not otherwise be found out.
					\item[NRSV] Break the arm of the wicked and evildoers; seek out their wickedness until you find none.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 10:16} % *PSALMS-10-16
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-10-16}

			The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֣ה מֶ֭לֶךְ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד אָבְד֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם מֵֽאַרְצֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{βασιλεύσει Κύριος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος· ἀπολεῖσθε, ἔθνη, ἐκ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is King for ever and ever: The nations are perished out of his land.
					\item[NIV] The LORD is King for ever and ever; the nations will perish from his land.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is king forever and ever; the nations shall perish from his land.

					\item[LXX] \gr{τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν τῶν πενήτων εἰσήκουσεν Κύριος, τὴν ἑτοιμασίαν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν προσέσχεν τὸ οὖς σου,}

					\item[ASV] Jehovah, thou hast heard the desire of the meek: Thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear;

					\item[NRSV] O LORD, you will hear the desire of the meek; you will strengthen their heart, you will incline your ear
					% % \item[OTX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{κρῖναι ὀρφανῷ καὶ ταπεινῷ, ἵνα μὴ προσθῇ ἔτι μεγαλαυχεῖν ἄνθρωπος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.}
					% % \item[BSV]

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] defending the fatherless and the oppressed, so that mere earthly mortals will never again strike terror.
					\item[NRSV] to do justice for the orphan and the oppressed, so that those from earth may strike terror no more.

	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-11}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 11:1} % *PSALMS-11-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-11-1}

			In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד בַּֽיהוָ֨ה ׀ חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֑י נ֝֗וּדִי הַרְכֶ֥ם צִפּֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Εἰς τὸ τέλος· τῷ Δαυεὶδ ψαλμός. Ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ πέποιθα· πῶς ἐρεῖτε τῇ ψυχῇ μου Μεταναστεύου ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη ὡς στρουθίον;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. In Jehovah do I take refuge: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain;
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain.
					\item[NRSV] In the LORD I take refuge; how can you say to me, “Flee like a bird to the mountains;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 11:2} % *PSALMS-11-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-11-2}

			For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה הָרְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣ם עַל־יֶ֑תֶר לִיר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ־אֹ֝֗פֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἰδοὺ οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἐνέτειναν τόξον, ἡτοίμασαν βέλη εἰς φαρέτραν, τοῦ κατατοξεῦσαι ἐν σκοτομήνῃ τοὺς εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, They make ready their arrow upon the string, That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;
					\item[NIV] For look, the wicked bend their bows; they set their arrows against the strings to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
					\item[NRSV] for look, the wicked bend the bow, they have fitted their arrow to the string, to shoot in the dark at the upright in heart.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-11-3}

			If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֣י הַ֭שָּׁתוֹת יֵֽהָרֵס֑וּן צַ֝דִּ֗יק מַה־פָּעָֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἃ κατηρτίσω καθεῖλον· ὁ δὲ δίκαιος τί ἐποίησεν;}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] If the foundations be destroyed, What can the righteous do?
					\item[NIV] When the foundations are being destroyed, what can the righteous do?”
					\item[NRSV] If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?”

		\paragraph{Psalms 11:4} % *PSALMS-11-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-11-4}

			The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֤ה ׀ בְּֽהֵ֘יכַ֤ל קָדְשׁ֗וֹ יְהוָה֮ בַּשָּׁמַ֪יִם כִּ֫סְא֥וֹ עֵינָ֥יו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥יו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἐν ναῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ. Κύριος, ἐν οὐρανῷ ὁ θρόνος αὐτοῦ. οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν πένητα ἀποβλέπουσιν, τὰ βλέφαρα αὐτοῦ ἐξετάζει τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is in his holy temple; Jehovah, his throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
					\item[NIV] The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD is on his heavenly throne. He observes everyone on earth; his eyes examine them.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD’s throne is in heaven. His eyes behold, his gaze examines humankind.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 11:5} % *PSALMS-11-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-11-5}

			The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָה֮ צַדִּ֪יק יִ֫בְחָ֥ן וְ֭רָשָׁע וְאֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἐξετάζει τὸν δίκαιον καὶ τὸν ἀσεβῆ· ὁ δὲ ἀγαπῶν ἀδικίαν μισεῖ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχήν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah trieth the righteous; But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
					\item[NIV] The LORD examines the righteous, but the wicked, those who love violence, he hates with a passion.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked, and his soul hates the lover of violence.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 11:6} % *PSALMS-11-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-11-6}

			Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַמְטֵ֥ר עַל־רְשָׁעִ֗ים פַּ֫חִ֥ים אֵ֣שׁ וְ֭גָפְרִית וְר֥וּחַ זִלְעָפ֗וֹת מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπιβρέξει ἐπὶ ἁμαρτωλοὺς παγίδας· πῦρ καὶ θεῖον καὶ πνεῦμα καταιγίδος ἡ μερὶς τοῦ ποτηρίου αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] On the wicked he will rain fiery coals and burning sulfur; a scorching wind will be their lot.
					\item[NRSV] On the wicked he will rain coals of fire and sulfur; a scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-11-7}

			For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה צְדָק֣וֹת אָהֵ֑ב יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽימוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι δίκαιος Κύριος καὶ δικαιοσύνας ἠγάπησεν, εὐθύτητα εἶδεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For Jehovah is righteous; He loveth righteousness: The upright shall behold his face.
					\item[NIV] For the LORD is righteous, he loves justice; the upright will see his face.
					\item[NRSV] For the LORD is righteous; he loves righteous deeds; the upright shall behold his face.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 12} % *PSALMS-12
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-12}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 12:1} % *PSALMS-12-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-12-1}

			Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Σῶσόν με, Κύριε· ὅτι ἐκλέλοιπεν ὅσιος, ὅτι ὠλιγώθησαν αἱ ἀλήθειαι ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν ἀνθρώπων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, Jehovah; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. According to sheminith. A psalm of David. Help, LORD, for no one is faithful anymore; those who are loyal have vanished from the human race.
					\item[NRSV] Help, O LORD, for there is no longer anyone who is godly; the faithful have disappeared from humankind.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 12:2} % *PSALMS-12-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-12-2}

			They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוֹשִׁ֣יעָה יְ֭הוָה כִּי־גָמַ֣ר חָסִ֑יד כִּי־פַ֥סּוּ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μάταια ἐλάλησεν ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ, χείλη δόλια ἐν καρδίᾳ καὶ ἐν καρδίᾳ ἐλάλησαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They speak falsehood every one with his neighbor: With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.
					\item[NIV] Everyone lies to their neighbor; they flatter with their lips but harbor deception in their hearts.
					\item[NRSV] They utter lies to each other; with flattering lips and a double heart they speak.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 12:3} % *PSALMS-12-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-12-3}

			The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁ֤וְא ׀ יְֽדַבְּרוּ֮ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת־רֵ֫עֵ֥הוּ שְׂפַ֥ת חֲלָק֑וֹת בְּלֵ֖ב וָלֵ֣ב יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξολεθρεύσαι Κύριος πάντα τὰ χείλη τὰ δόλια καὶ γλῶσσαν μεγαλορήμονα,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh great things;
					\item[NIV] May the LORD silence all flattering lips and every boastful tongue—
					\item[NRSV] May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that makes great boasts,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 12:4} % *PSALMS-12-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-12-4}

			Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַכְרֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל־שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲלָק֑וֹת לָ֝שׁ֗וֹן מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοὺς εἰπόντας Τὴν γλῶσσαν ἡμῶν μεγαλυνοῦμεν, τὰ χείλη ἡμῶν παρ᾽ ἡμῶν ἐστίν· τίς ἡμῶν κύριός ἐστιν;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; Our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
					\item[NIV] those who say, “By our tongues we will prevail; our own lips will defend us—who is lord over us?”
					\item[NRSV] those who say, “With our tongues we will prevail; our lips are our own—who is our master?”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 12:5} % *PSALMS-12-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-12-5}

			For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָֽמְר֨וּ ׀ לִלְשֹׁנֵ֣נוּ נַ֭גְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵ֣ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ מִ֖י אָד֣וֹן לָֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ τῆς ταλαιπωρίας τῶν πτωχῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ στεναγμοῦ τῶν πενήτων νῦν ἀναστήσομαι, λέγει Κύριος· θήσομαι ἐν σωτηρίᾳ, παρησιάσομαι ἐν αὐτῷ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; I will set him in the safety he panteth for.
					\item[NIV] “Because the poor are plundered and the needy groan, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will protect them from those who malign them.”
					\item[NRSV] “Because the poor are despoiled, because the needy groan, I will now rise up,” says the LORD; “I will place them in the safety for which they long.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 12:6} % *PSALMS-12-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-12-6}

			The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִשֹּׁ֥ד עֲנִיִּים֮ מֵאַנְקַ֪ת אֶבְי֫וֹנִ֥ים עַתָּ֣ה אָ֭קוּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ית בְּ֝יֵ֗שַׁע יָפִ֥יחַֽ לֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὰ λόγια Κυρίου λόγια ἁγνά, ἀργύριον πεπυρωμένον, δοκίμιον τῇ γῇ, κεκαθαρισμένον ἑπταπλασίως.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The words of Jehovah are pure words; As silver tried in a furnace on the earth, Purified seven times.
					\item[NIV] And the words of the LORD are flawless, like silver purified in a crucible, like gold refined seven times.
					\item[NRSV] The promises of the LORD are promises that are pure, silver refined in a furnace on the ground, purified seven times.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 12:7} % *PSALMS-12-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-12-7}

			Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אִֽמֲר֣וֹת יְהוָה֮ אֲמָר֪וֹת טְהֹ֫ר֥וֹת כֶּ֣סֶף צָ֭רוּף בַּעֲלִ֣יל לָאָ֑רֶץ מְ֝זֻקָּ֗ק שִׁבְעָתָֽיִם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σύ, Κύριε, φυλάξεις ἡμᾶς, καὶ διατηρήσεις ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah, Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.
					\item[NIV] You, LORD, will keep the needy safe and will protect us forever from the wicked,
					\item[NRSV] You, O LORD, will protect us; you will guard us from this generation forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 12:8} % *PSALMS-12-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-12-8}

			The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַתָּֽה־יְהוָ֥ה תִּשְׁמְרֵ֑ם תִּצְּרֶ֓נּוּ ׀ מִן־הַדּ֖וֹר ז֣וּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κύκλῳ οἱ ἀσεβεῖς περιπατοῦσιν· κατὰ τὸ ὕψος σου ἐπολυώρησας τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.
					\item[NIV] who freely strut about when what is vile is honored by the human race.
					\item[NRSV] On every side the wicked prowl, as vileness is exalted among humankind.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 13} % *PSALMS-13
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-13}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 13:1} % *PSALMS-13-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-13-1}

			How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἕως πότε, Κύριε, ἐπιλήσῃ μου εἰς τέλος; ἕως πότε ἀποστρέψεις τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou forget me for ever? How long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. A psalm of David. How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
					\item[NRSV] How long, O LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 13:2} % *PSALMS-13-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-13-2}

			How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַד־אָ֣נָה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֣נִי נֶ֑צַח עַד־אָ֓נָה ׀ תַּסְתִּ֖יר אֶת־פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕως τίνος θήσομαι βουλὰς ἐν ψυχῇ μου, ὀδύνας ἐν καρδίᾳ μου ἡμέρας; ἕως πότε ὑψωθήσεται ὁ ἐχθρός μου ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart all the day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
					\item[NIV] How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and day after day have sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy triumph over me?
					\item[NRSV] How long must I bear pain in my soul, and have sorrow in my heart all day long? How long shall my enemy be exalted over me?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 13:3} % *PSALMS-13-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-13-3}

			Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַד־אָ֨נָה אָשִׁ֪ית עֵצ֡וֹת בְּנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וֹן בִּלְבָבִ֣י יוֹמָ֑ם עַד־אָ֓נָה ׀ יָר֖וּם אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπίβλεψον, εἰσάκουσόν μου, Κύριε ὁ θεός μου· φώτισον τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς, μή ποτε ὑπνώσω εἰς θάνατον,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Consider and answer me, O Jehovah my God: Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
					\item[NIV] Look on me and answer, LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death,
					\item[NRSV] Consider and answer me, O LORD my God! Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep the sleep of death,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 13:4} % *PSALMS-13-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-13-4}

			Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַבִּ֣יטָֽה עֲ֭נֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י הָאִ֥ירָה עֵ֝ינַ֗י פֶּן־אִישַׁ֥ן הַמָּֽוֶת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μή ποτε εἴπῃ ὁ ἐχθρός μου Ἴσχυσα πρὸς αὐτόν· οἱ θλίβοντές με ἀγαλλιάσονται ἐὰν σαλευθῶ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; Lest mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.
					\item[NIV] and my enemy will say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes will rejoice when I fall.
					\item[NRSV] and my enemy will say, “I have prevailed”; my foes will rejoice because I am shaken.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 13:5} % *PSALMS-13-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-13-5}

			But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{פֶּן־יֹאמַ֣ר אֹיְבִ֣י יְכָלְתִּ֑יו צָרַ֥י יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ כִּ֣י אֶמּֽוֹט׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου ἤλπισα· ἀγαλλιάσεται ἡ καρδία μου ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου· ᾄσω τῷ κυρίῳ τῷ εὐεργετήσαντί με, καὶ ψαλῶ τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου τοῦ ὑψίστου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But I have trusted in thy lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
					\item[NIV] But I trust in your unfailing love; my heart rejoices in your salvation.
					\item[NRSV] But I trusted in your steadfast love; my heart shall rejoice in your salvation.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 13:6} % *PSALMS-13-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-13-6}

			I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ בְּחַסְדְּךָ֣ בָטַחְתִּי֮ יָ֤גֵ֥ל לִבִּ֗י בִּֽישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥ךָ אָשִׁ֥ירָה לַיהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י גָמַ֣ל עָלָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου ἤλπισα· ἀγαλλιάσεται ἡ καρδία μου ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου· ᾄσω τῷ κυρίῳ τῷ εὐεργετήσαντί με, καὶ ψαλῶ τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου τοῦ ὑψίστου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will sing unto Jehovah, Because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
					\item[NIV] I will sing the LORD’s praise, for he has been good to me.
					\item[NRSV] I will sing to the LORD, because he has dealt bountifully with me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 14} % *PSALMS-14
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-14}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 14:1} % *PSALMS-14-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-14-1}

			The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽשְׁחִ֗יתוּ הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עֲלִילָ֗ה אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־טֽוֹב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Εἰς τὸ τέλος· ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ. Εἶπεν ἄφρων ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ Οὐκ ἔστιν θεός. διέφθειραν καὶ ἐβδελύχθησαν ἐν ἐπιτηδεύμασιν, οὐκ ἔστιν ποιῶν χρηστότητα, οὐκ ἔστιν ἕως ἑνός.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works; There is none that doeth good.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.
					\item[NRSV] Fools say in their hearts, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, they do abominable deeds; there is no one who does good.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 14:2} % *PSALMS-14-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-14-2}

			The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל־בְּנֵי־אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ διέκυψεν ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων, τοῦ ἰδεῖν εἰ ἔστιν συνίων ἢ ἐκζητῶν τὸν θεόν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.
					\item[NIV] The LORD looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD looks down from heaven on humankind to see if there are any who are wise, who seek after God.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 14:3} % *PSALMS-14-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-14-3}

			They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַכֹּ֥ל סָר֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־אֶחָֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πάντες ἐξέκλιναν, ἅμα ἠχρεώθησαν, οὐκ ἔστιν ποιῶν χρηστότητα, οὐκ ἔστιν ἕως ἑνός. τάφος ἀνεῳγμένος ὁ λάρυγξ αὐτῶν, ταῖς γλώσσαις αὐτῶν ἐδολιοῦσαν· ἰὸς ἀσπίδων ὑπὸ τὰ χείλη αὐτῶν, ὧν τὸ στόμα ἀρᾶς καὶ πικρίας γέμει· ὀξεῖς οἱ πόδες αὐτῶν ἐκχέαι αἷμα· σύντριμμα καὶ ταλαιπωρία ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν, καὶ ὁδὸν εἰρήνης οὐκ ἔγνωσαν· οὐκ ἔστιν φόβος θεοῦ ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They are all gone aside; they are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
					\item[NIV] All have turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
					\item[NRSV] They have all gone astray, they are all alike perverse; there is no one who does good, no, not one.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 14:4} % *PSALMS-14-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-14-4}

			Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ כָּל־פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐχὶ γνώσονται πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀδικίαν, οἱ κατέσθοντες τὸν λαόν μου βρώσει ἄρτου; τὸν κύριον οὐκ ἐπεκαλέσαντο.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And call not upon Jehovah?
					\item[NIV] Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Have they no knowledge, all the evildoers who eat up my people as they eat bread, and do not call upon the LORD?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 14:5} % *PSALMS-14-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-14-5}

			There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁ֤ם ׀ פָּ֣חֲדוּ פָ֑חַד כִּֽי־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּד֣וֹר צַדִּֽיק׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκεῖ ἐδειλίασαν φόβῳ οὗ οὐκ ἦν φόβος· ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἐν γενεᾷ δικαίᾳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] There were they in great fear; For God is in the generation of the righteous.
					\item[NIV] But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is present in the company of the righteous.
					\item[NRSV] There they shall be in great terror, for God is with the company of the righteous.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 14:6} % *PSALMS-14-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-14-6}

			Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עֲצַת־עָנִ֥י תָבִ֑ישׁוּ כִּ֖י יְהוָ֣ה מַחְסֵֽהוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{βουλὴν πτωχοῦ κατῃσχύνατε, ὅτι Κύριος ἐλπὶς αὐτοῦ ἐστιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Ye put to shame the counsel of the poor, Because Jehovah is his refuge.
					\item[NIV] You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor, but the LORD is their refuge.
					\item[NRSV] You would confound the plans of the poor, but the LORD is their refuge.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 14:7} % *PSALMS-14-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-14-7}

			Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ יְשׁוּעַ֪ת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָֽאֵל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς δώσει ἐκ Σιὼν τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Ἰσραήλ; ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέψαι Κύριον τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀγαλλιάσθω Ἰακὼβ καὶ εὐφρανθήτω Ἰσραήλ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When Jehovah bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
					\item[NIV] Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!
					\item[NRSV] O that deliverance for Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, Jacob will rejoice; Israel will be glad.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 15} % *PSALMS-15
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-15}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 15:1} % *PSALMS-15-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-15-1}

			Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְ֭הֹוָה מִי־יָג֣וּר בְּאָהֳלֶ֑ךָ מִֽי־יִ֝שְׁכֹּ֗ן בְּהַ֣ר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ. Κύριε, τίς παροικήσει ἐν τῷ σκηνώματί σου; καὶ τίς κατασκηνώσει ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ ἁγίῳ σου;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Jehovah, who shall sojourn in thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
					\item[NIV] A psalm of David. LORD, who may dwell in your sacred tent? Who may live on your holy mountain?
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, who may abide in your tent? Who may dwell on your holy hill?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 15:2} % *PSALMS-15-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-15-2}

			He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים וּפֹעֵ֥ל צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֥ר אֱ֝מֶ֗ת בִּלְבָבֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πορευόμενος ἄμωμος καὶ ἐργαζόμενος δικαιοσύνην, λαλῶν ἀλήθειαν ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, And speaketh truth in his heart;
					\item[NIV] The one whose walk is blameless, who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from their heart;
					\item[NRSV] Those who walk blamelessly, and do what is right, and speak the truth from their heart;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 15:3} % *PSALMS-15-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-15-3}

			He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֹֽא־רָגַ֨ל ׀ עַל־לְשֹׁנ֗וֹ לֹא־עָשָׂ֣ה לְרֵעֵ֣הוּ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝חֶרְפָּ֗ה לֹא־נָשָׂ֥א עַל־קְרֹֽבוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὃς οὐκ ἐδόλωσεν ἐν γλώσσῃ αὐτοῦ, οὐδὲ ἐποίησεν τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ κακόν, καὶ ὀνειδισμὸν οὐκ ἔλαβεν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἔγγιστα αὐτοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He that slandereth not with his tongue, Nor doeth evil to his friend, Nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbor;
					\item[NIV] whose tongue utters no slander, who does no wrong to a neighbor, and casts no slur on others;
					\item[NRSV] who do not slander with their tongue, and do no evil to their friends, nor take up a reproach against their neighbors;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 15:4} % *PSALMS-15-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-15-4}

			In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נִבְזֶ֤ה ׀ בְּֽעֵ֘ינָ֤יו נִמְאָ֗ס וְאֶת־יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה יְכַבֵּ֑ד נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְ֝הָרַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יָמִֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξουδένωται ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ πονηρευόμενος, τοὺς δὲ φοβουμένους Κύριον δοξάζει· ὁ ὀμνύων τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἀθετῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] In whose eyes a reprobate is despised, But who honoreth them that fear Jehovah; He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not;
					\item[NIV] who despises a vile person but honors those who fear the LORD; who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and does not change their mind;
					\item[NRSV] in whose eyes the wicked are despised, but who honor those who fear the LORD; who stand by their oath even to their hurt;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 15:5} % *PSALMS-15-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-15-5}

			He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כַּסְפּ֤וֹ ׀ לֹא־נָתַ֣ן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ֮ וְשֹׁ֥חַד עַל־נָקִ֗י לֹ֥א לָ֫קָ֥ח עֹֽשֵׂה־אֵ֑לֶּה לֹ֖א יִמּ֣וֹט לְעוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὸ ἀργύριον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔδωκεν ἐπὶ τόκῳ, καὶ δῶρα ἐπ᾽ ἀθῴοις οὐκ ἔλαβεν· ὁ ποιῶν ταῦτα οὐ σαλευθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He that putteth not out his money to interest, Nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
					\item[NIV] who lends money to the poor without interest; who does not accept a bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.
					\item[NRSV] who do not lend money at interest, and do not take a bribe against the innocent. Those who do these things shall never be moved.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 16} % *PSALMS-16
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-16}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 16:1} % *PSALMS-16-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-1}

			Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִכְתָּ֥ם לְדָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Στηλογραφία τῷ Δαυείδ. Φύλαξόν με, Κύριε, ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Michtam of David. Preserve me, O God; for in thee do I take refuge.
					\item[NIV] A miktam of David. Keep me safe, my God, for in you I take refuge.
					\item[NRSV] Protect me, O God, for in you I take refuge.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 16:2} % *PSALMS-16-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-2}

			O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל־עָלֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἶπα τῷ κυρίῳ Κύριός μου εἶ σύ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O my soul, thou hast said unto Jehovah, Thou art my Lord: I have no good beyond thee.
					\item[NIV] I say to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from you I have no good thing.”
					\item[NRSV] I say to the LORD, “You are my Lord; I have no good apart from you.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 16:3} % *PSALMS-16-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-3}

			But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לִ֭קְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־בָּאָ֣רֶץ הֵ֑מָּה וְ֝אַדִּירֵ֗י כָּל־חֶפְצִי־בָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτοῦ ἐθαυμάστωσεν πάντα τὰ θελήματα αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτοῖς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] As for the saints that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.
					\item[NIV] I say of the holy people who are in the land, “They are the noble ones in whom is all my delight.”
					\item[NRSV] As for the holy ones in the land, they are the noble, in whom is all my delight.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 16:4} % *PSALMS-16-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-4}

			Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל־אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶ֣ם מִדָּ֑ם וּֽבַל־אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת־שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗ם עַל־שְׂפָתָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπληθύνθησαν αἱ ἀσθένειαι αὐτῶν, μετὰ ταῦτα ἐτάχυναν· οὐ μὴ συναγάγω τὰς συναγωγὰς αὐτῶν ἐξ αἱμάτων, οὐδὲ μὴ μνησθῶ τῶν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν διὰ χειλέων μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Their sorrows shall be multiplied that give gifts for another god: Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.
					\item[NIV] Those who run after other gods will suffer more and more. I will not pour out libations of blood to such gods or take up their names on my lips.
					\item[NRSV] Those who choose another god multiply their sorrows; their drink offerings of blood I will not pour out or take their names upon my lips.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 16:5} % *PSALMS-16-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-5}

			The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה מְנָת־חֶלְקִ֥י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἡ μερὶς τῆς κληρονομίας μου καὶ τοῦ ποτηρίου μου· σὺ εἶ ὁ ἀποκαθιστῶν τὴν κληρονομίαν μου ἐμοί.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.
					\item[NIV] LORD, you alone are my portion and my cup; you make my lot secure.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; you hold my lot.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 16:6} % *PSALMS-16-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-6}

			The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ־לִ֭י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף־נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σχοινία ἐπέπεσάν μοι ἐν τοῖς κρατίστοις, καὶ γὰρ ἡ κληρονομία μου κρατίστη μοί ἐστιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.
					\item[NIV] The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; surely I have a delightful inheritance.
					\item[NRSV] The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; I have a goodly heritage.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 16:7} % *PSALMS-16-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-7}

			I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑נִי אַף־לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογήσω τὸν κύριον τὸν συνετίσαντά με· ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἕως νυκτὸς ἐπαίδευσάν με οἱ νεφροί μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will bless Jehovah, who hath given me counsel; Yea, my heart instructeth me in the night seasons.
					\item[NIV] I will praise the LORD, who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.
					\item[NRSV] I bless the LORD who gives me counsel; in the night also my heart instructs me.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 16:8} % *PSALMS-16-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-8}

			I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל־אֶמּֽוֹט׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{προορώμην τὸν κύριον ἐνώπιόν μου διὰ παντός, ὅτι ἐκ δεξιῶν μού ἐστιν, ἵνα μὴ σαλευθῶ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
					\item[NIV] I keep my eyes always on the LORD. With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
					\item[NRSV] I keep the LORD always before me; because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 16:9} % *PSALMS-16-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-9}

			Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לָכֵ֤ן ׀ שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּי וַיָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑י אַף־בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶֽטַח׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{διὰ τοῦτο ηὐφράνθη ἡ καρδία μου καὶ ἠγαλλιάσατο ἡ γλῶσσά μου, ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου κατασκηνώσει ἐπ᾽ ἐλπίδι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth; My flesh also shall dwell in safety.
					\item[NIV] Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure,
					\item[NRSV] Therefore my heart is glad, and my soul rejoices; my body also rests secure.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 16:10} % *PSALMS-16-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-10}

			For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י ׀ לֹא־תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣י לִשְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא־תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְךָ֗ לִרְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐκ ἐνκαταλείψεις τὴν ψυχήν μου εἰς ᾅδην, οὐδὲ δώσεις τὸν ὅσιόν σου ἰδεῖν διαφθοράν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou wilt not leave my soul to Sheol; Neither wilt thou suffer thy holy one to see corruption.
					\item[NIV] because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, nor will you let your faithful one see decay.
					\item[NRSV] For you do not give me up to Sheol, or let your faithful one see the Pit.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 16:11} % *PSALMS-16-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-16-11}

			Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγνώρισάς μοι ὁδοὺς ζωῆς· πληρώσεις με εὐφροσύνης μετὰ τοῦ προσώπου σου· τερπνότητες ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ σου εἰς τέλος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
					\item[NIV] You make known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.
					\item[NRSV] You show me the path of life. In your presence there is fullness of joy; in your right hand are pleasures forevermore.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 17} % *PSALMS-17
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-17}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 17:1} % *PSALMS-17-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-1}

			Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שִׁמְעָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה ׀ צֶ֗דֶק הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה רִנָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה תְפִלָּתִ֑י בְּ֝לֹ֗א שִׂפְתֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Προσευχὴ τοῦ Δαυείδ. Εἰσάκουσον, Κύριε, τῆς δικαιοσύνης μου, πρόσχες τῇ δεήσει μου· ἐνώτισαι τῆς προσευχῆς μου οὐκ ἐν χείλεσιν δολίοις.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Prayer of David. Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
					\item[NIV] A prayer of David. Hear me, LORD, my plea is just; listen to my cry. Hear my prayer— it does not rise from deceitful lips.
					\item[NRSV] Hear a just cause, O LORD; attend to my cry; give ear to my prayer from lips free of deceit.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 17:2} % *PSALMS-17-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-2}

			Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִ֭לְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י יֵצֵ֑א עֵ֝ינֶ֗יךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֥ינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκ προσώπου σου τὸ κρίμα μου ἐξέλθοι, οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἰδέτωσαν εὐθύτητας.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; Let thine eyes look upon equity.
					\item[NIV] Let my vindication come from you; may your eyes see what is right.
					\item[NRSV] From you let my vindication come; let your eyes see the right.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 17:3} % *PSALMS-17-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-3}

			Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בָּ֘חַ֤נְתָּ לִבִּ֨י ׀ פָּ֘קַ֤דְתָּ לַּ֗יְלָה צְרַפְתַּ֥נִי בַל־תִּמְצָ֑א זַ֝מֹּתִ֗י בַּל־יַעֲבָר־פִּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐδοκίμασας τὴν καρδίαν μου, ἐπεσκέψω νυκτός· ἐπύρωσάς με, καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθη ἐν ἐμοὶ ἀδικία.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou hast proved my heart; thou hast visited me in the night; Thou hast tried me, and findest nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
					\item[NIV] Though you probe my heart, though you examine me at night and test me, you will find that I have planned no evil; my mouth has not transgressed.
					\item[NRSV] If you try my heart, if you visit me by night, if you test me, you will find no wickedness in me; my mouth does not transgress.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 17:4} % *PSALMS-17-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-4}

			Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לִפְעֻלּ֣וֹת אָ֭דָם בִּדְבַ֣ר שְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ אֲנִ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אָרְח֥וֹת פָּרִֽיץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅπως ἂν μὴ λαλήσῃ τὸ στόμα μου τὰ ἔργα τῶν ἀνθρώπων, διὰ τοὺς λόγους τῶν χειλέων σου ἐγὼ ἐφύλαξα ὁδοὺς σκληράς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] As for the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the ways of the violent.
					\item[NIV] Though people tried to bribe me, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent through what your lips have commanded.
					\item[NRSV] As for what others do, by the word of your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 17:5} % *PSALMS-17-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-5}

			Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תָּמֹ֣ךְ אֲ֭שֻׁרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶ֑יךָ בַּל־נָמ֥וֹטּוּ פְעָמָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κατάρτισαι τὰ διαβήματά μου ἐν ταῖς τρίβοις σου, ἵνα μὴ σαλευθῇ τὰ διαβήματά μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] My steps have held fast to thy paths, My feet have not slipped.
					\item[NIV] My steps have held to your paths; my feet have not stumbled.
					\item[NRSV] My steps have held fast to your paths; my feet have not slipped.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 17:6} % *PSALMS-17-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-6}

			I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲנִֽי־קְרָאתִ֣יךָ כִֽי־תַעֲנֵ֣נִי אֵ֑ל הַֽט־אָזְנְךָ֥ לִ֝֗י שְׁמַ֣ע אִמְרָתִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ ἐκέκραξα, ὅτι ἐπήκουσάς μου, ὁ θεός· κλῖνον τὸ οὖς σου ἐμοὶ καὶ εἰσάκουσον τῶν ῥημάτων μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
					\item[NIV] I call on you, my God, for you will answer me; turn your ear to me and hear my prayer.
					\item[NRSV] I call upon you, for you will answer me, O God; incline your ear to me, hear my words.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 17:7} % *PSALMS-17-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-7}

			Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַפְלֵ֣ה חֲ֭סָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ חוֹסִ֑ים מִ֝מִּתְקוֹמְמִ֗ים בִּֽימִינֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{θαυμάστωσον τὰ ἐλέη σου, ὁ σώζων τοὺς ἐλπίζοντας ἐπὶ σὲ ἐκ τῶν ἀνθεστηκότων τῇ δεξιᾷ σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Show thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them that take refuge in thee From those that rise up against them.
					\item[NIV] Show me the wonders of your great love, you who save by your right hand those who take refuge in you from their foes.
					\item[NRSV] Wondrously show your steadfast love, O savior of those who seek refuge from their adversaries at your right hand.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 17:8} % *PSALMS-17-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-8}

			Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁ֭מְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁ֣וֹן בַּת־עָ֑יִן בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φύλαξόν με ὡς κόραν ὀφθαλμοῦ. ἐν σκέπῃ τῶν πτερύγων σου σκεπάσεις με}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Keep me as the apple of the eye; Hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
					\item[NIV] Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings
					\item[NRSV] Guard me as the apple of the eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 17:9} % *PSALMS-17-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-9}

			From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִפְּנֵ֣י רְ֭שָׁעִים ז֣וּ שַׁדּ֑וּנִי אֹיְבַ֥י בְּ֝נֶ֗פֶשׁ יַקִּ֥יפוּ עָלָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ προσώπου ἀσεβῶν τῶν ταλαιπωρησάντων με. οἱ ἐχθροί μου τὴν ψυχήν μου περιέσχον,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] From the wicked that oppress me, My deadly enemies, that compass me about.
					\item[NIV] from the wicked who are out to destroy me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.
					\item[NRSV] from the wicked who despoil me, my deadly enemies who surround me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 17:10} % *PSALMS-17-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-10}

			They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חֶלְבָּ֥מוֹ סָּגְר֑וּ פִּ֝֗ימוֹ דִּבְּר֥וּ בְגֵאֽוּת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὸ στέαρ αὐτῶν συνέκλεισαν, τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν ἐλάλησεν ὑπερηφανίαν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They are inclosed in their own fat: With their mouth they speak proudly.
					\item[NIV] They close up their callous hearts, and their mouths speak with arrogance.
					\item[NRSV] They close their hearts to pity; with their mouths they speak arrogantly.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 17:11} % *PSALMS-17-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-11}

			They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַ֭שֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנוּ עֵינֵיהֶ֥ם יָ֝שִׁ֗יתוּ לִנְט֥וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκβάλλοντές με νυνὶ περιεκύκλωσάν με, τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν ἔθεντο ἐκκλῖναι ἐν τῇ γῇ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They have now compassed us in our steps; They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
					\item[NIV] They have tracked me down, they now surround me, with eyes alert, to throw me to the ground.
					\item[NRSV] They track me down; now they surround me; they set their eyes to cast me to the ground.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---

			Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{דִּמְיֹנ֗וֹ כְּ֭אַרְיֵה יִכְס֣וֹף לִטְר֑וֹף וְ֝כִכְפִ֗יר יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὑπέλαβόν με ὡσεὶ λέων ἕτοιμος εἰς θήραν, καὶ ὡσεὶ σκύμνος οἰκῶν ἐν ἀποκρύφοις.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, And as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
					\item[NIV] They are like a lion hungry for prey, like a fierce lion crouching in cover.
					\item[NRSV] They are like a lion eager to tear, like a young lion lurking in ambush.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 17:13} % *PSALMS-17-13
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-13}

			Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{קוּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה קַדְּמָ֣ה פָ֭נָיו הַכְרִיעֵ֑הוּ פַּלְּטָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מֵרָשָׁ֥ע חַרְבֶּֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνάστηθι, Κύριε, πρόφθασον αὐτοὺς καὶ ὑποσκέλισον αὐτούς, ῥῦσαι τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀπὸ ἀσεβοῦς, ῥομφαίαν σου}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Arise, O Jehovah, Confront him, cast him down: Deliver my soul from the wicked by thy sword;
					\item[NIV] Rise up, LORD, confront them, bring them down; with your sword rescue me from the wicked.
					\item[NRSV] Rise up, O LORD, confront them, overthrow them! By your sword deliver my life from the wicked,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 17:14} % *PSALMS-17-14
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-14}

			From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִֽמְתִ֥ים יָדְךָ֨ ׀ יְהוָ֡ה מִֽמְתִ֬ים מֵחֶ֗לֶד חֶלְקָ֥ם בַּֽחַיִּים֮ וּֽצְפוּנְךָ֮ תְּמַלֵּ֪א בִ֫טְנָ֥ם יִשְׂבְּע֥וּ בָנִ֑ים וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ יִ֝תְרָ֗ם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ ἐχθρῶν τῆς χειρός σου· Κύριε ἀπολύων ἀπὸ γῆς, διαμέρισον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ζωῇ αὐτῶν· καὶ τῶν κεκρυμμένων σου ἐπλήσθη ἡ γαστὴρ αὐτῶν, ἐχορτάσθησαν ὑείων καὶ ἀφῆκαν τὰ κατάλοιπα τοῖς νηπίοις αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] From men by thy hand, O Jehovah, From men of the world, whose portion is in this life, And whose belly thou fillest with thy treasure: They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
					\item[NIV] By your hand save me from such people, LORD, from those of this world whose reward is in this life. May what you have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies; may their children gorge themselves on it, and may there be leftovers for their little ones.
					\item[NRSV] from mortals—by your hand, O LORD— from mortals whose portion in life is in this world. May their bellies be filled with what you have stored up for them; may their children have more than enough; may they leave something over to their little ones.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 17:15} % *PSALMS-17-15
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-17-15}

			As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲנִ֗י בְּ֭צֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶ֣ה פָנֶ֑יךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָ֥ה בְ֝הָקִ֗יץ תְּמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ὀφθήσομαι τῷ προσώπῳ σου, χορτασθήσομαι ἐν τῷ ὀφθῆναι τὴν δόξαν σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] As for me, I shall behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with beholding thy form.
					\item[NIV] As for me, I will be vindicated and will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.
					\item[NRSV] As for me, I shall behold your face in righteousness; when I awake I shall be satisfied, beholding your likeness.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 18} % *PSALMS-18

		\label{PSALMS-18}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 18:1} % *PSALMS-18-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-18-1}

			I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ ׀ לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר ׀ לַיהוָ֗ה אֶת־דִּ֭בְרֵי הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּי֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל־יְהוָ֘ה אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ εἶπεν· Ἀγαπήσω σε, Κύριε ἰσχύς μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David the servant of Jehovah, who spake unto Jehovah the words of this song in the day that Jehovah delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: and he said, I love thee, O Jehovah, my strength.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of David the servant of the LORD. He sang to the LORD the words of this song when the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love you, LORD, my strength.
					\item[NRSV] I love you, O LORD, my strength.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

			The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחָמְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος στερέωμά μου καὶ καταφυγή μου καὶ ῥύστης μου· ὁ θεός μου βοηθός, καὶ ἐλπιῶ ἐπ᾽ αὐτόν· ὑπερασπιστής μου καὶ κέρας σωτηρίας, ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my rock, in whom I will take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
					\item[NIV] The LORD is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, my God, my rock in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-18-3}

			I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֤ה ׀ סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן־יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνῶν ἐπικαλέσομαι Κύριον, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου σωθήσομαι.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] I called to the LORD, who is worthy of praise, and I have been saved from my enemies.
					\item[NRSV] I call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised, so I shall be saved from my enemies.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-18-4}

			The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמִן־אֹ֝יְבַ֗י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{περιέσχον με ὠδῖνες θανάτου, καὶ χείμαρροι ἀνομίας ἐξετάραξάν με·}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] The cords of death entangled me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.
					\item[NRSV] The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of perdition assailed me;

			The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲפָפ֥וּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὠδῖνες ᾅδου περιεκύκλωσάν με, προέφθασάν με παγίδες θανάτου.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The cords of Sheol were round about me; The snares of death came upon me.
					\item[NIV] The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.
					\item[NRSV] the cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 18:6} % *PSALMS-18-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-18-6}

			In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαί με ἐπεκαλεσάμην τὸν κύριον, καὶ πρὸς τὸν θεόν μου ἐκέκραξα· ἤκουσεν ἐκ ναοῦ ἁγίου αὐτοῦ φωνῆς μου, καὶ ἡ κραυγή μου ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὰ ὦτα αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] In my distress I called upon Jehovah, And cried unto my God: He heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry before him came into his ears.
					\item[NIV] In my distress I called to the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came before him, into his ears.
					\item[NRSV] In my distress I called upon the LORD; to my God I cried for help. From his temple he heard my voice, and my cry to him reached his ears.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\label{PSALMS-18-7}

			Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בַּצַּר־לִ֤י ׀ אֶֽקְרָ֣א יְהוָה֮ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֪י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו ׀ תָּב֬וֹא בְאָזְנָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐσαλεύθη καὶ ἔντρομος ἐγενήθη ἡ γῆ, καὶ τὰ θεμέλια τῶν ὀρέων ἐταράχθησαν καὶ ἐσαλεύθησαν, ὅτι ὠργίσθη αὐτοῖς ὁ θεός.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations also of the mountains quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.
					\item[NIV] The earth trembled and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains shook; they trembled because he was angry.
					\item[NRSV] Then the earth reeled and rocked; the foundations also of the mountains trembled and quaked, because he was angry.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

					\item[BHS] \he{וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ ׀ הָאָ֗רֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνέβη καπνὸς ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ, καὶ πῦρ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ κατεφλόγισεν, ἄνθρακες ἀνήφθησαν ἀπ᾽ αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.

					\item[NRSV] Smoke went up from his nostrils, and devouring fire from his mouth; glowing coals flamed forth from him.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-18-9}

			He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן ׀ בְּאַפּ֗וֹ וְאֵשׁ־מִפִּ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἔκλινεν οὐρανὸν καὶ κατέβη, καὶ γνόφος ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ῥῦσαί με ἐξ ἀντιλογιῶν λαοῦ, καταστήσεις με εἰς κεφαλὴν ἐθνῶν· λαὸς ὃν οὐκ ἔγνων ἐδούλευσέν μοι,}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 19:1} % *PSALMS-19-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-19-1}

			The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Οἱ οὐρανοὶ διηγοῦνται δόξαν θεοῦ, ποίησιν δὲ χειρῶν αὐτοῦ ἀναγγέλλει τὸ στερέωμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament showeth his handiwork.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. A psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
					\item[NRSV] The heavens are telling the glory of God; and the firmament proclaims his handiwork.

			\label{PSALMS-19-2}

			Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡμέρα τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐρεύγεται ῥῆμα, καὶ νὺξ νυκτὶ ἀναγγέλλει γνῶσιν.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] Day to day pours forth speech, and night to night declares knowledge.

					\item[BHS] \he{י֣וֹם לְ֭יוֹם יַבִּ֣יעַֽ אֹ֑מֶר וְלַ֥יְלָה לְּ֝לַ֗יְלָה יְחַוֶּה־דָּֽעַת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐκ εἰσὶν λαλιαὶ οὐδὲ λόγοι ὧν οὐχὶ ἀκούονται αἱ φωναὶ αὐτῶν·}

					% % \item[NETS]

					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐξῆλθεν ὁ φθόγγος αὐτῶν, καὶ εἰς τὰ πέρατα τῆς οἰκουμένης τὰ ῥήματα αὐτῶν.}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּכָל־הָאָ֨רֶץ ׀ יָ֘צָ֤א קַוָּ֗ם וּבִקְצֵ֣ה תֵ֭בֵל מִלֵּיהֶ֑ם לַ֝שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ שָֽׂם־אֹ֥הֶל בָּהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῷ ἡλίῳ ἔθετο τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ· καὶ αὐτὸς ὡς νυμφίος ἐκπορευόμενος ἐκ παστοῦ αὐτοῦ, ἀγαλλιάσεται ὡς γίγας δραμεῖν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ.}

					\item[NRSV] which comes out like a bridegroom from his wedding canopy, and like a strong man runs its course with joy.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-19-6}

			His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְה֗וּא כְּ֭חָתָן יֹצֵ֣א מֵחֻפָּת֑וֹ יָשִׂ֥ישׂ כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר לָר֥וּץ אֹֽרַח׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπ᾽ ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἡ ἔξοδος αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ κατάντημα αὐτοῦ ἕως ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ· καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὃς ἀποκρυβήσεται τὴν θέρμην αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] His going forth is from the end of the heavens, And his circuit unto the ends of it; And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
					\item[NIV] It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
					\item[NRSV] Its rising is from the end of the heavens, and its circuit to the end of them; and nothing is hid from its heat.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 19:7} % *PSALMS-19-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-19-7}

			The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִקְצֵ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם ׀ מֽוֹצָא֗וֹ וּתְקוּפָת֥וֹ עַל־קְצוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ין נִ֝סְתָּ֗ר מֵֽחַמָּתוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ νόμος τοῦ κυρίου ἄμωμος, ἐπιστρέφων ψυχάς· ἡ μαρτυρία Κυρίου πιστή, σοφίζουσα νήπια.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul: The testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple.
					\item[NIV] The law of the LORD is perfect, refreshing the soul. The statutes of the LORD are trustworthy, making wise the simple.
					\item[NRSV] The law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the decrees of the LORD are sure, making wise the simple;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 19:8} % *PSALMS-19-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-19-8}

			The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תּ֘וֹרַ֤ת יְהוָ֣ה תְּ֭מִימָה מְשִׁ֣יבַת נָ֑פֶשׁ עֵד֥וּת יְהוָ֥ה נֶ֝אֱמָנָ֗ה מַחְכִּ֥ימַת פֶּֽתִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὰ δικαιώματα Κυρίου εὐθεῖα, εὐφραίνοντα καρδίαν· ἡ ἐντολὴ Κυρίου τηλαυγής, φωτίζουσα ὀφθαλμούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes.
					\item[NIV] The precepts of the LORD are right, giving joy to the heart. The commands of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
					\item[NRSV] the precepts of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart; the commandment of the LORD is clear, enlightening the eyes;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
