		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-19-9}

			The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{פִּקּ֘וּדֵ֤י יְהוָ֣ה יְ֭שָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי־לֵ֑ב מִצְוַ֥ת יְהוָ֥ה בָּ֝רָ֗ה מְאִירַ֥ת עֵינָֽיִם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ φόβος Κυρίου ἁγνός, διαμένων εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος· τὰ κρίματα Κυρίου ἀληθινά, δεδικαιωμένα ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever: The ordinances of Jehovah are true, and righteous altogether.
					\item[NIV] The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever. The decrees of the LORD are firm, and all of them are righteous.
					\item[NRSV] the fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the ordinances of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-19-10}

			More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִרְאַ֤ת יְהוָ֨ה ׀ טְהוֹרָה֮ עוֹמֶ֪דֶת לָ֫עַ֥ד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי־יְהוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπιθυμητὰ ὑπὲρ χρυσίον καὶ λίθον τίμιον πολὺν καὶ γλυκύτερα ὑπὲρ μέλι καὶ κηρίον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.
					\item[NIV] They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the honeycomb.
					\item[NRSV] More to be desired are they than gold, even much fine gold; sweeter also than honey, and drippings of the honeycomb.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 19:11} % *PSALMS-19-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-19-11}

			Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽנֶּחֱמָדִ֗ים מִ֭זָּהָב וּמִפַּ֣ז רָ֑ב וּמְתוּקִ֥ים מִ֝דְּבַ֗שׁ וְנֹ֣פֶת צוּפִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ γὰρ ὁ δοῦλός σου φυλάσσει αὐτά· ἐν τῷ φυλάσσειν αὐτὰ ἀνταπόδοσις πολλή.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Moreover by them is thy servant warned: In keeping them there is great reward.
					\item[NIV] By them your servant is warned; in keeping them there is great reward.
					\item[NRSV] Moreover by them is your servant warned; in keeping them there is great reward.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 19:12} % *PSALMS-19-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-19-12}

			Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גַּֽם־עַ֭בְדְּךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְרָ֗ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{παραπτώματα τίς συνήσει; ἐκ τῶν κρυφίων μου καθάρισόν με,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who can discern his errors? Clear thou me from hidden faults.
					\item[NIV] But who can discern their own errors? Forgive my hidden faults.
					\item[NRSV] But who can detect their errors? Clear me from hidden faults.
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-19-13}

			Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׁגִיא֥וֹת מִֽי־יָבִ֑ין מִֽנִּסְתָּר֥וֹת נַקֵּֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἀπὸ ἀλλοτρίων φεῖσαι τοῦ δούλου σου· ἐὰν μή μου κατακυριεύσουσιν, τότε ἄμωμος ἔσομαι καὶ καθαρισθήσομαι ἀπὸ ἁμαρτίας μεγάλης.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; Let them not have dominion over me: Then shall I be upright, And I shall be clear from great transgression.
					\item[NIV] Keep your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless, innocent of great transgression.
					\item[NRSV] Keep back your servant also from the insolent; do not let them have dominion over me. Then I shall be blameless, and innocent of great transgression.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-19-14}

			Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גַּ֤ם מִזֵּדִ֨ים ׀ חֲשֹׂ֬ךְ עַבְדֶּ֗ךָ אַֽל־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִ֣י אָ֣ז אֵיתָ֑ם וְ֝נִקֵּ֗יתִי מִפֶּ֥שַֽׁע רָֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἔσονται εἰς εὐδοκίαν τὰ λόγια τοῦ στόματός μου καὶ ἡ μελέτη τῆς καρδίας μου ἐνώπιόν σου διὰ παντός, Κύριε, βοηθέ μου καὶ λυτρωτά μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.
					\item[NIV] May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight, LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
					\item[NRSV] Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable to you, O LORD, my rock and my redeemer.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

			The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἐπακούσαι σου Κύριος ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεως, ὑπερασπίσαι σου τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ Ἰακώβ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high;
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. A psalm of David. May the LORD answer you when you are in distress; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD answer you in the day of trouble! The name of the God of Jacob protect you!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-20-2}

			Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξαποστείλαι σοι βοήθειαν ἐξ ἁγίου, καὶ ἐκ Σιὼν ἀντιλάβοιτό σου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Send thee help from the sanctuary, And strengthen thee out of Zion;
					\item[NIV] May he send you help from the sanctuary and grant you support from Zion.
					\item[NRSV] May he send you help from the sanctuary, and give you support from Zion.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 20:3} % *PSALMS-20-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-20-3}

			Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִשְׁלַֽח־עֶזְרְךָ֥ מִקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּ֝מִצִּיּ֗וֹן יִסְעָדֶֽךָּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μνησθείη πάσης θυσίας σου, καὶ τὸ ὁλοκαύτωμά σου πιανάτω. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Remember all thy offerings, And accept thy burnt-sacrifice; [Selah.
					\item[NIV] May he remember all your sacrifices and accept your burnt offerings.
					\item[NRSV] May he remember all your offerings, and regard with favor your burnt sacrifices. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 20:4} % *PSALMS-20-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-20-4}

			Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִזְכֹּ֥ר כָּל־מִנְחֹתֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלָתְךָ֖ יְדַשְּׁנֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{δῴη σοι κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν σου, καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν βουλήν σου πληρώσαι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Grant thee thy heart's desire, And fulfil all thy counsel.
					\item[NIV] May he give you the desire of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
					\item[NRSV] May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your plans.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 20:5} % *PSALMS-20-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-20-5}

			We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִֽתֶּן־לְךָ֥ כִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל־עֲצָתְךָ֥ יְמַלֵּֽא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀγαλλιασώμεθα ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου, καὶ ἐν ὀνόματι θεοῦ ἡμῶν μεγαλυνθησόμεθα. πληρώσαι Κύριος πάντα τὰ αἰτήματά σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] We will triumph in thy salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners: Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions.
					\item[NIV] May we shout for joy over your victory and lift up our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your requests.
					\item[NRSV] May we shout for joy over your victory, and in the name of our God set up our banners. May the LORD fulfill all your petitions.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 20:6} % *PSALMS-20-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-20-6}

			Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נְרַנְּנָ֤ה ׀ בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{νῦν ἔγνων ὅτι ἔσωσεν Κύριος τὸν χριστὸν αὐτοῦ· ἐπακούσεται αὐτοῦ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἁγίου αὐτοῦ, ἐν δυναστείαις ἡ σωτηρία τῆς δεξιᾶς αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; He will answer him from his holy heaven With the saving strength of his right hand.
					\item[NIV] Now this I know: The LORD gives victory to his anointed. He answers him from his heavenly sanctuary with the victorious power of his right hand.
					\item[NRSV] Now I know that the LORD will help his anointed; he will answer him from his holy heaven with mighty victories by his right hand.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 20:7} % *PSALMS-20-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-20-7}

			Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ ׀ יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὗτοι ἐν ἅρμασιν καὶ οὗτοι ἐν ἵπποις, ἡμεῖς δὲ ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν μεγαλυνθησόμεθα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of Jehovah our God.
					\item[NIV] Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
					\item[NRSV] Some take pride in chariots, and some in horses, but our pride is in the name of the LORD our God.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 20:8} % *PSALMS-20-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-20-8}

			They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ ׀ בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αὐτοὶ συνεποδίσθησαν καὶ ἔπεσαν, ἡμεῖς δὲ ἀνέστημεν καὶ ἀνωρθώθημεν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They are bowed down and fallen; But we are risen, and stand upright.
					\item[NIV] They are brought to their knees and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
					\item[NRSV] They will collapse and fall, but we shall rise and stand upright.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 20:9} % *PSALMS-20-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-20-9}

			Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, σῶσον τὸν βασιλέα σου, καὶ ἐπάκουσον ἡμῶν ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλεσώμεθά σε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Save, Jehovah: Let the King answer us when we call.
					\item[NIV] LORD, give victory to the king! Answer us when we call!
					\item[NRSV] Give victory to the king, O LORD; answer us when we call.
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 21} % *PSALMS-21
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-21}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 21:1} % *PSALMS-21-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-21-1}

			The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου εὐφρανθήσεται ὁ βασιλεύς, καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου ἀγαλλιάσεται σφόδρα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. The king shall joy in thy strength, O Jehovah; And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. A psalm of David. The king rejoices in your strength, LORD. How great is his joy in the victories you give!
					\item[NRSV] In your strength the king rejoices, O LORD, and in your help how greatly he exults!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 21:2} % *PSALMS-21-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-21-2}

			Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּעָזְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמַח־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ֝בִישׁ֥וּעָתְךָ֗ יָּ֥גֶל מְאֹֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ἔδωκας αὐτῷ, καὶ τὴν δέησιν τῶν χειλέων αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐστέρησας αὐτόν. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou hast given him his heart's desire, And hast not withholden the request of his lips. [Selah
					\item[NIV] You have granted him his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips.
					\item[NRSV] You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 21:3} % *PSALMS-21-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-21-3}

			For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תַּאֲוַ֣ת לִ֭בּוֹ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ וַאֲרֶ֥שֶׁת שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו בַּל־מָנַ֥עְתָּ סֶּֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι προέφθασας αὐτὸν ἐν εὐλογίαις χρηστότητος, ἔθηκας ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ στέφανον ἐκ λίθου τιμίου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou meetest him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.
					\item[NIV] You came to greet him with rich blessings and placed a crown of pure gold on his head.
					\item[NRSV] For you meet him with rich blessings; you set a crown of fine gold on his head.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-21-4}

			He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־תְ֭קַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכ֣וֹת ט֑וֹב תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ עֲטֶ֣רֶת פָּֽז׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ζωὴν ᾐτήσατό σε, καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτῷ, μακρότητα ἡμερῶν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He asked life of thee, thou gavest it him, Even length of days for ever and ever.
					\item[NIV] He asked you for life, and you gave it to him— length of days, for ever and ever.
					\item[NRSV] He asked you for life; you gave it to him— length of days forever and ever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 21:5} % *PSALMS-21-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-21-5}

			His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חַיִּ֤ים ׀ שָׁאַ֣ל מִ֭מְּךָ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ אֹ֥רֶךְ יָ֝מִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μεγάλη ἡ δόξα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου, δόξαν καὶ μεγαλοπρέπειαν ἐπιθήσεις ἐπ᾽ αὐτόν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] His glory is great in thy salvation: Honor and majesty dost thou lay upon him.
					\item[NIV] Through the victories you gave, his glory is great; you have bestowed on him splendor and majesty.
					\item[NRSV] His glory is great through your help; splendor and majesty you bestow on him.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-21-6}

			For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גָּד֣וֹל כְּ֭בוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ ה֥וֹד וְ֝הָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι δώσεις αὐτῷ εὐλογίαν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος, εὐφρανεῖς αὐτὸν ἐν χαρᾷ μετὰ τοῦ προσώπου σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou makest him most blessed for ever: Thou makest him glad with joy in thy presence.
					\item[NIV] Surely you have granted him unending blessings and made him glad with the joy of your presence.
					\item[NRSV] You bestow on him blessings forever; you make him glad with the joy of your presence.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 21:7} % *PSALMS-21-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-21-7}

			For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־תְשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָעַ֑ד תְּחַדֵּ֥הוּ בְ֝שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐλπίζει ἐπὶ Κύριον, καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐλέει τοῦ ὑψίστου οὐ μὴ σαλευθῇ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the king trusteth in Jehovah; And through the lovingkindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.
					\item[NIV] For the king trusts in the LORD; through the unfailing love of the Most High he will not be shaken.
					\item[NRSV] For the king trusts in the LORD, and through the steadfast love of the Most High he shall not be moved.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-21-8}

			Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὑρεθείη ἡ χείρ σου πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου, ἡ δεξιά σου εὕροι πάντας τοὺς μισοῦντάς σε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thy hand will find out all thine enemies; Thy right hand will find out those that hate thee.
					\item[NIV] Your hand will lay hold on all your enemies; your right hand will seize your foes.
					\item[NRSV] Your hand will find out all your enemies; your right hand will find out those who hate you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-21-9}

			Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תִּמְצָ֣א יָ֭דְךָ לְכָל־אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יְ֝מִֽינְךָ תִּמְצָ֥א שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{θήσεις αὐτοὺς ὡς κλίβανον πυρὸς εἰς καιρὸν τοῦ προσώπου σου· Κύριε, ἐν ὀργῇ σου συνταράξεις αὐτούς, καὶ καταφάγεται αὐτοὺς πῦρ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou wilt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger: Jehovah will swallow them up in his wrath, And the fire shall devour them.
					\item[NIV] When you appear for battle, you will burn them up as in a blazing furnace. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath, and his fire will consume them.
					\item[NRSV] You will make them like a fiery furnace when you appear. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath, and fire will consume them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

			Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּשִׁיתֵ֤מוֹ ׀ כְּתַנּ֥וּר אֵשׁ֮ לְעֵ֪ת פָּ֫נֶ֥יךָ יְ֭הוָה בְּאַפּ֣וֹ יְבַלְּעֵ֑ם וְֽתֹאכְלֵ֥ם אֵֽשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν ἀπὸ γῆς ἀπολεῖς, καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν ἀπὸ υἱῶν ἀνθρώπων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Their fruit wilt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.
					\item[NIV] You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from mankind.
					\item[NRSV] You will destroy their offspring from the earth, and their children from among humankind.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

			For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{פִּ֭רְיָמוֹ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּאַבֵּ֑ד וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἔκλιναν εἰς σὲ κακά, διελογίσαντο βουλὴν ἣν οὐ μὴ δύνωνται στῆσαι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For they intended evil against thee; They conceived a device which they are not able to perform.
					\item[NIV] Though they plot evil against you and devise wicked schemes, they cannot succeed.
					\item[NRSV] If they plan evil against you, if they devise mischief, they will not succeed.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---

			Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּי־נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה בַּל־יוּכָֽלוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι θήσεις αὐτοὺς νῶτον, ἐν τοῖς περιλοίποις σου ἑτοιμάσεις τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou wilt make them turn their back; Thou wilt make ready with thy bowstrings against their face.
					\item[NIV] You will make them turn their backs when you aim at them with drawn bow.
					\item[NRSV] For you will put them to flight; you will aim at their faces with your bows.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-21-13}

			Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם בְּ֝מֵֽיתָרֶ֗יךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὑψώθητι, Κύριε, ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου, ᾄσομεν καὶ ψαλοῦμεν τὰς δυναστείας σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Be thou exalted, O Jehovah, in thy strength: So will we sing and praise thy power.
					\item[NIV] Be exalted in your strength, LORD; we will sing and praise your might.
					\item[NRSV] Be exalted, O LORD, in your strength! We will sing and praise your power.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 22} % *PSALMS-22
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-22}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 22:1} % *PSALMS-22-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-1}

			My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־אַיֶּ֥לֶת הַשַּׁ֗חַר מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεός μου, πρόσχες μοι· ἵνα τί ἐγκατέλιπές με; μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς σωτηρίας μου οἱ λόγοι τῶν παραπτωμάτων μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to Aijeleth hash-Shahar. A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? Why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. To the tune of “The Doe of the Morning.” A psalm of David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from my cries of anguish?
					\item[NRSV] My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, from the words of my groaning?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 22:2} % *PSALMS-22-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-2}

			O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֵלִ֣י אֵ֭לִי לָמָ֣ה עֲזַבְתָּ֑נִי רָח֥וֹק מִֽ֝ישׁוּעָתִ֗י דִּבְרֵ֥י שַׁאֲגָתִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεός μου, κεκράξομαι ἡμέρας πρὸς σὲ καὶ οὐκ εἰσακούσῃ, καὶ νυκτός, καὶ οὐκ εἰς ἄνοιαν ἐμοί.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou answerest not; And in the night season, and am not silent.
					\item[NIV] My God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer, by night, but I find no rest.
					\item[NRSV] O my God, I cry by day, but you do not answer; and by night, but find no rest.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-3}

			But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י אֶקְרָ֣א י֭וֹמָם וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ֑ה וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה וְֽלֹא־דֽוּמִיָּ֥ה לִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σὺ δὲ ἐν ἁγίοις κατοικεῖς, ὁ ἔπαινος Ἰσραήλ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One; you are the one Israel praises.
					\item[NRSV] Yet you are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-4}

			Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν, ἤλπισαν καὶ ἐρύσω αὐτούς·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Our fathers trusted in thee: They trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
					\item[NIV] In you our ancestors put their trust; they trusted and you delivered them.
					\item[NRSV] In you our ancestors trusted; they trusted, and you delivered them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּ֭ךָ בָּטְח֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בָּ֝טְח֗וּ וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵֽמוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πρὸς σὲ ἐκέκραξαν καὶ ἐσώθησαν, ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισαν καὶ οὐ κατῃσχύνθησαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They cried unto thee, and were delivered: They trusted in thee, and were not put to shame.
					\item[NIV] To you they cried out and were saved; in you they trusted and were not put to shame.
					\item[NRSV] To you they cried, and were saved; in you they trusted, and were not put to shame.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 22:6} % *PSALMS-22-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-6}

			But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֵלֶ֣יךָ זָעֲק֣וּ וְנִמְלָ֑טוּ בְּךָ֖ בָטְח֣וּ וְלֹא־בֽוֹשׁוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δέ εἰμι σκώληξ καὶ οὐκ ἄνθρωπος, ὄνειδος ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἐξουδένημα λαοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised of the people.
					\item[NIV] But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by everyone, despised by the people.
					\item[NRSV] But I am a worm, and not human; scorned by others, and despised by the people.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{πάντες οἱ θεωροῦντές με ἐξεμυκτήρισάν με, ἐλάλησαν ἐν χείλεσιν, ἐκίνησαν κεφαλήν}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] All who see me mock at me; they make mouths at me, they shake their heads;

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-8}

			He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כָּל־רֹ֭אַי יַלְעִ֣גוּ לִ֑י יַפְטִ֥ירוּ בְ֝שָׂפָ֗ה יָנִ֥יעוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἤλπισεν ἐπὶ κύριον, ῥυσάσθω αὐτόν· σωσάτω αὐτόν, ὅτι θέλει αὐτόν,}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] “He trusts in the LORD,” they say, “let the LORD rescue him. Let him deliver him, since he delights in him.”
					\item[NRSV] “Commit your cause to the LORD; let him deliver— let him rescue the one in whom he delights!”

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-9}

			But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ יַ֝צִּילֵ֗הוּ כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ἐκσπάσας με ἐκ γαστρός, ἡ ἐλπίς μου ἀπὸ μαστῶν τῆς μητρός μου·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Yet you brought me out of the womb; you made me trust in you, even at my mother’s breast.
					\item[NRSV] Yet it was you who took me from the womb; you kept me safe on my mother’s breast.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-10}

			I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה גֹחִ֣י מִבָּ֑טֶן מַ֝בְטִיחִ֗י עַל־שְׁדֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπὶ σὲ ἐπερίφην ἐκ μήτρας, ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου θεός μου εἶ σύ· μὴ ἀποστῇς ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ, ὅτι θλίψις ἐγγύς,}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] From birth I was cast on you; from my mother’s womb you have been my God.
					\item[NRSV] On you I was cast from my birth, and since my mother bore me you have been my God.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 22:11} % *PSALMS-22-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-11}

			Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עָ֭לֶיךָ הָשְׁלַ֣כְתִּי מֵרָ֑חֶם מִבֶּ֥טֶן אִ֝מִּ֗י אֵ֣לִי אָֽתָּה׃}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 22:12} % *PSALMS-22-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-12}

			Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

			\begin{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-13}

			They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{סְ֭בָבוּנִי פָּרִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים אַבִּירֵ֖י בָשָׁ֣ן כִּתְּרֽוּנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἤνοιξαν ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν, ὡς λέων ὁ ἁρπάζων καὶ ὠρυόμενος.}

		\paragraph{Psalms 22:15} % *PSALMS-22-15
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-15}

			My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כַּמַּ֥יִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי֮ וְהִתְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כָּֽל־עַצְמ֫וֹתָ֥י הָיָ֣ה לִ֭בִּי כַּדּוֹנָ֑ג נָ֝מֵ֗ס בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξηράνθη ὡσεὶ ὄστρακον ἡ ἰσχύς μου, καὶ ἡ γλῶσσά μου κεκόλληται τῷ λάρυγγί μου, καὶ εἰς χοῦν θανάτου κατήγαγές με.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐκ ἐξουδένωσεν οὐδὲ προσώχθισεν τῇ δεήσει τοῦ πτωχοῦ, οὐδὲ ἀπέστρεψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῷ κεκραγέναι με πρὸς αὐτὸν εἰσήκουσέν μου.}

					\item[NRSV] For he did not despise or abhor the affliction of the afflicted; he did not hide his face from me, but heard when I cried to him.

					\item[LXX] \gr{παρὰ σοῦ ὁ ἔπαινός μου ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ μεγάλῃ, τὰς εὐχάς μου ἀποδώσω ἐνώπιον τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτόν.}

		\paragraph{Psalms 22:30} % *PSALMS-22-30
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-30}

			A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָכְל֬וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֨וּ ׀ כָּֽל־דִּשְׁנֵי־אֶ֗רֶץ לְפָנָ֣יו יִ֭כְרְעוּ כָּל־יוֹרְדֵ֣י עָפָ֑ר וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ לֹ֣א חִיָּֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ τὸ σπέρμα μου δουλεύσει αὐτῷ· ἀναγγελήσεται τῷ κυρίῳ γενεὰ ἡ ἐρχομένη,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A seed shall serve him; It shall be told of the Lord unto the next generation.
					\item[NIV] Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord.
					\item[NRSV] Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 22:31} % *PSALMS-22-31
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-22-31}

			They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זֶ֥רַע יַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ יְסֻפַּ֖ר לַֽאדֹנָ֣י לַדּֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἀναγγελοῦσιν τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ λαῷ τῷ τεχθησομένῳ, ὃν ἐποίησεν ὁ κύριος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They shall come and shall declare his righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done it.
					\item[NIV] They will proclaim his righteousness, declaring to a people yet unborn: He has done it!
					\item[NRSV] and proclaim his deliverance to a people yet unborn, saying that he has done it.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 23} % *PSALMS-23
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-23}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 23:1} % *PSALMS-23-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-23-1}

			The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד יְהוָ֥ה רֹ֝עִ֗י לֹ֣א אֶחְסָֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ. Κύριος ποιμαίνει με, καὶ οὐδέν με ὑστερήσει.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.
					\item[NIV] A psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd, I lack nothing.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is my shepherd, I shall not want.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 23:2} % *PSALMS-23-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-23-2}

			He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בִּנְא֣וֹת דֶּ֭שֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵ֑נִי עַל־מֵ֖י מְנֻח֣וֹת יְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰς τόπον χλόης, ἐκεῖ με κατεσκήνωσεν· ἐπὶ ὕδατος ἀναπαύσεως ἐξέθρεψέν με·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.
					\item[NIV] He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters,
					\item[NRSV] He makes me lie down in green pastures; he leads me beside still waters;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 23:3} % *PSALMS-23-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-23-3}

			He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נַפְשִׁ֥י יְשׁוֹבֵ֑ב יַֽנְחֵ֥נִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי־צֶ֝֗דֶק לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐπέστρεψεν. ὡδήγησέν με ἐπὶ τρίβους δικαιοσύνης ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
					\item[NIV] he refreshes my soul. He guides me along the right paths for his name’s sake.
					\item[NRSV] he restores my soul. He leads me in right paths for his name’s sake.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 23:4} % *PSALMS-23-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-23-4}

			Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גַּ֤ם כִּֽי־אֵלֵ֨ךְ בְּגֵ֪יא צַלְמָ֡וֶת לֹא־אִ֘ירָ֤א רָ֗ע כִּי־אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּדִ֑י שִׁבְטְךָ֥ וּ֝מִשְׁעַנְתֶּ֗ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐὰν γὰρ καὶ πορευθῶ ἐν μέσῳ σκιᾶς θανάτου, οὐ φοβηθήσομαι κακά, ὅτι σὺ μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ εἶ· ἡ ῥάβδος σου καὶ ἡ βακτηρία σου, αὐταί με παρεκάλεσαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.
					\item[NIV] Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
					\item[NRSV] Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I fear no evil; for you are with me; your rod and your staff— they comfort me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 23:5} % *PSALMS-23-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-23-5}

			Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תַּעֲרֹ֬ךְ לְפָנַ֨י ׀ שֻׁלְחָ֗ן נֶ֥גֶד צֹרְרָ֑י דִּשַּׁ֖נְתָּ בַשֶּׁ֥מֶן רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י כּוֹסִ֥י רְוָיָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡτοίμασας ἐνώπιόν μου τράπεζαν ἐξ ἐναντίας τῶν θλιβόντων με· ἐλίπανας ἐν ἐλαίῳ τὴν κεφαλήν μου, καὶ τὸ ποτήριόν σου μεθύσκον ὡς κράτιστον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.
					\item[NIV] You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
					\item[NRSV] You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; you anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 23:6} % *PSALMS-23-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-23-6}

			Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַ֤ךְ ׀ ט֤וֹב וָחֶ֣סֶד יִ֭רְדְּפוּנִי כָּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְּבֵית־יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ τὸ ἔλεός σου καταδιώξεταί με πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς μου, καὶ τὸ κατοικεῖν με ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου εἰς μακρότητα ἡμερῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.
					\item[NIV] Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
					\item[NRSV] Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life, and I shall dwell in the house of the LORD my whole life long.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 24} % *PSALMS-24
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-24}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 24:1} % *PSALMS-24-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-24-1}

			The earth is the LORD's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר לַֽ֭יהוָה הָאָ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֑הּ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ· τῆς μιᾶς σαββάτων. Τοῦ κυρίου ἡ γῆ καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς, ἡ οἰκουμένη καὶ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. The earth is Jehovah's, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.
					\item[NIV] Of David. A psalm. The earth is the LORD’s, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it;
					\item[NRSV] The earth is the LORD’s and all that is in it, the world, and those who live in it;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 24:2} % *PSALMS-24-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-24-2}

			For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּי־ה֭וּא עַל־יַמִּ֣ים יְסָדָ֑הּ וְעַל־נְ֝הָר֗וֹת יְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αὐτὸς ἐπὶ θαλασσῶν ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτήν, καὶ ἐπὶ ποταμῶν ἡτοίμασεν αὐτήν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For he hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.
					\item[NIV] for he founded it on the seas and established it on the waters.
					\item[NRSV] for he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the rivers.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 24:3} % *PSALMS-24-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-24-3}

			Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִֽי־יַעֲלֶ֥ה בְהַר־יְהוָ֑ה וּמִי־יָ֝קוּם בִּמְק֥וֹם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς ἀναβήσεται εἰς τὸ ὄρος τοῦ κυρίου, καὶ τίς στήσεται ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who shall ascend into the hill of Jehovah? And who shall stand in his holy place?
					\item[NIV] Who may ascend the mountain of the LORD? Who may stand in his holy place?
					\item[NRSV] Who shall ascend the hill of the LORD? And who shall stand in his holy place?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 24:4} % *PSALMS-24-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-24-4}

			He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר־לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ לֹא־נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀθῷος χερσὶν καὶ καθαρὸς τῇ καρδίᾳ, ὃς οὐκ ἔλαβεν ἐπὶ ματαίῳ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ὤμοσεν ἐπὶ δόλῳ τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lifted up his soul unto falsehood, And hath not sworn deceitfully.
					\item[NIV] The one who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not trust in an idol or swear by a false god.
					\item[NRSV] Those who have clean hands and pure hearts, who do not lift up their souls to what is false, and do not swear deceitfully.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 24:5} % *PSALMS-24-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-24-5}

			He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὗτος λήμψεται εὐλογίαν παρὰ Κυρίου, καὶ ἐλεημοσύνην παρὰ θεοῦ σωτῆρος αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He shall receive a blessing from Jehovah, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.
					\item[NIV] They will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from God their Savior.
					\item[NRSV] They will receive blessing from the LORD, and vindication from the God of their salvation.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 24:6} % *PSALMS-24-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-24-6}

			This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זֶ֭ה דּ֣וֹר דֹּרְשָׁ֑יו מְבַקְשֵׁ֨י פָנֶ֖יךָ יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αὕτη ἡ γενεὰ ζητούντων αὐτόν, ζητούντων τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ θεοῦ Ἰακώβ. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] This is the generation of them that seek after him, That seek thy face, even Jacob. [Selah
					\item[NIV] Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek your face, God of Jacob.
					\item[NRSV] Such is the company of those who seek him, who seek the face of the God of Jacob. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 24:7} % *PSALMS-24-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-24-7}

			Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים ׀ רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭הִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָב֗וֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄρατε πύλας, οἱ ἄρχοντες ὑμῶν, καὶ ἐπάρθητε, πύλαι αἰώνιοι, καὶ εἰσελεύσεται ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					\item[NRSV] Lift up your heads, O gates! and be lifted up, O ancient doors! that the King of glory may come in.

		\paragraph{Psalms 24:8} % *PSALMS-24-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-24-8}

			Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִ֥י זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְ֭הוָה עִזּ֣וּז וְגִבּ֑וֹר יְ֝הוָ֗ה גִּבּ֥וֹר מִלְחָמָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης; Κύριος κραταιὸς καὶ δυνατός, Κύριος δυνατὸς ἐν πολέμῳ.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
					\item[NRSV] Who is the King of glory? The LORD, strong and mighty, the LORD, mighty in battle.
					% % \item[OTX*]

			Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים ׀ רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וּ֭שְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָבֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄρατε πύλας, οἱ ἄρχοντες ὑμῶν, καὶ ἐπάρθητε, πύλαι αἰώνιοι, καὶ εἰσελεύσεται ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης.}
					% % \item[BSV]

					\item[NIV] Lift up your heads, you gates; lift them up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.
					\item[NRSV] Lift up your heads, O gates! and be lifted up, O ancient doors! that the King of glory may come in.
					% % \item[OTX*]

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης; Κύριος τῶν δυνάμεων, αὐτός ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης.}

					\item[NIV] Who is he, this King of glory? The LORD Almighty— he is the King of glory.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 25} % *PSALMS-25
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-25}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 25:1} % *PSALMS-25-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-1}

			Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ. Πρὸς σέ, Κύριε, ἦρα τὴν ψυχήν μου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Unto thee, O Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.
					\item[NIV] Of David. In you, LORD my God, I put my trust.
					\item[NRSV] To you, O LORD, I lift up my soul.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 25:2} % *PSALMS-25-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-2}

			O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל־יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεός μου· ἐπὶ σοὶ πέποιθα· μὴ καταισχυνθείην, μηδὲ καταγελασάτωσάν μου οἱ ἐχθροί μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O my God, in thee have I trusted, Let me not be put to shame; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.
					\item[NIV] I trust in you; do not let me be put to shame, nor let my enemies triumph over me.
					\item[NRSV] O my God, in you I trust; do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 25:3} % *PSALMS-25-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-3}

			Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גַּ֣ם כָּל־קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ γὰρ πάντες οἱ ὑπομένοντές σε οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῶσιν· αἰσχυνθήτωσαν οἱ ἀνομοῦντες διὰ κενῆς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Yea, none that wait for thee shall be put to shame: They shall be put to shame that deal treacherously without cause.
					\item[NIV] No one who hopes in you will ever be put to shame, but shame will come on those who are treacherous without cause.
					\item[NRSV] Do not let those who wait for you be put to shame; let them be ashamed who are wantonly treacherous.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 25:4} % *PSALMS-25-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-4}

			Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὰς ὁδούς σου, Κύριε, γνώρισόν μοι, καὶ τὰς τρίβους σου δίδαξόν με·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths.
					\item[NIV] Show me your ways, LORD, teach me your paths.
					\item[NRSV] Make me to know your ways, O LORD; teach me your paths.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 25:5} % *PSALMS-25-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-5}

			Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ ׀ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁδήγησόν με ἐπὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου καὶ δίδαξόν με, ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ θεὸς ὁ σωτήρ μου, καὶ σὲ ὑπέμεινα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.
					\item[NIV] Guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and my hope is in you all day long.
					\item[NRSV] Lead me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation; for you I wait all day long.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 25:6} % *PSALMS-25-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-6}

			Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μνήσθητι τῶν οἰκτειρμῶν σου, καὶ τὰ ἐλέη σου, ὅτι ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνός εἰσιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Remember, O Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindness; For they have been ever of old.
					\item[NIV] Remember, LORD, your great mercy and love, for they are from of old.
					\item[NRSV] Be mindful of your mercy, O LORD, and of your steadfast love, for they have been from of old.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 25:7} % *PSALMS-25-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-7}

			Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י ׀ וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל־תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכָר־לִי־אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἁμαρτίας νεότητός μου καὶ ἀγνοίας μὴ μνησθῇς· κατὰ τὸ ἔλεός σου μνήσθητί μου ἕνεκα τῆς χρηστότητός σου, Κύριε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy lovingkindness remember thou me, For thy goodness' sake, O Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Do not remember the sins of my youth and my rebellious ways; according to your love remember me, for you, LORD, are good.
					\item[NRSV] Do not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions; according to your steadfast love remember me, for your goodness’ sake, O LORD!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 25:8} % *PSALMS-25-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-8}

			Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{טוֹב־וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{χρηστὸς καὶ εὐθὴς ὁ κύριος· διὰ τοῦτο νομοθετήσει ἁμαρτάνοντας ἐν ὁδῷ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Good and upright is Jehovah: Therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.
					\item[NIV] Good and upright is the LORD; therefore he instructs sinners in his ways.
					\item[NRSV] Good and upright is the LORD; therefore he instructs sinners in the way.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 25:9} % *PSALMS-25-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-9}

			The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁδηγήσει πρᾳεῖς ἐν κρίσει, διδάξει πρᾳεῖς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The meek will he guide in justice; And the meek will he teach his way.
					\item[NIV] He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them his way.
					\item[NRSV] He leads the humble in what is right, and teaches the humble his way.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 25:10} % *PSALMS-25-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-10}

			All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כָּל־אָרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πᾶσαι αἱ ὁδοὶ Κυρίου ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθεια τοῖς ἐκζητοῦσιν τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] All the paths of Jehovah are lovingkindness and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
					\item[NIV] All the ways of the LORD are loving and faithful toward those who keep the demands of his covenant.
					\item[NRSV] All the paths of the LORD are steadfast love and faithfulness, for those who keep his covenant and his decrees.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 25:11} % *PSALMS-25-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-11}

			For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕνεκα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου, Κύριε, καὶ ἱλάσῃ τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ μου· πολλὴ γάρ ἐστιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thy name's sake, O Jehovah, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.
					\item[NIV] For the sake of your name, LORD, forgive my iniquity, though it is great.
					\item[NRSV] For your name’s sake, O LORD, pardon my guilt, for it is great.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 25:12} % *PSALMS-25-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-25-12}

			What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִי־זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὁ φοβούμενος τὸν κύριον; νομοθετήσει αὐτῷ ἐν ὁδῷ ᾗ ᾑρετίσατο·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 26} % *PSALMS-26
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-26}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 26:1} % *PSALMS-26-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-26-1}

			Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־אֲ֭נִי בְּתֻמִּ֣י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּבַיהוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τοῦ Δαυείδ. Κρῖνόν με, Κύριε, ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν ἀκακίᾳ μου ἐπορεύθην, καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ ἐλπίζων οὐ μὴ σαλευθῶ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in Jehovah without wavering.
					\item[NIV] Of David. Vindicate me, LORD, for I have led a blameless life; I have trusted in the LORD and have not faltered.
					\item[NRSV] Vindicate me, O LORD, for I have walked in my integrity, and I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

			\label{PSALMS-26-2}

			Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּחָנֵ֣נִי יְהוָ֣ה וְנַסֵּ֑נִי צָרְפָ֖ה כִלְיוֹתַ֣י וְלִבִּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{δοκίμασόν με, Κύριε, καὶ πείρασόν με, πύρωσον τοὺς νεφρούς μου καὶ τὴν καρδίαν μου.}

					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] Test me, LORD, and try me, examine my heart and my mind;
					\item[NRSV] Prove me, O LORD, and try me; test my heart and mind.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι τὸ ἔλεός σου κατέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μού ἐστιν, καὶ εὐηρέστησα ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου.}

		\paragraph{Psalms 26:7} % *PSALMS-26-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-26-7}

			That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַ֭שְׁמִעַ בְּק֣וֹל תּוֹדָ֑ה וּ֝לְסַפֵּ֗ר כָּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῦ ἀκοῦσαι φωνὴν αἰνέσεως, καὶ διηγήσασθαι πάντα τὰ θαυμάσιά σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, And tell of all thy wondrous works.
					\item[NIV] proclaiming aloud your praise and telling of all your wonderful deeds.
					\item[NRSV] singing aloud a song of thanksgiving, and telling all your wondrous deeds.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 26:8} % *PSALMS-26-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-26-8}

			LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה אָ֭הַבְתִּי מְע֣וֹן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מְק֗וֹם מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, ἠγάπησα εὐπρεπίαν οἴκου σου καὶ τόπον σκηνώματος δόξης σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah, I love the habitation of thy house, And the place where thy glory dwelleth.
					\item[NIV] LORD, I love the house where you live, the place where your glory dwells.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, I love the house in which you dwell, and the place where your glory abides.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 26:9} % *PSALMS-26-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-26-9}

			Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַל־תֶּאֱסֹ֣ף עִם־חַטָּאִ֣ים נַפְשִׁ֑י וְעִם־אַנְשֵׁ֖י דָמִ֣ים חַיָּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ συναπολέσῃς μετὰ ἀσεβῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου, καὶ μετὰ ἀνδρῶν αἱμάτων τὴν ζωήν μου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with men of blood;
					\item[NIV] Do not take away my soul along with sinners, my life with those who are bloodthirsty,
					\item[NRSV] Do not sweep me away with sinners, nor my life with the bloodthirsty,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-26-10}

			In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲשֶׁר־בִּידֵיהֶ֥ם זִמָּ֑ה וִֽ֝ימִינָ֗ם מָ֣לְאָה שֹּֽׁחַד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὧν ἐν χερσὶν ἀνομίαι, ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτῶν ἐπλήσθη δώρων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] In whose hands is wickedness, And their right hand is full of bribes.
					\item[NIV] in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.
					\item[NRSV] those in whose hands are evil devices, and whose right hands are full of bribes.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 26:11} % *PSALMS-26-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-26-11}

			But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַ֭אֲנִי בְּתֻמִּ֥י אֵלֵ֗ךְ פְּדֵ֣נִי וְחָנֵּֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν ἀκακίᾳ μου ἐπορεύθην· λύτρωσαί με καὶ ἐλέησόν με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] I lead a blameless life; deliver me and be merciful to me.
					\item[NRSV] But as for me, I walk in my integrity; redeem me, and be gracious to me.

			My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רַ֭גְלִי עָֽמְדָ֣ה בְמִישׁ֑וֹר בְּ֝מַקְהֵלִ֗ים אֲבָרֵ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ γὰρ πούς μου ἔστη ἐν εὐθύτητι· ἐν ἐκκλησίαις εὐλογήσω σε, Κύριε.}

					\item[NIV] My feet stand on level ground; in the great congregation I will praise the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] My foot stands on level ground; in the great congregation I will bless the LORD.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
