	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 27} % *PSALMS-27
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-27}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:1} % *PSALMS-27-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-1}

			The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ יְהוָ֤ה ׀ אוֹרִ֣י וְ֭יִשְׁעִי מִמִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהוָ֥ה מָֽעוֹז־חַ֝יַּ֗י מִמִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τοῦ Δαυείδ, πρὸ τοῦ χρισθῆναι. Κύριος φωτισμός μου καὶ σωτήρ μου, τίνα φοβηθήσομαι; Κύριος ὑπερασπιστὴς τῆς ζωῆς μου, ἀπὸ τίνος δειλιάσω;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Jehovah is my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?
					\item[NIV] Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— of whom shall I be afraid?
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:2} % *PSALMS-27-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-2}

			When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בִּקְרֹ֤ב עָלַ֨י ׀ מְרֵעִים֮ לֶאֱכֹ֪ל אֶת־בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥י צָרַ֣י וְאֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י הֵ֖מָּה כָשְׁל֣וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῷ ἐγγίζειν ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ κακοῦντας τοῦ φαγεῖν τὰς σάρκας μου, οἱ θλίβοντές με καὶ οἱ ἐχθροί μου αὐτοὶ ἠσθένησαν καὶ ἔπεσαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] When evil-doers came upon me to eat up my flesh, Even mine adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
					\item[NIV] When the wicked advance against me to devour me, it is my enemies and my foes who will stumble and fall.
					\item[NRSV] When evildoers assail me to devour my flesh— my adversaries and foes— they shall stumble and fall.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:3} % *PSALMS-27-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-3}

			Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אִם־תַּחֲנֶ֬ה עָלַ֨י ׀ מַחֲנֶה֮ לֹֽא־יִירָ֪א לִ֫בִּ֥י אִם־תָּק֣וּם עָ֭לַי מִלְחָמָ֑ה בְּ֝זֹ֗את אֲנִ֣י בוֹטֵֽחַ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐὰν παρατάξηται ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ παρεμβολή, οὐ φοβηθήσεται ἡ καρδία μου· ἐὰν ἐπαναστῇ ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ πόλεμος, ἐν ταύτῃ ἐγὼ ἐλπίζω.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Though a host should encamp against me, My heart shall not fear: Though war should rise against me, Even then will I be confident.
					\item[NIV] Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then I will be confident.
					\item[NRSV] Though an army encamp against me, my heart shall not fear; though war rise up against me, yet I will be confident.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:4} % *PSALMS-27-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-4}

			One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַחַ֤ת ׀ שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵֽאֵת־יְהוָה֮ אוֹתָ֪הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣י בְּבֵית־יְ֭הוָה כָּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑י לַחֲז֥וֹת בְּנֹֽעַם־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וּלְבַקֵּ֥ר בְּהֵיכָלֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μίαν ᾐτησάμην παρὰ Κυρίου, ταύτην ἐκζητήσω· τοῦ κατοικεῖν με ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς μου, τοῦ θεωρεῖν με τὴν τερπνότητα τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἐπισκέπτεσθαι τὸν ναὸν αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] One thing have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after: That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of Jehovah, And to inquire in his temple.
					\item[NIV] One thing I ask from the LORD, this only do I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and to seek him in his temple.
					\item[NRSV] One thing I asked of the LORD, that will I seek after: to live in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:5} % *PSALMS-27-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-5}

			For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י יִצְפְּנֵ֨נִי ׀ בְּסֻכֹּה֮ בְּי֪וֹם רָ֫עָ֥ה יַ֭סְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵ֣תֶר אָהֳל֑וֹ בְּ֝צ֗וּר יְרוֹמְמֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἔκρυψέν με ἐν σκηνῇ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κακῶν μου· ἐσκέπασέν με ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ τῆς σκηνῆς αὐτοῦ, ἐν πέτρᾳ ὕψωσέν με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For in the day of trouble he will keep me secretly in his pavilion: In the covert of his tabernacle will he hide me; He will lift me up upon a rock.
					\item[NIV] For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his sacred tent and set me high upon a rock.
					\item[NRSV] For he will hide me in his shelter in the day of trouble; he will conceal me under the cover of his tent; he will set me high on a rock.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:6} % *PSALMS-27-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-6}

			And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְעַתָּ֨ה יָר֪וּם רֹאשִׁ֡י עַ֤ל אֹֽיְבַ֬י סְֽבִיבוֹתַ֗י וְאֶזְבְּחָ֣ה בְ֭אָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה לַיהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ὕψωσεν τὴν κεφαλήν μου ἐπ᾽ ἐχθρούς μου· ἐκύκλωσα καὶ ἔθυσα ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ αὐτοῦ θυσίαν ἀλαλαγμοῦ, ᾄσομαι καὶ ψαλῶ τῷ κυρίῳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me; And I will offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Then my head will be exalted above the enemies who surround me; at his sacred tent I will sacrifice with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Now my head is lifted up above my enemies all around me, and I will offer in his tent sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make melody to the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:7} % *PSALMS-27-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-7}

			Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׁמַע־יְהוָ֖ה קוֹלִ֥י אֶקְרָ֗א וְחָנֵּ֥נִי וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰσάκουσον, Κύριε, τῆς φωνῆς μου ἧς ἐκέκραξα· ἐλέησόν με καὶ εἰσάκουσόν μου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Hear, O Jehovah, when I cry with my voice: Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
					\item[NIV] Hear my voice when I call, LORD; be merciful to me and answer me.
					\item[NRSV] Hear, O LORD, when I cry aloud, be gracious to me and answer me!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:8} % *PSALMS-27-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-8}

			When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְךָ֤ ׀ אָמַ֣ר לִ֭בִּי בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י אֶת־פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σοὶ εἶπεν ἡ καρδία μου. ἐξεζήτησα τὸ πρόσωπόν σου· τὸ πρόσωπόν σου, Κύριε, ζητήσω.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Jehovah, will I seek.
					\item[NIV] My heart says of you, “Seek his face!” Your face, LORD, I will seek.
					\item[NRSV] “Come,” my heart says, “seek his face!” Your face, LORD, do I seek.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:9} % *PSALMS-27-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-9}

			Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ ׀ מִמֶּנִּי֮ אַֽל־תַּט־בְּאַ֗ף עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ עֶזְרָתִ֥י הָיִ֑יתָ אַֽל־תִּטְּשֵׁ֥נִי וְאַל־תַּֽ֝עַזְבֵ֗נִי אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ, μὴ ἐκκλίνῃς ἐν ὀργῇ ἀπὸ τοῦ δούλου σου· βοηθός μου γενοῦ, μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με καὶ μὴ ὑπερίδῃς με, ὁ θεὸς ὁ σωτήρ μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Hide not thy face from me; Put not thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; Cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
					\item[NIV] Do not hide your face from me, do not turn your servant away in anger; you have been my helper. Do not reject me or forsake me, God my Savior.
					\item[NRSV] Do not hide your face from me. Do not turn your servant away in anger, you who have been my help. Do not cast me off, do not forsake me, O God of my salvation!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:10} % *PSALMS-27-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-10}

			When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּי־אָבִ֣י וְאִמִּ֣י עֲזָב֑וּנִי וַֽיהוָ֣ה יַֽאַסְפֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ὁ πατήρ μου καὶ ἡ μήτηρ μου ἐγκατέλιπόν με, ὁ δὲ κύριος προσελάβετό με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] When my father and my mother forsake me, Then Jehovah will take me up.
					\item[NIV] Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
					\item[NRSV] If my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will take me up.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:11} % *PSALMS-27-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-11}

			Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{ה֤וֹרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה דַּ֫רְכֶּ֥ךָ וּ֭נְחֵנִי בְּאֹ֣רַח מִישׁ֑וֹר לְ֝מַ֗עַן שׁוֹרְרָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{νομοθέτησόν με, Κύριε, τῇ ὁδῷ σου, καὶ ὁδήγησόν με ἐν τρίβῳ εὐθείᾳ ἕνεκα τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; And lead me in a plain path, Because of mine enemies.
					\item[NIV] Teach me your way, LORD; lead me in a straight path because of my oppressors.
					\item[NRSV] Teach me your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path because of my enemies.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:12} % *PSALMS-27-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-12}

			Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַֽל־תִּ֭תְּנֵנִי בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ צָרָ֑י כִּ֥י קָֽמוּ־בִ֥י עֵֽדֵי־שֶׁ֝֗קֶר וִיפֵ֥חַ חָמָֽס׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ παραδῷς με εἰς ψυχὰς θλιβόντων με, ὅτι ἐπανέστησάν μοι μάρτυρες ἄδικοι, καὶ ἐψεύσατο ἡ ἀδικία ἑαυτῇ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Deliver me not over unto the will of mine adversaries: For false witnesses are risen up against me, And such as breathe out cruelty.
					\item[NIV] Do not turn me over to the desire of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, spouting malicious accusations.
					\item[NRSV] Do not give me up to the will of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen against me, and they are breathing out violence.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:13} % *PSALMS-27-13
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-13}

			I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לׅׄוּלֵׅׄ֗אׅׄ הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי לִרְא֥וֹת בְּֽטוּב־יְהוָ֗ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πιστεύσω τοῦ ἰδεῖν τὰ ἀγαθὰ Κυρίου ἐν γῇ ζώντων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah In the land of the living.
					\item[NIV] I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
					\item[NRSV] I believe that I shall see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 27:14} % *PSALMS-27-14
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-27-14}

			Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל־יְה֫וָ֥ה חֲ֭זַק וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὑπόμεινον τὸν κύριον· ἀνδρίζου, καὶ κραταιούσθω ἡ καρδία σου, καὶ ὑπόμεινον τὸν κύριον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Wait for Jehovah: Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Wait for the LORD; be strong and take heart and wait for the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Wait for the LORD; be strong, and let your heart take courage; wait for the LORD!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 28} % *PSALMS-28
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-28}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 28:1} % *PSALMS-28-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-28-1}

			Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְדָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤יךָ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ אֶקְרָ֗א צוּרִי֮ אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַ֪שׁ מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי פֶּן־תֶּֽחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τοῦ Δαυείδ. Πρὸς σέ, Κύριε, ἐκέκραξα, ὁ θεός μου, μὴ παρασιωπήσῃς ἐπ᾽ ἑμοί· μή ποτε παρασιωπήσῃς ἐπ᾽ ἐμοὶ καὶ ὁμοιωθήσομαι τοῖς καταβαίνουσιν εἰς λάκκον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I call: My rock, be not thou deaf unto me; Lest, if thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
					\item[NIV] Of David. To you, LORD, I call; you are my Rock, do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if you remain silent, I will be like those who go down to the pit.
					\item[NRSV] To you, O LORD, I call; my rock, do not refuse to hear me, for if you are silent to me, I shall be like those who go down to the Pit.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 28:2} % *PSALMS-28-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-28-2}

			Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל תַּ֭חֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ בְּנָשְׂאִ֥י יָ֝דַ֗י אֶל־דְּבִ֥יר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰσάκουσον τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου ἐν τῷ δέεσθαί με πρὸς σέ, ἐν τῷ με αἴρειν χεῖράς μου εἰς ναὸν ἅγιόν σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
					\item[NIV] Hear my cry for mercy as I call to you for help, as I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
					\item[NRSV] Hear the voice of my supplication, as I cry to you for help, as I lift up my hands toward your most holy sanctuary.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 28:3} % *PSALMS-28-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-28-3}

			Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַל־תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣נִי עִם־רְשָׁעִים֮ וְעִם־פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לוֹם עִם־רֵֽעֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝רָעָ֗ה בִּלְבָבָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ συνελκύσῃς μετὰ ἁμαρτωλῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου, καὶ μετὰ ἐργαζομένων ἀδικίαν μὴ συναπολέσῃς με, τῶν λαλούντων εἰρήνην μετὰ τῶν πλησίον αὐτῶν, κακὰ δὲ ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Draw me not away with the wicked, And with the workers of iniquity; That speak peace with their neighbors, But mischief is in their hearts.
					\item[NIV] Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil, who speak cordially with their neighbors but harbor malice in their hearts.
					\item[NRSV] Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who are workers of evil, who speak peace with their neighbors, while mischief is in their hearts.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 28:4} % *PSALMS-28-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-28-4}

			Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תֶּן־לָהֶ֣ם כְּפָעֳלָם֮ וּכְרֹ֪עַ מַֽעַלְלֵ֫יהֶ֥ם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְ֭דֵיהֶם תֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֖ב גְּמוּלָ֣ם לָהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{δὸς αὐτοῖς κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν καὶ κατὰ τὴν πονηρίαν τῶν ἐπιτηδευμάτων αὐτῶν· κατὰ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν δὸς αὐτοῖς, ἀπόδος τὸ ἀνταπόδομα αὐτῶν αὐτοῖς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings: Give them after the operation of their hands; Render to them their desert.
					\item[NIV] Repay them for their deeds and for their evil work; repay them for what their hands have done and bring back on them what they deserve.
					\item[NRSV] Repay them according to their work, and according to the evil of their deeds; repay them according to the work of their hands; render them their due reward.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 28:5} % *PSALMS-28-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-28-5}

			Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י לֹ֤א יָבִ֡ינוּ אֶל־פְּעֻלֹּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה וְאֶל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑יו יֶ֝הֶרְסֵ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐ συνῆκαν εἰς τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου καὶ εἰς τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτοῦ, καθελεῖς αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐ μὴ οἰκοδομήσεις αὐτούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Because they regard not the works of Jehovah, Nor the operation of his hands, He will break them down and not build them up.
					\item[NIV] Because they have no regard for the deeds of the LORD and what his hands have done, he will tear them down and never build them up again.
					\item[NRSV] Because they do not regard the works of the LORD, or the work of his hands, he will break them down and build them up no more.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 28:6} % *PSALMS-28-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-28-6}

			Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּי־שָׁ֝מַע ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογητὸς Κύριος, ὅτι εἰσήκουσεν τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Blessed be Jehovah, Because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
					\item[NIV] Praise be to the LORD, for he has heard my cry for mercy.
					\item[NRSV] Blessed be the LORD, for he has heard the sound of my pleadings.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 28:7} % *PSALMS-28-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-28-7}

			The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֤ה ׀ עֻזִּ֥י וּמָגִנִּי֮ בּ֤וֹ בָטַ֥ח לִבִּ֗י וְֽנֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑י וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י אֲהוֹדֶֽנּוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος βοηθός μου καὶ ὑπερασπιστής μου· ἐπ᾽ αὐτῷ ἤλπισεν ἡ καρδία μου, καὶ ἐβοηθήθην, καὶ ἀνέθαλεν ἡ σάρξ μου· καὶ ἐκ θελήματός μου ἐξομολογήσομαι αὐτῷ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is my strength and my shield; My heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; And with my song will I praise him.
					\item[NIV] The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is my strength and my shield; in him my heart trusts; so I am helped, and my heart exults, and with my song I give thanks to him.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 28:8} % *PSALMS-28-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-28-8}

			The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֥ה עֹֽז־לָ֑מוֹ וּמָ֘ע֤וֹז יְשׁוּע֖וֹת מְשִׁיח֣וֹ הֽוּא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος κραταίωμα τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς τῶν σωτηρίων τοῦ χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is their strength, And he is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
					\item[NIV] The LORD is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is the strength of his people; he is the saving refuge of his anointed.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 28:9} % *PSALMS-28-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-28-9}

			Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוֹשִׁ֤יעָה ׀ אֶת־עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד־הָעוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σῶσον τὸν λαόν σου καὶ εὐλόγησον τὴν κληρονομίαν σου, καὶ ποίμανον αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔπαρον αὐτοὺς ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: Be their shepherd also, and bear them up for ever.
					\item[NIV] Save your people and bless your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.
					\item[NRSV] O save your people, and bless your heritage; be their shepherd, and carry them forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 29} % *PSALMS-29
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-29}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:1} % *PSALMS-29-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-1}

			Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה בְּנֵ֣י אֵלִ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ· ἐξοδίου σκηνῆς. Ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ, υἱοὶ θεοῦ, ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ υἱοὺς κριῶν· ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν καὶ τιμήν,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Ascribe unto Jehovah, O ye sons of the mighty, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.
					\item[NIV] A psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, you heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
					\item[NRSV] Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:2} % *PSALMS-29-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-2}

			Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ· προσκυνήσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν αὐλῇ ἁγίᾳ αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name; Worship Jehovah in holy array.
					\item[NIV] Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name; worship the LORD in the splendor of his holiness.
					\item[NRSV] Ascribe to the LORD the glory of his name; worship the LORD in holy splendor.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:3} % *PSALMS-29-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-3}

			The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{ק֥וֹל יְהוָ֗ה עַל־הַ֫מָּ֥יִם אֵֽל־הַכָּב֥וֹד הִרְעִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל־מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐπὶ τῶν ὑδάτων, ὁ θεὸς τῆς δόξης ἐβρόντησεν, Κύριος ἐπὶ ὑδάτων πολλῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: The God of glory thundereth, Even Jehovah upon many waters.
					\item[NIV] The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the LORD thunders over the mighty waters.
					\item[NRSV] The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the LORD, over mighty waters.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:4} % *PSALMS-29-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-4}

			The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{קוֹל־יְהוָ֥ה בַּכֹּ֑חַ ק֥וֹל יְ֝הוָ֗ה בֶּהָדָֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐν ἰσχύι, φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐν μεγαλοπρεπίᾳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.
					\item[NIV] The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
					\item[NRSV] The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:5} % *PSALMS-29-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-5}

			The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה שֹׁבֵ֣ר אֲרָזִ֑ים וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֶת־אַרְזֵ֥י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φωνὴ Κυρίου συντρίβοντος κέδρους· συντρίψει Κύριος τὰς κέδρους τοῦ Λιβάνου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The voice of Jehovah breaketh the cedars; Yea, Jehovah breaketh in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
					\item[NIV] The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
					\item[NRSV] The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:6} % *PSALMS-29-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-6}

			He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיַּרְקִידֵ֥ם כְּמוֹ־עֵ֑גֶל לְבָנ֥וֹן וְ֝שִׂרְיֹ֗ן כְּמ֣וֹ בֶן־רְאֵמִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ λεπτυνεῖ αὐτὰς ὡς τὸν μόσχον τὸν Λίβανον· καὶ ὁ ἠγαπημένος ὡς υἱὸς μονοκερώτων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild-ox.
					\item[NIV] He makes Lebanon leap like a calf, Sirion like a young wild ox.
					\item[NRSV] He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:7} % *PSALMS-29-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-7}

			The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{קוֹל־יְהוָ֥ה חֹצֵ֗ב לַהֲב֥וֹת אֵֽשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φωνὴ Κυρίου διακόπτοντος φλόγα πυρός.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The voice of Jehovah cleaveth the flames of fire.
					\item[NIV] The voice of the LORD strikes with flashes of lightning.
					\item[NRSV] The voice of the LORD flashes forth flames of fire.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:8} % *PSALMS-29-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-8}

			The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה יָחִ֣יל מִדְבָּ֑ר יָחִ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִדְבַּ֥ר קָדֵֽשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φωνὴ Κυρίου συνσείοντος ἔρημον, συνσείσει κύριος τὴν ἔρημον Καδής.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
					\item[NIV] The voice of the LORD shakes the desert; the LORD shakes the Desert of Kadesh.
					\item[NRSV] The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:9} % *PSALMS-29-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-9}

			The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{ק֤וֹל יְהוָ֨ה ׀ יְחוֹלֵ֣ל אַיָּלוֹת֮ וַֽיֶּחֱשֹׂ֪ף יְעָ֫ר֥וֹת וּבְהֵיכָל֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ אֹמֵ֥ר כָּבֽוֹד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φωνὴ Κυρίου καταρτιζομένου ἐλάφους, καὶ ἀποκαλύψει δρυμούς· καὶ ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτοῦ πᾶς τις λέγει δόξαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, And strippeth the forests bare: And in his temple everything saith, Glory.
					\item[NIV] The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in his temple all cry, “Glory!”
					\item[NRSV] The voice of the LORD causes the oaks to whirl, and strips the forest bare; and in his temple all say, “Glory!”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:10} % *PSALMS-29-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-10}

			The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְ֭הוָה לַמַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְ֝הוָ֗ה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος τὸν κατακλυσμὸν κατοικιεῖ· καὶ καθιεῖται Κύριος βασιλεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah sat as King at the Flood; Yea, Jehovah sitteth as King for ever.
					\item[NIV] The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD sits enthroned as king forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 29:11} % *PSALMS-29-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-29-11}

			The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה עֹ֭ז לְעַמּ֣וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן יְהוָ֓ה ׀ יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת־עַמּ֣וֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἰσχὺν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ δώσει, Κύριος εὐλογήσει τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν εἰρήνῃ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.
					\item[NIV] The LORD gives strength to his people; the LORD blesses his people with peace.
					\item[NRSV] May the LORD give strength to his people! May the LORD bless his people with peace!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 30} % *PSALMS-30
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-30}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 30:1} % *PSALMS-30-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-30-1}

			I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁיר־חֲנֻכַּ֖ת הַבַּ֣יִת לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὑψώσω σε, Κύριε, ὅτι ὑπέλαβές με, καὶ οὐκ ηὔφρανας τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm; a Song at the Dedication of the House. A Psalm of David. I will extol thee, O Jehovah; for thou hast raised me up, And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
					\item[NIV] A psalm. A song. For the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt you, LORD, for you lifted me out of the depths and did not let my enemies gloat over me.
					\item[NRSV] I will extol you, O LORD, for you have drawn me up, and did not let my foes rejoice over me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 30:2} % *PSALMS-30-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-30-2}

			O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה כִּ֣י דִלִּיתָ֑נִי וְלֹא־שִׂמַּ֖חְתָּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε ὁ θεός μου, ἐκέκραξα πρὸς σὲ καὶ ἰάσω με·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O Jehovah my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
					\item[NIV] LORD my God, I called to you for help, and you healed me.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD my God, I cried to you for help, and you have healed me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 30:3} % *PSALMS-30-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-30-3}

			O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֑י שִׁוַּ֥עְתִּי אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ וַתִּרְפָּאֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, ἀνήγαγες ἐξ ᾅδου τὴν ψυχήν μου, ἔσωσάς με ἀπὸ τῶν καταβαινόντων εἰς λάκκον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] O LORD, you brought up my soul from Sheol, restored me to life from among those gone down to the Pit.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ψάλατε τῷ κυρίῳ, οἱ ὅσιοι αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῇ μνήμῃ τῆς ἁγιωσύνης αὐτοῦ.}

			For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חֲסִידָ֑יו וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ὀργὴ ἐν τῷ θυμῷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ζωὴ ἐν τῷ θελήματι αὐτοῦ· τὸ ἑσπέρας αὐλισθήσεται κλαυθμός, καὶ εἰς τὸ πρωὶ ἀγαλλίασις.}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] For his anger is but for a moment; his favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may linger for the night, but joy comes with the morning.

					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י רֶ֨גַע ׀ בְּאַפּוֹ֮ חַיִּ֪ים בִּרְצ֫וֹנ֥וֹ בָּ֭עֶרֶב יָלִ֥ין בֶּ֗כִי וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר רִנָּֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ εἶπα ἐν τῇ εὐθηνίᾳ μου Οὐ μὴ σαλευθῶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς ὠφελία ἐν τῷ αἵματί μου, ἐν τῷ καταβῆναί με εἰς διαφθοράν; μὴ ἐξομολογήσεταί σοι χοῦς, ἢ ἀναγγελεῖ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου;}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔστρεψας τὸν κοπετόν μου εἰς χαρὰν ἐμοί, διέρρηξας τὸν σάκκον μου καὶ περιέζωσάς με εὐφροσύνην,}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 31} % *PSALMS-31
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-31}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 31:1} % *PSALMS-31-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-1}

			In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἐπὶ σοί, Κύριε, ἤλπισα, μὴ καταισχυνθείην εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ῥῦσαί με καὶ ἐξελοῦ με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge; Let me never be put to shame: Deliver me in thy righteousness.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. A psalm of David. In you, LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in your righteousness.
					\item[NRSV] In you, O LORD, I seek refuge; do not let me ever be put to shame; in your righteousness deliver me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 31:2} % *PSALMS-31-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-2}

			Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל־אֵב֣וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κλῖνον πρὸς μὲ τὸ οὖς σου, τὰχυνον τοῦ ἐξελέσθαι με· γενοῦ μοι εἰς θεὸν ὑπερασπιστήν, καὶ εἰς οἶκον καταφυγῆς τοῦ σῶσαί με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Bow down thine ear unto me; deliver me speedily: Be thou to me a strong rock, A house of defence to save me.
					\item[NIV] Turn your ear to me, come quickly to my rescue; be my rock of refuge, a strong fortress to save me.
					\item[NRSV] Incline your ear to me; rescue me speedily. Be a rock of refuge for me, a strong fortress to save me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 31:3} % *PSALMS-31-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-3}

			For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַטֵּ֤ה אֵלַ֨י ׀ אָזְנְךָ֮ מְהֵרָ֪ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י ׀ לְֽצוּר־מָ֭עוֹז לְבֵ֥ית מְצוּד֗וֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι κραταίωμά μου καὶ καταφυγή μου εἶ σύ, καὶ ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός σου ὁδηγήσεις με καὶ διαθρέψεις με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou art my rock and my fortress; Therefore for thy name's sake lead me and guide me.
					\item[NIV] Since you are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of your name lead and guide me.
					\item[NRSV] You are indeed my rock and my fortress; for your name’s sake lead me and guide me,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 31:4} % *PSALMS-31-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-4}

			Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־סַלְעִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָ֑תָּה וּלְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξάξεις με ἐκ παγίδος ταύτης ἧς ἔκρυψάν μοι, ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ὑπερασπιστής μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Pluck me out of the net that they have laid privily for me; For thou art my stronghold.
					\item[NIV] Keep me free from the trap that is set for me, for you are my refuge.
					\item[NRSV] take me out of the net that is hidden for me, for you are my refuge.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-5}

			Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נִי מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑י כִּֽי־אַ֝תָּה מָֽעוּזִּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰς χεῖράς σου παραθήσομαι τὸ πνεῦμά μου· ἐλυτρώσω με, Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῆς ἀληθείας.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Into thy hand I commend my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Jehovah, thou God of truth.
					\item[NIV] Into your hands I commit my spirit; deliver me, LORD, my faithful God.
					\item[NRSV] Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, O LORD, faithful God.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 31:6} % *PSALMS-31-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-6}

			I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐμίσησας τοὺς φυλάσσοντας ματαιότητας διὰ κενῆς· ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ ἤλπισα.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I hate them that regard lying vanities; But I trust in Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] I hate those who cling to worthless idols; as for me, I trust in the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] You hate those who pay regard to worthless idols, but I trust in the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 31:7} % *PSALMS-31-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-7}

			I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀγαλλιάσομαι καὶ εὐφρανθήσομαι ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου, ὅτι ἐπεῖδες τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου, ἔσωσας ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will be glad and rejoice in thy lovingkindness; For thou hast seen my affliction: Thou hast known my soul in adversities;
					\item[NIV] I will be glad and rejoice in your love, for you saw my affliction and knew the anguish of my soul.
					\item[NRSV] I will exult and rejoice in your steadfast love, because you have seen my affliction; you have taken heed of my adversities,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 31:8} % *PSALMS-31-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-8}

			And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת־עָנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ οὐ συνέκλεισάς με εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθροῦ, ἔστησας ἐν εὐρυχώρῳ τοὺς πόδας μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And thou hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; Thou hast set my feet in a large place.
					\item[NIV] You have not given me into the hands of the enemy but have set my feet in a spacious place.
					\item[NRSV] and have not delivered me into the hand of the enemy; you have set my feet in a broad place.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 31:9} % *PSALMS-31-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-9}

			Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐλέησόν με, Κύριε, ὅτι θλίβομαι· ἐταράχθη ἐν θυμῷ ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου, ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ ἡ γαστήρ μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah, for I am in distress: Mine eye wasteth away with grief, yea, my soul and my body.
					\item[NIV] Be merciful to me, LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes grow weak with sorrow, my soul and body with grief.
					\item[NRSV] Be gracious to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eye wastes away from grief, my soul and body also.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-10}

			For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר־לִ֥י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְכַ֥עַס עֵינִ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י וּבִטְנִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐξέλιπεν ἐν ὀδύνῃ ἡ ζωή μου, καὶ τὰ ἔτη μου ἐν στεναγμοῖς· ἠσθένησεν ἐν πτωχίᾳ ἡ ἰσχύς μου, καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἐταράχθησαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For my life is spent with sorrow, And my years with sighing: My strength faileth because of mine iniquity, And my bones are wasted away.
					\item[NIV] My life is consumed by anguish and my years by groaning; my strength fails because of my affliction, and my bones grow weak.
					\item[NRSV] For my life is spent with sorrow, and my years with sighing; my strength fails because of my misery, and my bones waste away.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-11}

			I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י כָל֪וּ בְיָג֡וֹן חַיַּי֮ וּשְׁנוֹתַ֪י בַּאֲנָ֫חָ֥ה כָּשַׁ֣ל בַּעֲוֺנִ֣י כֹחִ֑י וַעֲצָמַ֥י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{παρὰ πάντας τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἐγενήθην ὄνειδος, καὶ τοῖς γείτοσίν μου σφόδρα, καὶ φόβος τοῖς γνωστοῖς μου· οἱ θεωροῦντές με ἔξω ἔφυγον ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Because of all my enemies, I am the utter contempt of my neighbors and an object of dread to my closest friends— those who see me on the street flee from me.
					\item[NRSV] I am the scorn of all my adversaries, a horror to my neighbors, an object of dread to my acquaintances; those who see me in the street flee from me.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-12}

			I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִכָּל־צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַ֨י ׀ מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֪חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י רֹאַ֥י בַּח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπελήσθην ὡσεὶ νεκρὸς ἀπὸ καρδίας, ἐγενήθην ὡσεὶ σκεῦος ἀπολωλός.}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] I am forgotten as though I were dead; I have become like broken pottery.
					\item[NRSV] I have passed out of mind like one who is dead; I have become like a broken vessel.

			\label{PSALMS-31-13}

			For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּכְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἤκουσα ψόγον πολλῶν παροικούντων κυκλόθεν· ἐν τῷ συναχθῆναι αὐτοὺς ἅμα ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ τοῦ λαβεῖν τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐβουλεύσαντο.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] For I hear many whispering, “Terror on every side!” They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
					\item[NRSV] For I hear the whispering of many— terror all around!— as they scheme together against me, as they plot to take my life.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי ׀ דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֪וֹר מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י זָמָֽמוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ ἐπὶ σὲ ἤλπισα, Κύριε· εἶπα Σὺ εἶ ὁ θεός μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] But I trust in you, LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
					\item[NRSV] But I trust in you, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ עָלֶ֣יךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥י אָֽתָּה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν ταῖς χερσίν σου οἱ κλῆροί μου· ῥῦσαί με ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν μου καὶ ἐκ τῶν καταδιωκόντων με.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] My times are in your hands; deliver me from the hands of my enemies, from those who pursue me.
					\item[NRSV] My times are in your hand; deliver me from the hand of my enemies and persecutors.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-16}

			Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּיָדְךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד־א֝וֹיְבַ֗י וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπίφανον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ τὸν δοῦλόν σου, σῶσόν με ἐν τῷ ἐλέει σου.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: Save me in thy lovingkindness.
					\item[NIV] Let your face shine on your servant; save me in your unfailing love.
					\item[NRSV] Let your face shine upon your servant; save me in your steadfast love.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 31:17} % *PSALMS-31-17
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-17}

			Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הָאִ֣ירָה פָ֭נֶיךָ עַל־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, μὴ καταισχυνθείην, ὅτι ἐπεκαλεσάμην σε· αἰσχυνθείησαν οἱ ἀσεβεῖς καὶ καταχθείησαν εἰς ᾅδου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let me not be put to shame, O Jehovah; for I have called upon thee: Let the wicked be put to shame, let them be silent in Sheol.
					\item[NIV] Let me not be put to shame, LORD, for I have cried out to you; but let the wicked be put to shame and be silent in the realm of the dead.
					\item[NRSV] Do not let me be put to shame, O LORD, for I call on you; let the wicked be put to shame; let them go dumbfounded to Sheol.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

			\label{PSALMS-31-18}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄλαλα γενηθήτωσαν τὰ χείλη τὰ δόλια, τὰ λαλοῦντα κατὰ τοῦ δικαίου ἀνομίαν ἐν ὑπερηφανίᾳ καὶ ἐξουδενώσει.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the lying lips be dumb, Which speak against the righteous insolently, With pride and contempt.
					\item[NIV] Let their lying lips be silenced, for with pride and contempt they speak arrogantly against the righteous.
					\item[NRSV] Let the lying lips be stilled that speak insolently against the righteous with pride and contempt.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-19}

			Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּבְר֖וֹת עַל־צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡς πολὺ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς χρηστότητός σου, Κύριε, ἧς ἔκρυψας τοῖς φοβουμένοις σε· ἐξειργάσω τοῖς ἐλπίζουσιν ἐπὶ σὲ ἐναντίον τῶν υἱῶν τῶν ἀνθρώπων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Oh how great is thy goodness, Which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee, Which thou hast wrought for them that take refuge in thee, Before the sons of men!
					\item[NIV] How abundant are the good things that you have stored up for those who fear you, that you bestow in the sight of all, on those who take refuge in you.
					\item[NRSV] O how abundant is your goodness that you have laid up for those who fear you, and accomplished for those who take refuge in you, in the sight of everyone!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 31:20} % *PSALMS-31-20
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-20}

			Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מָ֤ה רַֽב־טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר־צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κατακρύψεις αὐτοὺς ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ τοῦ προσώπου σου ἀπὸ ταραχῆς ἀνθρώπων· σκεπάσεις αὐτοὺς ἐν σκηνῇ ἀπὸ ἀντιλογίας γλωσσῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] In the covert of thy presence wilt thou hide them from the plottings of man: Thou wilt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
					\item[NIV] In the shelter of your presence you hide them from all human intrigues; you keep them safe in your dwelling from accusing tongues.
					\item[NRSV] In the shelter of your presence you hide them from human plots; you hold them safe under your shelter from contentious tongues.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 31:21} % *PSALMS-31-21
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-21}

			Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם ׀ בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογητὸς Κύριος, ὅτι ἐθαυμάστωσεν τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἐν πόλει περιοχῆς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Blessed be Jehovah; For he hath showed me his marvellous lovingkindness in a strong city.
					\item[NIV] Praise be to the LORD, for he showed me the wonders of his love when I was in a city under siege.
					\item[NRSV] Blessed be the LORD, for he has wondrously shown his steadfast love to me when I was beset as a city under siege.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 31:22} % *PSALMS-31-22
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-22}

			For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא חַסְדּ֥וֹ לִ֝֗י בְּעִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ εἶπα ἐν τῇ ἐκστάσει μου Ἀπέρριμμαι ἄρα ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου· διὰ τοῦτο εἰσήκουσας, Κύριε, τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου ἐν τῷ κεκραγέναι με πρὸς σέ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] As for me, I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: Nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications, When I cried unto thee.
					\item[NIV] In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from your sight!” Yet you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help.
					\item[NRSV] I had said in my alarm, “I am driven far from your sight.” But you heard my supplications when I cried out to you for help.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 31:23} % *PSALMS-31-23
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-23}

			O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֗י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י אֵלֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀγαπήσατε τὸν κύριον, πάντες οἱ ὅσιοι αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἀληθείας ἐκζητεῖ Κύριος, καὶ ἀνταποδίδωσιν τοῖς περισσῶς ποιοῦσιν ὑπερηφανίαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Oh love Jehovah, all ye his saints: Jehovah preserveth the faithful, And plentifully rewardeth him that dealeth proudly.
					\item[NIV] Love the LORD, all his faithful people! The LORD preserves those who are true to him, but the proud he pays back in full.
					\item[NRSV] Love the LORD, all you his saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but abundantly repays the one who acts haughtily.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 31:24} % *PSALMS-31-24
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-31-24}

			Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֶֽהֱב֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל־חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל־יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνδρίζεσθε, καὶ κραταιούσθω ἡ καρδία ὑμῶν, πάντες οἱ ἐλπίζοντες ἐπὶ Κύριον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Be strong, and let your heart take courage, All ye that hope in Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who wait for the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 32:1} % *PSALMS-32-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-32-1}

			Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְדָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י נְֽשׂוּי־פֶּ֗שַׁע כְּס֣וּי חֲטָאָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Συνέσεως τῷ Δαυείδ. Μακάριοι ὧν ἀφέθησαν αἱ ἀνομίαι, καὶ ὧν ἐπεκαλύφθησαν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Maschil. Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.
					\item[NIV] Of David. A maskil. Blessed is the one whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
					\item[NRSV] Happy are those whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 32:2} % *PSALMS-32-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-32-2}

			Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity,%
				\footnote{%
					\label{PSALMS-32-2-imputeth}%
					See \hyperref[ROMANS-4-8]{Romans 4:8}.
					}
			and in whose spirit there is no guile.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהוָ֣ה ל֣וֹ עָוֺ֑ן וְאֵ֖ין בְּרוּח֣וֹ רְמִיָּה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μακάριος ἀνήρ, οὗ οὐ μὴ λογίσηται κύριος ἁμαρτίαν, οὐδὲ ἔστιν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ δόλος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.
					\item[NIV] Blessed is the one whose sin the LORD does not count against them and in whose spirit is no deceit.
					\item[NRSV] Happy are those to whom the LORD imputes no iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 32:3} % *PSALMS-32-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-32-3}

			When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־הֶ֭חֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּל֣וּ עֲצָמָ֑י בְּ֝שַׁאֲגָתִ֗י כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐσίγησα, ἐπαλαιώθη τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἀπὸ τοῦ κράζειν με ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] When I kept silence, my bones wasted away Through my groaning all the day long.
					\item[NIV] When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
					\item[NRSV] While I kept silence, my body wasted away through my groaning all day long.

		\paragraph{Psalms 32:4} % *PSALMS-32-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-32-4}

			For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י ׀ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗י יָ֫דֶ֥ךָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑י בְּחַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς ἐβαρύνθη ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ ἡ χείρ σου, ἐστράφην εἰς ταλαιπωρίαν ἐν τῷ ἐνπαγῆναι ἄκανθαν. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture was changed as with the drought of summer. [Selah
					\item[NIV] For day and night your hand was heavy on me; my strength was sapped as in the heat of summer.
					\item[NRSV] For day and night your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was dried up as by the heat of summer. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 32:5} % *PSALMS-32-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-32-5}

			I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חַטָּאתִ֨י אוֹדִ֪יעֲךָ֡ וַעֲוֺ֘נִ֤י לֹֽא־כִסִּ֗יתִי אָמַ֗רְתִּי אוֹדֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַי לַיהוָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֺ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὴν ἁμαρτίαν μου ἐγνώρισα, καὶ τὴν ἀνομίαν μου οὐκ ἐκάλυψα· εἶπα Ἐξαγορεύσω κατ᾽ ἐμοῦ τὴν ἁμαρτίαν μου τῷ κυρίῳ, καὶ σὺ ἀφῆκας τὴν ἀσέβειαν τῆς καρδίας μου. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I acknowledged my sin unto thee, And mine iniquity did I not hide: I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Jehovah; And thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. [Selah
					\item[NIV] Then I acknowledged my sin to you and did not cover up my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD.” And you forgave the guilt of my sin.
					\item[NRSV] Then I acknowledged my sin to you, and I did not hide my iniquity; I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 32:6} % *PSALMS-32-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-32-6}

			For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַל־זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כָּל־חָסִ֨יד ׀ אֵלֶיךָ֮ לְעֵ֪ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק לְ֭שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὑπὲρ ταύτης προσεύξεται πᾶς ὅσιος πρὸς σὲ ἐν καιρῷ εὐθέτῳ· πλὴν ἐν κατακλυσμῷ ὑδάτων πολλῶν πρὸς αὐτὸν οὐκ ἐγγιοῦσιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For this let every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: Surely when the great waters overflow they shall not reach unto him.
					\item[NIV] Therefore let all the faithful pray to you while you may be found; surely the rising of the mighty waters will not reach them.
					\item[NRSV] Therefore let all who are faithful offer prayer to you; at a time of distress, the rush of mighty waters shall not reach them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 32:7} % *PSALMS-32-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-32-7}

			Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַתָּ֤ה ׀ סֵ֥תֶר לִי֮ מִצַּ֪ר תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥נִי רָנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט תְּס֖וֹבְבֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σύ μου εἶ καταφυγὴ ἀπὸ θλίψεως τῆς περιεχούσης με· τὸ ἀγαλλίαμά μου, λύτρωσαί με ἀπὸ τῶν κυκλωσάντων με. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou art my hiding-place; thou wilt preserve me from trouble; Thou wilt compass me about with songs of deliverance. [Selah
					\item[NIV] You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance.
					\item[NRSV] You are a hiding place for me; you preserve me from trouble; you surround me with glad cries of deliverance. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨ ׀ וְֽאוֹרְךָ֗ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ־ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִֽיעֲצָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יךָ עֵינִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{συνετιῶ σε καὶ συνβιβῶ σε ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ πορεύσῃ, ἐπιστηριῶ ἐπὶ σὲ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee with mine eye upon thee.
					\item[NIV] I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my loving eye on you.
					\item[NRSV] I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will counsel you with my eye upon you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
