					\item[NIV] My soul is downcast within me; therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon—from Mount Mizar.
					\item[NRSV] and my God. My soul is cast down within me; therefore I remember you from the land of Jordan and of Hermon, from Mount Mizar.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-42-7}

			Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י עָלַי֮ נַפְשִׁ֪י תִשְׁתּ֫וֹחָ֥ח עַל־כֵּ֗ן אֶ֭זְכָּרְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יַרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֝חֶרְמוֹנִ֗ים מֵהַ֥ר מִצְעָֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄβυσσος ἄβυσσον ἐπικαλεῖται εἰς φωνὴν τῶν καταρακτῶν σου· πάντες οἱ μετεωρισμοί σου καὶ τὰ κύματά σου ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ διῆλθον.}

					\item[NIV] Deep calls to deep in the roar of your waterfalls; all your waves and breakers have swept over me.
					\item[NRSV] Deep calls to deep at the thunder of your cataracts; all your waves and your billows have gone over me.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-42-8}

			Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּהֽוֹם־אֶל־תְּה֣וֹם ק֭וֹרֵא לְק֣וֹל צִנּוֹרֶ֑יךָ כָּֽל־מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥יךָ וְ֝גַלֶּ֗יךָ עָלַ֥י עָבָֽרוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡμέρας ἐντελεῖται Κύριος τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ, καὶ νυκτὸς δηλώσει· παρ᾽ ἐμοὶ προσευχὴ τῷ θεῷ τῆς ζωῆς μου.}

					\item[NRSV] By day the LORD commands his steadfast love, and at night his song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.

			I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יוֹמָ֤ם ׀ יְצַוֶּ֬ה יְהוָ֨ה ׀ חַסְדּ֗וֹ וּ֭בַלַּיְלָה שִׁיר֣וֹ עִמִּ֑י תְּ֝פִלָּ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל חַיָּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐρῶ τῷ θεῷ Ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ, διὰ τὶ μου ἐπελάθου; ἵνα τὶ σκυθρωπάζων πορεύομαι ἐν τῷ ἐκθλίβειν τὸν ἐχθρόν μου;}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
					\item[NIV] I say to God my Rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?”
					\item[NRSV] I say to God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why must I walk about mournfully because the enemy oppresses me?”

			As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אוֹמְרָ֤ה ׀ לְאֵ֥ל סַלְעִי֮ לָמָ֪ה שְׁכַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה־קֹדֵ֥ר אֵלֵ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῷ καταθλάσαι τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ὠνείδισάν με οἱ θλίβοντές με, ἐν τῷ λέγειν αὐτούς μοι καθ᾽ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεός σου;}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] My bones suffer mortal agony as my foes taunt me, saying to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
					\item[NRSV] As with a deadly wound in my body, my adversaries taunt me, while they say to me continually, “Where is your God?”

			Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּרֶ֤צַח ׀ בְּֽעַצְמוֹתַ֗י חֵרְפ֥וּנִי צוֹרְרָ֑י בְּאָמְרָ֥ם אֵלַ֥י כָּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אַיֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἵνα τί περίλυπος εἶ, ἡ ψυχή, καὶ ἵνα τί συνταράσσεις με; ἔλπισον ἐπὶ τὸν θεόν, ὅτι ἐξομολογήσομαι αὐτῷ· ἡ σωτηρία τοῦ προσώπου μου ὁ θεός μου.}

					\item[NIV] Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
					\item[NRSV] Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; for I shall again praise him, my help and my God.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 43} % *PSALMS-43
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-43}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 43:1} % *PSALMS-43-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-43-1}

			Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים ׀ וְרִ֘יבָ֤ה רִיבִ֗י מִגּ֥וֹי לֹא־חָסִ֑יד מֵ֤אִישׁ־מִרְמָ֖ה וְעַוְלָ֣ה תְפַלְּטֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ. Κρῖνόν με, ὁ θεός, καὶ δίκασον τὴν δίκην μου ἐξ ἔθνους οὐχ ὁσίου· ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἀδίκου καὶ δολίου ῥῦσαί με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
					\item[NIV] Vindicate me, my God, and plead my cause against an unfaithful nation. Rescue me from those who are deceitful and wicked.
					\item[NRSV] Vindicate me, O God, and defend my cause against an ungodly people; from those who are deceitful and unjust deliver me!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 43:2} % *PSALMS-43-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-43-2}

			For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה ׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י מָֽעוּזִּי֮ לָמָ֪ה זְנַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה־קֹדֵ֥ר אֶתְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ θεὸς κραταίωμά μου· ἵνα τί ἀπώσω με; καὶ ἵνα τί σκυθρωπάζων πορεύομαι ἐν τῷ ἐκθλίβειν τὸν ἐχθρόν μου;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou art the God of my strength; why hast thou cast me off? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
					\item[NIV] You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?
					\item[NRSV] For you are the God in whom I take refuge; why have you cast me off? Why must I walk about mournfully because of the oppression of the enemy?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 43:3} % *PSALMS-43-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-43-3}

			O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׁלַח־אוֹרְךָ֣ וַ֭אֲמִתְּךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּנִי יְבִיא֥וּנִי אֶל־הַֽר־קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ וְאֶל־מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξαπόστειλον τὸ φῶς σου καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου· αὐτά με ὡδήγησαν καὶ ἤγαγόν με εἰς ὄρος ἅγιόν σου καὶ εἰς τὰ σκηνώματά σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Oh send out thy light and thy truth; let them lead me: Let them bring me unto thy holy hill, And to thy tabernacles.
					\item[NIV] Send me your light and your faithful care, let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.
					\item[NRSV] O send out your light and your truth; let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy hill and to your dwelling.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 43:4} % *PSALMS-43-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-43-4}

			Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְאָב֤וֹאָה ׀ אֶל־מִזְבַּ֬ח אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל־אֵל֮ שִׂמְחַ֪ת גִּ֫ילִ֥י וְאוֹדְךָ֥ בְכִנּ֗וֹר אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ εἰσελεύσομαι πρὸς τὸ θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θεοῦ, πρὸς τὸν θεὸν τὸν εὐφραίνοντα τὴν νεότητά μου· ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι, Κύριε ὁ θεός μου, ἐν κιθάρᾳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Then will I go unto the altar of God, Unto God my exceeding joy; And upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.
					\item[NIV] Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God.
					\item[NRSV] Then I will go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy; and I will praise you with the harp, O God, my God.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 43:5} % *PSALMS-43-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-43-5}

			Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מַה־תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י ׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה־תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἵνα τί περίλυπος εἶ, ψυχή, καὶ ἵνα τί συνταράσσεις με; ἔλπισον ἐπὶ τὸν θεόν, ὅτι ἐξομολογήσομαι αὐτῷ· σωτήριον τοῦ προσώπου μου ὁ θεός μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, Who is the help of my countenance, and my God.
					\item[NIV] Why, my soul, are you downcast? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
					\item[NRSV] Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; for I shall again praise him, my help and my God.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 44} % *PSALMS-44
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-44}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 44:1} % *PSALMS-44-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-44-1}

			We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὁ θεός, ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν ἡμῶν ἠκούσαμεν, οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἀνήγγειλαν ἡμῖν, ἔργον ὃ εἰργάσω ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῶν, ἐν ἡμέραις ἀρχαίαις.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Maschil. We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, What work thou didst in their days, In the days of old.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A maskil. We have heard it with our ears, O God; our ancestors have told us what you did in their days, in days long ago.
					\item[NRSV] We have heard with our ears, O God, our ancestors have told us, what deeds you performed in their days, in the days of old:
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 44:2} % *PSALMS-44-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-44-2}

			How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ בְּאָזְנֵ֬ינוּ שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵ֥ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָ֑נוּ פֹּ֥עַל פָּעַ֥לְתָּ בִֽ֝ימֵיהֶ֗ם בִּ֣ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡ χείρ σου ἔθνη ἐξωλόθρευσεν, καὶ κατεφύτευσας αὐτούς, ἐκάκωσας λαοὺς καὶ ἐξέβαλες αὐτούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand; But them thou didst plant: Thou didst afflict the peoples; But them thou didst spread abroad.
					\item[NIV] With your hand you drove out the nations and planted our ancestors; you crushed the peoples and made our ancestors flourish.
					\item[NRSV] you with your own hand drove out the nations, but them you planted; you afflicted the peoples, but them you set free;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 44:3} % *PSALMS-44-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-44-3}

			For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַתָּ֤ה ׀ יָדְךָ֡ גּוֹיִ֣ם ה֭וֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵ֑ם תָּרַ֥ע לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐ γὰρ ἐν τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ αὐτῶν ἐκληρονόμησαν γῆν, καὶ ὁ βραχίων αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔσωσεν αὐτούς· ἀλλ᾽ ἡ δεξιά σου καὶ ὁ βραχίων σου καὶ ὁ φωτισμὸς τοῦ προσώπου σου, ὅτι εὐδόκησας ἐν αὐτοῖς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For they gat not the land in possession by their own sword, Neither did their own arm save them; But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, Because thou wast favorable unto them.
					\item[NIV] It was not by their sword that they won the land, nor did their arm bring them victory; it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, for you loved them.
					\item[NRSV] for not by their own sword did they win the land, nor did their own arm give them victory; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your countenance, for you delighted in them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 44:4} % *PSALMS-44-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-44-4}

			Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י לֹ֪א בְחַרְבָּ֡ם יָ֥רְשׁוּ אָ֗רֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם֮ לֹא־הוֹשִׁ֪יעָ֫ה לָּ֥מוֹ כִּֽי־יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וּ֭זְרוֹעֲךָ וְא֥וֹר פָּנֶ֗יךָ כִּ֣י רְצִיתָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σὺ εἶ αὐτὸς ὁ βασιλεύς μου καὶ ὁ θεός μου, ὁ ἐντελλόμενος τὰς σωτηρίας Ἰακώβ.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] You are my King and my God, who decrees victories for Jacob.
					\item[NRSV] You are my King and my God; you command victories for Jacob.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν σοὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ἡμῶν κερατιοῦμεν, καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐξουθενώσομεν τοὺς ἐπανιστανομένους ἡμῖν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐ γὰρ ἐπὶ τῷ τόξῳ μου ἐλπιῶ, καὶ ἡ ῥομφαία μου οὐ σώσει με·}

			But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θρόνος σου, ὁ θεός, εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος, ῥάβδος εὐθύτητος ἡ ῥάβδος τῆς βασιλείας σου.}

					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֣י ה֭וֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵ֥ינוּ הֱבִישֽׁוֹתָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῷ θεῷ ἐπαινεσθησόμεθα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν, καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐξομολογησόμεθα εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. διάψαλμα.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] In God we make our boast all day long, and we will praise your name forever.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 45} % *PSALMS-45
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-45}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 45:1} % *PSALMS-45-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-45-1}

			My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־שֹׁ֭שַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי־קֹ֑רַח מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל שִׁ֣יר יְדִידֹֽת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἐξηρεύξατο ἡ καρδία μου λόγον ἀγαθόν, λέγω ἐγὼ τὰ ἔργα μου τῷ βασιλεῖ· ἡ γλῶσσά μου κάλαμος γραμματέως ὀξυγράφου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves. My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter; I speak the things which I have made touching the king: My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of the Sons of Korah. A maskil. A wedding song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
					\item[NRSV] My heart overflows with a goodly theme; I address my verses to the king; my tongue is like the pen of a ready scribe.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 45:2} % *PSALMS-45-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-45-2}

			Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רָ֘חַ֤שׁ לִבִּ֨י ׀ דָּ֘בָ֤ר ט֗וֹב אֹמֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי מַעֲשַׂ֣י לְמֶ֑לֶךְ לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י עֵ֤ט ׀ סוֹפֵ֬ר מָהִֽיר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡραῖος κάλλει παρὰ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ἐξεχύθη ἡ χάρις ἐν χείλεσίν σου· διὰ τοῦτο εὐλόγησέν σε ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou art fairer than the children of men; Grace is poured into thy lips: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
					\item[NIV] You are the most excellent of men and your lips have been anointed with grace, since God has blessed you forever.
					\item[NRSV] You are the most handsome of men; grace is poured upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 45:3} % *PSALMS-45-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-45-3}

			Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

			\begin{versebox}

					% % \item[NETS]

					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: Therefore shall the peoples give thee thanks for ever and ever.
					\item[NIV] I will perpetuate your memory through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you for ever and ever.
					\item[NRSV] I will cause your name to be celebrated in all generations; therefore the peoples will praise you forever and ever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 46} % *PSALMS-46
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-46}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 46:1} % *PSALMS-46-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-46-1}

			God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֑רַח עַֽל־עֲלָמ֥וֹת שִֽׁיר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καταφυγὴ καὶ δύναμις, βοηθὸς ἐν θλίψεσιν ταῖς εὑρούσαις ἡμᾶς σφόδρα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah; set to Alamoth. A Song. God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. According to alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
					\item[NRSV] God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 46:2} % *PSALMS-46-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-46-2}

			Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱלֹהִ֣ים לָ֭נוּ מַחֲסֶ֣ה וָעֹ֑ז עֶזְרָ֥ה בְ֝צָר֗וֹת נִמְצָ֥א מְאֹֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{διὰ τοῦτο οὐ φοβηθησόμεθα ἐν τῷ ταράσσεσθαι τὴν γῆν καὶ μετατίθεσθαι ὄρη ἐν καρδίαις θαλασσῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be shaken into the heart of the seas
					\item[NIV] Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea,
					\item[NRSV] Therefore we will not fear, though the earth should change, though the mountains shake in the heart of the sea;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 46:3} % *PSALMS-46-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-46-3}

			Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַל־כֵּ֣ן לֹא־נִ֭ירָא בְּהָמִ֣יר אָ֑רֶץ וּבְמ֥וֹט הָ֝רִ֗ים בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἤχησαν καὶ ἐταράχθησαν τὰ ὕδατα αὐτῶν, ἐταράχθησαν τὰ ὄρη ἐν τῇ κραταιότητι αὐτοῦ. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, Though the mountains tremble with the swelling thereof. [Selah
					\item[NIV] though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging.
					\item[NRSV] though its waters roar and foam, though the mountains tremble with its tumult. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 46:4} % *PSALMS-46-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-46-4}

			There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יֶהֱמ֣וּ יֶחְמְר֣וּ מֵימָ֑יו יִֽרְעֲשֽׁוּ־הָרִ֖ים בְּגַאֲוָת֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῦ ποταμοῦ τὰ ὁρμήματα εὐφραίνουσιν τὴν πόλιν τοῦ θεοῦ· ἡγίασεν τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ ὁ ὕψιστος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.
					\item[NIV] There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
					\item[NRSV] There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy habitation of the Most High.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 46:5} % *PSALMS-46-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-46-5}

			God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נָהָ֗ר פְּלָגָ֗יו יְשַׂמְּח֥וּ עִיר־אֱלֹהִ֑ים קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֽוֹן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεὸς ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς, οὐ σαλευθήσεται· βοηθήσει αὐτῇ ὁ θεὸς τῷ προσώπῳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God will help her, and that right early.
					\item[NIV] God is within her, she will not fall; God will help her at break of day.
					\item[NRSV] God is in the midst of the city; it shall not be moved; God will help it when the morning dawns.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 46:6} % *PSALMS-46-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-46-6}

			The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ֭קִרְבָּהּ בַּל־תִּמּ֑וֹט יַעְזְרֶ֥הָ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לִפְנ֥וֹת בֹּֽקֶר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐταράχθησαν ἔθνη, ἔκλιναν βασιλεῖαι· ἔδωκεν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ, ἐσαλεύθη ἡ γῆ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered his voice, the earth melted.
					\item[NIV] Nations are in uproar, kingdoms fall; he lifts his voice, the earth melts.
					\item[NRSV] The nations are in an uproar, the kingdoms totter; he utters his voice, the earth melts.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

			\label{PSALMS-46-7}

			The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הָמ֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם מָ֣טוּ מַמְלָכ֑וֹת נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹל֗וֹ תָּמ֥וּג אָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος τῶν δυνάμεων μεθ᾽ ἡμῶν, ἀντιλήμπτωρ ἡμῶν ὁ θεὸς Ἰακώβ. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah
					\item[NIV] The LORD Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-46-8}

			Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{δεῦτε, ἴδετε τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου, ἃ ἔθετο τέρατα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Come, behold the works of Jehovah, What desolations he hath made in the earth.
					\item[NIV] Come and see what the LORD has done, the desolations he has brought on the earth.
					\item[NRSV] Come, behold the works of the LORD; see what desolations he has brought on the earth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 46:9} % *PSALMS-46-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-46-9}

			He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְֽכוּ־חֲ֭זוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֖ם שַׁמּ֣וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνταναιρῶν πολέμους μέχρι τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς, τόξον συντρίψει καὶ συνκλάσει ὅπλον, καὶ θυρεοὺς κατακαύσει ἐν πυρί.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.
					\item[NIV] He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth. He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; he burns the shields with fire.
					\item[NRSV] He makes wars cease to the end of the earth; he breaks the bow, and shatters the spear; he burns the shields with fire.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 46:10} % *PSALMS-46-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-46-10}

			Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מַשְׁבִּ֥ית מִלְחָמוֹת֮ עַד־קְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ קֶ֣שֶׁת יְ֭שַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית עֲ֝גָל֗וֹת יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σχολάσατε, καὶ γνῶτε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεός· ὑψωθήσομαι ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ὑψωθήσομαι ἐν τῇ γῇ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
					\item[NIV] He says, “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.”
					\item[NRSV] “Be still, and know that I am God! I am exalted among the nations, I am exalted in the earth.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-46-11}

			The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַרְפּ֣וּ וּ֭דְעוּ כִּי־אָנֹכִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָר֥וּם בַּ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם אָר֥וּם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος τῶν δυνάμεων μεθ᾽ ἡμῶν, ἀντιλήμπτωρ ἡμῶν ὁ θεὸς Ἰακώβ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. [Selah
					\item[NIV] The LORD Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 47} % *PSALMS-47
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-47}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 47:1} % *PSALMS-47-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-47-1}

			O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ ׀ לִבְנֵי־קֹ֬רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Πάντα τὰ ἔθνη κροτήσατε χεῖρας, ἀλαλάξατε τῷ θεῷ ἐν φωνῇ ἀγαλλιάσεως.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all ye peoples; Shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.
					\item[NRSV] Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout to God with loud songs of joy.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

			\label{PSALMS-47-2}

			For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

					\item[BHS] \he{כָּֽל־הָ֭עַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָ֑ף הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִ֗ים בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι Κύριος Ὕψιστος φοβερός, βασιλεὺς μέγας ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For Jehovah Most High is terrible; He is a great King over all the earth.
					\item[NIV] For the LORD Most High is awesome, the great King over all the earth.
					\item[NRSV] For the LORD, the Most High, is awesome, a great king over all the earth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

			\label{PSALMS-47-3}

			He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־יְהוָ֣ה עֶלְי֣וֹן נוֹרָ֑א מֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝דוֹל עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὑπέταξεν λαοὺς ἡμῖν, καὶ ἔθνη ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας ἡμῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He subdueth peoples under us, And nations under our feet.
					\item[NIV] He subdued nations under us, peoples under our feet.
					\item[NRSV] He subdued peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

			\label{PSALMS-47-4}

			He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַדְבֵּ֣ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתֵּ֑ינוּ וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים תַּ֣חַת רַגְלֵֽינוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξελέξατο ἡμῖν τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ, τὴν καλλονὴν Ἰακὼβ ἣν ἠγάπησεν. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He chooseth our inheritance for us, The glory of Jacob whom he loved. [Selah
					\item[NIV] He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved.
					\item[NRSV] He chose our heritage for us, the pride of Jacob whom he loves. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐφρανθήτω τὸ ὄρος Σιών, ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν αἱ θυγατέρες τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἕνεκα τῶν κριμάτων σου, Κύριε.}

					% % \item[NETS]

					% % \item[OTR2]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-48-12}

			Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִשְׂמַ֤ח ׀ הַר־צִיּ֗וֹן תָּ֭גֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ֝מַ֗עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κυκλώσατε Σιὼν καὶ περιβάλετε αὐτήν, διηγήσασθε ἐν τοῖς πύργοις αὐτῆς·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-48-13}

			Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{סֹ֣בּוּ צִ֭יּוֹן וְהַקִּיפ֑וּהָ סִ֝פְר֗וּ מִגְדָּלֶֽיהָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{θέσθε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν δύναμιν αὐτῆς, καὶ καταδιέλεσθε τὰς βάρεις αὐτῆς, ὅπως ἂν διηγήσησθε εἰς γενεὰν ἑτέραν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] consider well her ramparts, view her citadels, that you may tell of them to the next generation.
					\item[NRSV] consider well its ramparts; go through its citadels, that you may tell the next generation
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-48-14}

			For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֤יתוּ לִבְּכֶ֨ם ׀ לְֽחֵילָ֗ה פַּסְּג֥וּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ לְמַ֥עַן תְּ֝סַפְּר֗וּ לְד֣וֹר אַחֲרֽוֹן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For this God is our God for ever and ever: He will be our guide even unto death.
					\item[NIV] For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide even to the end.
					\item[NRSV] that this is God, our God forever and ever. He will be our guide forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἀκούσατε ταῦτα, πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, ἐνωτίσασθε, πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν οἰκουμένην,}

					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all who live in this world,
					\item[NRSV] Hear this, all you peoples; give ear, all inhabitants of the world,

					\item[LXX] \gr{οἵ τε γηγενεῖς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ πλούσιος καὶ πένης.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{τὸ στόμα μου λαλήσει σοφίαν, καὶ ἡ μελέτη τῆς καρδίας μου σύνεσιν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{κλινῶ εἰς παραβολὴν τὸ οὖς μου, ἀνοίξω ἐν ψαλτηρίῳ τὸ πρόβλημά μου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἵνα τί φοβοῦμαι ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πονηρᾷ; ἡ ἀνομία τῆς πτέρνης μου κυκλώσει με,}

					\item[LXX] \gr{οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπὶ τῇ δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ πλήθει τοῦ πλούτου αὐτῶν καυχώμενοι.}

			None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀδελφὸς οὐ λυτροῦται· λυτρώσεται ἄνθρωπος; οὐ δώσει τῷ θεῷ ἐξίλασμα αὐτοῦ,}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] No one can redeem the life of another or give to God a ransom for them—
					\item[NRSV] Truly, no ransom avails for one’s life, there is no price one can give to God for it.

		% % ---

			(For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ τὴν τιμὴν τῆς λυτρώσεως τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐκοπίασεν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα,}

					\item[NIV] the ransom for a life is costly, no payment is ever enough—
					\item[NRSV] For the ransom of life is costly, and can never suffice,

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-49-9}

			That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְ֭יֵקַר פִּדְי֥וֹן נַפְשָׁ֗ם וְחָדַ֥ל לְעוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ζήσεται εἰς τέλος, ὅτι οὐκ ὄψεται καταφθοράν,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] so that they should live on forever and not see decay.
					\item[NRSV] that one should live on forever and never see the grave.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 49:10} % *PSALMS-49-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-49-10}

			For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וִֽיחִי־ע֥וֹד לָנֶ֑צַח לֹ֖א יִרְאֶ֣ה הַשָּֽׁחַת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅταν ἴδῃ σοφοὺς ἀποθνήσκοντας. ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἄνους καὶ ἄφρων ἀπολοῦνται, καὶ καταλείψουσιν ἀλλοτρίοις τὸν πλοῦτον αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For he shall see it. Wise men die; The fool and the brutish alike perish, And leave their wealth to others.
					\item[NIV] For all can see that the wise die, that the foolish and the senseless also perish, leaving their wealth to others.
					\item[NRSV] When we look at the wise, they die; fool and dolt perish together and leave their wealth to others.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 49:11} % *PSALMS-49-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-49-11}

			Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י יִרְאֶ֨ה ׀ חֲכָ֘מִ֤ים יָמ֗וּתוּ יַ֤חַד כְּסִ֣יל וָבַ֣עַר יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְעָזְב֖וּ לַאֲחֵרִ֣ים חֵילָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ οἱ τάφοι αὐτῶν οἰκίαι αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, σκηνώματα αὐτῶν εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν· ἐπεκαλέσαντο τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τῶν γαιῶν αὐτῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, And their dwelling-places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.
					\item[NIV] Their tombs will remain their houses forever, their dwellings for endless generations, though they had named lands after themselves.
					\item[NRSV] Their graves are their homes forever, their dwelling places to all generations, though they named lands their own.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-49-12}

			Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{קִרְבָּ֤ם בָּתֵּ֨ימוֹ ׀ לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם מִ֭שְׁכְּנֹתָם לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר קָֽרְא֥וּ בִ֝שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עֲלֵ֣י אֲדָמֽוֹת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἄνθρωπος ἐν τιμῇ ὢν οὐ συνῆκεν· παρασυνεβλήθη τοῖς κτήνεσιν τοῖς ἀνοήτοις καὶ ὡμοιώθη αὐτοῖς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But man being in honor abideth not: He is like the beasts that perish.
					\item[NIV] People, despite their wealth, do not endure; they are like the beasts that perish.
					\item[NRSV] Mortals cannot abide in their pomp; they are like the animals that perish.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 49:13} % *PSALMS-49-13
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-49-13}

			This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְאָדָ֣ם בִּ֭יקָר בַּל־יָלִ֑ין נִמְשַׁ֖ל כַּבְּהֵמ֣וֹת נִדְמֽוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αὕτη ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτῶν σκάνδαλον αὐτοῖς, καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν εὐλογήσουσιν. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-49-14}

			Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זֶ֣ה דַ֭רְכָּם כֵּ֣סֶל לָ֑מוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֓ם ׀ בְּפִיהֶ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡς πρόβατα ἐν ᾅδῃ ἔθεντο, θάνατος ποιμαίνει αὐτούς· καὶ κατακυριεύσουσιν αὐτῶν οἱ εὐθεῖς τὸ πρωί, καὶ ἡ βοήθεια αὐτῶν παλαιωθήσεται ἐν τῷ ᾅδῃ ἐκ τῆς δόξης αὐτῶν.}

					\item[NRSV] Like sheep they are appointed for Sheol; Death shall be their shepherd; straight to the grave they descend, and their form shall waste away; Sheol shall be their home.

			But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{πλὴν ὁ θεὸς λυτρώσεται τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ χειρὸς ᾅδου, ὅταν λαμβάνῃ με. διάψαλμα.}

					% % \item[AB ]

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol; For he will receive me. [Selah
					\item[NIV] But God will redeem me from the realm of the dead; he will surely take me to himself.
					\item[NRSV] But God will ransom my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah

					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ φοβοῦ ὅταν πλουτήσῃ ἄνθρωπος, καὶ ὅταν πληθυνθῇ ἡ δόξα τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ·}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 50:1} % *PSALMS-50-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-50-1}

			The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֵ֤ל ׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֡ים יְֽהוָ֗ה דִּבֶּ֥ר וַיִּקְרָא־אָ֑רֶץ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ עַד־מְבֹאֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ. Θεὸς θεῶν Κύριος ἐλάλησεν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὴν γῆν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου καὶ μέχρι δυσμῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] A psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to where it sets.
					\item[NRSV] The mighty one, God the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting.

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεὸς ἐμφανῶς ἥξει, ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, καὶ οὐ παρασιωπήσεται· πῦρ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ καυθήσεται, καὶ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ καταιγὶς σφόδρα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{προσκαλέσεται τὸν οὐρανὸν ἄνω καὶ τὴν γῆν, διακρῖναι τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֹ֣א עַל־זְ֭בָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶ֖יךָ לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐκ ἐπὶ ταῖς θυσίαις σου ἐλέγξω σε, τὰ δὲ ὁλοκαυτώματά σου ἐνώπιόν μού ἐστιν διὰ παντός·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 51} % *PSALMS-51
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-51}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 51:1} % *PSALMS-51-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-51-1}

				\footnote{%
					% \label{}%
					Lehi speaks in language very similar to this verse in \hyperref[1NEPHI-8-8]{1 Nephi 8:8}.
					}%
			Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

			\begin{versebox}

					% % \item[NETS]

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] For the director of music. A psalm of David. When the prophet Nathan came to him after David had committed adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions.

		\paragraph{Psalms 52:1} % *PSALMS-52-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-52-1}

			Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τί ἐνκαυχᾷ ἐν κακίᾳ, ὁ δυνατός, ἀνομίαν ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. Maschil of David; when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech. Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? The lovingkindness of God endureth continually.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. A maskil of David. When Doeg the Edomite had gone to Saul and told him: “David has gone to the house of Ahimelek.” Why do you boast of evil, you mighty hero? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?
					\item[NRSV] Why do you boast, O mighty one, of mischief done against the godly? All day long
					% % \item[OTX*]

			Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀδικίαν ἐλογίσατο ἡ γλῶσσά σου· ὡσεὶ ξυρὸν ἐξηκονημένον ἐποίησας δόλον.}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] You who practice deceit, your tongue plots destruction; it is like a sharpened razor.
					\item[NRSV] you are plotting destruction. Your tongue is like a sharp razor, you worker of treachery.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἠγάπησας κακίαν ὑπὲρ ἀγαθωσύνην, ἀδικίαν ὑπὲρ τὸ λαλῆσαι δικαιοσύνην. διάψαλμα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{διὰ τοῦτο ὁ θεὸς καθελεῖ σε εἰς τέλος· ἐκτίλαι σε καὶ μεταναστεύσαι σε ἀπὸ σκηνώματος, καὶ τὸ ῥίζωμά σου ἐκ γῆς ζώντων. διάψαλμα.}

			\label{PSALMS-52-7}

			Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גַּם־אֵל֮ יִתָּצְךָ֪ לָ֫נֶ֥צַח יַחְתְּךָ֣ וְיִסָּחֲךָ֣ מֵאֹ֑הֶל וְשֵֽׁרֶשְׁךָ֨ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ חַיִּ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος ὃς οὐκ ἔθετο τὸν θεὸν βοηθὸν αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ ἐπήλπισεν ἐπὶ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ πλούτου αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐδυναμώθη ἐπὶ τῇ ματαιότητι αὐτοῦ.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.

					\item[NRSV] “See the one who would not take refuge in God, but trusted in abundant riches, and sought refuge in wealth!”

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-52-8}

			But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ ὡσεὶ ἐλαία κατάκαρπος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ· ἤλπισα ἐπὶ τὸ ἔλεος τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος·}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God. I trust in the steadfast love of God forever and ever.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ὅτι ἐποίησας· καὶ ὑπομενῶ τὸ ὄνομά σου, ὅτι χρηστὸν ἐναντίον τῶν ὁσίων σου.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					\item[NRSV] I will thank you forever, because of what you have done. In the presence of the faithful I will proclaim your name, for it is good.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 53} % *PSALMS-53
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-53}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 53:1} % *PSALMS-53-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-53-1}

			The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־מָחֲלַ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Εἶπεν ἄφρων ἐν καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ Οὐκ ἔστιν θεός. διέφθειραν καὶ ἐβδελύχθησαν ἐν ἀνομίαις, οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ποιῶν ἀγαθόν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath. Maschil of David. The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity; There is none that doeth good.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. According to mahalath. A maskil of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and their ways are vile; there is no one who does good.
					\item[NRSV] Fools say in their hearts, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, they commit abominable acts; there is no one who does good.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 53:2} % *PSALMS-53-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-53-2}

			God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽ֝שְׁחִ֗יתוּ וְהִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עָ֝֗וֶל אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־טֽוֹב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ διέκυψεν ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων, τοῦ ἰδεῖν εἰ ἔστιν συνίων ἢ ἐκζητῶν τὸν θεόν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.
					\item[NIV] God looks down from heaven on all mankind to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.
					\item[NRSV] God looks down from heaven on humankind to see if there are any who are wise, who seek after God.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 53:3} % *PSALMS-53-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-53-3}

			Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל־בְּנֵ֫י אָדָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵ֗שׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πάντες ἐξέκλιναν, ἅμα ἠχρεώθησαν, οὐκ ἔστιν ποιῶν ἀγαθόν, οὐκ ἔστιν ἕως ἑνός.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Every one of them is gone back; they are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
					\item[NIV] Everyone has turned away, all have become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
					\item[NRSV] They have all fallen away, they are all alike perverse; there is no one who does good, no, not one.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 53:4} % *PSALMS-53-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-53-4}

			Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כֻּלּ֥וֹ סָג֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־אֶחָֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐχὶ γνώσονται πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν, οἱ ἔσθοντες τὸν λαόν μου βρώσει ἄρτου; τὸν θεὸν οὐκ ἐπεκαλέσαντο.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And call not upon God?
					\item[NIV] Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on God.
					\item[NRSV] Have they no knowledge, those evildoers, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and do not call upon God?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 53:5} % *PSALMS-53-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-53-5}

			There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ פֹּ֤עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκεῖ φοβηθήσονται φόβον οὗ οὐκ ἦν φόβος, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς διεσκόρπισεν ὀστᾶ ἀνθρωπαρέσκων· κατῃσχύνθησαν, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἐξουδένωσεν αὐτούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] There were they in great fear, where no fear was; For God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: Thou hast put them to shame, because God hath rejected them.
					\item[NIV] But there they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to dread. God scattered the bones of those who attacked you; you put them to shame, for God despised them.
					\item[NRSV] There they shall be in great terror, in terror such as has not been. For God will scatter the bones of the ungodly; they will be put to shame, for God has rejected them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 53:6} % *PSALMS-53-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-53-6}

			Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁ֤ם ׀ פָּֽחֲדוּ־פַחַד֮ לֹא־הָ֪יָה֫ פָ֥חַד כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֗ים פִּ֭זַּר עַצְמ֣וֹת חֹנָ֑ךְ הֱ֝בִשֹׁ֗תָה כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים מְאָסָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς δώσει ἐκ Σιὼν τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ Ἰσραήλ; ἐν τῷ ἀποστρέψαι Κύριον τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀγαλλιάσεται Ἰακὼβ καὶ εὐφρανθήσεται Ἰσραήλ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
					\item[NIV] Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When God restores his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!
					\item[NRSV] O that deliverance for Israel would come from Zion! When God restores the fortunes of his people, Jacob will rejoice; Israel will be glad.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 54} % *PSALMS-54
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-54}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 54:1} % *PSALMS-54-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-54-1}

			Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὁ θεός, ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου σῶσόν με, καὶ ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου κρῖνόν με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David; when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us? Save me, O God, by thy name, And judge me in thy might.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David. When the Ziphites had gone to Saul and said, “Is not David hiding among us?” Save me, O God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.
					\item[NRSV] Save me, O God, by your name, and vindicate me by your might.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 54:2} % *PSALMS-54-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-54-2}

			Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּב֣וֹא הַ֭זִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לְשָׁא֑וּל הֲלֹ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד מִסְתַּתֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεός, εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου, ἐνώτισαι τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.
					\item[NIV] Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
					\item[NRSV] Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 54:3} % *PSALMS-54-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-54-3}

			For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱ֭לֹהִים בְּשִׁמְךָ֣ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי וּבִגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ תְדִינֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἀλλότριοι ἐπανέστησαν ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ, καὶ κραταιοὶ ἐζήτησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου· οὐ προέθεντο τὸν θεὸν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For strangers are risen up against me, And violent men have sought after my soul: They have not set God before them. [Selah
					\item[NIV] Arrogant foes are attacking me; ruthless people are trying to kill me— people without regard for God.
					\item[NRSV] For the insolent have risen against me, the ruthless seek my life; they do not set God before them. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 54:4} % *PSALMS-54-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-54-4}

			Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱ֭לֹהִים שְׁמַ֣ע תְּפִלָּתִ֑י הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὁ θεὸς βοηθεῖ μοι, καὶ ὁ κύριος ἀντιλήμπτωρ τῆς ψυχῆς μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Behold, God is my helper: The Lord is of them that uphold my soul.
					\item[NIV] Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me.
					\item[NRSV] But surely, God is my helper; the Lord is the upholder of my life.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 54:5} % *PSALMS-54-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-54-5}

			He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י זָרִ֨ים ׀ קָ֤מוּ עָלַ֗י וְֽ֭עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י לֹ֤א שָׂ֨מוּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְנֶגְדָּ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀποστρέψει τὰ κακὰ τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου· ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου ἐξολόθρευσον αὐτούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He will requite the evil unto mine enemies: Destroy thou them in thy truth.
					\item[NIV] Let evil recoil on those who slander me; in your faithfulness destroy them.
					\item[NRSV] He will repay my enemies for their evil. In your faithfulness, put an end to them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 54:6} % *PSALMS-54-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-54-6}

			I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִנֵּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים עֹזֵ֣ר לִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י בְּֽסֹמְכֵ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἑκουσίως θύσω σοι, ἐξομολογήσομαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου, ὅτι ἀγαθόν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto thee: I will give thanks unto thy name, O Jehovah, for it is good.
					\item[NIV] I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you; I will praise your name, LORD, for it is good.
					\item[NRSV] With a freewill offering I will sacrifice to you; I will give thanks to your name, O LORD, for it is good.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 54:7} % *PSALMS-54-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-54-7}

			For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָשִׁ֣יב הָ֭רַע לְשֹׁרְרָ֑י בַּ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ הַצְמִיתֵֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐκ πάσης θλίψεως ἐρύσω με, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου ἐπεῖδεν ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For he hath delivered me out of all trouble; And mine eye hath seen my desire upon mine enemies.
					\item[NIV] You have delivered me from all my troubles, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
					\item[NRSV] For he has delivered me from every trouble, and my eye has looked in triumph on my enemies.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 55} % *PSALMS-55
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-55}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 55:1} % *PSALMS-55-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-55-1}

			Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἐνώτισαι, ὁ θεός, τὴν προσευχήν μου, καὶ μὴ ὑπερίδῃς τὴν δέησίν μου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David. Give ear to my prayer, O God; And hide not thyself from my supplication.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;
					\item[NRSV] Give ear to my prayer, O God; do not hide yourself from my supplication.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 55:2} % *PSALMS-55-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-55-2}

			Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַאֲזִ֣ינָה אֱ֭לֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְאַל־תִּ֝תְעַלַּ֗ם מִתְּחִנָּתִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πρόσχες μοι καὶ εἰσάκουσόν μου. ἐλυπήθην ἐν τῇ ἀδολεσχίᾳ μου, καὶ ἐταράχθην}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Attend unto me, and answer me: I am restless in my complaint, and moan,
					\item[NIV] hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught
					\item[NRSV] Attend to me, and answer me; I am troubled in my complaint. I am distraught
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 55:3} % *PSALMS-55-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-55-3}

			Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַקְשִׁ֣יבָה לִּ֣י וַעֲנֵ֑נִי אָרִ֖יד בְּשִׂיחִ֣י וְאָהִֽימָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ φωνῆς ἐχθροῦ καὶ ἀπὸ θλίψεως ἁμαρτωλοῦ· ὅτι ἐξέκλιναν ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ ἀνομίαν, καὶ ἐν ὀργῇ ἐνεκότουν μοι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked; For they cast iniquity upon me, And in anger they persecute me.
					\item[NIV] because of what my enemy is saying, because of the threats of the wicked; for they bring down suffering on me and assail me in their anger.
					\item[NRSV] by the noise of the enemy, because of the clamor of the wicked. For they bring trouble upon me, and in anger they cherish enmity against me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 55:4} % *PSALMS-55-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-55-4}

			My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִקּ֤וֹל אוֹיֵ֗ב מִפְּנֵ֣י עָקַ֣ת רָשָׁ֑ע כִּי־יָמִ֥יטוּ עָלַ֥י אָ֝֗וֶן וּבְאַ֥ף יִשְׂטְמֽוּנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡ καρδία μου ἐταράχθη ἐν ἐμοί, καὶ δειλία θανάτου ἐπέπεσεν ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]

					\item[BHS] \he{יִשְׁמַ֤ע ׀ אֵ֨ל ׀ וְֽיַעֲנֵם֮ וְיֹ֤שֵׁ֥ב קֶ֗דֶם סֶ֥לָה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֣ין חֲלִיפ֣וֹת לָ֑מוֹ וְלֹ֖א יָרְא֣וּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξέτεινεν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ ἀποδιδόναι· ἐβεβήλωσαν τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He hath put forth his hands against such as were at peace with him: He hath profaned his covenant.
					\item[NIV] My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
					\item[NRSV] My companion laid hands on a friend and violated a covenant with me
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁלַ֣ח יָ֭דָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָ֗יו חִלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{διεμερίσθησαν ἀπὸ ὀργῆς τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἤγγισεν ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ· ἡπαλύνθησαν οἱ λόγοι αὐτοῦ ὑπὲρ ἔλαιον, καὶ αὐτοί εἰσιν βολίδες.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] His mouth was smooth as butter, But his heart was war: His words were softer than oil, Yet were they drawn swords.
					\item[NIV] His talk is smooth as butter, yet war is in his heart; his words are more soothing than oil, yet they are drawn swords.
					\item[NRSV] with speech smoother than butter, but with a heart set on war; with words that were softer than oil, but in fact were drawn swords.

			Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חָלְק֤וּ ׀ מַחְמָאֹ֣ת פִּיו֮ וּֽקֲרָב־לִ֫בּ֥וֹ רַכּ֖וּ דְבָרָ֥יו מִשֶּׁ֗מֶן וְהֵ֣מָּה פְתִחֽוֹת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπίριψον ἐπὶ Κύριον τὴν μέριμνάν σου, καὶ αὐτός σε διαθρέψει· οὐ δώσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα σάλον τῷ δικαίῳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Cast your cares on the LORD and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken.
					\item[NRSV] Cast your burden on the LORD, and he will sustain you; he will never permit the righteous to be moved.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-55-23}

			But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עַל־יְהוָ֨ה ׀ יְהָבְךָ֮ וְה֪וּא יְכַ֫לְכְּלֶ֥ךָ לֹא־יִתֵּ֖ן לְעוֹלָ֥ם מ֗וֹט לַצַּדִּֽיק׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σὺ δέ, ὁ θεός, κατάξεις αὐτοὺς εἰς φρέαρ διαφθορᾶς· ἄνδρες αἱμάτων καὶ δολιότητος οὐ μὴ ἡμισεύσωσιν τὰς ἡμέρας αὐτῶν· ἐγὼ δὲ ἐλπιῶ ἐπὶ σέ, Κύριε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] But you, God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of decay; the bloodthirsty and deceitful will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in you.
					\item[NRSV] But you, O God, will cast them down into the lowest pit; the bloodthirsty and treacherous shall not live out half their days. But I will trust in you.
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 56:1} % *PSALMS-56-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-56-1}

			Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ ׀ עַל־י֬וֹנַת אֵ֣לֶם רְ֭חֹקִים לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בֶּֽאֱחֹ֨ז אֹת֖וֹ פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים בְּגַֽת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἐλέησόν με, Κύριε, ὅτι κατεπάτησέν με ἄνθρωπος, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν πολεμῶν ἔθλιψέν με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to Jonath elem rehokim. A Psalm of David. Michtam; when the Philistines took him in Gath. Be merciful unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: All the day long he fighting oppresseth me.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” Of David. A miktam. When the Philistines had seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, my God, for my enemies are in hot pursuit; all day long they press their attack.
					\item[NRSV] Be gracious to me, O God, for people trample on me; all day long foes oppress me;

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{κατεπάτησάν με οἱ ἐχθροί μου ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἀπὸ ὕψους ἡμέρας· ὅτι πολλοὶ οἱ πολεμοῦντές με}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 57} % *PSALMS-57
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-57}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 57:1} % *PSALMS-57-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-57-1}

			Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־תַּ֭שְׁחֵת לְדָוִ֣ד מִכְתָּ֑ם בְּבָרְח֥וֹ מִפְּנֵי־שָׁ֝א֗וּל בַּמְּעָרָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἐλέησόν με, ὁ θεός, ἐλέησόν με· ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ πέποιθεν ἡ ψυχή μου, καὶ ἐν τῇ σκιᾷ τῶν πτερύγων σου ἐλπιῶ ἕως οὗ παρέλθῃ ἡ ἀνομία.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to Al-tashheth. A Psalm of David. Michtam; when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me; For my soul taketh refuge in thee: Yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I take refuge, Until these calamities be overpast.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” Of David. A miktam. When he had fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, my God, have mercy on me, for in you I take refuge. I will take refuge in the shadow of your wings until the disaster has passed.
					\item[NRSV] Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me, for in you my soul takes refuge; in the shadow of your wings I will take refuge, until the destroying storms pass by.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 57:2} % *PSALMS-57-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-57-2}

			I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חָנֵּ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים ׀ חָנֵּ֗נִי כִּ֥י בְךָ֮ חָסָ֪יָה נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י וּבְצֵֽל־כְּנָפֶ֥יךָ אֶחְסֶ֑ה עַ֝֗ד יַעֲבֹ֥ר הַוּֽוֹת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κεκράξομαι πρὸς τὸν θεὸν τὸν ὕψιστον, τὸν θεὸν τὸν εὐεργετήσαντά με. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will cry unto God Most High, Unto God that performeth all things for me.
					\item[NIV] I cry out to God Most High, to God, who vindicates me.
					\item[NRSV] I cry to God Most High, to God who fulfills his purpose for me.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-57-3}

			He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֶ֭קְרָא לֵֽאלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן לָ֝אֵ֗ל גֹּמֵ֥ר עָלָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξαπέστειλεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἔσωσέν με, ἔδωκεν εἰς ὄνειδος τοὺς καταπατοῦντάς με· ἐξαπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν αὐτοῦ,}
					% % \item[BSV]

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] He sends from heaven and saves me, rebuking those who hotly pursue me— God sends forth his love and his faithfulness.
					\item[NRSV] He will send from heaven and save me, he will put to shame those who trample on me. Selah God will send forth his steadfast love and his faithfulness.

					\item[BHS] \he{יִשְׁלַ֤ח מִשָּׁמַ֨יִם ׀ וְֽיוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי חֵרֵ֣ף שֹׁאֲפִ֣י סֶ֑לָה יִשְׁלַ֥ח אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים חַסְדּ֥וֹ וַאֲמִתּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐρύσατο τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ μέσου σκύμνων. ἐκοιμήθην τεταραγμένος· υἱοὶ ἀνθρώπων, οἱ ὀδόντες αὐτῶν ὅπλον καὶ βέλη, καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν μάχαιρα ὀξεῖα.}

					\item[NRSV] I lie down among lions that greedily devour human prey; their teeth are spears and arrows, their tongues sharp swords.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 58} % *PSALMS-58
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-58}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 58:1} % *PSALMS-58-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-58-1}

			Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵ֗ת לְדָוִ֥ד מִכְתָּֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Εἰ ἀληθῶς ἄρα δικαιοσύνην λαλεῖτε; εὐθεῖα κρίνετε, οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to Al-tashheth. A Psalm of David. Michtam. Do ye indeed in silence speak righteousness? Do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” Of David. A miktam. Do you rulers indeed speak justly? Do you judge people with equity?
					\item[NRSV] Do you indeed decree what is right, you gods? Do you judge people fairly?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 58:2} % *PSALMS-58-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-58-2}

			Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ γὰρ ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀνομίας ἐργάζεσθε ἐν τῇ γῇ, ἀδικίαν αἱ χεῖρες ὑμῶν συνπλέκουσιν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπηλλοτριώθησαν οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀπὸ μήτρας, ἐπλανήθησαν ἀπὸ γαστρός, ἐλάλησαν ψεύδη.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{θυμὸς αὐτοῖς κατὰ τὴν ὁμοίωσιν τοῦ ὄφεως, ὡσεὶ ἀσπίδος κωφῆς καὶ βυούσης τὰ ὦτα αὐτῆς,}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡσεὶ κηρὸς ὁ τακεὶς ἀνταναιρεθήσονται· ἐπέπεσε πῦρ, καὶ οὐκ εἶδον τὸν ἥλιον.}

					\item[NRSV] Let them be like the snail that dissolves into slime; like the untimely birth that never sees the sun.

					\item[LXX] \gr{πρὸ τοῦ συνεῖναι τὰς ἀκάνθας ὑμῶν τὴν ῥάμνον, ὡσεὶ ζῶντας, ὡσεὶ ἐν ὀργῇ καταπίεται ὑμᾶς.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐφρανθήσεται δίκαιος ὅταν ἴδῃ ἐκδίκησιν ἀσεβῶν. τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ νίψεται ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐρεῖ ἄνθρωπος Εἰ ἄρα ἐστὶν καρπὸς τῷ δικαίῳ; ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ θεὸς κρίνων αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ γῇ.}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 59} % *PSALMS-59
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-59}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 59:1} % *PSALMS-59-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-59-1}

			Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת֮ לְדָוִ֪ד מִ֫כְתָּ֥ם בִּשְׁלֹ֥חַ שָׁא֑וּל וַֽיִּשְׁמְר֥וּ אֶת־הַ֝בַּ֗יִת לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἐξελοῦ με ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου, ὁ θεός, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐπανιστανομένων ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ λύτρωσαί με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to Al-tashheth. A Psalm of David. Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: Set me on high from them that rise up against me.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” Of David. A miktam. When Saul had sent men to watch David’s house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O God; be my fortress against those who are attacking me.
					\item[NRSV] Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise up against me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 59:2} % *PSALMS-59-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-59-2}

			Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַצִּילֵ֖נִי מֵאֹיְבַ֥י ׀ אֱלֹהָ֑י מִּמִתְקוֹמְמַ֥י תְּשַׂגְּבֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ῥῦσαί με ἐκ τῶν ἐργαζομένων τὴν ἀνομίαν, καὶ ἐξ ἀνδρῶν αἱμάτων σῶσόν με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from the bloodthirsty men.
					\item[NIV] Deliver me from evildoers and save me from those who are after my blood.
					\item[NRSV] Deliver me from those who work evil; from the bloodthirsty save me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-59-3}

			For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַ֭צִּילֵנִי מִפֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וּֽמֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἐθήρευσαν τὴν ψυχήν μου, ἐπέθεντο ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ κραταιοί· οὔτε ἡ ἀνομία μου οὔτε ἡ ἁμαρτία μου, Κύριε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; The mighty gather themselves together against me: Not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] See how they lie in wait for me! Fierce men conspire against me for no offense or sin of mine, LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Even now they lie in wait for my life; the mighty stir up strife against me. For no transgression or sin of mine, O LORD,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-59-4}

			They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה אָֽרְב֡וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וּרוּ עָלַ֣י עַזִ֑ים לֹא־פִשְׁעִ֖י וְלֹא־חַטָּאתִ֣י יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄνευ ἀνομίας ἔδραμον καὶ κατεύθυνα· ἐξεγέρθητι εἰς συνάντησίν μου καὶ ἴδε,}
