					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They run and prepare themselves without my fault: Awake thou to help me, and behold.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 59:5} % *PSALMS-59-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-59-5}

			Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּֽלִי־עָ֭וֺן יְרוּצ֣וּן וְיִכּוֹנָ֑נוּ ע֖וּרָה לִקְרָאתִ֣י וּרְאֵה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ σύ, Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων, ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραήλ, πρόσχες τοῦ ἐπισκέψασθαι πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, μὴ οἰκτειρήσῃς πάντας τοὺς ἐργαζομένους τὴν ἀνομίαν. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 60} % *PSALMS-60
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-60}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 60:1} % *PSALMS-60-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-60-1}

			O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוּשַׁ֣ן עֵד֑וּת מִכְתָּ֖ם לְדָוִ֣ד לְלַמֵּֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὁ θεός, ἀπώσω ἡμᾶς καὶ καθεῖλες ἡμᾶς, ὠργίσθης καὶ οἰκτείρησας ἡμᾶς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to Shushan Eduth. Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand. O God thou hast cast us off, thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; oh restore us again.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A miktam of David. For teaching. When he fought Aram Naharaim and Aram Zobah, and when Joab returned and struck down twelve thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt. You have rejected us, God, and burst upon us; you have been angry—now restore us!
					\item[NRSV] O God, you have rejected us, broken our defenses; you have been angry; now restore us!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 60:2} % *PSALMS-60-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-60-2}

			Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּהַצּוֹת֨וֹ ׀ אֶ֥ת אֲרַ֣ם נַהֲרַיִם֮ וְאֶת־אֲרַ֪ם צ֫וֹבָ֥ה וַיָּ֤שָׁב יוֹאָ֗ב וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־אֱד֣וֹם בְּגֵיא־מֶ֑לַח שְׁנֵ֖ים עָשָׂ֣ר אָֽלֶף׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{συνέσεισας τὴν γῆν καὶ συνετάραξας αὐτήν· ἴασαι τὰ συντρίμματα αὐτῆς, ὅτι ἐσαλεύθησαν,}

					% % \item[AB ]

					\item[LXX] \gr{διαμενεῖ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ· ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθειαν αὐτοῦ τίς ἐκζητήσει αὐτῶν;}

		\paragraph{Psalms 62:1} % *PSALMS-62-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-62-1}

			Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־יְדוּת֗וּן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Οὐχὶ τῷ θεῷ ὑποταγήσεται ἡ ψυχή μου; παρ᾽ αὐτοῦ γὰρ τὸ σωτήριόν μου.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; after the manner of Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. My soul waiteth in silence for God only: From him cometh my salvation.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David. Truly my soul finds rest in God; my salvation comes from him.
					\item[NRSV] For God alone my soul waits in silence; from him comes my salvation.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַ֣ךְ אֶל־אֱ֭לֹהִים דּֽוּמִיָּ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ γὰρ αὐτὸς ὁ θεός μου καὶ σωτήρ μου, ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου· οὐ μὴ σαλευθῶ ἐπὶ πλεῖον.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He only is my rock and my salvation: He is my high tower; I shall not be greatly moved.
					\item[NIV] Truly he is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will never be shaken.
					\item[NRSV] He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I shall never be shaken.

			How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַךְ־ה֣וּא צ֭וּרִי וִֽישׁוּעָתִ֑י מִ֝שְׂגַּבִּ֗י לֹא־אֶמּ֥וֹט רַבָּֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕως πότε ἐπιτίθεσθε ἐπ᾽ ἄνθρωπον; φονεύετε πάντες ὡς τοίχῳ κεκλιμένῳ καὶ φραγμῷ ὠσμένῳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] How long will you assault me? Would all of you throw me down— this leaning wall, this tottering fence?
					\item[NRSV] How long will you assail a person, will you batter your victim, all of you, as you would a leaning wall, a tottering fence?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַד־אָ֤נָה ׀ תְּהֽוֹתְת֣וּ עַל אִישׁ֮ תְּרָצְּח֪וּ כֻ֫לְּכֶ֥ם כְּקִ֥יר נָט֑וּי גָּ֝דֵ֗ר הַדְּחוּיָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πλὴν τὴν τιμήν μου ἐβουλεύσαντο ἀπώσασθαι, ἔδραμον ἐν δίψει· τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν εὐλογοῦσαν, καὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν κατηρῶντο. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] Their only plan is to bring down a person of prominence. They take pleasure in falsehood; they bless with their mouths, but inwardly they curse. Selah

					\item[LXX] \gr{πλὴν τῷ θεῷ ὑποτάγηθι, ψυχή μου, ὅτι παρ᾽ αὐτοῦ ἡ ὑπομονή μου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ τὸ σωτήριόν μου καὶ ἡ δόξα μου· ὁ θεὸς τῆς βοηθείας μου, καὶ ἡ ἐλπίς μου ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐλπίσατε ἐπ᾽ αὐτόν, πᾶσα συναγωγὴ λαοῦ· ἐκχέετε ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν· ὁ θεὸς βοηθὸς ἡμῶν. διάψαλμα.}

			Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בִּטְח֘וּ ב֤וֹ בְכָל־עֵ֨ת ׀ עָ֗ם שִׁפְכֽוּ־לְפָנָ֥יו לְבַבְכֶ֑ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים מַחֲסֶה־לָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πλὴν μάταιοι οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ψευδεῖς οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐν ζυγοῖς τοῦ ἀδικῆσαι, αὐτοὶ ἐκ ματαιότητος ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] Those of low estate are but a breath, those of high estate are a delusion; in the balances they go up; they are together lighter than a breath.

					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ ἐλπίζετε ἐπὶ ἀδικίαν, καὶ ἐπὶ ἁρπάγματα μὴ ἐπιποθεῖτε· πλοῦτος ἐὰν ῥέῃ, μὴ προστίθεσθε καρδίαν}

					\item[NRSV] Put no confidence in extortion, and set no vain hopes on robbery; if riches increase, do not set your heart on them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַחַ֤ת ׀ דִּבֶּ֬ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים שְׁתַּֽיִם־ז֥וּ שָׁמָ֑עְתִּי כִּ֥י עֹ֝֗ז לֵאלֹהִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ σοῦ, κύριε, τὸ ἔλεος, ὅτι σὺ ἀποδώσεις ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] and steadfast love belongs to you, O Lord. For you repay to all according to their work.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 63} % *PSALMS-63
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-63}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 63:1} % *PSALMS-63-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-63-1}

			O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בִּ֝הְיוֹת֗וֹ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὁ θεὸς ὁ θεός μου, πρὸς σὲ ὀρθρίζω· ἐδίψησέν σοι ἡ ψυχή μου, ποσαπλῶς σοι ἡ σάρξ μου, ἐν γῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἀβάτῳ καὶ ἀνύδρῳ,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee: My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.
					\item[NIV] A psalm of David. When he was in the Desert of Judah. You, God, are my God, earnestly I seek you; I thirst for you, my whole being longs for you, in a dry and parched land where there is no water.
					\item[NRSV] O God, you are my God, I seek you, my soul thirsts for you; my flesh faints for you, as in a dry and weary land where there is no water.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 63:2} % *PSALMS-63-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-63-2}

			To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ אֵלִ֥י אַתָּ֗ה אֲ‍ֽשַׁחֲ֫רֶ֥ךָּ צָמְאָ֬ה לְךָ֨ ׀ נַפְשִׁ֗י כָּמַ֣הּ לְךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י בְּאֶֽרֶץ־צִיָּ֖ה וְעָיֵ֣ף בְּלִי־מָֽיִם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὕτως ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ὤφθην σοι, τοῦ ἰδεῖν τὴν δύναμίν σου καὶ τὴν δόξαν σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] So have I looked upon thee in the sanctuary, To see thy power and thy glory.
					\item[NIV] I have seen you in the sanctuary and beheld your power and your glory.
					\item[NRSV] So I have looked upon you in the sanctuary, beholding your power and glory.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι κρεῖσσον τὸ ἔλεός σου ὑπὲρ ζωάς· τὰ χείλη μου ἐπαινέσουσίν σε.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[LXX] \gr{οὕτως εὐλογήσω σε ἐν τῇ ζωῇ μου, ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἀρῶ τὰς χεῖρὰς μου.}

			\label{PSALMS-64-1}

			Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

			\begin{versebox}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; preserve my life from the dread enemy.

		\paragraph{Psalms 64:5} % *PSALMS-64-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-64-5}

			They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לִיר֣וֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֣ים תָּ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם יֹ֝רֻ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκραταίωσαν ἑαυτοῖς λόγον πονηρόν, διηγήσαντο τοῦ κρύψαι παγίδας· εἶπαν Τίς ὄψεται αὐτούς;}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They encourage themselves in an evil purpose; They commune of laying snares privily; They say, Who will see them?
					\item[NIV] They encourage each other in evil plans, they talk about hiding their snares; they say, “Who will see it?”
					\item[NRSV] They hold fast to their evil purpose; they talk of laying snares secretly, thinking, “Who can see us?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 64:6} % *PSALMS-64-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-64-6}

			They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְחַזְּקוּ־לָ֨מוֹ ׀ דָּ֘בָ֤ר רָ֗ע יְֽ֭סַפְּרוּ לִטְמ֣וֹן מוֹקְשִׁ֑ים אָ֝מְר֗וּ מִ֣י יִרְאֶה־לָּֽמוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξηραύνησαν ἀνομίαν, ἐξέλιπον ἐξεραυνῶντες ἐξεραυνήσει· προσελεύσεται ἄνθρωπος καὶ καρδία βαθεῖα,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They search out iniquities; We have accomplished, say they, a diligent search: And the inward thought and the heart of every one is deep.
					\item[NIV] They plot injustice and say, “We have devised a perfect plan!” Surely the human mind and heart are cunning.
					\item[NRSV] Who can search out our crimes? We have thought out a cunningly conceived plot.” For the human heart and mind are deep.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 64:7} % *PSALMS-64-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-64-7}

			But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַֽחְפְּֽשׂוּ־עוֹלֹ֗ת תַּ֭מְנוּ חֵ֣פֶשׂ מְחֻפָּ֑שׂ וְקֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ὑψωθήσεται ὁ θεός. βέλος νηπίων ἐγενήθησαν αἱ πληγαὶ αὐτῶν,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But God will shoot at them; With an arrow suddenly shall they be wounded.
					\item[NIV] But God will shoot them with his arrows; they will suddenly be struck down.
					\item[NRSV] But God will shoot his arrow at them; they will be wounded suddenly.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---

			So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיֹּרֵ֗ם אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם הָ֝י֗וּ מַכּוֹתָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐξουθένησαν αὐτὸν αἱ γλῶσσαι αὐτῶν. ἐταράχθησαν πάντες οἱ θεωροῦντες αὐτούς,}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] He will turn their own tongues against them and bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.
					\item[NRSV] Because of their tongue he will bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake with horror.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---

			And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיַּכְשִׁיל֣וּהוּ עָלֵ֣ימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם יִ֝תְנֹדֲד֗וּ כָּל־רֹ֥אֵה בָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐφοβήθη πᾶς ἄνθρωπος· καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν τὰ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ τὰ ποιήματα αὐτοῦ συνῆκαν.}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-64-10}

			The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיִּֽירְא֗וּ כָּל־אָ֫דָ֥ם וַ֭יַּגִּידוּ פֹּ֥עַל אֱלֹהִ֗ים וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥הוּ הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐφρανθήσεται δίκαιος ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ, καὶ ἐλπιεῖ ἐπ᾽ αὐτόν· καὶ ἐπαινεσθήσονται πάντες οἱ εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] The righteous will rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in him; all the upright in heart will glory in him!
					\item[NRSV] Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in him. Let all the upright in heart glory.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 65} % *PSALMS-65

		\label{PSALMS-65}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 65:1} % *PSALMS-65-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-65-1}

			Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָוִ֥ד שִֽׁיר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Σοὶ πρέπει ὕμνος, ὁ θεός, ἐν Σιών, καὶ σοὶ ἀποδοθήσεται εὐχή.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm. A Song of David. Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion; And unto thee shall the vow be performed.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. A psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits you, our God, in Zion; to you our vows will be fulfilled.
					\item[NRSV] Praise is due to you, O God, in Zion; and to you shall vows be performed,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-65-2}

			O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְךָ֤ דֻֽמִיָּ֬ה תְהִלָּ֓ה אֱלֹ֘הִ֥ים בְּצִיּ֑וֹן וּ֝לְךָ֗ יְשֻׁלַּם־נֶֽדֶר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰσάκουσον προσευχῆς μου, πρὸς σὲ πᾶσα σὰρξ ἥξει.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O thou that hearest prayer, Unto thee shall all flesh come.
					\item[NIV] You who answer prayer, to you all people will come.
					\item[NRSV] O you who answer prayer! To you all flesh shall come.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שֹׁמֵ֥עַ תְּפִלָּ֑ה עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ כָּל־בָּשָׂ֥ר יָבֹֽאוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{λόγοι ἀνόμων ὑπερηδυνάμωσαν ἡμᾶς, καὶ τὰς ἀσεβείας ἡμῶν σὺ ἱλάσῃ.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Iniquities prevail against me: As for our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.
					\item[NIV] When we were overwhelmed by sins, you forgave our transgressions.
					\item[NRSV] When deeds of iniquity overwhelm us, you forgive our transgressions.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\label{PSALMS-65-4}

			Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{דִּבְרֵ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹת גָּ֣בְרוּ מֶ֑נִּי פְּ֝שָׁעֵ֗ינוּ אַתָּ֥ה תְכַפְּרֵֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μακάριος ὃν ἐξελέξω καὶ προσελάβου, κατασκηνώσει ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς σου. πλησθησόμεθα ἐν τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς τοῦ οἴκου σου· ἅγιος ὁ ναός σου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, That he may dwell in thy courts: We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, Thy holy temple.
					\item[NIV] Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.
					\item[NRSV] Happy are those whom you choose and bring near to live in your courts. We shall be satisfied with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 65:5} % *PSALMS-65-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-65-5}

			By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַשְׁרֵ֤י ׀ תִּֽבְחַ֣ר וּתְקָרֵב֮ יִשְׁכֹּ֪ן חֲצֵ֫רֶ֥יךָ נִ֭שְׂבְּעָה בְּט֣וּב בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{θαυμαστὸς ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ. ἐπάκουσον ἡμῶν, ὁ θεὸς ὁ σωτὴρ ἡμῶν, ἡ ἐλπὶς πάντων τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] By terrible things thou wilt answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation, Thou that art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of them that are afar off upon the sea:
					\item[NIV] You answer us with awesome and righteous deeds, God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,
					\item[NRSV] By awesome deeds you answer us with deliverance, O God of our salvation; you are the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-65-6}

			Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נ֤וֹרָא֨וֹת ׀ בְּצֶ֣דֶק תַּ֭עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ מִבְטָ֥ח כָּל־קַצְוֵי־אֶ֝֗רֶץ וְיָ֣ם רְחֹקִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἑτοιμάζων ὄρη ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι σου, περιεζωσμένος ἐν δυναστίᾳ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who by his strength setteth fast the mountains, Being girded about with might;
					\item[NIV] who formed the mountains by your power, having armed yourself with strength,
					\item[NRSV] By your strength you established the mountains; you are girded with might.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מֵכִ֣ין הָרִ֣ים בְּכֹח֑וֹ נֶ֝אְזָ֗ר בִּגְבוּרָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ συνταράσσων τὸ ὕδωρ τῆς θαλάσσης, ἤχους κυμάτων αὐτῆς. ταραχθήσονται τὰ ἔθνη}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ φοβηθήσονται οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὰ πέρατα ἀπὸ τῶν σημείων σου· ἐξόδους πρωίας καὶ ἑσπέρας τέρψεις.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

					\item[NRSV] Those who live at earth’s farthest bounds are awed by your signs; you make the gateways of the morning and the evening shout for joy.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיִּ֤ירְא֨וּ ׀ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י קְ֭צָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶ֑יךָ מ֤וֹצָֽאֵי־בֹ֖קֶר וָעֶ֣רֶב תַּרְנִֽין׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπεσκέψω τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐμέθυσας αὐτήν, ἐπλήθυνας τοῦ πλουτίσαι αὐτήν· ὁ ποταμὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπληρώθη ὑδάτων· ἡτοίμασας τὴν τροφὴν αὐτῶν, ὅτι οὕτως ἡ ἑτοιμασία σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[LXX] \gr{εἴπατε τῷ θεῷ Ὡς φοβερὰ τὰ ἔργα σου· ἐν τῷ πλήθει τῆς δυνάμεώς σου ψεύσονταί σε οἱ ἐχθροί σου·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{πᾶσα ἡ γῆ προσκυνησάτωσάν σοι καὶ ψαλάτωσάν σοι, ψαλάτωσαν τῷ ὀνόματί σου. διάψαλμα.}

			God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογήσαι ἡμᾶς ὁ θεός, καὶ φοβηθήτωσαν αὐτὸν πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] God will bless us; And all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
					\item[NIV] May God bless us still, so that all the ends of the earth will fear him.
					\item[NRSV] May God continue to bless us; let all the ends of the earth revere him.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 68:1} % *PSALMS-68-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-68-1}

			Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לְדָוִ֗ד מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἀναστήτω ὁ θεός, καὶ διασκορπισθήτωσαν οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ φυγέτωσαν οἱ μισοῦντες αὐτὸν ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; A Psalm of David, a Song. Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered; Let them also that hate him flee before him.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. A song. May God arise, may his enemies be scattered; may his foes flee before him.
					\item[NRSV] Let God rise up, let his enemies be scattered; let those who hate him flee before him.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 68:2} % *PSALMS-68-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-68-2}

			As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אוֹיְבָ֑יו וְיָנ֥וּסוּ מְ֝שַׂנְאָ֗יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡς ἐκλείπει καπνὸς ἐκλιπέτωσαν· ὡς τήκεται κηρὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου πυρός, οὕτως ἀπόλοιντο οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ θεοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
					\item[NIV] May you blow them away like smoke— as wax melts before the fire, may the wicked perish before God.
					\item[NRSV] As smoke is driven away, so drive them away; as wax melts before the fire, let the wicked perish before God.

			But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כְּהִנְדֹּ֥ף עָשָׁ֗ן תִּ֫נְדֹּ֥ף כְּהִמֵּ֣ס דּ֭וֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־אֵ֑שׁ יֹאבְד֥וּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ οἱ δίκαιοι εὐφρανθήτωσαν, διάψαλμα. ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ, τερφθήτωσαν ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ.}

					\item[NRSV] But let the righteous be joyful; let them exult before God; let them be jubilant with joy.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾄσατε τῷ θεῷ, ψάλατε τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ· ὁδοποιήσατε τῷ ἐπιβεβηκότι ἐπὶ δυσμῶν· Κύριος ὄνομα αὐτῷ· καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ.}

					\item[NRSV] Sing to God, sing praises to his name; lift up a song to him who rides upon the clouds— his name is the LORD— be exultant before him.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ταραχθήσονται ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ, τοῦ πατρὸς τῶν ὀρφανῶν καὶ κριτοῦ τῶν χηρῶν· ὁ θεὸς ἐν τόπῳ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεὸς κατοικίζει μονοτρόπους ἐν οἴκῳ, ἐξάγων πεπεδημένους ἐν ἀνδρίᾳ, ὁμοίως τοὺς παραπικραίνοντας, τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν τάφοις.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπιτίμησον τοῖς θηρίοις τοῦ καλάμου· ἡ συναγωγὴ τῶν ταύρων ἐν ταῖς δαμάλεσιν τῶν λαῶν τοῦ μὴ ἀποκλεισθῆναι τοὺς δεδοκιμασμένους τῷ ἀργυρίῳ· διασκόρπισον ἔθνη τὰ τοὺς πολέμους θέλοντα.}

			\label{PSALMS-69-1}

			Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ עַֽל־שׁוֹשַׁנִּ֬ים לְדָוִֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Σῶσόν με, ὁ θεός, ὅτι εἰσήλθοσαν ὕδατα ἕως ψυχῆς μου.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] For the director of music. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.
					\item[NRSV] Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---

			I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֤י בָ֖אוּ מַ֣יִם עַד־נָֽפֶשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐνεπάγην εἰς ἰλὺν βυθοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὑπόστασις· ἦλθον εἰς τὰ βάθη τῆς θαλάσσης, καὶ καταιγὶς κατεπόντισέν με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
					\item[NIV] I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.
					\item[NRSV] I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold; I have come into deep waters, and the flood sweeps over me.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-69-3}

			I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{טָבַ֤עְתִּי ׀ בִּיוֵ֣ן מְ֭צוּלָה וְאֵ֣ין מָעֳמָ֑ד בָּ֥אתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי־מַ֝֗יִם וְשִׁבֹּ֥לֶת שְׁטָפָֽתְנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκοπίασα κράζων, ἐβραγχίασεν ὁ λάρυγξ μου, ἐξέλιπον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐγγίζειν ἐπὶ τὸν θεόν μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I am weary with my crying; my throat is dried: Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
					\item[NIV] I am worn out calling for help; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
					\item[NRSV] I am weary with my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes grow dim with waiting for my God.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 69:4} % *PSALMS-69-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-69-4}

			They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָגַ֣עְתִּי בְקָרְאִי֮ נִחַ֪ר גְּר֫וֹנִ֥י כָּל֥וּ עֵינַ֑י מְ֝יַחֵ֗ל לֵאלֹהָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπληθύνθησαν ὑπὲρ τὰς τρίχας τῆς κεφαλῆς μου οἱ μισοῦντές με δωρεάν· ἐκραταιώθησαν οἱ ἐχθροί μου οἱ ἐκδιώκοντές με ἀδίκως· ἃ οὐχ ἥρπασα τότε ἀπετίννυον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: That which I took not away I have to restore.
					\item[NIV] Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.
					\item[NRSV] More in number than the hairs of my head are those who hate me without cause; many are those who would destroy me, my enemies who accuse me falsely. What I did not steal must I now restore?

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-69-5}

			O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רַבּ֤וּ ׀ מִשַּׂעֲר֣וֹת רֹאשִׁי֮ שֹׂנְאַ֪י חִ֫נָּ֥ם עָצְמ֣וּ מַ֭צְמִיתַי אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־גָ֝זַ֗לְתִּי אָ֣ז אָשִֽׁיב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεὸς, σὺ ἔγνως τὴν ἀφροσύνην μου, καὶ αἱ πλημμελίαι μου ἀπὸ σοῦ οὐκ ἐκρύβησαν.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O God, thou knowest my foolishness; And my sins are not hid from thee.
					\item[NIV] You, God, know my folly; my guilt is not hidden from you.
					\item[NRSV] O God, you know my folly; the wrongs I have done are not hidden from you.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 69:6} % *PSALMS-69-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-69-6}

			Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁמוֹתַ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא־נִכְחָֽדוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ αἰσχυνθείησαν ἐπ᾽ ἐμοὶ οἱ ὑπομένοντές σε, Κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων· μὴ ἐντραπείησαν ἐπ᾽ ἐμοὶ οἱ ζητοῦντές σε, ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Lord, the LORD Almighty, may those who hope in you not be disgraced because of me; God of Israel, may those who seek you not be put to shame because of me.
					\item[NRSV] Do not let those who hope in you be put to shame because of me, O Lord GOD of hosts; do not let those who seek you be dishonored because of me, O God of Israel.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 69:7} % *PSALMS-69-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-69-7}

			Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַל־יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ בִ֨י ׀ קֹוֶיךָ֮ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֗ה צְבָ֫א֥וֹת אַל־יִכָּ֣לְמוּ בִ֣י מְבַקְשֶׁ֑יךָ אֱ֝לֹהֵ֗י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἕνεκα σοῦ ὑπήνεγκα ὀνειδισμόν, ἐκάλυψεν ἐντροπὴ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπηλλοτριωμένος ἐγενήθην τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου, καὶ ξένος τοῖς υἱοῖς τῆς μητρός μου·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ οἴκου σου καταφάγεταί με, καὶ οἱ ὀνειδισμοὶ τῶν ὀνειδιζόντων σε ἐπέπεσαν ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{κατ᾽ ἐμοῦ ἠδολέσχουν οἱ καθήμενοι ἐν πύλῃ, καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ ἔψαλλον οἱ πίνοντες τὸν οἶνον.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{σῶσόν με ἀπὸ πηλοῦ, ἵνα μὴ ἐνπαγῶ· ῥυσθείην ἐκ τῶν μισούντων με καὶ ἐκ τοῦ βάθους τῶν ὑδάτων.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{μή με καταποντισάτω καταιγὶς ὕδατος, μηδὲ καταπιέτω με βυθός, μηδὲ συνσχέτω ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ φρέαρ στόμα αὐτοῦ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰσάκουσόν μου, Κύριε, ὅτι χρηστὸν τὸ ἔλεός σου· κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν οἰκτειρμῶν σου ἐπίβλεψον ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ·}

					\item[NRSV] Answer me, O LORD, for your steadfast love is good; according to your abundant mercy, turn to me.

					\item[LXX] \gr{σὺ γὰρ γινώσκεις τὸν ὀνειδισμόν μου καὶ τὴν αἰσχύνην μου καὶ τὴν ἐντροπήν μου· ἐναντίον σου πάντες οἱ θλίβοντές με.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

			\label{PSALMS-69-20}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִ֣י וּ֭בָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִ֑י נֶ֝גְדְּךָ֗ כָּל־צוֹרְרָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὀνειδισμὸν προσεδόκησεν ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ ταλαιπωρίαν· καὶ ὑπέμεινα συνλυπούμενον, καὶ οὐχ ὑπῆρξεν, καὶ παρακαλοῦντα, καὶ οὐχ εὗρον.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: And I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.

					\item[NRSV] Insults have broken my heart, so that I am in despair. I looked for pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἔδωκαν εἰς τὸ βρῶμά μου χολήν, καὶ εἰς τὴν δίψαν μου ἐπότισάν με ὄξος.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] They gave me poison for food, and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בְּבָרוּתִ֣י רֹ֑אשׁ וְ֝לִצְמָאִ֗י יַשְׁק֥וּנִי חֹֽמֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{γενηθήτω ἡ τράπεζα αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν εἰς παγίδα, καὶ εἰς ἀνταπόδοσιν καὶ εἰς σκάνδαλον·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 70} % *PSALMS-70
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-70}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 70:1} % *PSALMS-70-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-70-1}

			MAKE HASTE, O GOD, TO DELIVER ME; MAKE HASTE TO HELP ME, O LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὁ θεός, εἰς τὴν βοήθειάν μου πρόσχες·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David; to bring to remembrance. Make haste, O God, to deliver me; Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of David. A petition. Hasten, O God, to save me; come quickly, LORD, to help me.
					\item[NRSV] Be pleased, O God, to deliver me. O LORD, make haste to help me!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 70:2} % *PSALMS-70-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-70-2}

			Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָֽׁה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰσχυνθείησαν καὶ ἐντραπείησαν οἱ ζητοῦντές μου τὴν ψυχήν, ἀποστραφείησαν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ καταισχυνθείησαν οἱ βουλόμενοί μοι κακά·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let them be put to shame and confounded That seek after my soul: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.
					\item[NIV] May those who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
					\item[NRSV] Let those be put to shame and confusion who seek my life. Let those be turned back and brought to dishonor who desire to hurt me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 70:3} % *PSALMS-70-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-70-3}

			Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀποστραφείησαν παραυτίκα αἰσχυνόμενοι οἱ λέγοντές μοι Εὖγε εὖγε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say, Aha, aha.
					\item[NIV] May those who say to me, “Aha! Aha!” turn back because of their shame.
					\item[NRSV] Let those who say, “Aha, Aha!” turn back because of their shame.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 70:4} % *PSALMS-70-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-70-4}

			Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָ֭שׁוּבוּ עַל־עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָ֝אֹמְרִ֗ים הֶ֘אָ֥ח ׀ הֶאָֽח׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν καὶ εὐφρανθήτωσαν ἐπὶ σοὶ πάντες οἱ ζητοῦντές σε, καὶ λεγέτωσαν διὰ παντός Μεγαλυνθήτω ὁ θεός, οἱ ἀγαπῶντες τὸ σωτήριόν σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee; And let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
					\item[NIV] But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who long for your saving help always say, “The LORD is great!”
					\item[NRSV] Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation say evermore, “God is great!”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 70:5} % *PSALMS-70-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-70-5}

			But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ ׀ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל־מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ πτωχὸς καὶ πένης· ὁ θεός, βοήθησόν μοι· βοηθός μου καὶ ῥύστης μου εἶ σύ· Κύριε, μὴ χρονίσῃς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But I am poor and needy; Make haste unto me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; O Jehovah, make no tarrying.
					\item[NIV] But as for me, I am poor and needy; come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; LORD, do not delay.
					\item[NRSV] But I am poor and needy; hasten to me, O God! You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 71} % *PSALMS-71
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-71}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 71:1} % *PSALMS-71-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-1}

			In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּךָֽ־יְהוָ֥ה חָסִ֑יתִי אַל־אֵב֥וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τῷ Δαυείδ, υἱῶν Ἰωναδὰβ καὶ τῶν πρώτων αἰχμαλωτισθέντων. Ὁ θεὸς, ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισα, μὴ καταισχυνθείην εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge: Let me never be put to shame.
					\item[NIV] In you, LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
					\item[NRSV] In you, O LORD, I take refuge; let me never be put to shame.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 71:2} % *PSALMS-71-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-2}

			Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֗ תַּצִּילֵ֥נִי וּֽתְפַלְּטֵ֑נִי הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אָ֝זְנְךָ֗ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου ῥῦσαί με καὶ ἐξελοῦ με, κλῖνον πρὸς μὲ τὸ οὖς σου καὶ σῶσόν με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me: Bow down thine ear unto me, and save me.
					\item[NIV] In your righteousness, rescue me and deliver me; turn your ear to me and save me.
					\item[NRSV] In your righteousness deliver me and rescue me; incline your ear to me and save me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 71:3} % *PSALMS-71-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-3}

			Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י ׀ לְצ֥וּר מָע֡וֹן לָב֗וֹא תָּמִ֗יד צִוִּ֥יתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־סַלְעִ֖י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָֽתָּה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{γενοῦ μοι εἰς θεὸν ὑπερασπιστήν, εἰς τόπον ὀχυρὸν τοῦ σῶσαί με· ὅτι στερέωμά μου καὶ καταφυγή μου εἶ σύ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Be thou to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: Thou hast given commandment to save me; For thou art my rock and my fortress.
					\item[NIV] Be my rock of refuge, to which I can always go; give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
					\item[NRSV] Be to me a rock of refuge, a strong fortress, to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 71:4} % *PSALMS-71-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-4}

			Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י פַּ֭לְּטֵנִי מִיַּ֣ד רָשָׁ֑ע מִכַּ֖ף מְעַוֵּ֣ל וְחוֹמֵץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεός, ῥῦσαί με ἐκ χειρὸς ἁμαρτωλοῦ, ἐκ χειρὸς παρανομοῦντος καὶ ἀδικοῦντος·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Rescue me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
					\item[NIV] Deliver me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of those who are evil and cruel.
					\item[NRSV] Rescue me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and cruel.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-5}

			For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה תִקְוָתִ֑י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְ֝הוִ֗ה מִבְטַחִ֥י מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι σὺ εἶ ἡ ὑπομονή μου, κύριε· Κύριος ἡ ἐλπίς μου ἐκ νεότητός μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou art my hope, O Lord Jehovah: Thou art my trust from my youth.
					\item[NIV] For you have been my hope, Sovereign LORD, my confidence since my youth.
					\item[NRSV] For you, O Lord, are my hope, my trust, O LORD, from my youth.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 71:6} % *PSALMS-71-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-6}

			By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עָלֶ֤יךָ ׀ נִסְמַ֬כְתִּי מִבֶּ֗טֶן מִמְּעֵ֣י אִ֭מִּי אַתָּ֣ה גוֹזִ֑י בְּךָ֖ תְהִלָּתִ֣י תָמִֽיד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπὶ σὲ ἐπεστηρίχθην ἀπὸ γαστρός, ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου σύ μου εἶ σκεπαστής· ἐν σοὶ ἡ ὕμνησίς μου διὰ παντός.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] By thee have I been holden up from the womb; Thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: My praise shall be continually of thee.
					\item[NIV] From birth I have relied on you; you brought me forth from my mother’s womb. I will ever praise you.
					\item[NRSV] Upon you I have leaned from my birth; it was you who took me from my mother’s womb. My praise is continually of you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-7}

			I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כְּ֭מוֹפֵת הָיִ֣יתִי לְרַבִּ֑ים וְ֝אַתָּ֗ה מַֽחֲסִי־עֹֽז׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡσεὶ τέρας ἐγενήθην τοῖς πολλοῖς, καὶ σὺ βοηθὸς κραταιός.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I am as a wonder unto many; But thou art my strong refuge.
					\item[NIV] I have become a sign to many; you are my strong refuge.
					\item[NRSV] I have been like a portent to many, but you are my strong refuge.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-8}

			Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִמָּ֣לֵא פִ֭י תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ כָּל־הַ֝יּ֗וֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πληρωθήτω τὸ στόμα μου αἰνέσεως, ὅπως ὑμνήσω τὴν δόξαν σου, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν μεγαλοπρεπίαν σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] My mouth shall be filled with thy praise, And with thy honor all the day.
					\item[NIV] My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.
					\item[NRSV] My mouth is filled with your praise, and with your glory all day long.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-9}

			Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַֽל־תַּ֭שְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵ֣ת זִקְנָ֑ה כִּכְל֥וֹת כֹּ֝חִ֗י אַֽל־תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ ἀπορίψῃς με εἰς καιρὸν γήρους, ἐν τῷ ἐκλιπεῖν τὴν ἰσχύν μου μὴ ἐνκαταλίπῃς με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Cast me not off in the time of old age; Forsake me not when my strength faileth.
					\item[NIV] Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.
					\item[NRSV] Do not cast me off in the time of old age; do not forsake me when my strength is spent.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-10}

			For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־אָמְר֣וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י נוֹעֲצ֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι εἶπαν οἱ ἐχθροί μου ἐμοί, καὶ οἱ φυλάσσοντες τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐβουλεύσαντο ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For mine enemies speak concerning me; And they that watch for my soul take counsel together,
					\item[NIV] For my enemies speak against me; those who wait to kill me conspire together.
					\item[NRSV] For my enemies speak concerning me, and those who watch for my life consult together.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-11}

			Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

					\item[LXX] \gr{λέγοντες Ὁ θεὸς ἐνκατέλιπεν αὐτόν· καταδιώξατε καὶ καταλάβετε αὐτόν, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ῥυόμενος.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Saying, God hath forsaken him: Pursue and take him; for there is none to deliver.
					\item[NIV] They say, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for no one will rescue him.”
					\item[NRSV] They say, “Pursue and seize that person whom God has forsaken, for there is no one to deliver.”

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 71:12} % *PSALMS-71-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-71-12}

			O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱ֭לֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεός, μὴ μακρύνῃς ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ,}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me.
					\item[NIV] Do not be far from me, my God; come quickly, God, to help me.
					\item[NRSV] O God, do not be far from me; O my God, make haste to help me!

		% % ---

			Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ יִכְלוּ֮ שֹׂטְנֵ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יַֽעֲט֣וּ חֶ֭רְפָּה וּכְלִמָּ֑ה מְ֝בַקְשֵׁ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰσχυνθήτωσαν καὶ ἐκλιπέτωσαν οἱ ἐνδιαβάλλοντες τὴν ψυχήν μου, περιβαλέσθωσαν αἰσχύνην καὶ ἐντροπὴν οἱ ζητοῦντες τὰ κακά μοι.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] May my accusers perish in shame; may those who want to harm me be covered with scorn and disgrace.
					\item[NRSV] Let my accusers be put to shame and consumed; let those who seek to hurt me be covered with scorn and disgrace.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ διὰ παντὸς ἐλπιῶ, καὶ προσθήσω ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν αἴνεσίν σου.}

					\item[NIV] As for me, I will always have hope; I will praise you more and more.

					\item[LXX] \gr{τὸ στόμα μου ἐξαγγελεῖ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν σωτηρίαν σου, ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνων πραγματίας.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰσελεύσομαι ἐν δυναστίᾳ Κυρίου· Κύριε, μνησθήσομαι τῆς δικαιοσύνης σου μόνου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἕως γήρους καὶ πρεσβείου· ὁ θεός, μὴ ἐνκαταλίπῃς με ἕως ἂν ἀπαγγείλω τὸν βραχίονά σου πάσῃ τῇ γενεᾷ τῇ ἐρχομένῃ, τὴν δυναστίαν σου}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἔδειξάς μοι θλίψεις πολλὰς καὶ κακά, καὶ ἐπιστρέψας ἐζωοποίησάς με, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀβύσσων τῆς γῆς πάλιν ἀνήγαγές με,}

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ γὰρ ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν σκεύει ψαλμοῦ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου, ψαλῶ σοι, ὁ θεός, ἐν κιθάρᾳ, ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 72} % *PSALMS-72
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-72}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 72:1} % *PSALMS-72-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-72-1}

			Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לִשְׁלֹמֹ֨ה ׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ תֵּ֑ן וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ לְבֶן־מֶֽלֶךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Εἰς Σαλομών. Ὁ θεός, τὸ κρίμα σου τῷ βασιλεῖ δός, καὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου τῷ υἱῷ τοῦ βασιλέως,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of Solomon. Give the king thy judgments, O God, And thy righteousness unto the king's son.
					\item[NIV] Of Solomon. Endow the king with your justice, O God, the royal son with your righteousness.
					\item[NRSV] Give the king your justice, O God, and your righteousness to a king’s son.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 72:2} % *PSALMS-72-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-72-2}

			He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ κρινεῖ τοὺς πτωχοὺς τοῦ λαοῦ· καὶ σώσεις τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν πενήτων, καὶ ταπεινώσει συκοφάντην·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐρύσατο πτωχὸν ἐκ χειρὸς δυνάστου, καὶ πένητα ᾧ οὐχ ὑπῆρχεν βοηθός·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ζήσεται καὶ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ χρυσίου τῆς Ἀραβίας, καὶ προσεύξονται περὶ αὐτοῦ διὰ παντός, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν εὐλογήσουσιν αὐτόν.}

			There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהִ֤י פִסַּת־בַּ֨ר ׀ בָּאָרֶץ֮ בְּרֹ֪אשׁ הָ֫רִ֥ים יִרְעַ֣שׁ כַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן פִּרְי֑וֹ וְיָצִ֥יצוּ מֵ֝עִ֗יר כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔσται στήριγμα ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐπ᾽ ἄκρων τῶν ὀρέων· ὑπεραρθήσεται ὑπὲρ τὸν Λίβανον ὁ καρπὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐξανθήσουσιν ἐκ πόλεως ὡσεὶ χόρτος τῆς γῆς.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] There shall be abundance of grain in the earth upon the top of the mountains; The fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: And they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
					\item[NIV] May grain abound throughout the land; on the tops of the hills may it sway. May the crops flourish like Lebanon and thrive like the grass of the field.
					\item[NRSV] May there be abundance of grain in the land; may it wave on the tops of the mountains; may its fruit be like Lebanon; and may people blossom in the cities like the grass of the field.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-72-17}

			His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהִ֤י שְׁמ֨וֹ לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם לִפְנֵי־שֶׁמֶשׁ֮ יִנּ֪וֹן שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ וְיִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֑וֹ כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם יְאַשְּׁרֽוּהוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔστω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ εὐλογημένον εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, πρὸ τοῦ ἡλίου διαμενεῖ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ· καὶ εὐλογηθήσονται ἐν αὐτῷ πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς, πάντα τὰ ἔθνη μακαριοῦσιν αὐτόν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] His name shall endure for ever; His name shall be continued as long as the sun: And men shall be blessed in him; All nations shall call him happy.
					\item[NIV] May his name endure forever; may it continue as long as the sun. Then all nations will be blessed through him, and they will call him blessed.
					\item[NRSV] May his name endure forever, his fame continue as long as the sun. May all nations be blessed in him; may they pronounce him happy.

					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογητὸς Κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραήλ, ὁ ποιῶν θαυμάσια μόνος,}

					\item[NIV] Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
					\item[NRSV] Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who alone does wondrous things.

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ εὐλογητὸν τὸ ὄνομα τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος· καὶ πληρωθήσεται τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ. γένοιτο, γένοιτο.}

					\item[NRSV] Blessed be his glorious name forever; may his glory fill the whole earth. Amen and Amen.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 73} % *PSALMS-73
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-73}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 73:1} % *PSALMS-73-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-1}

			Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אַ֤ךְ ט֭וֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֱלֹהִ֗ים לְבָרֵ֥י לֵבָֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ. Ὡς ἀγαθὸς τῷ Ἰσραὴλ ὁ θεός, τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, Even to such as are pure in heart.
					\item[NIV] A psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
					\item[NRSV] Truly God is good to the upright, to those who are pure in heart.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 73:2} % *PSALMS-73-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-2}

			But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַאֲנִ֗י כִּ֭מְעַט נָטָ֣יוּ רַגְלָ֑י כְּ֝אַ֗יִן שֻׁפְּכ֥וּ אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐμοῦ δὲ παρὰ μικρὸν ἐσαλεύθησαν οἱ πόδες, παρ᾽ ὀλίγον ἐξεχύθη τὰ διαβήματά μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipped.
					\item[NIV] But as for me, my feet had almost slipped; I had nearly lost my foothold.
					\item[NRSV] But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 73:3} % *PSALMS-73-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-3}

			For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־קִ֭נֵּאתִי בַּֽהוֹלְלִ֑ים שְׁל֖וֹם רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֶרְאֶֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐζήλωσα ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀνόμοις, εἰρήνην ἁμαρτωλῶν θεωρῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For I was envious at the arrogant, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
					\item[NIV] For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
					\item[NRSV] For I was envious of the arrogant; I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-4}

			For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י אֵ֖ין חַרְצֻבּ֥וֹת לְמוֹתָ֗ם וּבָרִ֥יא אוּלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀνάνευσις ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ αὐτῶν, καὶ στερέωμα ἐν τῇ μάστιγι αὐτῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For there are no pangs in their death; But their strength is firm.
					\item[NIV] They have no struggles; their bodies are healthy and strong.
					\item[NRSV] For they have no pain; their bodies are sound and sleek.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 73:5} % *PSALMS-73-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-5}

			They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בַּעֲמַ֣ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ אֵינֵ֑מוֹ וְעִם־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א יְנֻגָּֽעוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν κόποις ἀνθρώπων οὐκ εἰσίν, καὶ μετὰ ἀνθρώπων οὐ μαστιγωθήσονται.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They are not in trouble as other men; Neither are they plagued like other men.
					\item[NIV] They are free from common human burdens; they are not plagued by human ills.
					\item[NRSV] They are not in trouble as others are; they are not plagued like other people.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 73:6} % *PSALMS-73-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-6}

			Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לָ֭כֵן עֲנָקַ֣תְמוֹ גַאֲוָ֑ה יַעֲטָף־שִׁ֝֗ית חָמָ֥ס לָֽמוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{διὰ τοῦτο ἐκράτησεν αὐτοὺς ἡ ὑπερηφανία, περιεβάλοντο ἀδικίαν καὶ ἀσέβειαν αὐτῶν.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; Violence covereth them as a garment.
					\item[NIV] Therefore pride is their necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.
					\item[NRSV] Therefore pride is their necklace; violence covers them like a garment.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 73:7} % *PSALMS-73-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-7}

			Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָ֭צָא מֵחֵ֣לֶב עֵינֵ֑מוֹ עָ֝בְר֗וּ מַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת לֵבָֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξελεύσεται ὡς ἐκ στέατος ἡ ἀδικία αὐτῶν, διῆλθον εἰς διάθεσιν καρδίας·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Their eyes stand out with fatness: They have more than heart could wish.
					\item[NIV] From their callous hearts comes iniquity; their evil imaginations have no limits.
					\item[NRSV] Their eyes swell out with fatness; their hearts overflow with follies.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-8}

			They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָמִ֤יקוּ ׀ וִידַבְּר֣וּ בְרָ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁק מִמָּר֥וֹם יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{διενοήθησαν καὶ ἐλάλησαν ἐν πονηρίᾳ, ἀδικίαν εἰς τὸ ὕψος ἐλάλησαν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression: They speak loftily.
					\item[NIV] They scoff, and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
					\item[NRSV] They scoff and speak with malice; loftily they threaten oppression.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 73:9} % *PSALMS-73-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-9}

			They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שַׁתּ֣וּ בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם פִּיהֶ֑ם וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם תִּֽהֲלַ֥ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔθεντο εἰς οὐρανὸν τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν, καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτῶν διῆλθεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Their mouths lay claim to heaven, and their tongues take possession of the earth.
					\item[NRSV] They set their mouths against heaven, and their tongues range over the earth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 73:10} % *PSALMS-73-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-10}

			Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

					\item[LXX] \gr{διὰ τοῦτο ἐπιστρέψει ὁ λαός μου ἐνταῦθα, καὶ ἡμέραι πλήρεις εὑρεθήσονται αὐτοῖς,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Therefore his people return hither: And waters of a full cup are drained by them.
					\item[NIV] Therefore their people turn to them and drink up waters in abundance.
					\item[NRSV] Therefore the people turn and praise them, and find no fault in them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 73:11} % *PSALMS-73-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-11}

			And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְֽאָמְר֗וּ אֵיכָ֥ה יָדַֽע־אֵ֑ל וְיֵ֖שׁ דֵּעָ֣ה בְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ εἶπαν Πῶς ἔγνω ὁ θεός; καὶ εἰ ἔστιν γνῶσις ἐν τῷ ὑψίστῳ;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And they say, How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?
					\item[NIV] They say, “How would God know? Does the Most High know anything?”
					\item[NRSV] And they say, “How can God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\label{PSALMS-73-12}

			Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִנֵּה־אֵ֥לֶּה רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְשַׁלְוֵ֥י ע֝וֹלָ֗ם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָֽיִל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἰδοὺ ἁμαρτωλοὶ καὶ εὐθηνοῦνται· εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατέσχον πλούτου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Behold, these are the wicked; And, being alway at ease, they increase in riches.
					\item[NIV] This is what the wicked are like— always free of care, they go on amassing wealth.
					\item[NRSV] Such are the wicked; always at ease, they increase in riches.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-73-13}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 74} % *PSALMS-74
	% -----

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 74:1} % *PSALMS-74-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-74-1}

			O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{Συνέσεως τῷ Ἀσάφ. Ἵνα τί ἀπώσω, ὁ θεός, εἰς τέλος; ὠργίσθη ὁ θυμός σου ἐπὶ πρόβατα νομῆς σου;}

					\item[LXX] \gr{μνήσθητι τῆς συναγωγῆς σου ἧς ἐκτήσω ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς· ἐλυτρώσω ῥάβδον κληρονομίας σου, ὄρος Σιὼν τοῦτο ὃ κατεσκήνωσας ἐν αὐτῷ.}

					\item[NRSV] Remember your congregation, which you acquired long ago, which you redeemed to be the tribe of your heritage. Remember Mount Zion, where you came to dwell.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים שֹׁפֵ֑ט זֶ֥ה יַ֝שְׁפִּ֗יל וְזֶ֣ה יָרִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ποτήριον ἐν χειρὶ Κυρίου, οἴνου ἀκράτου πλῆρες κεράσματος, καὶ ἔκλινεν ἐκ τούτου εἰς τοῦτο· πλὴν ὁ τρυγίας αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐξεκενώθη, καὶ πίονται πάντες οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ τῆς γῆς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and the wine foameth; It is full of mixture, and he poureth out of the same: Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.
					\item[NIV] In the hand of the LORD is a cup full of foaming wine mixed with spices; he pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to its very dregs.
					\item[NRSV] For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup with foaming wine, well mixed; he will pour a draught from it, and all the wicked of the earth shall drain it down to the dregs.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 75:9} % *PSALMS-75-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-75-9}

			But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י כ֪וֹס בְּֽיַד־יְהוָ֡ה וְיַ֤יִן חָמַ֨ר ׀ מָ֥לֵא מֶסֶךְ֮ וַיַּגֵּ֪ר מִ֫זֶּ֥ה אַךְ־שְׁ֭מָרֶיהָ יִמְצ֣וּ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ כֹּ֝֗ל רִשְׁעֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγὼ δὲ ἀγαλλιάσομαι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ψαλῶ τῷ θεῷ Ἰακώβ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
					\item[NIV] As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob,
					\item[NRSV] But I will rejoice forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַ֭אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְעֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ πάντα τὰ κέρατα τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν συνκλάσω, καὶ ὑψωθήσεται τὰ κέρατα τοῦ δικαίου.}

					\item[NRSV] All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

			\label{PSALMS-76-1}

			In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְאָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Γνωστὸς ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ ὁ θεός, ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ μέγα τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song. In Judah is God known: His name is great in Israel.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph. A song. God is renowned in Judah; in Israel his name is great.
					\item[NRSV] In Judah God is known, his name is great in Israel.

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν εἰρήνῃ ὁ τόπος αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ κατοικητήριον αὐτοῦ ἐν Σιών·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] His tent is in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.
					\item[NRSV] His abode has been established in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκεῖ συνέτριψεν τὰ κράτη τῶν τόξων, ὅπλον καὶ ῥομφαίαν καὶ πόλεμον· ἐκεῖ συνκλάσει τὰ κέρατα. διάψαλμα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{φωτίζεις σὺ θαυμαστῶς ἀπὸ ὀρέων αἰωνίων.}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] You are radiant with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game.
					\item[NRSV] Glorious are you, more majestic than the everlasting mountains.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐταράχθησαν πάντες οἱ ἀσύνετοι τῇ καρδίᾳ· ὕπνωσαν ὕπνον αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐχ εὗρον οὐδὲν πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες τοῦ πλούτου ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The stouthearted are made a spoil, They have slept their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.
					\item[NIV] The valiant lie plundered, they sleep their last sleep; not one of the warriors can lift his hands.
					\item[NRSV] The stouthearted were stripped of their spoil; they sank into sleep; none of the troops was able to lift a hand.

					\item[BHS] \he{אֶשְׁתּוֹלְל֨וּ ׀ אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֭ב נָמ֣וּ שְׁנָתָ֑ם וְלֹא־מָצְא֖וּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַ֣יִל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ ἐπιτιμήσεώς σου, ὁ θεὸς Ἰακώβ, ἐνύσταξαν οἱ ἐπιβεβηκότες τοὺς ἵππους.}

					\item[NIV] At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both horse and chariot lie still.
					\item[NRSV] At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both rider and horse lay stunned.

			Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִ֭גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב נִ֝רְדָּ֗ם וְרֶ֣כֶב וָסֽוּס׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σὺ φοβερὸς εἶ, καὶ τίς ἀντιστήσεταί σοι ἀπὸ τῆς ὀργῆς σου;}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou, even thou, art to be feared; And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
					\item[NIV] It is you alone who are to be feared. Who can stand before you when you are angry?
					\item[NRSV] But you indeed are awesome! Who can stand before you when once your anger is roused?

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἠκόντισας κρίσιν, γῆ ἐφοβήθη καὶ ἡσύχασεν,}

			When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῷ ἀναστῆναι εἰς κρίσιν τὸν, θεόν, τοῦ σῶσαι πάντας τοὺς πρᾳεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ. διάψαλμα.}

			Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּקוּם־לַמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט אֱלֹהִ֑ים לְהוֹשִׁ֖יעַ כָּל־עַנְוֵי־אֶ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה׃}

					\item[LXX] \gr{εὔξασθε καὶ ἀπόδοτε Κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν· πάντες οἱ κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ οἴσουσιν δῶρα}

					\item[NRSV] Make vows to the LORD your God, and perform them; let all who are around him bring gifts to the one who is awesome,

	\subsubsection{Psalms 77} % *PSALMS-77
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-77}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 77:1} % *PSALMS-77-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-77-1}

			I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ יְדוּת֗וּן לְאָסָ֥ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Φωνῇ μου πρὸς Κύριον ἐκέκραξα, καὶ ἡ φωνή μου πρὸς τὸν θεόν, καὶ προσέσχεν μοι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{πλῆθος ἠχοῦς ὕδατος· φωνὴν ἔδωκαν αἱ νεφέλαι, καὶ γὰρ τὰ βέλη σου διαπορεύονται·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The clouds poured out water; The skies sent out a sound: Thine arrows also went abroad.
					\item[NIV] The clouds poured down water, the heavens resounded with thunder; your arrows flashed back and forth.
					\item[NRSV] The clouds poured out water; the skies thundered; your arrows flashed on every side.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 77:18} % *PSALMS-77-18
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-77-18}

			The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זֹ֤רְמוּ מַ֨יִם ׀ עָב֗וֹת ק֭וֹל נָתְנ֣וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים אַף־חֲ֝צָצֶ֗יךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φωνὴ τῆς βροντῆς σου ἐν τῷ τροχῷ, ἐσαλεύθη καὶ ἔντρομος ἐγενήθη ἡ γῆ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The voice of thy thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lightened the world: The earth trembled and shook.
					\item[NIV] Your thunder was heard in the whirlwind, your lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
					\item[NRSV] The crash of your thunder was in the whirlwind; your lightnings lit up the world; the earth trembled and shook.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 77:19} % *PSALMS-77-19
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-77-19}

			Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{ק֤וֹל רַעַמְךָ֨ ׀ בַּגַּלְגַּ֗ל הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקִ֣ים תֵּבֵ֑ל רָגְזָ֖ה וַתִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ ἡ ὁδός σου, καὶ αἱ τρίβοι σου ἐν ὕδασι πολλοῖς, καὶ τὰ ἴχνη σου οὐ γνωσθήσονται.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thy way was in the sea, And thy paths in the great waters, And thy footsteps were not known.
					\item[NIV] Your path led through the sea, your way through the mighty waters, though your footprints were not seen.
					\item[NRSV] Your way was through the sea, your path, through the mighty waters; yet your footprints were unseen.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-77-20}

			Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בַּיָּ֤ם דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ וּֽ֭שְׁבִֽילְךָ בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝עִקְּבוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נֹדָֽעוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡδήγησας ὡς πρόβατα τὸν λαόν σου ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ καὶ Ἀαρών.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou leddest thy people like a flock, By the hand of Moses and Aaron.
					\item[NIV] You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
					\item[NRSV] You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
					% % \item[OTX*]
