			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 78} % *PSALMS-78
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-78}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 78:1} % *PSALMS-78-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-1}

			Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָה עַ֭מִּי תּוֹרָתִ֑י הַטּ֥וּ אָ֝זְנְכֶ֗ם לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Συνέσεως τῷ Ἀσάφ. Προσέχετε λαός μου τὸν νόμον μου, κλίνατε τὸ οὖς ὑμῶν εἰς τά ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my law: Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
					\item[NIV] A maskil of Asaph. My people, hear my teaching; listen to the words of my mouth.
					\item[NRSV] Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 78:2} % *PSALMS-78-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-2}

			I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה בְמָשָׁ֣ל פִּ֑י אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝יד֗וֹת מִנִּי־קֶֽדֶם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνοίξω ἐν παραβολαῖς τὸ στόμα μου, φθέγξομαι προβλήματα ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings of old,
					\item[NIV] I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter hidden things, things from of old—
					\item[NRSV] I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings from of old,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 78:3} % *PSALMS-78-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-3}

			Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁ֭מַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵ֑ם וַ֝אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν καὶ ἔγνωμεν αὐτά, καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν διηγήσαντο ἡμῖν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.
					\item[NIV] things we have heard and known, things our ancestors have told us.
					\item[NRSV] things that we have heard and known, that our ancestors have told us.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 78:4} % *PSALMS-78-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-4}

			We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֹ֤א נְכַחֵ֨ד ׀ מִבְּנֵיהֶ֗ם לְד֥וֹר אַחֲר֗וֹן מְֽ֭סַפְּרִים תְּהִלּ֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וֶעֱזוּז֥וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָֽׂה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐκ ἐκρύβη ἀπὸ τῶν τέκνων αὐτῶν εἰς γενεὰν ἑτέραν, ἀπαγγέλλοντες τὰς αἰνέσεις Κυρίου καὶ τὰς δυναστίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ ἃ ἐποίησεν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] We will not hide them from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of Jehovah, And his strength, and his wondrous works that he hath done.
					\item[NIV] We will not hide them from their descendants; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the LORD, his power, and the wonders he has done.
					\item[NRSV] We will not hide them from their children; we will tell to the coming generation the glorious deeds of the LORD, and his might, and the wonders that he has done.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 78:5} % *PSALMS-78-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-5}

			For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיָּ֤קֶם עֵד֨וּת ׀ בְּֽיַעֲקֹ֗ב וְתוֹרָה֮ שָׂ֤ם בְּיִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִ֭וָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ לְ֝הוֹדִיעָ֗ם לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἀνέστησεν μαρτύριον ἐν Ἰακώβ, καὶ νόμον ἔθετο ἐν Ἰσραήλ, ὃν ἐνετείλατο τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν γνωρίσαι αὐτὸν τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For he established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which he commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;
					\item[NIV] He decreed statutes for Jacob and established the law in Israel, which he commanded our ancestors to teach their children,
					\item[NRSV] He established a decree in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our ancestors to teach to their children;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 78:6} % *PSALMS-78-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-6}

			That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ ׀ דּ֣וֹר אַ֭חֲרוֹן בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅπως ἂν γνῷ γενεὰ ἑτέρα, υἱοὶ οἱ τεχθησόμενοι, καὶ ἀναστήσονται καὶ ἀπαγγελοῦσιν αὐτὰ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] That the generation to come might know them, even the children that should be born; Who should arise and tell them to their children,
					\item[NIV] so the next generation would know them, even the children yet to be born, and they in turn would tell their children.
					\item[NRSV] that the next generation might know them, the children yet unborn, and rise up and tell them to their children,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 78:7} % *PSALMS-78-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-7}

			That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי־אֵ֑ל וּמִצְוֺתָ֥יו יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἵνα θῶνται ἐπὶ τὸν θεὸν τὴν ἐλπίδα αὐτῶν, καὶ μὴ ἐπιλάθωνται τῶν ἔργων τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ ἐκζητήσουσιν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] That they might set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep his commandments,
					\item[NIV] Then they would put their trust in God and would not forget his deeds but would keep his commands.
					\item[NRSV] so that they should set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 78:8} % *PSALMS-78-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-8}

			And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְלֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ ׀ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֗ם דּוֹר֮ סוֹרֵ֪ר וּמֹ֫רֶ֥ה דּ֭וֹר לֹא־הֵכִ֣ין לִבּ֑וֹ וְלֹא־נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת־אֵ֣ל רוּחֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἵνα μὴ γένωνται ὡς οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν γενεὰ σκολιὰ καὶ παραπικραίνουσα, γενεὰ ἥτις οὐ κατηύθυνεν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστώθη μετὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῆς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
					\item[NIV] They would not be like their ancestors— a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose hearts were not loyal to God, whose spirits were not faithful to him.
					\item[NRSV] and that they should not be like their ancestors, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation whose heart was not steadfast, whose spirit was not faithful to God.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 78:9} % *PSALMS-78-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-9}

			The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּֽנֵי־אֶפְרַ֗יִם נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רוֹמֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּי֣וֹם קְרָֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{υἱοὶ Ἐφράιμ ἐντείνοντες καὶ βάλλοντες τόξον ἐστράφησαν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πολέμου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.
					\item[NIV] The men of Ephraim, though armed with bows, turned back on the day of battle;
					\item[NRSV] The Ephraimites, armed with the bow, turned back on the day of battle.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 78:10} % *PSALMS-78-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-10}

			They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ֝בְתוֹרָת֗וֹ מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָלֶֽכֶת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐκ ἐφυλάξαντο τὴν διαθήκην τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἤθελον πορεύεσθαι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in his law;
					\item[NIV] they did not keep God’s covenant and refused to live by his law.
					\item[NRSV] They did not keep God’s covenant, but refused to walk according to his law.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 78:11} % *PSALMS-78-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-78-11}

			And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיִּשְׁכְּח֥וּ עֲלִילוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶרְאָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐπελάθοντο τῶν εὐεργεσιῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν θαυμασίων αὐτοῦ ὧν ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς,}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἔβρεξεν ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς ὡσεὶ χοῦν σάρκας, καὶ ὡσεὶ ἄμμον θαλασσῶν πετεινὰ πτερωτά·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐπέπεσον εἰς μέσον τῆς παρεμβολῆς αὐτῶν, κύκλῳ τῶν σκηνωμάτων αὐτῶν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{αὐτὸς δέ ἐστιν οἰκτίρμων καὶ ἱλάσεται ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐ διαφθερεῖ· καὶ πληθυνεῖ τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι τὸν θυμὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐχὶ ἐκκαύσει πᾶσαν τὴν ὀργὴν αὐτοῦ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἐλπίδι καὶ οὐκ ἐδειλίασαν, καὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν ἐκάλυψεν θάλασσα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐξέβαλεν ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν ἔθνη, καὶ ἐκληροδότησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν σχοινίῳ κληροδοσίας, καὶ κατεσκήνωσεν ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν αὐτῶν ταῖς φυλαῖς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.}

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐπείρασαν καὶ παρεπίκραναν τὸν θεὸν τὸν ὕψιστον, καὶ τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐφυλάξαντο·}

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν καὶ ἠσυνθέτησαν καθὼς καὶ οἱ πατέρες αὐτῶν καὶ μετεστράφησαν εἰς τόξον στρεβλόν·}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 79} % *PSALMS-79
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-79}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 79:1} % *PSALMS-79-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-79-1}

			O GOD, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֡ים בָּ֤אוּ גוֹיִ֨ם ׀ בְּֽנַחֲלָתֶ֗ךָ טִ֭מְּאוּ אֶת־הֵיכַ֣ל קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ שָׂ֖מוּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לְעִיִּֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ. Ὁ θεός, ἤλθοσαν ἔθνη εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν σου, ἐμίαναν τὸν ναὸν τὸν ἅγιόν σου, ἔθεντο Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς ὀπωροφυλάκιον·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance; Thy holy temple have they defiled; They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
					\item[NIV] A psalm of Asaph. O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple, they have reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
					\item[NRSV] O God, the nations have come into your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple; they have laid Jerusalem in ruins.
					% % \item[OTX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-79-2}

			The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נָֽתְנ֡וּ אֶת־נִבְלַ֬ת עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ מַ֭אֲכָל לְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּשַׂ֥ר חֲ֝סִידֶ֗יךָ לְחַיְתוֹ־אָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔθεντο τὰ θνησιμαῖα τῶν δούλων σου βρώματα τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, τὰς σάρκας τῶν ὁσίων σου τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] They have left the dead bodies of your servants as food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your own people for the animals of the wild.
					\item[NRSV] They have given the bodies of your servants to the birds of the air for food, the flesh of your faithful to the wild animals of the earth.

			Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁפְכ֬וּ דָמָ֨ם ׀ כַּמַּ֗יִם סְֽבִ֘יב֤וֹת יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם וְאֵ֣ין קוֹבֵֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξέχεαν τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν ὡς ὕδωρ κύκλῳ Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ θάπτων.}

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] They have poured out blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.

			We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הָיִ֣ינוּ חֶ֭רְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵ֑ינוּ לַ֥עַג וָ֝קֶ֗לֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵֽינוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγενήθημεν εἰς ὄνειδος τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν, μυκτηρισμὸς καὶ χλευασμὸς τοῖς κύκλῳ ἡμῶν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕως πότε, Κύριε, ὀργισθήσῃ εἰς τέλος; ἐκκαυθήσεται ὡς πῦρ ὁ ζῆλός σου;}

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?
					\item[NRSV] How long, O LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealous wrath burn like fire?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׁפֹ֤ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֨ אֶֽל־הַגּוֹיִם֮ אֲשֶׁ֪ר לֹא־יְדָ֫ע֥וּךָ וְעַ֥ל מַמְלָכ֑וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ֗ לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔκχεον τὴν ὀργήν σου ἐπὶ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ ἐπεγνωκότα σε, καὶ ἐπὶ βασιλείας αἳ τὸ ὄνομά σου οὐκ ἐπεκαλέσαντο·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name;
					\item[NRSV] Pour out your anger on the nations that do not know you, and on the kingdoms that do not call on your name.

		\paragraph{Psalms 79:8} % *PSALMS-79-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-79-8}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַֽל־תִּזְכָּר־לָנוּ֮ עֲוֺנֹ֪ת רִאשֹׁ֫נִ֥ים מַ֭הֵר יְקַדְּמ֣וּנוּ רַחֲמֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י דַלּ֣וֹנוּ מְאֹֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ μνησθῇς ἡμῶν ἀνομιῶν ἀρχαίων· ταχὺ προκαταλαβέτωσαν ἡμᾶς οἱ οἰκτειρμοί σου, ὅτι ἐπτωχεύσαμεν σφόδρα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NRSV] Do not remember against us the iniquities of our ancestors; let your compassion come speedily to meet us, for we are brought very low.

			\label{PSALMS-79-9}

			Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עָזְרֵ֤נוּ ׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׁעֵ֗נוּ עַל־דְּבַ֥ר כְּבֽוֹד־שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְהַצִּילֵ֥נוּ וְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־חַ֝טֹּאתֵ֗ינוּ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{βοήθησον ἡμῖν, ὁ θεὸς ὁ σωτὴρ ἡμῶν, ἕνεκα τῆς δόξης τοῦ ὀνόματός σου· Κύριε, ῥῦσαι ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἱλάσθητι ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ἡμῶν ἕνεκα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name; And deliver us, and forgive our sins, for thy name's sake.
					\item[NIV] Help us, God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name’s sake.
					\item[NRSV] Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of your name; deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 79:10} % *PSALMS-79-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-79-10}

			Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לָ֤מָּה ׀ יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִם֮ אַיֵּ֪ה אֱ‍ֽלֹהֵ֫יהֶ֥ם יִוָּדַ֣ע בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם לְעֵינֵ֑ינוּ נִ֝קְמַ֗ת דַּֽם־עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ הַשָּׁפֽוּךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μή ποτε εἴπωσιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν; καὶ γνωσθήτω ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐνώπιον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ἡμῶν ἡ ἐκδίκησις τοῦ αἵματος τῶν δούλων σου τοῦ ἐκκεχυμένου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God? Let the avenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed Be known among the nations in our sight.
					\item[NIV] Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.
					\item[NRSV] Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let the avenging of the outpoured blood of your servants be known among the nations before our eyes.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 79:11} % *PSALMS-79-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-79-11}

			Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תָּ֤ב֣וֹא לְפָנֶיךָ֮ אֶנְקַ֪ת אָ֫סִ֥יר כְּגֹ֥דֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ֑ ה֝וֹתֵ֗ר בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰσελθάτω ἐνώπιόν σου ὁ στεναγμὸς τῶν πεπεδημένων, κατὰ τὴν μεγαλωσύνην τοῦ βραχίονός σου, περιποίησαι τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν τεθανατωμένων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee: According to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to death;
					\item[NIV] May the groans of the prisoners come before you; with your strong arm preserve those condemned to die.
					\item[NRSV] Let the groans of the prisoners come before you; according to your great power preserve those doomed to die.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 79:12} % *PSALMS-79-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-79-12}

			And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְהָ֘שֵׁ֤ב לִשְׁכֵנֵ֣ינוּ שִׁ֭בְעָתַיִם אֶל־חֵיקָ֑ם חֶרְפָּ֘תָ֤ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר חֵרְפ֣וּךָ אֲדֹנָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπόδος τοῖς γείτοσιν ἡμῶν ἑπταπλάσια εἰς τὸν κόλπον αὐτῶν, τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτῶν ὃν ὠνείδισάν σε, κύριε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And render unto our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
					\item[NIV] Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the contempt they have hurled at you, Lord.
					\item[NRSV] Return sevenfold into the bosom of our neighbors the taunts with which they taunted you, O Lord!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-79-13}

			So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַמְּךָ֨ ׀ וְצֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתֶךָ֮ נ֤וֹדֶ֥ה לְּךָ֗ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֑ר נְ֝סַפֵּ֗ר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡμεῖς γὰρ λαός σου καὶ πρόβατα τῆς νομῆς σου ἀνθομολογησόμεθά σοι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἐξαγγελοῦμεν τὴν αἴνεσίν σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture Will give thee thanks for ever: We will show forth thy praise to all generations.
					\item[NIV] Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will praise you forever; from generation to generation we will proclaim your praise.
					\item[NRSV] Then we your people, the flock of your pasture, will give thanks to you forever; from generation to generation we will recount your praise.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 80} % *PSALMS-80
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-80}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 80:1} % *PSALMS-80-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-80-1}

			Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶל־שֹׁשַׁנִּ֑ים עֵד֖וּת לְאָסָ֣ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὁ ποιμαίνων τὸν Ἰσραὴλ πρόσχες, ὁ ὁδηγῶν ὡσεὶ πρόβατα τὸν Ἰωσήφ· ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῶν χερουβεὶμ ἐμφάνηθι,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim Eduth. A Psalm of Asaph. Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that sittest above the cherubim, shine forth.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” Of Asaph. A psalm. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock. You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
					\item[NRSV] Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock! You who are enthroned upon the cherubim, shine forth
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 80:2} % *PSALMS-80-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-80-2}

			Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רֹ֘עֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל ׀ הַאֲזִ֗ינָה נֹהֵ֣ג כַּצֹּ֣אן יוֹסֵ֑ף יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הוֹפִֽיעָה׃}

					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῶν δυνάμεων, ἕως πότε ὀργίζῃ ἐπὶ τὴν προσευχὴν τοῦ δούλου σου;}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποστῶμεν ἀπὸ σοῦ· ζωώσεις ἡμᾶς, καὶ τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐπικαλεσόμεθα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν θλίψει ἐπεκαλέσω με καὶ ἐρυσάμην σε· ἐπήκουσά σου ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ καταιγίδος, ἐδοκίμασά σε ἐπὶ ὕδατος Ἀντιλογίας. διάψαλμα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῷ μηδενὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν ἐταπείνωσα, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θλίβοντας αὐτοὺς ἐπέβαλον τὴν χεῖρά μου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{οἱ ἐχθροὶ Κυρίου ἐψεύσαντο αὐτῷ, καὶ ἔσται ὁ καιρὸς αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐψώμισεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ στέατος πυροῦ, καὶ ἐκ πέτρας μέλι ἐχόρτασεν αὐτούς.}

			\label{PSALMS-82-1}

			God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ף אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּעֲדַת־אֵ֑ל בְּקֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ. Ὁ θεὸς ἔστη ἐν συναγωγῇ θεῶν, ἐν μέσῳ δὲ θεοὺς διακρίνει.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] A psalm of Asaph. God presides in the great assembly; he renders judgment among the “gods":
					\item[NRSV] God has taken his place in the divine council; in the midst of the gods he holds judgment:

					\item[BHS] \he{עַד־מָתַ֥י תִּשְׁפְּטוּ־עָ֑וֶל וּפְנֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תִּשְׂאוּ־סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕως πότε κρίνετε ἀδικίαν, καὶ πρόσωπα ἁμαρτωλῶν λαμβάνετε; διάψαλμα.}

					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁפְטוּ־דַ֥ל וְיָת֑וֹם עָנִ֖י וָרָ֣שׁ הַצְדִּֽיקוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κρίνατε ὀρφανὸν καὶ πτωχόν, ταπεινὸν καὶ πένητα δικαιώσατε·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐκ ἔγνωσαν οὐδὲ συνῆκαν, ἐν σκότει διαπορεύονται· σαλευθήσονται πάντα τὰ θεμέλια τῆς γῆς.}

			Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְאָסָֽף׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὁ θεός, τίς ὁμοιωθήσεταί σοι; μὴ σιγήσῃς μηδὲ καταπραύνῃς, ὁ θεός·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] A song. A psalm of Asaph. O God, do not remain silent; do not turn a deaf ear, do not stand aloof, O God.
					\item[NRSV] O God, do not keep silence; do not hold your peace or be still, O God!

					\item[LXX] \gr{εἶπαν Δεῦτε καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσωμεν αὐτοὺς ἐξ ἔθνους, καὶ οὐ μὴ μνησθῇ τὸ ὄνομα Ἰσραὴλ ἔτι·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐβουλεύσαντο ἐν ὁμονοίᾳ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, κατὰ σοῦ διαθήκην διέθεντο,}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] They conspire with one accord; against you they make a covenant—

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 84:1} % *PSALMS-84-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-84-1}

			How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־הַגִּתִּ֑ית לִבְנֵי־קֹ֥רַח מִזְמֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὡς ἀγαπητὰ τὰ σκηνώματά σου, Κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Jehovah of hosts!

					\item[NRSV] How lovely is your dwelling place, O LORD of hosts!

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\label{PSALMS-84-2}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מַה־יְּדִיד֥וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶ֗יךָ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπιποθεῖ καὶ ἐκλείπει ἡ ψυχή μου εἰς τὰς αὐλὰς τοῦ κυρίου· ἡ καρδία μου καὶ ἡ σάρξ μου ἠγαλλιάσαντο ἐπὶ θεὸν ζῶντα.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah; My heart and my flesh cry out unto the living God.

					\item[NRSV] My soul longs, indeed it faints for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh sing for joy to the living God.

		\paragraph{Psalms 84:3} % *PSALMS-84-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-84-3}

			Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נִכְסְפָ֬ה וְגַם־כָּלְתָ֨ה ׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ לְחַצְר֪וֹת יְה֫וָ֥ה לִבִּ֥י וּבְשָׂרִ֑י יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ אֶ֣ל אֵֽל־חָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ γὰρ στρουθίον εὗρεν ἑαυτῷ οἰκίαν, καὶ τρυγὼν νοσσιὰν ἑαυτῇ οὗ θήσει τὰ νοσσία αὐτῆς· τὰ θυσιαστήριά σου, Κύριε τῶν δυνάμεων, ὁ βασιλεύς μου καὶ ὁ θεός μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{μακάριοι πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ σου, εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων αἰνέσουσίν σε. διάψαλμα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{μακάριος ἀνὴρ οὗ ἐστιν ἡ ἀντίλημψις αὐτοῦ παρὰ σοῦ, Κύριε· ἀναβάσεις ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ διέθετο,}

					\item[LXX] \gr{Εὐδόκησας, Κύριε, τὴν γῆν σου, ἀπέστρεψας τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Ἰακώβ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] LORD, you were favorable to your land; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀφῆκας τὰς ἀνομίας τῷ λαῷ σου, ἐκάλυψας τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν. διάψαλμα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὀργισθήσῃ ἡμῖν; ἢ διατενεῖς τὴν ὀργήν σου ἀπὸ γενεᾶς εἰς γενεάν;}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף־בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεός, σὺ ἐπιστρέψας ζωώσεις ἡμᾶς, καὶ ὁ λαός σου εὐφρανθήσεται ἐπὶ σοί.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Wilt thou not quicken us again, That thy people may rejoice in thee?
					\item[NIV] Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
					\item[NRSV] Will you not revive us again, so that your people may rejoice in you?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 85:7} % *PSALMS-85-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-85-7}

			Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֲֽלֹא־אַ֭תָּה תָּשׁ֣וּב תְּחַיֵּ֑נוּ וְ֝עַמְּךָ֗ יִשְׂמְחוּ־בָֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{δεῖξον ἡμῖν, Κύριε, τὸ ἔλεός σου, καὶ τὸ σωτήριόν σου, Κύριε, δῴης ἡμῖν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Show us thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, And grant us thy salvation.
					\item[NIV] Show us your unfailing love, LORD, and grant us your salvation.
					\item[NRSV] Show us your steadfast love, O LORD, and grant us your salvation.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 85:8} % *PSALMS-85-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-85-8}

			I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַרְאֵ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝יֶשְׁעֲךָ֗ תִּתֶּן־לָֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀκούσομαι τί λαλήσει ἐν ἐμοὶ Κύριος ὁ θεός, ὅτι λαλήσει εἰρήνην ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ὁσίους αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἐπιστρέφοντας πρὸς αὐτὸν καρδίαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will hear what God Jehovah will speak; For he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: But let them not turn again to folly.
					\item[NIV] I will listen to what God the LORD says; he promises peace to his people, his faithful servants— but let them not turn to folly.
					\item[NRSV] Let me hear what God the LORD will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, to his faithful, to those who turn to him in their hearts.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 85:9} % *PSALMS-85-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-85-9}

			Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה־יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֪ל ׀ יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י ׀ יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל־עַמּ֥וֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָ֑יו וְֽאַל־יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πλὴν ἐγγὺς τῶν φοβουμένων αὐτὸν τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ, τοῦ κατασκηνῶσαι δόξαν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἡμῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, That glory may dwell in our land.
					\item[NIV] Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.
					\item[NRSV] Surely his salvation is at hand for those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-85-10}

			Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַ֤ךְ ׀ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθεια συνήντησαν, δικαιοσύνη καὶ εἰρήνη κατεφίλησαν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Love and faithfulness meet together; righteousness and peace kiss each other.
					\item[NRSV] Steadfast love and faithfulness will meet; righteousness and peace will kiss each other.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-85-11}

			Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חֶֽסֶד־וֶאֱמֶ֥ת נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ צֶ֖דֶק וְשָׁל֣וֹם נָשָֽׁקוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀλήθεια ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἀνέτειλεν, καὶ δικαιοσύνη ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ διέκυψεν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.
					\item[NIV] Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
					\item[NRSV] Faithfulness will spring up from the ground, and righteousness will look down from the sky.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-85-12}

			Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ γὰρ ὁ κύριος δώσει χρηστότητα, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡμῶν δώσει τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς.}

					\item[NIV] The LORD will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD will give what is good, and our land will yield its increase.

			Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{δικαιοσύνη ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ προπορεύσεται, καὶ θήσει εἰς ὁδὸν τὰ διαβήματα αὐτοῦ.}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 86} % *PSALMS-86
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-86}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 86:1} % *PSALMS-86-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-86-1}

			Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הַטֵּֽה־יְהוָ֣ה אָזְנְךָ֣ עֲנֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־עָנִ֖י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן אָֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Προσευχὴ τῷ Δαυείδ. Κλῖνον, Κύριε, τὸ οὖς σου καὶ εἰσάκουσόν μου, ὅτι πτωχὸς καὶ πένης εἰμὶ ἐγώ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Prayer of David. Bow down thine ear, O Jehovah, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.
					\item[NIV] A prayer of David. Hear me, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
					\item[NRSV] Incline your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 86:2} % *PSALMS-86-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-86-2}

			Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי֮ כִּֽי־חָסִ֪יד אָ֥נִי הוֹשַׁ֣ע עַ֭בְדְּךָ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֑י הַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φύλαξον τὴν ψυχήν μου, ὅτι ὅσιός εἰμι· σῶσον τὸν δοῦλόν σου, ὁ θεός μου, τὸν ἐλπίζοντα ἐπὶ σέ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Preserve my soul; for I am godly: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
					\item[NIV] Guard my life, for I am faithful to you; save your servant who trusts in you. You are my God;
					\item[NRSV] Preserve my life, for I am devoted to you; save your servant who trusts in you. You are my God;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 86:3} % *PSALMS-86-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-86-3}

			Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חָנֵּ֥נִי אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶ֝קְרָ֗א כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐλέησόν με, κύριε, ὅτι πρὸς σὲ κεκράξομαι ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Be merciful unto me, O Lord; For unto thee do I cry all the day long.
					\item[NIV] have mercy on me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
					\item[NRSV] be gracious to me, O Lord, for to you do I cry all day long.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 86:4} % *PSALMS-86-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-86-4}

			Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שַׂ֭מֵּחַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὔφρανον τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ δούλου σου, ὅτι πρὸς σέ, κύριε, ἦρα τὴν ψυχήν μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Rejoice the soul of thy servant; For unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
					\item[NIV] Bring joy to your servant, Lord, for I put my trust in you.
					\item[NRSV] Gladden the soul of your servant, for to you, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 86:5} % *PSALMS-86-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-86-5}

			For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב־חֶ֝֗סֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι σύ, κύριε, χρηστὸς καὶ ἐπιεικὴς καὶ πολυέλεος πᾶσι τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις σε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in lovingkindness unto all them that call upon thee.
					\item[NIV] You, Lord, are forgiving and good, abounding in love to all who call to you.
					\item[NRSV] For you, O Lord, are good and forgiving, abounding in steadfast love to all who call on you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 86:6} % *PSALMS-86-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-86-6}

			Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַאֲזִ֣ינָה יְ֭הוָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבָה בְּק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐνώτισαι, Κύριε, τὴν προσευχήν μου, καὶ πρόσχες τῇ φωνῇ τῆς δεήσεώς μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer; And hearken unto the voice of my supplications.
					\item[NIV] Hear my prayer, LORD; listen to my cry for mercy.
					\item[NRSV] Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; listen to my cry of supplication.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 86:7} % *PSALMS-86-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-86-7}

			In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּי֣וֹם צָ֭רָתִ֥י אֶקְרָאֶ֗ךָּ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς μου ἐκέκραξα πρὸς σέ, ὅτι εἰσήκουσάς μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee; For thou wilt answer me.
					\item[NIV] When I am in distress, I call to you, because you answer me.
					\item[NRSV] In the day of my trouble I call on you, for you will answer me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 86:8} % *PSALMS-86-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-86-8}

			Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֵין־כָּמ֖וֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִ֥ים ׀ אֲדֹנָ֗י וְאֵ֣ין כְּֽמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐκ ἔστιν ὅμοιός σοι ἐν θεοῖς, κύριε, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κατὰ τὰ ἔργα σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] There is none like unto thee among the gods, O Lord; Neither are there any works like unto thy works.
					\item[NIV] Among the gods there is none like you, Lord; no deeds can compare with yours.
					\item[NRSV] There is none like you among the gods, O Lord, nor are there any works like yours.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 86:9} % *PSALMS-86-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-86-9}

			All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כָּל־גּוֹיִ֤ם ׀ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָב֤וֹאוּ ׀ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֲדֹנָ֑י וִֽיכַבְּד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὅσα ἐποίησας ἥξουσιν καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν ἐνώπιόν σου, Κύριε, καὶ δοξάσουσιν τὸ ὄνομά σου·}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] All the nations you have made shall come and bow down before you, O Lord, and shall glorify your name.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι μέγας εἶ σὺ καὶ ποιῶν θαυμάσια, σὺ εἶ ὁ θεὸς μόνος ὁ μέγας.}

					\item[NIV] For you are great and do marvelous deeds; you alone are God.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁδήγησόν με, Κύριε, τῇ ὁδῷ σου, καὶ πορεύσομαι τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου· εὐφρανθήτω ἡ καρδία μου τοῦ φοβεῖσθαι τὸ ὄνομά σου.}

					\item[NRSV] Teach me your way, O LORD, that I may walk in your truth; give me an undivided heart to revere your name.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι, Κύριε ὁ θεός μου, ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου, καὶ δοξάσω τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι τὸ ἔλεός σου μέγα ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ, καὶ ἐρρύσω τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐξ ᾅδου κατωτάτου.}

					\item[NIV] For great is your love toward me; you have delivered me from the depths, from the realm of the dead.
					\item[NRSV] For great is your steadfast love toward me; you have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεός, παράνομοι ἐπανέστησαν ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ, καὶ συναγωγὴ κραταιῶν ἐζήτησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου· οὐ προέθεντό σε ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν.}

					\item[NRSV] O God, the insolent rise up against me; a band of ruffians seeks my life, and they do not set you before them.

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ σύ, Κύριε ὁ θεός, οἰκτίρμων καὶ ἐλεήμων, μακρόθυμος καὶ πολυέλεος καὶ ἀληθινός.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπίβλεψον ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ καὶ ἐλέησόν με, δὸς τὸ κράτος σου τῷ παιδί σου, καὶ σῶσον τὸν υἱὸν τῆς παιδίσκης σου.}

					\item[NRSV] Turn to me and be gracious to me; give your strength to your servant; save the child of your serving girl.

			Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עֲשֵֽׂה־עִמִּ֥י א֗וֹת לְט֫וֹבָ֥ה וְיִרְא֣וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י וְיֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥נִי וְנִחַמְתָּֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ποίησον μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ σημεῖον εἰς ἀγαθόν, καὶ ἰδέτωσαν οἱ μισοῦντές με καὶ αἰσχυνθήτωσαν, ὅτι σύ, Κύριε, ἐβοήθησάς μοι καὶ παρεκάλεσάς με.}

					\item[NIV] Give me a sign of your goodness, that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for you, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
					\item[NRSV] Show me a sign of your favor, so that those who hate me may see it and be put to shame, because you, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

		\paragraph{Psalms 87:1} % *PSALMS-87-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-87-1}

			His foundation is in the holy mountains.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לִבְנֵי־קֹ֭רַח מִזְמ֣וֹר שִׁ֑יר יְ֝סוּדָת֗וֹ בְּהַרְרֵי־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τοῖς υἱοῖς Κόρε ψαλμὸς ᾠδῆς. Οἱ θεμέλιοι αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. A song. He has founded his city on the holy mountain.
					\item[NRSV] On the holy mount stands the city he founded;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֹהֵ֣ב יְ֭הוָה שַׁעֲרֵ֣י צִיּ֑וֹן מִ֝כֹּ֗ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀγαπᾷ Κύριος τὰς πύλας Σειὼν ὑπὲρ πάντα τὰ σκηνώματα Ἰακώβ.}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נִ֭כְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּ֣ר בָּ֑ךְ עִ֖יר הָאֱלֹהִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃}

			\label{PSALMS-87-4}

			I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַזְכִּ֤יר ׀ רַ֥הַב וּבָבֶ֗ל לְֽיֹ֫דְעָ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה פְלֶ֣שֶׁת וְצ֣וֹר עִם־כּ֑וּשׁ זֶ֝֗ה יֻלַּד־שָֽׁם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μνησθήσομαι Ῥαὰβ καὶ Βαβυλῶνος τοῖς γινώσκουσίν με· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀλλόφυλοι καὶ Τύρος καὶ λαὸς Αἰθιόπων, οὗτοι ἐγενήθησαν ἐκεῖ.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] “I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me— Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush — and will say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”
					\item[NRSV] Among those who know me I mention Rahab and Babylon; Philistia too, and Tyre, with Ethiopia— “This one was born there,” they say.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

			\label{PSALMS-87-5}

			And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וּֽלֲצִיּ֨וֹן ׀ יֵאָמַ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּ֑הּ וְה֖וּא יְכוֹנְנֶ֣הָ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Μήτηρ Σειών, ἐρεῖ ἄνθρωπος, καί Ἄνθρωπος ἐγενήθη ἐν αὐτῇ, καί Αὐτὸς ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτὴν ὁ ὕψιστος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Indeed, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High himself will establish her.”
					\item[NRSV] And of Zion it shall be said, “This one and that one were born in it”; for the Most High himself will establish it.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְפֹּר בִּכְת֣וֹב עַמִּ֑ים זֶ֖ה יֻלַּד־שָׁ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος διηγήσεται ἐν γραφῇ λαῶν καὶ ἀρχόντων τούτων τῶν γεγενημένων ἐν αὐτῇ. διάψαλμα.}

					\item[NRSV] The LORD records, as he registers the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah

			\begin{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 88:1} % *PSALMS-88-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-88-1}

			O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֥יר מִזְמ֗וֹר לִבְנֵ֫י קֹ֥רַח לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־מָחֲלַ֣ת לְעַנּ֑וֹת מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְהֵימָ֥ן הָאֶזְרָחִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε ὁ θεὸς τῆς σωτηρίας μου, ἡμέρας ἐκέκραξα καὶ ἐν νυκτὶ ἐναντίον σου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite. O Jehovah, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee.
					\item[NIV] A song. A psalm of the Sons of Korah. For the director of music. According to mahalath leannoth. A maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. LORD, you are the God who saves me; day and night I cry out to you.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, God of my salvation, when, at night, I cry out in your presence,

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\label{PSALMS-88-2}

			Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְ֭הוָה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י יוֹם־צָעַ֖קְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰσελθέτω ἐνώπιόν σου ἡ προσευχή μου, κλῖνον τὸ οὖς σου εἰς τὴν δέησίν μου, Κύριε.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{προσελογίσθην μετὰ τῶν καταβαινόντων εἰς λάκκον, ἐγενήθην ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἀβοήθητος,}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν νεκροῖς ἐλεύθερος· ὡσεὶ τραυματίαι ἐρριμμένοι καθεύδοντες ἐν τάφῳ, ὧν οὐκ ἐμνήσθης ἔτι, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐκ τῆς χειρός σου ἀπώσθησαν·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔθεντό με ἐν λάκκῳ κατωτάτῳ, ἐν σκοτεινοῖς καὶ ἐν σκιᾷ θανάτου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ ἐπεστηρίχθη ὁ θυμός σου, καὶ πάντας τοὺς μετεωρισμούς σου ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ ἐπήγαγες. διάψαλμα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐμάκρυνας τοὺς γνωστούς μου ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἔθεντό με βδέλυγμα ἑαυτοῖς· παρεδόθην καὶ οὐκ ἐξεπορευόμην.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἠσθένησαν ἀπὸ πτωχείας· καὶ ἐκέκραξα πρὸς σέ, Κύριε, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν, διεπέτασα τὰς χεῖράς μου·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ τοῖς νεκροῖς ποιήσεις θαυμάσια; ἢ ἰατροὶ ἀναστήσουσιν καὶ ἐξομολογήσονταί σοι;}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἵνα τί, Κύριε, ἀπωθεῖς τὴν προσευχήν μου, ἀποστρέφεις τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ;}

					\item[LXX] \gr{πτωχός εἰμι ἐγὼ καὶ ἐν κόποις ἐκ νεότητός μου, ὑψωθεὶς δὲ ἐταπεινώθην καὶ ἐξηπορήθην.}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-89-1}

			I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְאֵיתָ֥ן הָֽאֶזְרָחִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τὰ ἐλέη σου, Κύριε, εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ᾄσομαι, εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεὰν ἀπαγγελῶ τὴν ἀλήθειάν σου ἐν τῷ στόματί μου.}

					\item[NRSV] I will sing of your steadfast love, O LORD, forever; with my mouth I will proclaim your faithfulness to all generations.

					\item[BHS] \he{חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֓ר ׀ אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בְּפִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι εἶπας Εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔλεος οἰκοδομηθήσεται, ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ἑτοιμασθήσεται ἡ ἀλήθειά σου·}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-89-43}

			Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֲ֭רִימוֹתָ יְמִ֣ין צָרָ֑יו הִ֝שְׂמַ֗חְתָּ כָּל־אוֹיְבָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπέστρεψας τὴν βοήθειαν τῆς ῥομφαίας αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἀντελάβου αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Yea, thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.
					\item[NIV] Indeed, you have turned back the edge of his sword and have not supported him in battle.
					\item[NRSV] Moreover, you have turned back the edge of his sword, and you have not supported him in battle.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{κατέλυσας ἀπὸ καθαρισμοῦ αὐτόν, τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν κατέρραξας·}

					\item[NIV] You have put an end to his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
					\item[NRSV] You have removed the scepter from his hand, and hurled his throne to the ground.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-89-45}

			The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ מִטְּהָר֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ לָאָ֥רֶץ מִגַּֽרְתָּה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐσμίκρυνας τὰς ἡμέρας τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ, κατέχεας αὐτοῦ αἰσχύνην. διάψαλμα.}

					\item[NIV] You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with a mantle of shame.
					\item[NRSV] You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with shame. Selah

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-89-46}

			How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִ֭קְצַרְתָּ יְמֵ֣י עֲלוּמָ֑יו הֶֽעֱטִ֨יתָ עָלָ֖יו בּוּשָׁ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕως πότε, Κύριε, ἀποστρέψεις εἰς τέλος; ἐκκαυθήσεται ὡς πῦρ ἡ ὀργή σου;}

					% % \item[AB ]

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?
					\item[NRSV] How long, O LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-89-47}

			Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַד־מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּסָּתֵ֣ר לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֖ר כְּמוֹ־אֵ֣שׁ חֲמָתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μνήσθητι τίς μου ἡ ὑπόστασις· μὴ γὰρ ματαίως ἔκτισας πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων;}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Remember how fleeting is my life. For what futility you have created all humanity!
					\item[NRSV] Remember how short my time is— for what vanity you have created all mortals!

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-89-48}

			What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זְכָר־אֲנִ֥י מֶה־חָ֑לֶד עַל־מַה־שָּׁ֝֗וְא בָּרָ֥אתָ כָל־בְּנֵי־אָדָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ζήσεται καὶ οὐκ ὄψεται θάνατον; ῥύσεται τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐκ χειρὸς ᾅδου; διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Who can live and not see death, or who can escape the power of the grave?

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-89-49}

			Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִ֤י גֶ֣בֶר יִֽ֭חְיֶה וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־מָּ֑וֶת יְמַלֵּ֨ט נַפְשׁ֖וֹ מִיַּד־שְׁא֣וֹל סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ποῦ ἐστιν τὰ ἐλέη σου τὰ ἀρχαῖα, Κύριε, ἃ ὤμοσας τῷ Δαυεὶδ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου;}

					\item[NIV] Lord, where is your former great love, which in your faithfulness you swore to David?

		\paragraph{Psalms 89:50} % *PSALMS-89-50
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-89-50}

			Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַיֵּ֤ה ׀ חֲסָדֶ֖יךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֥ים ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לְ֝דָוִ֗ד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μνήσθητι, Κύριε, τοῦ ὀνειδισμοῦ τῶν δούλων σου, οὗ ὑπέσχου ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ μου πολλῶν ἐθνῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] Remember, O Lord, how your servant is taunted; how I bear in my bosom the insults of the peoples,
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{οὗ ὠνείδισαν οἱ ἐχθροί σου, Κύριε, οὗ ὠνείδισαν τὸ ἀντάλλαγμα τοῦ χριστοῦ σου.}

					\item[NRSV] with which your enemies taunt, O LORD, with which they taunted the footsteps of your anointed.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 90} % *PSALMS-90
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-90}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 90:1} % *PSALMS-90-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-90-1}

			Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּפִלָּה֮ לְמֹשֶׁ֪ה אִֽישׁ־הָאֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים אֲ‍ֽדֹנָ֗י מָע֣וֹן אַ֭תָּה הָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֗נוּ בְּדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Προσευχὴ τοῦ Μωυσῆ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ. Κύριε, καταφυγὴ ἡμῖν ἐγενήθης ἐν γενεᾷ καὶ γενεᾷ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place In all generations.
					\item[NIV] A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations.
					\item[NRSV] Lord, you have been our dwelling place in all generations.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 90:2} % *PSALMS-90-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-90-2}

			Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּטֶ֤רֶם ׀ הָ֘רִ֤ים יֻלָּ֗דוּ וַתְּח֣וֹלֵֽל אֶ֣רֶץ וְתֵבֵ֑ל וּֽמֵעוֹלָ֥ם עַד־ע֝וֹלָ֗ם אַתָּ֥ה אֵֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πρὸ τοῦ ὄρη γενηθῆναι καὶ πλασθῆναι τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν οἰκουμένην, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος σὺ εἶ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
					\item[NIV] Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the whole world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.
					\item[NRSV] Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever you had formed the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 90:3} % *PSALMS-90-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-90-3}

			Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תָּשֵׁ֣ב אֱ֭נוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּ֑א וַ֝תֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וּבוּ בְנֵי־אָדָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς ἄνθρωπον εἰς ταπείνωσιν, καὶ εἶπας Ἐπιστρέψατε υἱοὶ ἀνθρώπων;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou turnest man to destruction, And sayest, Return, ye children of men.
					\item[NIV] You turn people back to dust, saying, “Return to dust, you mortals.”
					\item[NRSV] You turn us back to dust, and say, “Turn back, you mortals.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 90:4} % *PSALMS-90-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-90-4}

			For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י אֶ֪לֶף שָׁנִ֡ים בְּֽעֵינֶ֗יךָ כְּי֣וֹם אֶ֭תְמוֹל כִּ֣י יַעֲבֹ֑ר וְאַשְׁמוּרָ֥ה בַלָּֽיְלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι χίλια ἔτη ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς σου ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ ἐχθὲς ἥτις διῆλθεν, καὶ φυλακὴ ἐν νυκτί.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For a thousand years in thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.
					\item[NIV] A thousand years in your sight are like a day that has just gone by, or like a watch in the night.
					\item[NRSV] For a thousand years in your sight are like yesterday when it is past, or like a watch in the night.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 90:5} % *PSALMS-90-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-90-5}

			Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זְ֭רַמְתָּם שֵׁנָ֣ה יִהְי֑וּ בַּ֝בֹּ֗קֶר כֶּחָצִ֥יר יַחֲלֹֽף׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὰ ἐξουδενώματα αὐτῶν ἔτη ἔσονται, τὸ πρωὶ ὡσεὶ χλόη παρέλθοι·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
					\item[NIV] Yet you sweep people away in the sleep of death— they are like the new grass of the morning:
					\item[NRSV] You sweep them away; they are like a dream, like grass that is renewed in the morning;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 90:6} % *PSALMS-90-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-90-6}

			In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בַּ֭בֹּקֶר יָצִ֣יץ וְחָלָ֑ף לָ֝עֶ֗רֶב יְמוֹלֵ֥ל וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὸ πρωὶ ἀνθήσαι καὶ παρέλθοι, τὸ ἑσπέρας ἀποπέσοι, σκληρυνθείη καὶ ξηρανθείη.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
					\item[NIV] In the morning it springs up new, but by evening it is dry and withered.
					\item[NRSV] in the morning it flourishes and is renewed; in the evening it fades and withers.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-90-7}

			For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־כָלִ֥ינוּ בְאַפֶּ֑ךָ וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ נִבְהָֽלְנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐξελίπομεν ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ σου, καὶ ἐν τῷ θυμῷ σου ἐταράχθημεν·}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שַׁתָּ֣ה עֲוֺנֹתֵ֣ינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ עֲ֝לֻמֵ֗נוּ לִמְא֥וֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔθου τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν ἐνώπιόν σου, ὁ αἰὼν ἡμῶν εἰς φωτισμὸν τοῦ προσώπου σου.}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֣י כָל־יָ֭מֵינוּ פָּנ֣וּ בְעֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּלִּ֖ינוּ שָׁנֵ֣ינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶֽגֶה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι ἡμῶν ἐξέλιπον, καὶ ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ σου ἐξελίπομεν· τὰ ἔτη ἡμῶν ὡς ἀράχνην ἐμελέτων.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] All our days pass away under your wrath; we finish our years with a moan.
					\item[NRSV] For all our days pass away under your wrath; our years come to an end like a sigh.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-90-10}

			The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְמֵֽי־שְׁנוֹתֵ֨ינוּ בָהֶ֥ם שִׁבְעִ֪ים שָׁנָ֡ה וְאִ֤ם בִּגְבוּרֹ֨ת ׀ שְׁמ֘וֹנִ֤ים שָׁנָ֗ה וְ֭רָהְבָּם עָמָ֣ל וָאָ֑וֶן כִּי־גָ֥ז חִ֝֗ישׁ וַנָּעֻֽפָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἱ ἡμέραι τῶν ἐτῶν ἡμῶν ἐν ἐνιαυτοῖς ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη, ἐὰν δὲ ἐν δυναστείαις, ὀγδοήκοντα ἔτη, καὶ τὸ πλεῖον αὐτῶν κόπος καὶ πόνος· ὅτι ἐπῆλθεν πραύτης ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς, καὶ παιδευθησόμεθα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow; For it is soon gone, and we fly away.
					\item[NIV] Our days may come to seventy years, or eighty, if our strength endures; yet the best of them are but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
					\item[NRSV] The days of our life are seventy years, or perhaps eighty, if we are strong; even then their span is only toil and trouble; they are soon gone, and we fly away.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς γινώσκει τὸ κράτος τῆς ὀργῆς σου, καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου τοῦ θυμοῦ σου ἐξαριθμήσασθαι;}

					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] If only we knew the power of your anger! Your wrath is as great as the fear that is your due.
					\item[NRSV] Who considers the power of your anger? Your wrath is as great as the fear that is due you.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐνεπλήσθημεν τὸ πρωὶ τοῦ ἐλέους σου, καὶ ἠγαλλιασάμεθα καὶ εὐφράνθημεν ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἡμῶν,}

			And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἔστω ἡ λαμπρότης Κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς, καὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν ἡμῶν κατεύθυνον ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς.}

	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-91}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 91:1} % *PSALMS-91-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-91-1}

			He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּסֵ֣תֶר עֶלְי֑וֹן בְּצֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְלוֹנָֽן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Αἶνος ᾠδῆς τῷ Δαυείδ. Ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν βοηθείᾳ τοῦ ὑψίστου ἐν σκέπῃ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ αὐλισθήσεται.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
					\item[NIV] Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
					\item[NRSV] You who live in the shelter of the Most High, who abide in the shadow of the Almighty,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐρεῖ τῷ θεῷ Ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου εἶ· καὶ καταφυγή μου ὁ θεός μου, ἐλπιῶ ἐπ᾽ αὐτόν.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּֽילְךָ מִפַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ מִדֶּ֥בֶר הַוּֽוֹת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι αὐτὸς ῥύσεται ἐκ παγίδος θηρευτῶν, καὶ ἀπὸ λόγου ταραχώδους·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the deadly pestilence.
					\item[NIV] Surely he will save you from the fowler’s snare and from the deadly pestilence.
					\item[NRSV] For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler and from the deadly pestilence;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-91-4}

			He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τοῖς μεταφρένοις αὐτοῦ ἐπισκιάσει σοι, καὶ ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτοῦ ἐλπιεῖς· ὅπλῳ κυκλώσει σε ἡ ἀλήθεια αὐτοῦ.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι εὔφρανάς με, Κύριε, ἐν τῷ ποιήματί σου, καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν χειρῶν σου ἀγαλλιάσομαι.}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 93} % *PSALMS-93
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-93}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 93:1} % *PSALMS-93-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-93-1}

			The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ גֵּא֪וּת לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ לָבֵ֣שׁ יְ֭הוָה עֹ֣ז הִתְאַזָּ֑ר אַף־תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל בַּל־תִּמּֽוֹט׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ προσαββάτου, ὅτε κατῴκισται ἡ γῆ· αἶνος ᾠδῆς τῷ Δαυείδ. Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, εὐπρέπειαν ἐνεδύσατο· ἐνεδύσατο Κύριος δύναμιν καὶ περιεζώσατο, καὶ γὰρ ἐστερέωσεν τὴν οἰκουμένην, ἥτις οὐ σαλευθήσεται}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah reigneth; He is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.
					\item[NIV] The LORD reigns, he is robed in majesty; the LORD is robed in majesty and armed with strength; indeed, the world is established, firm and secure.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is king, he is robed in majesty; the LORD is robed, he is girded with strength. He has established the world; it shall never be moved;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 93:2} % *PSALMS-93-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-93-2}

			Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נָכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֲךָ֣ מֵאָ֑ז מֵֽעוֹלָ֣ם אָֽתָּה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕτοιμος ὁ θρόνος σου ἀπὸ τότε· ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος σὺ εἶ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.
					\item[NIV] Your throne was established long ago; you are from all eternity.
					\item[NRSV] your throne is established from of old; you are from everlasting.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 93:3} % *PSALMS-93-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-93-3}

			The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נָשְׂא֤וּ נְהָר֨וֹת ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה נָשְׂא֣וּ נְהָר֣וֹת קוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂא֖וּ נְהָר֣וֹת דָּכְיָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπῆραν οἱ ποταμοί, Κύριε, ἐπῆραν οἱ ποταμοὶ φωνὰς αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.
					\item[NIV] The seas have lifted up, LORD, the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves.
					\item[NRSV] The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their roaring.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 93:4} % *PSALMS-93-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-93-4}

			The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִקֹּל֨וֹת ׀ מַ֤יִם רַבִּ֗ים אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָ֑ם אַדִּ֖יר בַּמָּר֣וֹם יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ φωνῶν ὑδάτων πολλῶν θαυμαστοὶ οἱ μετεωρισμοὶ τῆς θαλάσσης· θαυμαστὸς ἐν ὑψηλοῖς ὁ κύριος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.
					\item[NIV] Mightier than the thunder of the great waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is mighty.
					\item[NRSV] More majestic than the thunders of mighty waters, more majestic than the waves of the sea, majestic on high is the LORD!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 93:5} % *PSALMS-93-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-93-5}

			Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עֵֽדֹתֶ֨יךָ ׀ נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ מְאֹ֗ד לְבֵיתְךָ֥ נַאֲוָה־קֹ֑דֶשׁ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὰ μαρτύριά σου ἐπιστώθησαν σφόδρα· τῷ οἴκῳ σου πρέπει ἁγίασμα, Κύριε, εἰς μακρότητα ἡμερῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.
					\item[NIV] Your statutes, LORD, stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days.
					\item[NRSV] Your decrees are very sure; holiness befits your house, O LORD, forevermore.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 94} % *PSALMS-94
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-94}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 94:1} % *PSALMS-94-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-1}

			O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֵל־נְקָמ֥וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֖ל נְקָמ֣וֹת הוֹפִֽיַע׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ, τετράδι σαββάτων. Ὁ θεὸς ἐκδικήσεων Κύριος, ὁ θεὸς ἐκδικήσεων ἐπαρρησιάσατο.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.
					\item[NIV] The LORD is a God who avenges. O God who avenges, shine forth.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, you God of vengeance, you God of vengeance, shine forth!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 94:2} % *PSALMS-94-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-2}

			Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִ֭נָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵ֣ט הָאָ֑רֶץ הָשֵׁ֥ב גְּ֝מ֗וּל עַל־גֵּאִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὑψώθητι ὁ κρίνων τὴν γῆν, ἀπόδος ἀνταπόδοσιν τοῖς ὑπερηφάνοις.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud their desert.
					\item[NIV] Rise up, Judge of the earth; pay back to the proud what they deserve.
					\item[NRSV] Rise up, O judge of the earth; give to the proud what they deserve!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 94:3} % *PSALMS-94-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-3}

			LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַד־מָתַ֖י רְשָׁעִ֥ים ׀ יְהוָ֑ה עַד־מָ֝תַ֗י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕως πότε ἁμαρτωλοί, Κύριε, ἕως πότε ἁμαρτωλοὶ καυχήσονται;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?
					\item[NIV] How long, LORD, will the wicked, how long will the wicked be jubilant?
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked exult?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 94:4} % *PSALMS-94-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-4}

			How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַבִּ֣יעוּ יְדַבְּר֣וּ עָתָ֑ק יִֽ֝תְאַמְּר֗וּ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φθέγξονται καὶ λαλήσουσιν ἀδικίαν, λαλήσουσιν πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.
					\item[NIV] They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers are full of boasting.
					\item[NRSV] They pour out their arrogant words; all the evildoers boast.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-5}

			They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַמְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה יְדַכְּא֑וּ וְֽנַחֲלָתְךָ֥ יְעַנּֽוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὸν λαόν σου, Κύριε, ἐταπείνωσαν, καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν σου ἐκάκωσαν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah, And afflict thy heritage.
					\item[NIV] They crush your people, LORD; they oppress your inheritance.
					\item[NRSV] They crush your people, O LORD, and afflict your heritage.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-6}

			They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַ֭לְמָנָה וְגֵ֣ר יַהֲרֹ֑גוּ וִֽיתוֹמִ֣ים יְרַצֵּֽחוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{χήραν καὶ ὀρφανὸν ἀπέκτειναν, καὶ προσήλυτον ἐφόνευσαν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] They slay the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
					\item[NRSV] They kill the widow and the stranger, they murder the orphan,

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-7}

			Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַ֭יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־יָּ֑הּ וְלֹא־יָ֝בִ֗ין אֱלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ εἶπαν Οὐκ ὄψεται Κύριος, οὐδὲ συνήσει ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ἰακώβ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And they say, Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.
					\item[NIV] They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob takes no notice.”
					\item[NRSV] and they say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob does not perceive.”

			\label{PSALMS-94-8}

			Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בִּ֭ינוּ בֹּעֲרִ֣ים בָּעָ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מָתַ֥י תַּשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σύνετε δή, ἄφρονες ἐν τῷ λαῷ· καὶ μωροί, ποτὲ φρονήσατε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?
					\item[NIV] Take notice, you senseless ones among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?
					\item[NRSV] Understand, O dullest of the people; fools, when will you be wise?

			He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

					\item[BHS] \he{הֲנֹ֣טַֽע אֹ֭זֶן הֲלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִֽם־יֹ֥צֵֽר עַ֝֗יִן הֲלֹ֣א יַבִּֽיט׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ φυτεύσας τὸ οὖς, οὐχὶ ἀκούει; ἢ ὁ πλάσας ὀφθαλμούς, οὐ κατανοεῖ;}
