					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Does he who fashioned the ear not hear? Does he who formed the eye not see?
					\item[NRSV] He who planted the ear, does he not hear? He who formed the eye, does he not see?

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]

			He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֲיֹסֵ֣ר גּ֭וֹיִם הֲלֹ֣א יוֹכִ֑יחַ הַֽמְלַמֵּ֖ד אָדָ֣ם דָּֽעַת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ παιδεύων ἔθνη, οὐχὶ ἐλέγξει, ὁ διδάσκων ἄνθρωπον γνῶσιν;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, Even he that teacheth man knowledge?
					\item[NIV] Does he who disciplines nations not punish? Does he who teaches mankind lack knowledge?
					\item[NRSV] He who disciplines the nations, he who teaches knowledge to humankind, does he not chastise?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-11}

			The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה יֹ֭דֵעַ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָדָ֑ם כִּי־הֵ֥מָּה הָֽבֶל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος γινώσκει τοὺς διαλογισμοὺς τῶν ἀνθρώπων, ὅτι εἰσὶν μάταιοι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.
					\item[NIV] The LORD knows all human plans; he knows that they are futile.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD knows our thoughts, that they are but an empty breath.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-12}

			Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַשְׁרֵ֤י ׀ הַגֶּ֣בֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶ֣נּוּ יָּ֑הּ וּֽמִתּוֹרָתְךָ֥ תְלַמְּדֶֽנּוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μακάριος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃν ἂν σὺ παιδεύσῃς, Κύριε, καὶ ἐκ τοῦ νόμου σου διδάξῃς αὐτόν,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;
					\item[NIV] Blessed is the one you discipline, LORD, the one you teach from your law;
					\item[NRSV] Happy are those whom you discipline, O LORD, and whom you teach out of your law,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-13}

			That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְהַשְׁקִ֣יט ל֭וֹ מִ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עַ֤ד יִכָּרֶ֖ה לָרָשָׁ֣ע שָֽׁחַת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῦ πρᾳῦναι αὐτῷ ἀφ᾽ ἡμερῶν πονηρῶν, ἕως οὗ ὀρυγῇ τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ βόθρος.}
					% % \item[BSV]

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

			For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐκ ἀπώσεται Κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψει,}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.
					\item[NIV] For the LORD will not reject his people; he will never forsake his inheritance.
					\item[NRSV] For the LORD will not forsake his people; he will not abandon his heritage;

		\paragraph{Psalms 94:15} % *PSALMS-94-15
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-15}

			But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־עַד־צֶ֭דֶק יָשׁ֣וּב מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝אַחֲרָ֗יו כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕως οὗ δικαιοσύνη ἐπιστρέψῃ εἰς κρίσιν, καὶ ἐχόμενοι αὐτῆς πάντες οἱ εὐθεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For judgment shall return unto righteousness; And all the upright in heart shall follow it.
					\item[NIV] Judgment will again be founded on righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
					\item[NRSV] for justice will return to the righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---

			Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

					\item[BHS] \he{מִֽי־יָק֣וּם לִ֭י עִם־מְרֵעִ֑ים מִֽי־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב לִ֝י עִם־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς ἀναστήσεταί μοι ἐπὶ πονηρευομένους, ἢ τίς συνπαραστήσεταί μοι ἐπὶ ἐργαζομένους τὴν ἀνομίαν;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
					\item[NIV] Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?
					\item[NRSV] Who rises up for me against the wicked? Who stands up for me against evildoers?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					\item[BHS] \he{לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י כִּמְעַ֓ט ׀ שָֽׁכְנָ֖ה דוּמָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰ μὴ ὅτι Κύριος ἐβοήθησέν μοι, παρὰ βραχὺ παρῴκησεν τῷ ᾅδῃ ἡ ψυχή μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Unless the LORD had given me help, I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.
					\item[NRSV] If the LORD had not been my help, my soul would soon have lived in the land of silence.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

			When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.

					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰ ἔλεγον Σεσάλευται ὁ πούς μου, τὸ ἔλεός σου, Κύριε, βοηθεῖ μοι.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] When I said, “My foot is slipping,” your unfailing love, LORD, supported me.
					\item[NRSV] When I thought, “My foot is slipping,” your steadfast love, O LORD, held me up.

			In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ὀδυνῶν μου ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ μου, αἱ παρακλήσεις σου ἠγάπησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought me joy.
					\item[NRSV] When the cares of my heart are many, your consolations cheer my soul.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-94-20}

			Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ συνπροσέσται σοι θρόνος ἀνομίας, ὁ πλάσσων κόπον ἐπὶ προστάγματι;}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Can a corrupt throne be allied with you— a throne that brings on misery by its decrees?
					\item[NRSV] Can wicked rulers be allied with you, those who contrive mischief by statute?

		% % ---

			They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָ֭גוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְדָ֖ם נָקִ֣י יַרְשִֽׁיעוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{θηρεύσουσιν ἐπὶ ψυχὴν δικαίου, καὶ αἷμα ἀθῷον καταδικάσονται.}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיְהִ֬י יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י לְמִשְׂגָּ֑ב וֵ֝אלֹהַ֗י לְצ֣וּר מַחְסִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐγένετό μοι Κύριος εἰς καταφυγήν, καὶ ὁ θεός μου εἰς βοηθὸν ἐλπίδος μου·}

					\item[NIV] But the LORD has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.

			And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיָּ֤שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֨ם ׀ אֶת־אוֹנָ֗ם וּבְרָעָתָ֥ם יַצְמִיתֵ֑ם יַ֝צְמִיתֵ֗ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἀποδώσει αὐτοῖς τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν πονηρίαν αὐτῶν· ἀφανιεῖ αὐτοὺς Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν.}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 95:1} % *PSALMS-95-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-95-1}

			O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Αἶνος ᾠδῆς τῷ Δαυείδ. Δεῦτε ἀγαλλιασώμεθα τῷ κυρίῳ, ἀλαλάξωμεν τῷ θεῷ τῷ σωτῆρι ἡμῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
					\item[NIV] Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.
					\item[NRSV] O come, let us sing to the LORD; let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-95-2}

			Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{προφθάσωμεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐξομολογήσει, καὶ ἐν ψαλμοῖς ἀλαλάξωμεν αὐτῷ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
					\item[NIV] Let us come before him with thanksgiving and extol him with music and song.
					\item[NRSV] Let us come into his presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to him with songs of praise!

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 95:3} % *PSALMS-95-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-95-3}

			For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι θεὸς μέγας Κύριος καὶ βασιλεὺς μέγας ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς θεούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For Jehovah is a great God, And a great King above all gods.
					\item[NIV] For the LORD is the great God, the great King above all gods.
					\item[NRSV] For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

			\label{PSALMS-95-4}

			In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְתוֹעֲפ֖וֹת הָרִ֣ים לֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐκ ἀπώσεται Κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰ ὕψη τῶν ὀρέων αὐτοῦ ἐστιν·}

					\item[NRSV] In his hand are the depths of the earth; the heights of the mountains are his also.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

			The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲשֶׁר־ל֣וֹ הַ֭יָּם וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ἡ θάλασσα καὶ αὐτὸς ἐποίησεν αὐτήν, καὶ τὴν ξηρὰν αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ἔπλασαν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{δεῦτε προσκυνήσωμεν καὶ προσπέσωμεν αὐτῷ, καὶ κλαύσωμεν ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ ποιήσαντος ἡμᾶς·}

					\item[NIV] Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the LORD our Maker;

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-95-7}

			For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם־בְּקֹל֥וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, καὶ ἡμεῖς λαὸς νομῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ πρόβατα χειρὸς αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For he is our God, And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, oh that ye would hear his voice!
					\item[NIV] for he is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if only you would hear his voice,
					\item[NRSV] For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. O that today you would listen to his voice!

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-95-8}

			Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַל־תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָ֑ה כְּי֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν, ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ, κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ πειρασμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ·}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] “Do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, as you did that day at Massah in the wilderness,
					\item[NRSV] Do not harden your hearts, as at Meribah, as on the day at Massah in the wilderness,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 95:9} % *PSALMS-95-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-95-9}

			When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭סּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּ֝חָנ֗וּנִי גַּם־רָא֥וּ פָעֳלִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὗ ἐπείρασαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν, ἐδοκίμασαν καὶ ἴδοσαν τὰ ἔργα μου.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] where your ancestors tested me; they tried me, though they had seen what I did.
					\item[NRSV] when your ancestors tested me, and put me to the proof, though they had seen my work.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 95:10} % *PSALMS-95-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-95-10}

			Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה ׀ אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא־יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη προσώχθισα τῇ γενεᾷ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ εἶπα Ἀεὶ πλανῶνται τῇ καρδίᾳ, καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰς ὁδούς μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Forty years long was I grieved with that generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:
					\item[NIV] For forty years I was angry with that generation; I said, ‘They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known my ways.’
					\item[NRSV] For forty years I loathed that generation and said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they do not regard my ways.”

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-95-11}

			Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי בְאַפִּ֑י אִם־יְ֝בֹא֗וּן אֶל־מְנוּחָתִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.}

					% % \item[NETS]

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’”
					\item[NRSV] Therefore in my anger I swore, “They shall not enter my rest.”

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 96:1} % *PSALMS-96-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-96-1}

			O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ὅτε ὁ οἶκος οἰκοδομεῖται μετὰ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν· ᾠδὴ τῷ Δαυείδ. ᾌσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ᾆσμα καινόν, ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
					\item[NRSV] O sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.

			Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ, εὐλογήσατε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀναγγείλατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς λαοῖς τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι μέγας Κύριος καὶ αἰνετὸς σφόδρα, φοβερός ἐστιν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς θεούς·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι πάντες οἱ θεοὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν δαιμόνια, ὁ δὲ κύριος τοὺς οὐρανοὺς ἐποίησεν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξομολόγησις καὶ ὡραιότης ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, ἁγιωσύνη καὶ μεγαλοπρέπεια ἐν τῷ ἁγιάσματι αὐτοῦ.}

					\item[BHS] \he{הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ, αἱ πατριαὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν, ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν καὶ τιμήν·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ, ἄρατε θυσίας καὶ εἰσπορεύεσθε εἰς τὰς αὐλὰς αὐτοῦ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{εἴπατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν Ὁ κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, καὶ γὰρ κατώρθωσεν τὴν οἰκουμένην, ἥτις οὐ σαλευθήσεται· κρινεῖ λαοὺς ἐν εὐθύτητι.}

					\item[NIV] Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is firmly established, it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity.

					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἀγαλλιάσθω ἡ γῆ, σαλευθήτω ἡ θάλασσα καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
					\item[NIV] Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it.
					\item[NRSV] Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; let the sea roar, and all that fills it;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 96:12} % *PSALMS-96-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-96-12}

			Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּ֑וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־יָֽעַר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{χαρήσεται τὰ πεδία καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς, τότε ἀγαλλιάσονται πάντα τὰ ξύλα τοῦ δρυμοῦ}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the field exult, and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy
					\item[NIV] Let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them; let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.
					\item[NRSV] let the field exult, and everything in it. Then shall all the trees of the forest sing for joy
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 96:13} % *PSALMS-96-13
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-96-13}

			Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה ׀ כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בֶּאֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πρὸ προσώπου Κυρίου, ὅτι ἔρχεται, ὅτι ἔρχεται κρῖναι τὴν γῆν· κρινεῖ τὴν οἰκουμένην ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ λαοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Before Jehovah; for he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with his truth.
					\item[NIV] Let all creation rejoice before the LORD, for he comes, he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in his faithfulness.
					\item[NRSV] before the LORD; for he is coming, for he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with his truth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 97} % *PSALMS-97
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-97}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:1} % *PSALMS-97-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-1}

			The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τῷ Δαυείδ, ὅτε ἡ γῆ αὐτοῦ καθίσταται. Ὁ κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, ἀγαλλιάσεται ἡ γῆ, εὐφρανθήτωσαν νῆσοι πολλαί.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.
					\item[NIV] The LORD reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is king! Let the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be glad!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:2} % *PSALMS-97-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-2}

			Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{νεφέλη καὶ γνόφος κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ, δικαιοσύνη καὶ κρίμα κατόρθωσις τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
					\item[NIV] Clouds and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
					\item[NRSV] Clouds and thick darkness are all around him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:3} % *PSALMS-97-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-3}

			A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֵ֭שׁ לְפָנָ֣יו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּתְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πῦρ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ προπορεύσεται, καὶ φλογιεῖ κύκλῳ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.
					\item[NIV] Fire goes before him and consumes his foes on every side.
					\item[NRSV] Fire goes before him, and consumes his adversaries on every side.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:4} % *PSALMS-97-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-4}

			His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣יו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔφαναν αἱ ἀστραπαὶ αὐτοῦ τῇ οἰκουμένῃ, εἶδεν καὶ ἐσαλεύθη ἡ γῆ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] His lightnings lightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.
					\item[NIV] His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.
					\item[NRSV] His lightnings light up the world; the earth sees and trembles.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:5} % *PSALMS-97-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-5}

			The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הָרִ֗ים כַּדּוֹנַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὰ ὄρη ἐτάκησαν ὡσεὶ κηρὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου Κυρίου, ἀπὸ προσώπου Κυρίου πάσης τῆς γῆς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
					\item[NIV] The mountains melt like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
					\item[NRSV] The mountains melt like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:6} % *PSALMS-97-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-6}

			The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ וְרָא֖וּ כָל־הָעַמִּ֣ים כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνήγγειλαν οἱ οὐρανοὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἴδοσαν πάντες οἱ λαοὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.
					\item[NIV] The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all peoples see his glory.
					\item[NRSV] The heavens proclaim his righteousness; and all the peoples behold his glory.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:7} % *PSALMS-97-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-7}

			Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ ׀ כָּל־עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֝וֹ כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰσχυνθήτωσαν πάντες οἱ προσκυνοῦντες τοῖς γλυπτοῖς, οἱ ἐγκαυχώμενοι ἐν τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν· προσκυνήσατε αὐτῷ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.
					\item[NIV] All who worship images are put to shame, those who boast in idols— worship him, all you gods!
					\item[NRSV] All worshipers of images are put to shame, those who make their boast in worthless idols; all gods bow down before him.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:8} % *PSALMS-97-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-8}

			Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח ׀ צִיּ֗וֹן וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἤκουσεν καὶ εὐφράνθη Σειών, καὶ ἠγαλλιάσαντο αἱ θυγατέρες τῆς Ἰουδαίας, ἕνεκεν τῶν κριμάτων σου, Κύριε·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Zion hears and rejoices and the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments, LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Zion hears and is glad, and the towns of Judah rejoice, because of your judgments, O God.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:9} % *PSALMS-97-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-9}

			For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι σὺ εἶ Κύριος ὁ ὕψιστος ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν, σφόδρα ὑπερυψώθης ὑπὲρ πάντας τοὺς θεούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.
					\item[NIV] For you, LORD, are the Most High over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.
					\item[NRSV] For you, O LORD, are most high over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:10} % *PSALMS-97-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-10}

			Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑יו מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οἱ ἀγαπῶντες τὸν κύριον, μισεῖτε πονηρόν· φυλάσσει Κύριος τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν ὁσίων αὐτοῦ, ἐκ χειρὸς ἁμαρτωλῶν ῥύσεται αὐτούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
					\item[NIV] Let those who love the LORD hate evil, for he guards the lives of his faithful ones and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD loves those who hate evil; he guards the lives of his faithful; he rescues them from the hand of the wicked.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:11} % *PSALMS-97-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-11}

			Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{א֭וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּֽלְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φῶς ἀνέτειλεν τῷ δικαίῳ, καὶ τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ εὐφροσύνη.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
					\item[NIV] Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart.
					\item[NRSV] Light dawns for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 97:12} % *PSALMS-97-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-97-12}

			Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐφράνθητε, δίκαιοι, ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ, καὶ ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῇ μνήμῃ τῆς ἁγιωσύνης αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial name.
					\item[NIV] Rejoice in the LORD, you who are righteous, and praise his holy name.
					\item[NRSV] Rejoice in the LORD, O you righteous, and give thanks to his holy name!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 98} % *PSALMS-98
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-98}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 98:1} % *PSALMS-98-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-98-1}

			O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָ֨ה ׀ שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ כִּֽי־נִפְלָא֣וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה־לּ֥וֹ יְ֝מִינ֗וֹ וּזְר֥וֹעַ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ. ᾌσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ᾆσμα καινόν, ὅτι θαυμαστὰ ἐποίησεν Κύριος· ἔσωσεν αὐτῷ ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ βραχίων ὁ ἅγιος αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm. Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.
					\item[NIV] A psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things; his right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
					\item[NRSV] O sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things. His right hand and his holy arm have gotten him victory.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 98:2} % *PSALMS-98-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-98-2}

			The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוֹדִ֣יעַ יְ֭הוָה יְשׁוּעָת֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י הַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם גִּלָּ֥ה צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐγνώρισεν Κύριος τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ ἐναντίον τῶν ἐθνῶν· ἀπεκάλυψεν τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.
					\item[NIV] The LORD has made his salvation known and revealed his righteousness to the nations.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD has made known his victory; he has revealed his vindication in the sight of the nations.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 98:3} % *PSALMS-98-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-98-3}

			He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זָ֘כַ֤ר חַסְדּ֨וֹ ׀ וֶֽאֱֽמוּנָתוֹ֮ לְבֵ֪ית יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל רָא֥וּ כָל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֝֗ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐμνήσθη τοῦ ἐλέους αὐτοῦ τῷ Ἰακώβ, καὶ τῆς ἀληθείας αὐτοῦ τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραήλ· εἴδοσαν πάντα τὰ πέρατα τῆς γῆς τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
					\item[NIV] He has remembered his love and his faithfulness to Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
					\item[NRSV] He has remembered his steadfast love and faithfulness to the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the victory of our God.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 98:4} % *PSALMS-98-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-98-4}

			Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הָרִ֣יעוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְרַנְּנ֣וּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀλαλάξατε τῷ θεῷ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ, ᾄσατε καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε καὶ ψάλατε.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.
					\item[NIV] Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;
					\item[NRSV] Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth into joyous song and sing praises.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 98:5} % *PSALMS-98-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-98-5}

			Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר וְק֣וֹל זִמְרָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ψάλατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν κιθάρᾳ, ἐν κιθάρᾳ καὶ φωνῇ ψαλμοῦ,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.
					\item[NIV] make music to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing,
					\item[NRSV] Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, with the lyre and the sound of melody.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 98:6} % *PSALMS-98-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-98-6}

			With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בַּ֭חֲצֹ֣צְרוֹת וְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לִפְנֵ֤י ׀ הַמֶּ֬לֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν σάλπιγξιν ἐλαταῖς καὶ φωνῇ σάλπιγγος κερατίνης· ἀλαλάξατε ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως Κυρίῳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] with trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn— shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
					\item[NRSV] With trumpets and the sound of the horn make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 98:7} % *PSALMS-98-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-98-7}

			Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִרְעַ֣ם הַ֭יָּם וּמְלֹא֑וֹ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σαλευθήτω ἡ θάλασσα καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς, ἡ οἰκουμένη καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες αὐτήν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;
					\item[NIV] Let the sea resound, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
					\item[NRSV] Let the sea roar, and all that fills it; the world and those who live in it.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 98:8} % *PSALMS-98-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-98-8}

			Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נְהָר֥וֹת יִמְחֲאוּ־כָ֑ף יַ֝֗חַד הָרִ֥ים יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ποταμοὶ κροτήσουσιν χειρὶ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, τὰ ὄρη ἀγαλλιάσονται,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together
					\item[NIV] Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy;
					\item[NRSV] Let the floods clap their hands; let the hills sing together for joy
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 98:9} % *PSALMS-98-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-98-9}

			Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לִֽפְֽנֵי־יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἥκει κρῖναι τὴν γῆν· κρινεῖ τὴν οἰκουμένην ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ λαοὺς ἐν εὐθύτητι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.
					\item[NIV] let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples with equity.
					\item[NRSV] at the presence of the LORD, for he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 99} % *PSALMS-99
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-99}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 99:1} % *PSALMS-99-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-99-1}

			The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ. Κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, ὀργιζέσθωσαν λαοί· ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῶν χερουβείμ, σαλευθήτω ἡ γῆ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He sitteth above the cherubim; let the earth be moved.
					\item[NIV] The LORD reigns, let the nations tremble; he sits enthroned between the cherubim, let the earth shake.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is king; let the peoples tremble! He sits enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 99:2} % *PSALMS-99-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-99-2}

			The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְ֭הוָה בְּצִיּ֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וְרָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל־כָּל־הָֽעַמִּֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἐν Σειὼν μέγας, καὶ ὑψηλός ἐστιν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς λαούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is great in Zion; And he is high above all the peoples.
					\item[NIV] Great is the LORD in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is great in Zion; he is exalted over all the peoples.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 99:3} % *PSALMS-99-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-99-3}

			Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν πάντες τῷ ὀνόματί σου τῷ μεγάλῳ, ὅτι φοβερὸν καὶ ἅγιόν ἐστιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let them praise thy great and terrible name: Holy is he.
					\item[NIV] Let them praise your great and awesome name— he is holy.
					\item[NRSV] Let them praise your great and awesome name. Holy is he!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 99:4} % *PSALMS-99-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-99-4}

			The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב ׀ אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ τιμὴ βασιλέως κρίσιν ἀγαπᾷ· σὺ ἡτοίμασας εὐθύτητας, κρίσιν καὶ δικαιοσύνην ἐν Ἰακὼβ σὺ ἐποίησας.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The king's strength also loveth justice; Thou dost establish equity; Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.
					\item[NIV] The King is mighty, he loves justice— you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.
					\item[NRSV] Mighty King, lover of justice, you have established equity; you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 99:5} % *PSALMS-99-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-99-5}

			Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν, καὶ προσκυνεῖτε τῷ ὑποποδίῳ τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: Holy is he.
					\item[NIV] Exalt the LORD our God and worship at his footstool; he is holy.
					\item[NRSV] Extol the LORD our God; worship at his footstool. Holy is he!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 99:6} % *PSALMS-99-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-99-6}

			Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן ׀ בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἅγιός ἐστιν Μωυσῆς καὶ Ἀαρὼν ἐν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ Σαμουὴλ ἐν τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ· ἐπεκαλοῦντο τὸν κύριον, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπήκουσεν αὐτοῖς,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.
					\item[NIV] Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the LORD and he answered them.
					\item[NRSV] Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel also was among those who called on his name. They cried to the LORD, and he answered them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 99:7} % *PSALMS-99-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-99-7}

			He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן־לָֽמוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν στύλῳ νεφέλης ἐλάλει πρὸς αὐτούς· ἐφύλασσον τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ προστάγματα ἃ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud: They kept his testimonies, And the statute that he gave them.
					\item[NIV] He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.
					\item[NRSV] He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud; they kept his decrees, and the statutes that he gave them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 99:8} % *PSALMS-99-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-99-8}

			Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל־עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, σὺ ἐπήκουες αὐτῶν· ὁ θεός, εὐίλατος ἐγίνου αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐκδικῶν ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.
					\item[NIV] LORD our God, you answered them; you were to Israel a forgiving God, though you punished their misdeeds.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD our God, you answered them; you were a forgiving God to them, but an avenger of their wrongdoings.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 99:9} % *PSALMS-99-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-99-9}

			Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ כִּֽי־קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὑψοῦτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν, καὶ προσκυνεῖτε εἰς ὄρος ἅγιον αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἅγιος Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his holy hill; For Jehovah our God is holy.
					\item[NIV] Exalt the LORD our God and worship at his holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
					\item[NRSV] Extol the LORD our God, and worship at his holy mountain; for the LORD our God is holy.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 100} % *PSALMS-100
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-100}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 100:1} % *PSALMS-100-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-100-1}

			Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֥וֹר לְתוֹדָ֑ה הָרִ֥יעוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς εἰς ἐξομολόγησιν. Ἀλαλάξατε τῷ κυρίῳ, πᾶσα ἡ γῆ,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.
					\item[NIV] A psalm. For giving grateful praise. Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth.
					\item[NRSV] Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 100:2} % *PSALMS-100-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-100-2}

			Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה בֹּ֥אוּ לְ֝פָנָ֗יו בִּרְנָנָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{δουλεύσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ, εἰσέλθατε ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.
					\item[NIV] Worship the LORD with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.
					\item[NRSV] Worship the LORD with gladness; come into his presence with singing.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 100:3} % *PSALMS-100-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-100-3}

			Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי־יְהוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא־עָ֭שָׂנוּ וְל֣וֹ אֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מּ֗וֹ וְצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{γνῶτε ὅτι Κύριος, αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ θεός· αὐτὸς ἐποίησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ οὐχ ἡμεῖς, λαὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ πρόβατα τῆς νομῆς αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us, and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
					\item[NIV] Know that the LORD is God. It is he who made us, and we are his; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.
					\item[NRSV] Know that the LORD is God. It is he that made us, and we are his; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 100:4} % *PSALMS-100-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-100-4}

			Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בֹּ֤אוּ שְׁעָרָ֨יו ׀ בְּתוֹדָ֗ה חֲצֵרֹתָ֥יו בִּתְהִלָּ֑ה הֽוֹדוּ־ל֝֗וֹ בָּרֲכ֥וּ שְׁמֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰσέλθατε εἰς τὰς πύλας αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐξομολογήσει, τὰς αὐλὰς αὐτοῦ ἐν ὕμνοις· ἐξομολογεῖσθε αὐτῷ, αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.
					\item[NIV] Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.
					\item[NRSV] Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, bless his name.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 100:5} % *PSALMS-100-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-100-5}

			For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּי־ט֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְעַד־דֹּ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι χρηστὸς Κύριος, εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἕως γενεᾶς καὶ γενεᾶς ἡ ἀλήθεια αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness endureth for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.
					\item[NIV] For the LORD is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.
					\item[NRSV] For the LORD is good; his steadfast love endures forever, and his faithfulness to all generations.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 101} % *PSALMS-101
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-101}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 101:1} % *PSALMS-101-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-101-1}

			I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר חֶֽסֶד־וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τῷ Δαυεὶδ ψαλμός. Ἔλεος καὶ κρίσιν ᾄσομαί σοι, Κύριε·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. I will sing of lovingkindness and justice: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I sing praises.
					\item[NIV] Of David. A psalm. I will sing of your love and justice; to you, LORD, I will sing praise.
					\item[NRSV] I will sing of loyalty and of justice; to you, O LORD, I will sing.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 101:2} % *PSALMS-101-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-101-2}

			I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַשְׂכִּ֤ילָה ׀ בְּדֶ֬רֶךְ תָּמִ֗ים מָ֭תַי תָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑י אֶתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּתָם־לְ֝בָבִ֗י בְּקֶ֣רֶב בֵּיתִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ψαλῶ καὶ συνήσω ἐν ᾠδῇ ἀμώμῳ· πότε ἥξεις πρὸς μέ; διεπορευόμην ἐν ἀκακίᾳ καρδίας μου, ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ οἴκου μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way: Oh when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
					\item[NIV] I will be careful to lead a blameless life— when will you come to me? I will conduct the affairs of my house with a blameless heart.
					\item[NRSV] I will study the way that is blameless. When shall I attain it? I will walk with integrity of heart within my house;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 101:3} % *PSALMS-101-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-101-3}

			I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֹֽא־אָשִׁ֨ית ׀ לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינַ֗י דְּֽבַר־בְּלִ֫יָּ֥עַל עֲשֹֽׂה־סֵטִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי לֹ֖א יִדְבַּ֣ק בִּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐ προεθέμην πρὸ ὀφθαλμῶν μου πρᾶγμα παράνομον, ποιοῦντας παραβάσεις ἐμίσησα· οὐκ ἐκολλήθη μοι καρδία σκαμβή,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will set no base thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; It shall not cleave unto me.
					\item[NIV] I will not look with approval on anything that is vile. I hate what faithless people do; I will have no part in it.
					\item[NRSV] I will not set before my eyes anything that is base. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 101:4} % *PSALMS-101-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-101-4}

			A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֵבָ֣ב עִ֭קֵּשׁ יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נִּי רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א אֵדָֽע׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκκλίνοντος ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ τοῦ πονηροῦ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil thing.
					\item[NIV] The perverse of heart shall be far from me; I will have nothing to do with what is evil.
					\item[NRSV] Perverseness of heart shall be far from me; I will know nothing of evil.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 101:5} % *PSALMS-101-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-101-5}

			Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מְלָשְׁנִ֬י בַסֵּ֨תֶר ׀ רֵעֵהוּ֮ אוֹת֪וֹ אַ֫צְמִ֥ית גְּֽבַהּ־עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַ֣ב לֵבָ֑ב אֹ֝ת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὸν καταλαλοῦντα λάθρα τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ, τοῦτον ἐξεδίωκον· ὑπερηφάνῳ ὀφθαλμῷ καὶ ἀπλήστῳ καρδίᾳ, τούτῳ οὐ συνήσθιον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Whoso privily slandereth his neighbor, him will I destroy: Him that hath a high look and a proud heart will I not suffer.
					\item[NIV] Whoever slanders their neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not tolerate.
					\item[NRSV] One who secretly slanders a neighbor I will destroy. A haughty look and an arrogant heart I will not tolerate.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 101:6} % *PSALMS-101-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-101-6}

			Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עֵינַ֤י ׀ בְּנֶֽאֶמְנֵי־אֶרֶץ֮ לָשֶׁ֪בֶת עִמָּ֫דִ֥י הֹ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ תָּמִ֑ים ה֝֗וּא יְשָׁרְתֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ἐπὶ τοὺς πιστοὺς τῆς γῆς, τοῦ συνκαθῆσθαι αὐτοὺς μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ· πορευόμενος ἐν ὁδῷ ἀμώμῳ, οὗτός μοι ἐλειτούργει.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: He that walketh in a perfect way, he shall minister unto me.
					\item[NIV] My eyes will be on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; the one whose walk is blameless will minister to me.
					\item[NRSV] I will look with favor on the faithful in the land, so that they may live with me; whoever walks in the way that is blameless shall minister to me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 101:7} % *PSALMS-101-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-101-7}

			He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֹֽא־יֵשֵׁ֨ב ׀ בְּקֶ֥רֶב בֵּיתִי֮ עֹשֵׂ֪ה רְמִ֫יָּ֥ה דֹּבֵ֥ר שְׁקָרִ֑ים לֹֽא־יִ֝כּ֗וֹן לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐ κατῴκει ἐν μέσῳ τῆς οἰκίας μου ποιῶν ὑπερηφανίαν· λαλῶν ἄδικα οὐ κατεύθυνεν ἐναντίον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: He that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.
					\item[NIV] No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.
					\item[NRSV] No one who practices deceit shall remain in my house; no one who utters lies shall continue in my presence.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 101:8} % *PSALMS-101-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-101-8}

			I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַבְּקָרִ֗ים אַצְמִ֥ית כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָ֑רֶץ לְהַכְרִ֥ית מֵֽעִיר־יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰς τὰς πρωίας ἀπέκτεννον πάντας τοὺς ἁμαρτωλοὺς τῆς γῆς, τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἐκ πόλεως Κυρίου πάντας τοὺς ἐργαζομένους τὴν ἀδικίαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; To cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Every morning I will put to silence all the wicked in the land; I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Morning by morning I will destroy all the wicked in the land, cutting off all evildoers from the city of the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 102} % *PSALMS-102
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-102}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:1} % *PSALMS-102-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-1}

			Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי־יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Εἰσάκουσον, Κύριε, τῆς προσευχῆς μου, καὶ ἡ κραυγή μου πρὸς σὲ ἐλθάτω.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah. Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And let my cry come unto thee.
					\item[NIV] A prayer of an afflicted person who has grown weak and pours out a lament before the LORD. Hear my prayer, LORD; let my cry for help come to you.
					\item[NRSV] Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry come to you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:2} % *PSALMS-102-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-2}

			Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֽוֹא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ· ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ θλίβωμαι, κλῖνον τὸ οὖς σου πρὸς μέ· ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλέσωμαί σε, ταχὺ εἰσάκουσόν μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.
					\item[NIV] Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Turn your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.
					\item[NRSV] Do not hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Incline your ear to me; answer me speedily in the day when I call.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:3} % *PSALMS-102-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-3}

			For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ ׀ מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֪וֹם צַ֫ר לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אָזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐξέλιπον ὡσεὶ καπνὸς αἱ ἡμέραι μου, καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ὡσεὶ φρύγιον συνεφρύγησαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For my days consume away like smoke, And my bones are burned as a firebrand.
					\item[NIV] For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.
					\item[NRSV] For my days pass away like smoke, and my bones burn like a furnace.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:4} % *PSALMS-102-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-4}

			My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י כְּמוֹ־קֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπλήγην ὡσεὶ χόρτος καὶ ἐξηράνθη ἡ καρδία μου, ὅτι ἐπελαθόμην τοῦ φαγεῖν τὸν ἄρτον μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.
					\item[NIV] My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.
					\item[NRSV] My heart is stricken and withered like grass; I am too wasted to eat my bread.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:5} % *PSALMS-102-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-5}

			By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוּכָּֽה־כָ֭עֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי־שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ φωνῆς τοῦ στεναγμοῦ μου ἐκολλήθη τὸ ὀστοῦν μου τῇ σαρκί μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.
					\item[NIV] In my distress I groan aloud and am reduced to skin and bones.
					\item[NRSV] Because of my loud groaning my bones cling to my skin.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:6} % *PSALMS-102-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-6}

			I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡμοιώθην πελεκᾶνι ἐρημικῷ, ἐγενήθην ὡσεὶ νυκτικόραξ ἐν οἰκοπέδῳ,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.
					\item[NIV] I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
					\item[NRSV] I am like an owl of the wilderness, like a little owl of the waste places.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:7} % *PSALMS-102-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-7}

			I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἠγρύπνησα καὶ ἐγενήθην ὡσεὶ στρουθίον μονάζον ἐπὶ δώματι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.
					\item[NIV] I lie awake; I have become like a bird alone on a roof.
					\item[NRSV] I lie awake; I am like a lonely bird on the housetop.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:8} % *PSALMS-102-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-8}

			Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל־גָּֽג׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ὠνείδιζόν με οἱ ἐχθροί μου, καὶ οἱ ἐπαινοῦντές με κατ᾽ ἐμοῦ ὤμνυον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.
					\item[NIV] All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.
					\item[NRSV] All day long my enemies taunt me; those who deride me use my name for a curse.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:9} % *PSALMS-102-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-9}

			For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אוֹיְבָ֑י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι σποδὸν ὡσεὶ ἄρτον ἔφαγον, καὶ τὸ πόμα μου μετὰ κλαυθμοῦ ἐκίρνων,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,
					\item[NIV] For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears
					\item[NRSV] For I eat ashes like bread, and mingle tears with my drink,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:10} % *PSALMS-102-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-10}

			Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּי־אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς ὀργῆς σου καὶ τοῦ θυμοῦ σου, ὅτι ἐπάρας κατέρραξάς με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.
					\item[NIV] because of your great wrath, for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.
					\item[NRSV] because of your indignation and anger; for you have lifted me up and thrown me aside.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:11} % *PSALMS-102-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-11}

			My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִפְּנֵֽי־זַֽעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἱ ἡμέραι μου ὡσεὶ σκιὰ ἐκλίθησαν, καὶ ἐγὼ ὡσεὶ χόρτος ἐξηράνθην.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.
					\item[NIV] My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.
					\item[NRSV] My days are like an evening shadow; I wither away like grass.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:12} % *PSALMS-102-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-12}

			But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σὺ δέ, Κύριε, εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα μένεις, καὶ τὸ μνημόσυνόν σου εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial name unto all generations.
					\item[NIV] But you, LORD, sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations.
					\item[NRSV] But you, O LORD, are enthroned forever; your name endures to all generations.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:13} % *PSALMS-102-13
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-13}

			Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σὺ ἀναστὰς οἰκτειρήσεις τὴν Σειών, ὅτι καιρὸς τοῦ οἰκτειρῆσαι αὐτήν, ὅτι ἥκει καιρός.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.
					\item[NIV] You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.
					\item[NRSV] You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to favor it; the appointed time has come.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 102:14} % *PSALMS-102-14
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-102-14}

			For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי־עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי־בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד׃}
