			To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑וֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵ֥י פִ֝קֻּדָ֗יו לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῖς φυλάσσουσιν τὴν διαθήκην αὐτοῦ, καὶ μεμνημένοις τῶν ἐντολῶν αὐτοῦ τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτάς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] To such as keep his covenant, And to those that remember his precepts to do them.
					\item[NIV] with those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his precepts.
					\item[NRSV] to those who keep his covenant and remember to do his commandments.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 103:19} % *PSALMS-103-19
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-103-19}

			The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה בַּ֭שָּׁמַיִם הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכוּת֗וֹ בַּכֹּ֥ל מָשָֽׁלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἡτοίμασεν τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ πάντων δεσπόζει.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.
					\item[NIV] The LORD has established his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over all.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD has established his throne in the heavens, and his kingdom rules over all.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 103:20} % *PSALMS-103-20
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-103-20}

			Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בָּרֲכ֥וּ יְהוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον, πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ, δυνατοὶ ἰσχύι, ποιοῦντες τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ, τοῦ ἀκοῦσαι τῆς φωνῆς τῶν λόγων αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD, you his angels, you mighty ones who do his bidding, who obey his word.
					\item[NRSV] Bless the LORD, O you his angels, you mighty ones who do his bidding, obedient to his spoken word.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 103:21} % *PSALMS-103-21
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-103-21}

			Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בָּרֲכ֣וּ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־צְבָאָ֑יו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον, πᾶσαι αἱ δυνάμεις αὐτοῦ, λειτουργοὶ αὐτοῦ ποιοῦντες τὰ θελήματα αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts, Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD, all his heavenly hosts, you his servants who do his will.
					\item[NRSV] Bless the LORD, all his hosts, his ministers that do his will.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 103:22} % *PSALMS-103-22
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-103-22}

			Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בָּרֲכ֤וּ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ כָּֽל־מַעֲשָׂ֗יו בְּכָל־מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑וֹ בָּרֲכִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον, πάντα τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ τῆς δυναστείας αὐτοῦ· εὐλόγει, ἡ ψυχή μου, τὸν κύριον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Bless Jehovah, all ye his works, In all places of his dominion: Bless Jehovah, O my soul.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD, all his works everywhere in his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul.
					\item[NRSV] Bless the LORD, all his works, in all places of his dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 104} % *PSALMS-104
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-104}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:1} % *PSALMS-104-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-1}

			Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בָּרֲכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְה֫וָ֥ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי גָּדַ֣לְתָּ מְּאֹ֑ד ה֭וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר לָבָֽשְׁתָּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τῷ Δαυείδ. Εὐλόγει, ἡ ψυχή μου, τὸν κύριον· Κύριε, Κύριε, ὁ θεός μου, ὡς ἐμεγαλύνθης σφόδρα. ἐξομολόγησιν καὶ εὐπρέπειαν ἐνεδύσω,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD, my soul. LORD my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.
					\item[NRSV] Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:2} % *PSALMS-104-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-2}

			Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עֹֽטֶה־א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀναβαλλόμενος φῶς ὡς ἱμάτιον, ἐκτείνων τὸν οὐρανὸν ὡσεὶ δέρριν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment; Who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;
					\item[NIV] The LORD wraps himself in light as with a garment; he stretches out the heavens like a tent
					\item[NRSV] wrapped in light as with a garment. You stretch out the heavens like a tent,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:3} % *PSALMS-104-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-3}

			Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַ֥מְקָרֶֽה בַמַּ֗יִם עֲ‍ֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו הַשָּׂם־עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ στεγάζων ἐν ὕδασιν τὰ ὑπερῷα αὐτοῦ, ὁ τιθεὶς νέφη τὴν ἐπίβασιν αὐτοῦ, ὁ περιπατῶν ἐπὶ πτερύγων ἀνέμων·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters; Who maketh the clouds his chariot; Who walketh upon the wings of the wind;
					\item[NIV] and lays the beams of his upper chambers on their waters. He makes the clouds his chariot and rides on the wings of the wind.
					\item[NRSV] you set the beams of your chambers on the waters, you make the clouds your chariot, you ride on the wings of the wind,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:4} % *PSALMS-104-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-4}

			Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עֹשֶׂ֣ה מַלְאָכָ֣יו רוּח֑וֹת מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו אֵ֣שׁ לֹהֵֽט׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα, καὶ τοὺς λειτουργοὺς αὐτοῦ πῦρ φλέγον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who maketh winds his messengers; Flames of fire his ministers;
					\item[NIV] He makes winds his messengers, flames of fire his servants.
					\item[NRSV] you make the winds your messengers, fire and flame your ministers.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:5} % *PSALMS-104-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-5}

			Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יָֽסַד־אֶ֭רֶץ עַל־מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל־תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐθεμελίωσεν τὴν γῆν ἐπὶ τὴν ἀσφαλίαν αὐτῆς, οὐ κλιθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved for ever.
					\item[NIV] He set the earth on its foundations; it can never be moved.
					\item[NRSV] You set the earth on its foundations, so that it shall never be shaken.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:6} % *PSALMS-104-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-6}

			Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ כִּסִּית֑וֹ עַל־הָ֝רִ֗ים יַֽעַמְדוּ־מָֽיִם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄβυσσος ὡς ἱμάτιον τὸ περιβόλαιον αὐτοῦ, ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων στήσονται ὕδατα·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture; The waters stood above the mountains.
					\item[NIV] You covered it with the watery depths as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
					\item[NRSV] You cover it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:7} % *PSALMS-104-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-7}

			At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִן־גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן־ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ ἐπιτιμήσεώς σου φεύξονται, ἀπὸ φωνῆς βροντῆς σου δειλιάσουσιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away
					\item[NIV] But at your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;
					\item[NRSV] At your rebuke they flee; at the sound of your thunder they take to flight.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:8} % *PSALMS-104-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-8}

			They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַעֲל֣וּ הָ֭רִים יֵרְד֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת אֶל־מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה ׀ יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀναβαίνουσιν ὄρη, καὶ καταβαίνουσιν πεδία εἰς τόπον ὃν ἐθεμελίωσας αὐτοῖς·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.
					\item[NIV] they flowed over the mountains, they went down into the valleys, to the place you assigned for them.
					\item[NRSV] They rose up to the mountains, ran down to the valleys to the place that you appointed for them.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:9} % *PSALMS-104-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-9}

			Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גְּֽבוּל־שַׂ֭מְתָּ בַּל־יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל־יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅριον ἔθου ὃ οὐ παρελεύσονται, οὐδὲ ἀποστρέψουσιν καλύψαι τὴν γῆν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.
					\item[NIV] You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again will they cover the earth.
					\item[NRSV] You set a boundary that they may not pass, so that they might not again cover the earth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:10} % *PSALMS-104-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-10}

			He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ ἀποστέλλων πηγὰς ἐν φάραγξιν, ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ὀρέων διελεύσονται ὕδατα·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He sendeth forth springs into the valleys; They run among the mountains;
					\item[NIV] He makes springs pour water into the ravines; it flows between the mountains.
					\item[NRSV] You make springs gush forth in the valleys; they flow between the hills,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 104:11} % *PSALMS-104-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-11}

			They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל־חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ פְרָאִ֣ים צְמָאָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ποτιοῦσιν πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ, προσδέξονται ὄναγροι εἰς δίψαν αὐτῶν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπ᾽ αὐτὰ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσει, ἐκ μέσου τῶν πετρῶν δώσουσιν φωνήν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ποτίζων ὄρη ἐκ τῶν ὑπερῴων αὐτοῦ, ἀπὸ καρποῦ τῶν ἔργων σου χορτασθήσεται ἡ γῆ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξανατέλλων χόρτον τοῖς κτήνεσιν καὶ χλόην τῇ δουλείᾳ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, τοῦ ἐξαγαγεῖν ἄρτον ἐκ τῆς γῆς·}

					\item[NRSV] You cause the grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for people to use, to bring forth food from the earth,

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ οἶνος εὐφραίνει καρδίαν ἀνθρώπου, τοῦ ἱλαρῦναι πρόσωπον ἐν ἐλαίῳ, καὶ ἄρτος καρδίαν ἀνθρώπου στηρίζει.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{χορτασθήσεται τὰ ξύλα τοῦ πεδίου, αἱ κέδροι τοῦ Λιβάνου ἃς ἐφύτευσεν·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔθου σκότος καὶ ἐγένετο νύξ, ἐν αὐτῇ διελεύσονται πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ δρυμοῦ,}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνέτειλεν ὁ ἥλιος καὶ συναχθήσονται, καὶ ἐν ταῖς μάνδραις αὐτῶν κοιτασθήσονται·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡς ἐμεγαλύνθη τὰ ἔργα σου, Κύριε, πάντα ἐν σοφίᾳ ἐποίησας· ἐπληρώθη ἡ γῆ τῆς κτίσεώς σου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{αὕτη ἡ θάλασσα ἡ μεγάλη καὶ εὐρύχωρος· ἐκεῖ ἑρπετὰ ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός, ζῶα μικρὰ μετὰ μεγάλων,}

					\item[LXX] \gr{πάντα πρὸς σὲ προσδοκῶσιν, δοῦναι τὴν τροφὴν αὐτοῖς εὔκαιρον·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{δόντος σου αὐτοῖς συλλέξουσιν, ἀνοίξαντος δέ σου τὴν χεῖρα τὰ σύμπαντα ἐμπλησθήσεται χρηστότητος.}

					\item[NRSV] when you give to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are filled with good things.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-29}

			Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן וְֽאֶל־עֲפָרָ֥ם יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀποστρέψαντος δέ σου τὸ πρόσωπον ταραχθήσονται· ἀντανελεῖς τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκλείψουσιν, καὶ εἰς τὸν χοῦν αὐτῶν ἐπιστρέψουσιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; Thou takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.

					\item[NRSV] When you hide your face, they are dismayed; when you take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξαποστελεῖς τὸ πνεῦμά σου καὶ κτισθήσονται, καὶ ἀνακαινιεῖς τὸ πρόσωπον τῆς γῆς.}

		% % ---

			The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἤτω ἡ δόξα Κυρίου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, εὐφρανθήσεται Κύριος ἐπὶ τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ·}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-104-32}

			He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ ἐπιβλέπων ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ποιῶν αὐτὴν τρέμειν, ὁ ἁπτόμενος τῶν ὀρέων καὶ καπνίζονται.}

		% % ---

			I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾄσω τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν τῇ ζωῇ μου, ψαλῶ τῷ θεῷ μου ἕως ὑπάρχω·}

					\item[NRSV] I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have being.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡδυνθείη αὐτῷ ἡ διαλογή μου, ἐγὼ δὲ εὐφρανθήσομαι ἐπὶ τῷ κυρίῳ.}

			Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִתַּ֤מּוּ חַטָּאִ֨ים ׀ מִן־הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים ׀ ע֤וֹד אֵינָ֗ם בָּרֲכִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκλίποισαν ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἄνομοι, ὥστε μὴ ὑπάρχειν αὐτούς· εὐλόγει, ἡ ψυχή μου, τὸν κύριον.}

					\item[NRSV] Let sinners be consumed from the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Praise the LORD!

	\subsubsection{Psalms 105} % *PSALMS-105
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-105}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 105:1} % *PSALMS-105-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-105-1}

			O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἐπικαλεῖσθε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, ἀπαγγείλατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Oh give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known among the peoples his doings.
					\item[NIV] Give praise to the LORD, proclaim his name; make known among the nations what he has done.
					\item[NRSV] O give thanks to the LORD, call on his name, make known his deeds among the peoples.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-105-2}

			Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ־ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾄσατε αὐτῷ καὶ ψάλατε αὐτῷ, διηγήσασθε πάντα τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvellous works.
					\item[NIV] Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.
					\item[NRSV] Sing to him, sing praises to him; tell of all his wonderful works.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 105:3} % *PSALMS-105-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-105-3}

			Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב ׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπαινεῖσθε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ· εὐφρανθήτω καρδία ζητούντων τὸν κύριον.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					\item[NIV] Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
					\item[NRSV] Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 105:4} % *PSALMS-105-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-105-4}

			Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ζητήσατε τὸν κύριον καὶ κραταιώθητε, ζητήσατε τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ διὰ παντός·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Look to the LORD and his strength; seek his face always.
					\item[NRSV] Seek the LORD and his strength; seek his presence continually.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 105:5} % *PSALMS-105-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-105-5}

			Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μνήσθητε τῶν θαυμασίων αὐτοῦ ὧν ἐποίησεν, τὰ τέρατα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ κρίματα τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ·}

					\item[NRSV] Remember the wonderful works he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he has uttered,

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-105-6}

			O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדּ֑וֹ בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σπέρμα Ἀβραὰμ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ, υἱοὶ Ἰακὼβ ἐκλεκτοὶ αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O ye seed of Abraham his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
					\item[NIV] you his servants, the descendants of Abraham, his chosen ones, the children of Jacob.
					\item[NRSV] O offspring of his servant Abraham, children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 105:7} % *PSALMS-105-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-105-7}

			He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{ה֭וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכָל־הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃}

					\item[LXX] \gr{διέρρηξεν πέτραν, καὶ ἐρρύησαν ὕδατα, ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν ἀνύδροις ποταμοί.}

					\item[NIV] He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
					\item[NRSV] He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed through the desert like a river.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐμνήσθη τοῦ λόγου τοῦ ἁγίου αὐτοῦ, τοῦ πρὸς Ἀβραὰμ τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐξήγαγεν τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει, καὶ τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ.}

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] So he brought his people out with joy, his chosen ones with singing.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---

			And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצ֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς χώρας ἐθνῶν, καὶ πόνους λαῶν ἐκληρονόμησαν,}

			That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בַּעֲב֤וּר ׀ יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅπως ἂν φυλάξωσιν τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸν νὸμον αὐτοῦ ἐκζητήσωσιν.}

					\item[NRSV] that they might keep his statutes and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 106} % *PSALMS-106
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-106}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 106:1} % *PSALMS-106-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-1}

			Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽלְלוּיָ֨הּ ׀ הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ, ὅτι χρηστός, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise ye Jehovah. Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD. Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.
					\item[NRSV] Praise the LORD! O give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 106:2} % *PSALMS-106-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-2}

			Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς λαλήσει τὰς δυναστείας τοῦ κυρίου, ἀκουστὰς ποιήσει πάσας τὰς αἰνέσεις αὐτοῦ;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah, Or show forth all his praise?
					\item[NIV] Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the LORD or fully declare his praise?
					\item[NRSV] Who can utter the mighty doings of the LORD, or declare all his praise?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 106:3} % *PSALMS-106-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-3}

			Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַ֭שְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֹשֵׂ֖ה צְדָקָ֣ה בְכָל־עֵֽת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μακάριοι οἱ φυλάσσοντες κρίσιν καὶ ποιοῦντες δικαιοσύνην ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Blessed are they that keep justice, And he that doeth righteousness at all times.
					\item[NIV] Blessed are those who act justly, who always do what is right.
					\item[NRSV] Happy are those who observe justice, who do righteousness at all times.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 106:4} % *PSALMS-106-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-4}

			Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זָכְרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה בִּרְצ֣וֹן עַמֶּ֑ךָ פָּ֝קְדֵ֗נִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μνήσθητι ἡμῶν, Κύριε, ἐν τῇ εὐδοκίᾳ τοῦ λαοῦ σου, ἐπίσκεψαι ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Remember me, O Jehovah, with the favor that thou bearest unto thy people; Oh visit me with thy salvation,
					\item[NIV] Remember me, LORD, when you show favor to your people, come to my aid when you save them,
					\item[NRSV] Remember me, O LORD, when you show favor to your people; help me when you deliver them;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 106:5} % *PSALMS-106-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-5}

			That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לִרְא֤וֹת ׀ בְּט֘וֹבַ֤ת בְּחִירֶ֗יךָ לִ֭שְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת גּוֹיֶ֑ךָ לְ֝הִתְהַלֵּ֗ל עִם־נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῦ ἰδεῖν ἐν τῇ χρηστότητι τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν σου, τοῦ εὐφρανθῆναι ἐν τῇ εὐφροσύνῃ τοῦ ἔθνους σου, τοῦ ἐπαινεῖσθαι μετὰ τῆς κληρονομίας σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen, That I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, That I may glory with thine inheritance.
					\item[NIV] that I may enjoy the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may share in the joy of your nation and join your inheritance in giving praise.
					\item[NRSV] that I may see the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory in your heritage.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 106:6} % *PSALMS-106-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-6}

			We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חָטָ֥אנוּ עִם־אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ הֶעֱוִ֥ינוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡμάρτομεν μετὰ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν, ἠνομήσαμεν, ἠδικήσαμεν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
					\item[NIV] We have sinned, even as our ancestors did; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
					\item[NRSV] Both we and our ancestors have sinned; we have committed iniquity, have done wickedly.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 106:7} % *PSALMS-106-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-7}

			Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲב֘וֹתֵ֤ינוּ בְמִצְרַ֨יִם ׀ לֹא־הִשְׂכִּ֬ילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א זָ֭כְרוּ אֶת־רֹ֣ב חֲסָדֶ֑יךָ וַיַּמְר֖וּ עַל־יָ֣ם בְּיַם־סֽוּף׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ οὐ συνῆκαν τὰ θαυμάσιά σου, καὶ οὐκ ἐμνήσθησαν τοῦ πλήθους τοῦ ἐλέους σου, καὶ παρεπίκραναν ἀναβαίνοντες ἐν τῇ ἐρυθρᾷ θαλάσσῃ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; They remembered not the multitude of thy lovingkindnesses, But were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
					\item[NIV] When our ancestors were in Egypt, they gave no thought to your miracles; they did not remember your many kindnesses, and they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.
					\item[NRSV] Our ancestors, when they were in Egypt, did not consider your wonderful works; they did not remember the abundance of your steadfast love, but rebelled against the Most High at the Red Sea.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 106:8} % *PSALMS-106-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-8}

			Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמ֑וֹ לְ֝הוֹדִ֗יעַ אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτοὺς ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ, τοῦ γνωρίσαι τὴν δυναστείαν αὐτοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, That he might make his mighty power to be known.
					\item[NIV] Yet he saved them for his name’s sake, to make his mighty power known.
					\item[NRSV] Yet he saved them for his name’s sake, so that he might make known his mighty power.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 106:9} % *PSALMS-106-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-9}

			He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיִּגְעַ֣ר בְּיַם־ס֭וּף וַֽיֶּחֱרָ֑ב וַיּוֹלִיכֵ֥ם בַּ֝תְּהֹמ֗וֹת כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐπετίμησεν τῇ ἐρυθρᾷ θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐξηράνθη, καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἀβύσσῳ ὡς ἐν ἐρήμῳ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up: So he led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.
					\item[NIV] He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; he led them through the depths as through a desert.
					\item[NRSV] He rebuked the Red Sea, and it became dry; he led them through the deep as through a desert.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

			\label{PSALMS-106-10}

			And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּ֣ד שׂוֹנֵ֑א וַ֝יִּגְאָלֵ֗ם מִיַּ֥ד אוֹיֵֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρῶν μισούντων, καὶ ἐλυτρώσατο αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθροῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
					\item[NIV] He saved them from the hand of the foe; from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.
					\item[NRSV] So he saved them from the hand of the foe, and delivered them from the hand of the enemy.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 106:11} % *PSALMS-106-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-11}

			And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-44}

			Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַ֭יַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἴδεν ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτούς, ἐν τῷ αὐτὸν εἰσακοῦσαι τῆς δεήσεως αὐτῶν·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Yet he took note of their distress when he heard their cry;
					\item[NRSV] Nevertheless he regarded their distress when he heard their cry.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-45}

			And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר לָהֶ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ וַ֝יִּנָּחֵ֗ם כְּרֹ֣ב חֲסָדָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐμνήσθη τῆς διαθήκης αὐτοῦ, καὶ μετεμελήθη κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ ἐλέους αὐτοῦ,}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And he remembered for them his covenant, And repented according to the multitude of his lovingkindness.
					\item[NIV] for their sake he remembered his covenant and out of his great love he relented.
					\item[NRSV] For their sake he remembered his covenant, and showed compassion according to the abundance of his steadfast love.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אוֹתָ֣ם לְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִ֝פְנֵ֗י כָּל־שׁוֹבֵיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς οἰκτιρμοὺς ἐναντίον πάντων αἰχμαλωτισάντων αὐτούς.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.
					\item[NIV] He caused all who held them captive to show them mercy.
					\item[NRSV] He caused them to be pitied by all who held them captive.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 106:47} % *PSALMS-106-47
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-47}

			Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ ׀ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן־הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σῶσον ἡμᾶς, Κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, καὶ ἐπισυνάγαγε ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν, τοῦ ἐξομολογήσασθαι τῷ ὀνόματι τῷ ἁγίῳ σου, τοῦ ἐνκαυχᾶσθαι ἐν τῇ αἰνέσει σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Save us, O Jehovah our God, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.
					\item[NIV] Save us, LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
					\item[NRSV] Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 106:48} % *PSALMS-106-48
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-106-48}

			Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בָּר֤וּךְ־יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֪י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל מִן־הָ֤עוֹלָ֨ם ׀ וְעַ֬ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם וְאָמַ֖ר כָּל־הָעָ֥ם אָמֵ֗ן הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογητὸς Κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος· καὶ ἐρεῖ πᾶς ὁ λαός Γένοιτο.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Praise the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. And let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 107} % *PSALMS-107
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-107}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 107:1} % *PSALMS-107-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-107-1}

			O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ, ὅτι χρηστός, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
					\item[NIV] Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.
					\item[NRSV] O give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-107-2}

			Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰπάτωσαν οἱ λελυτρωμένοι ὑπὸ Κυρίου, οὓς ἐλυτρώσατο ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθροῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the redeemed of Jehovah say so, Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
					\item[NIV] Let the redeemed of the LORD tell their story— those he redeemed from the hand of the foe,
					\item[NRSV] Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, those he redeemed from trouble

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκ τῶν χωρῶν συνήγαγεν αὐτούς, ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν καὶ βορρᾶ καὶ θαλάσσης.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπλανήθησαν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν ἀνύδρῳ, ὁδὸν πόλιν κατοικητηρίου οὐχ εὗρον·}

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] Some wandered in desert wastes, finding no way to an inhabited town;

			Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

					\item[BHS] \he{רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם־צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες, ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτῶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐξέλιπεν.}

					% % \item[NETS]

			Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐκέκραξαν πρὸς Κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαι αὐτούς, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀναγκῶν αὐτῶν ἐρρύσατο αὐτούς·}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress;

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-107-7}

			And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַ֭יַּֽדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ὡδήγησεν αὐτοὺς εἰς ὁδὸν εὐθεῖαν τοῦ πορευθῆναι εἰς πόλιν κατοικητηρίου.}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-107-8}

			Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξομολογησάσθωσαν τῷ κυρίῳ τὰ ἐλέη αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Let them give thanks to the LORD for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for mankind,
					\item[NRSV] Let them thank the LORD for his steadfast love, for his wonderful works to humankind.

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-107-9}

			For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐχόρτασεν ψυχὴν κενήν, καὶ ψυχὴν πεινῶσαν ἐνέπλησεν ἀγαθῶν.}

					\item[NRSV] Some sat in darkness and in gloom, prisoners in misery and in irons,

			Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי־אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι παρεπίκραναν τὰ λόγια τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ ὑψίστου παρώξυναν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 108} % *PSALMS-108
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-108}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 108:1} % *PSALMS-108-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-108-1}

			O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 109} % *PSALMS-109
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-109}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 109:1} % *PSALMS-109-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-109-1}

			Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר אֱלֹהֵ֥י תְ֝הִלָּתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַֽשׁ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Εἰς τὸ τέλος· τῷ Δαυεὶδ ψαλμός. Ὁ θεός, τὴν αἴνεσίν μου μὴ παρασιωπήσῃς·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. My God, whom I praise, do not remain silent,
					\item[NRSV] Do not be silent, O God of my praise.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 109:2} % *PSALMS-109-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-109-2}

			For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י פִ֪י רָשָׁ֡ע וּֽפִי־מִ֭רְמָה עָלַ֣י פָּתָ֑חוּ דִּבְּר֥וּ אִ֝תִּ֗י לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι στόμα ἁμαρτωλοῦ καὶ στόμα δολίου ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ ἠνοίχθη, ἐλάλησαν κατ᾽ ἐμοῦ γλώσσῃ δολίᾳ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me: They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.
					\item[NIV] for people who are wicked and deceitful have opened their mouths against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.
					\item[NRSV] For wicked and deceitful mouths are opened against me, speaking against me with lying tongues.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 109:3} % *PSALMS-109-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-109-3}

			They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְדִבְרֵ֣י שִׂנְאָ֣ה סְבָב֑וּנִי וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֥וּנִי חִנָּֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ λόγοις μίσους ἐκύκλωσάν με, καὶ ἐπολέμησάν με δωρεάν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.
					\item[NIV] With words of hatred they surround me; they attack me without cause.
					\item[NRSV] They beset me with words of hate, and attack me without cause.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀναμνησθείη ἡ ἁμαρτία τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ ἔναντι Κυρίου, καὶ ἡ ἁμαρτία τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ μὴ ἐξαλειφθείη·}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-109-16}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀνθ᾽ ὧν οὐκ ἐμνήσθη τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἔλεος, καὶ κατεδίωξεν πένητα καὶ πτωχὸν καὶ κατανενυγμένον τῇ καρδίᾳ τοῦ θανατῶσαι.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] For he did not remember to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and the brokenhearted to their death.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἠγάπησεν κατάραν, καὶ ἥξει αὐτῷ· καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν εὐλογίαν, καὶ μακρυνθήσεται ἀπ᾽ αὐτοῦ.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

					\item[NRSV] He loved to curse; let curses come on him. He did not like blessing; may it be far from him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיִּלְבַּ֥שׁ קְלָלָ֗ה כְּמַ֫דּ֥וֹ וַתָּבֹ֣א כַמַּ֣יִם בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְ֝כַשֶּׁ֗מֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐνεδύσατο κατάραν ὡς ἱμάτιον, καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ὡς ὕδωρ εἰς τὰ ἔνκατα αὐτοῦ καὶ ὡς ἔλαιον ἐν τοῖς ὀστέοις αὐτοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.
					\item[NIV] He wore cursing as his garment; it entered into his body like water, into his bones like oil.
					\item[NRSV] He clothed himself with cursing as his coat, may it soak into his body like water, like oil into his bones.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

			\label{PSALMS-109-19}

			Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּהִי־ל֭וֹ כְּבֶ֣גֶד יַעְטֶ֑ה וּ֝לְמֵ֗זַח תָּמִ֥יד יַחְגְּרֶֽהָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{γενηθήτω αὐτῷ ὡς ἱμάτιον ὃ περιβάλλεται, καὶ ὡσεὶ ζώνη ἣν διὰ παντὸς ζώννυται.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
					\item[NIV] May it be like a cloak wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
					\item[NRSV] May it be like a garment that he wraps around himself, like a belt that he wears every day.”

					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῦτο τὸ ἔργον τῶν ἐνδιαβαλλόντων με παρὰ Κυρίῳ καὶ τῶν λαλούντων πονηρὰ κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς μου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ σύ, Κύριε κύριε, ποίησον μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ ἔλεος ἕνεκα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου, ὅτι χρηστὸν τὸ ἔλεός σου, ῥῦσαί με·}

					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NRSV] But you, O LORD my Lord, act on my behalf for your name’s sake; because your steadfast love is good, deliver me.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 110} % *PSALMS-110
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-110}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 110:1} % *PSALMS-110-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-110-1}

			The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר נְאֻ֤ם יְהוָ֨ה ׀ לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד־אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τῷ Δαυεὶδ ψαλμός. Εἶπεν ὁ κύριος τῷ κυρίῳ μου Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
					\item[NIV] Of David. A psalm. The LORD says to my lord: “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”
					\item[NRSV] The LORD says to my lord, “Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies your footstool.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 110:2} % *PSALMS-110-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-110-2}

			The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מַטֵּֽה־עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ῥάβδον δυνάμεως ἐξαποστελεῖ Κύριος ἐκ Σιών· καὶ κατακυρίευε ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
					\item[NIV] The LORD will extend your mighty scepter from Zion, saying, “Rule in the midst of your enemies!”
					\item[NRSV] The LORD sends out from Zion your mighty scepter. Rule in the midst of your foes.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 110:3} % *PSALMS-110-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-110-3}

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{μετὰ σοῦ ἡ ἀρχὴ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τῆς δυνάμεώς σου ἐν ταῖς λαμπρότησιν τῶν ἁγίων· ἐκ γαστρὸς πρὸ ἑωσφόρου ἐξεγέννησά σε.}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 110:4} % *PSALMS-110-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-110-4}

			The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָ֨ה ׀ וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה־כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל־דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי־צֶֽדֶק׃}
						\begin{compactenum}
							\item In a 1952 \textit{Biblica} article called ``\href{https://drive.google.com/file/d/1gOnOeNFysfCR0XvMSCnr2VVHa5-rRbz0/view?usp=sharing}{Canaanite-Phoenician influence in Qoheleth},'' Mitchell Dahood talks about the \he{`al--d*ib:rAt} construction in this verse. From page 48: ``One of the more striking morphological peculiarities of Ecclesiastes is encountered in the compound preposition \he{`l dbrt} which occurs three times: 3, 18; 7, 14 and 8, 2. The only other passage containing this prepositional phrase is Ps 110:4. Commentators generally explain the form as a late development of the Hebrew compound prepositions \he{`l dbr} and \he{`l dbry}. The source of this development is not to be sought in its `lateness', but rather in Phoenician morphology, where prepositions with the final \he{t} element exist alongside of the simple forms. Thus by the side of \he{`l} there is \he{`lt}; together with \he{lpN} there is \he{pnt}, and \he{btkt} is found in the sense of `in'. It is evident that \he{`l dbrt} fits into the Phoenician prepositional pattern.'' So the idea here would be that \he{`al--d*ib:rAt} is a compound preposition. 
						\end{compactenum}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὤμοσεν Κύριος καὶ οὐ μεταμεληθήσεται Σὺ εἶ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
					\item[NIV] The LORD has sworn and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.”
					\item[NRSV] The LORD has sworn and will not change his mind, “You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.”

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

					\item[NIV] The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow his precepts have good understanding. To him belongs eternal praise.
					\item[NRSV] The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all those who practice it have a good understanding. His praise endures forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 112} % *PSALMS-112
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-112}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 112:1} % *PSALMS-112-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-112-1}

			Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ אַשְׁרֵי־אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְוֺתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Μακάριος ἀνὴρ ὁ φοβούμενος τὸν κύριον, ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς αὐτοῦ θέλει σφόδρα·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD. Blessed are those who fear the LORD, who find great delight in his commands.
					\item[NRSV] Praise the LORD! Happy are those who fear the LORD, who greatly delight in his commandments.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 112:2} % *PSALMS-112-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-112-2}

			His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑וֹ דּ֭וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{δυνατὸν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ, γενεὰ εὐθέων εὐλογηθήσεται·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.
					\item[NIV] Their children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
					\item[NRSV] Their descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 112:3} % *PSALMS-112-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-112-3}

			Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוֹן־וָעֹ֥שֶׁר בְּבֵית֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{δόξα καὶ πλοῦτος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
					\item[NIV] Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.
					\item[NRSV] Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 112:4} % *PSALMS-112-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-112-4}

			Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֭וֹר לַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξανέτειλεν ἐν σκότει φῶς τοῖς εὐθέσι· ἐλεήμων καὶ οἰκτίρμων καὶ δίκαιος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: He is gracious, and merciful, and righteous.
					\item[NIV] Even in darkness light dawns for the upright, for those who are gracious and compassionate and righteous.
					\item[NRSV] They rise in the darkness as a light for the upright; they are gracious, merciful, and righteous.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 112:5} % *PSALMS-112-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-112-5}

			A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{טֽוֹב־אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{χρηστὸς ἀνὴρ ὁ οἰκτίρμων καὶ κιχρῶν, οἰκονομήσει τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ ἐν κρίσει·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.
					\item[NIV] Good will come to those who are generous and lend freely, who conduct their affairs with justice.
					\item[NRSV] It is well with those who deal generously and lend, who conduct their affairs with justice.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 112:6} % *PSALMS-112-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-112-6}

			Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־לְעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־יִמּ֑וֹט לְזֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα οὐ σαλευθήσεται· εἰς μνημόσυνον αἰώνιον ἔσται δίκαιος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.
					\item[NIV] Surely the righteous will never be shaken; they will be remembered forever.
					\item[NRSV] For the righteous will never be moved; they will be remembered forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 112:7} % *PSALMS-112-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-112-7}

			He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ ἀκοῆς πονηρᾶς οὐ φοβηθήσεται· ἑτοίμη ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ ἐλπίζειν ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] They will have no fear of bad news; their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] They are not afraid of evil tidings; their hearts are firm, secure in the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 112:8} % *PSALMS-112-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-112-8}

			His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּוֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐστήρικται ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ, οὐ φοβηθήσεται, ἕως οὗ ἐφίδῃ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see his desire upon his adversaries.
					\item[NIV] Their hearts are secure, they will have no fear; in the end they will look in triumph on their foes.
					\item[NRSV] Their hearts are steady, they will not be afraid; in the end they will look in triumph on their foes.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 112:9} % *PSALMS-112-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-112-9}

			He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{פִּזַּ֤ר ׀ נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתוֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֽוֹד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐσκόρπισεν, ἔδωκεν τοῖς πένησιν, ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος· τὸ κέρας αὐτοῦ ὑψωθήσεται ἐν δόξῃ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.
					\item[NIV] They have freely scattered their gifts to the poor, their righteousness endures forever; their horn will be lifted high in honor.
					\item[NRSV] They have distributed freely, they have given to the poor; their righteousness endures forever; their horn is exalted in honor.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 112:10} % *PSALMS-112-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-112-10}

			The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה ׀ וְכָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἁμαρτωλὸς ὄψεται καὶ ὀργισθήσεται, τοὺς ὀδόντας αὐτοῦ βρύξει καὶ τακήσεται· ἐπιθυμία ἁμαρτωλῶν ἀπολεῖται.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.
					\item[NIV] The wicked will see and be vexed, they will gnash their teeth and waste away; the longings of the wicked will come to nothing.
					\item[NRSV] The wicked see it and are angry; they gnash their teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked comes to nothing.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 113} % *PSALMS-113
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-113}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 113:1} % *PSALMS-113-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-113-1}

			Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Αἰνεῖτε, παῖδες, Κύριον, αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD, you his servants; praise the name of the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Praise the LORD! Praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 113:2} % *PSALMS-113-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-113-2}

			Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἴη τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου εὐλογημένον ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Blessed be the name of Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.
					\item[NIV] Let the name of the LORD be praised, both now and forevermore.
					\item[NRSV] Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time on and forevermore.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 113:3} % *PSALMS-113-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-113-3}

			From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD's name is to be praised.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹא֑וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου μέχρι δυσμῶν αἰνεῖται τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah's name is to be praised.
					\item[NIV] From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the LORD is to be praised.
					\item[NRSV] From the rising of the sun to its setting the name of the LORD is to be praised.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 113:4} % *PSALMS-113-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-113-4}

			The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רָ֖ם עַל־כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם ׀ יְהוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὑψηλὸς ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ὁ κύριος, ἐπὶ τοὺς οὐρανοὺς ἡ δόξα αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.
					\item[NIV] The LORD is exalted over all the nations, his glory above the heavens.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 113:5} % *PSALMS-113-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-113-5}

			Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִ֭י כַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ הַֽמַּגְבִּיהִ֥י לָשָֽׁבֶת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τίς ὡς Κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν; ὁ ἐν ὑψηλοῖς κατοικῶν,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who is like unto Jehovah our God, That hath his seat on high,
					\item[NIV] Who is like the LORD our God, the One who sits enthroned on high,
					\item[NRSV] Who is like the LORD our God, who is seated on high,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 113:6} % *PSALMS-113-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-113-6}

			Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽמַּשְׁפִּילִ֥י לִרְא֑וֹת בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ τὰ ταπεινὰ ἐφορῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]

			\label{PSALMS-115-1}

			Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֫א לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי־לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל־חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ ἡμῖν, Κύριε, μὴ ἡμῖν ἀλλ᾽ ἢ τῷ ὀνόματί σου δὸς δόξαν ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου καὶ τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Not to us, LORD, not to us but to your name be the glory, because of your love and faithfulness.
					\item[NRSV] Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your steadfast love and your faithfulness.

					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

			Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

					\item[BHS] \he{לָ֭מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אַיֵּה־נָ֝֗א אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μή ποτε εἴπωσιν τὰ ἔθνη Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν;}

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ δὲ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἄνω· ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς πάντα ὅσα ἠβούλετο ἐποίησεν.}

					% % \item[AB ]

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Our God is in heaven; he does whatever pleases him.
					\item[NRSV] Our God is in the heavens; he does whatever he pleases.

					\item[LXX] \gr{στόμα ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐ λαλοῦσιν, ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐκ ὄψονται·}

			They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ אַ֥ף לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יְרִיחֽוּן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὦτα ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐκ ἀκούσονται, ῥῖνας ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐκ ὀσφρανθήσονται·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;
					\item[NIV] They have ears, but cannot hear, noses, but cannot smell.
					\item[NRSV] They have ears, but do not hear; noses, but do not smell.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-115-7}

			They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְדֵיהֶ֤ם ׀ וְלֹ֬א יְמִישׁ֗וּן רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם וְלֹ֣א יְהַלֵּ֑כוּ לֹֽא־יֶ֝הְגּ֗וּ בִּגְרוֹנָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{χεῖρας ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐ ψηλαφήσουσιν, πόδας ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐ περιπατήσουσιν· οὐ φωνήσουσιν ἐν τῷ λάρυγγι αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] They have hands, but do not feel; feet, but do not walk; they make no sound in their throats.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅμοιοι αὐτοῖς γένοιντο οἱ ποιοῦντες αὐτὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπ᾽ αὐτοῖς.}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ ἤλπισεν ἐπὶ Κύριον· βοηθὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς αὐτῶν ἐστιν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{οἶκος Ἀαρὼν ἤλπισεν ἐπὶ Κύριον· βοηθὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς αὐτῶν ἐστιν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον ἤλπισαν ἐπ᾽ αὐτόν· βοηθὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ὑπερασπιστὴς αὐτῶν ἐστιν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἐμνήσθη ἡμῶν καὶ εὐλόγησεν ἡμᾶς, εὐλόγησεν τὸν οἶκον Ἰσραήλ, εὐλόγησεν τὸν οἶκον Ἀαρών·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{προσθείη Κύριος ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς, ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς ὑμῶν·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογημένοι ὑμεῖς ἐστε τῷ κυρίῳ, τῷ ποιήσαντι τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν.}

			The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ οὐρανὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ, τὴν δὲ γῆν ἔδωκεν τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων.}

			But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 116} % *PSALMS-116
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-116}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 116:1} % *PSALMS-116-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-116-1}

			I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָ֭הַבְתִּי כִּֽי־יִשְׁמַ֥ע ׀ יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־ק֝וֹלִ֗י תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Ἠγάπησα ὅτι εἰσακούσεται ὁ θεὸς τῆς φωνῆς τῆς δεήσεώς μου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.
					\item[NIV] I love the LORD, for he heard my voice; he heard my cry for mercy.
					\item[NRSV] I love the LORD, because he has heard my voice and my supplications.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 116:2} % *PSALMS-116-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-116-2}

			Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־הִטָּ֣ה אָזְנ֣וֹ לִ֑י וּבְיָמַ֥י אֶקְרָֽא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἔκλινεν τὸ οὖς αὐτοῦ ἐμοί, καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ ἐπεκαλεσάμην.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
					\item[NIV] Because he turned his ear to me, I will call on him as long as I live.
					\item[NRSV] Because he inclined his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 116:3} % *PSALMS-116-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-116-3}

			The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲפָפ֤וּנִי ׀ חֶבְלֵי־מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָג֣וֹן אֶמְצָֽא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{περιέσχον με ὠδῖνες θανάτου, κίνδυνοι ᾅδου εὕροσάν με· θλίψιν καὶ ὀδύνην εὗρον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
					\item[NIV] The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of the grave came over me; I was overcome by distress and sorrow.
					\item[NRSV] The snares of death encompassed me; the pangs of Sheol laid hold on me; I suffered distress and anguish.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 116:4} % *PSALMS-116-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-116-4}

			Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 117} % *PSALMS-117
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-117}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 117:1} % *PSALMS-117-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-117-1}

			O Praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה כָּל־גּוֹיִ֑ם שַׁ֝בְּח֗וּהוּ כָּל־הָאֻמִּֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Αἰνεῖτε τὸν κύριον, πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, αἰνεσάτωσαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ λαοί·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of Praise. O praise Jehovah, all ye nations; Laud him, all ye peoples.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD, all you nations; extol him, all you peoples.
					\item[NRSV] Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 117:2} % *PSALMS-117-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-117-2}

			For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֥י גָ֘בַ֤ר עָלֵ֨ינוּ ׀ חַסְדּ֗וֹ וֶֽאֱמֶת־יְהוָ֥ה לְעוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐκραταιώθη τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς, καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ κυρίου μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For his lovingkindness is great toward us; And the truth of Jehovah endureth for ever. Praise ye Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] For great is his love toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] For great is his steadfast love toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
