	\subsubsection{Psalms 118} % *PSALMS-118
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-118}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 118:1} % *PSALMS-118-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-118-1}

			O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ, ὅτι ἀγαθός, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
					\item[NIV] Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.
					\item[NRSV] O give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his steadfast love endures forever!

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

					\item[BHS] \he{יֹֽאמַר־נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰπάτω δὴ οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ ὅτι ἀγαθός, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let Israel now say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
					\item[NIV] Let Israel say: “His love endures forever.”
					\item[NRSV] Let Israel say, “His steadfast love endures forever.”

					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰπάτω δὴ οἶκος Ἀαρὼν ὅτι ἀγαθός, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ.}

		\paragraph{Psalms 118:5} % *PSALMS-118-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-118-5}

			I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִֽן־הַ֭מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν θλίψει ἐπεκαλεσάμην τὸν κύριον, καὶ ἐπήκουσέν μοι εἰς πλατυσμόν.}

					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] When hard pressed, I cried to the LORD; he brought me into a spacious place.
					\item[NRSV] Out of my distress I called on the LORD; the LORD answered me and set me in a broad place.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-118-6}

			The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἐμοὶ βοηθός, οὐ φοβηθήσομαι· τί ποιήσει μοι ἄνθρωπος;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear: What can man do unto me?
					\item[NIV] The LORD is with me; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?
					\item[NRSV] With the LORD on my side I do not fear. What can mortals do to me?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἐμοὶ βοηθός, κἀγὼ ἐπόψομαι τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is on my side among them that help me: Therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
					\item[NIV] The LORD is with me; he is my helper. I look in triumph on my enemies.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is on my side to help me; I shall look in triumph on those who hate me.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀγαθὸν πεποιθέναι ἐπὶ Κύριον ἢ πεποιθέναι ἐπ᾽ ἄνθρωπον·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in humans.
					\item[NRSV] It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to put confidence in mortals.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀγαθὸν ἐλπίζειν ἐπὶ Κύριον ἢ ἐλπίζειν ἐπ᾽ ἄρχοντας.}

		\paragraph{Psalms 118:10} % *PSALMS-118-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-118-10}

			All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐκύκλωσάν με, καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου ἠμυνάμην αὐτούς·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them down.
					\item[NRSV] All nations surrounded me; in the name of the LORD I cut them off!

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם־סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κυκλώσαντες ἐκύκλωσάν με, καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου ἠμυνάμην αὐτούς·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

		\paragraph{Psalms 118:12} % *PSALMS-118-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-118-12}

			They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκύκλωσάν με ὡσεὶ μέλισσαι κηρίον, καὶ ἐξεκαύθησαν ὡσεὶ πῦρ ἐν ἀκάνθαις, καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου ἠμυνάμην αὐτούς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] They surrounded me like bees; they blazed like a fire of thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off!

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-118-13}

			Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃}

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] I was pushed back and about to fall, but the LORD helped me.
					\item[NRSV] I was pushed hard, so that I was falling, but the LORD helped me.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-118-14}

			The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἰσχύς μου καὶ ὕμνησίς μου ὁ κύριος, καὶ ἐγένετό μοι εἰς σωτηρίαν.}

			The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

					\item[LXX] \gr{φωνὴ ἀγαλλιάσεως καὶ σωτηρίας ἐν σκηναῖς δικαίων. δεξιὰ Κυρίου ἐποίησεν δύναμιν,}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-118-16}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 119} % *PSALMS-119
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-119}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 119:1} % *PSALMS-119-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-119-1}

			Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַשְׁרֵ֥י תְמִֽימֵי־דָ֑רֶךְ הַֽ֝הֹלְכִ֗ים בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Μακάριοι ἄμωμοι ἐν ὁδῷ, οἱ πορευόμενοι ἐν νόμῳ Κυρίου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] ? ALEPH. Blessed are they that are perfect in the way, Who walk in the law of Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the law of the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Happy are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the LORD.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					\item[BHS] \he{אַ֭שְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵ֥י עֵדֹתָ֗יו בְּכָל־לֵ֥ב יִדְרְשֽׁוּהוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μακάριοι οἱ ἐξεραυνῶντες τὰ μαρτύρια αὐτοῦ, ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ ἐκζητοῦσιν αὐτόν·}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

		% % ---

			They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַ֭ף לֹֽא־פָעֲל֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה בִּדְרָכָ֥יו הָלָֽכוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐ γὰρ οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀνομίαν ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ ἐπορεύθησαν.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ γὰρ ἐκάθισαν ἄρχοντες, κατ᾽ ἐμοῦ κατελάλουν· ὁ δὲ δοῦλός σου ἠδολέσχει ἐν τοῖς δικαιώμασίν σου·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀπόστρεψον τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου τοῦ μὴ ἰδεῖν ματαιότητα, ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ σου ζῆσόν με.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀγαθόν μοι ὅτι ἐταπείνωσάς με, ὅπως ἂν μάθω τὰ δικαιώματά σου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{Αἱ χεῖρές σου ἔπλασάν με καὶ ἡτοίμασάν με· συνέτισόν με καὶ μαθήσομαι τὰς ἐντολάς σου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{οἱ φοβούμενοί σε ὄψονταί με καὶ εὐφρανθήσονται, ὅτι εἰς τοὺς λόγους σου ἐπήλπισα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰσχυνθήτωσαν ὑπερήφανοι, ὅτι ἀδίκως ἠνόμησαν εἰς ἐμέ· ἐγὼ δὲ ἀδολεσχήσω ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς σου.}

					\item[NRSV] Let the arrogant be put to shame, because they have subverted me with guile; as for me, I will meditate on your precepts.

					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-119-84}

			How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{πόσαι εἰσὶν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ δούλου σου; πότε ποιήσεις μοι ἐκ τῶν καταδιωκόντων με κρίσιν;}

					\item[LXX] \gr{πᾶσαι αἱ ἐντολαί σου ἀλήθεια· ἀδίκως κατεδίωξάν με, βοήθησόν μοι.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] All your commands are trustworthy; help me, for I am being persecuted without cause.

			\label{PSALMS-119-87}

			They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{καθήλωσον ἐκ τοῦ φόβου σου τὰς σάρκας μου, ἀπὸ γὰρ τῶν κριμάτων σου ἐφοβήθην.}

					% % \item[AB ]

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Πρὸς Κύριον ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαί με ἐκέκραξα, καὶ εἰσήκουσέν μου.}

			\label{PSALMS-121-1}

			I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֗יר לַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֶשָּׂ֣א עֵ֭ינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִ֑ים מֵ֝אַ֗יִן יָבֹ֥א עֶזְרִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου εἰς τὰ ὄρη· πόθεν ἥξει ἡ βοήθειά μου;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the mountains— where does my help come from?

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡ βοήθειά μου παρὰ Κυρίου τοῦ ποιήσαντος τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ δῷς εἰς σάλον τὸν πόδα σου, μηδὲ νυστάξει ὁ φυλάσσων σε.}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-121-5}

			The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֥ה שֹׁמְרֶ֑ךָ יְהוָ֥ה צִ֝לְּךָ֗ עַל־יַ֥ד יְמִינֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος φυλάξει σε, Κύριος σκέπη σου ἐπὶ χεῖρα δεξιάν σου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah is thy keeper: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.
					\item[NIV] The LORD watches over you— the LORD is your shade at your right hand;
					\item[NRSV] The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is your shade at your right hand.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 121:6} % *PSALMS-121-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-121-6}

			The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יוֹמָ֗ם הַשֶּׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹֽא־יַכֶּ֗כָּה וְיָרֵ֥חַ בַּלָּֽיְלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡμέρας ὁ ἥλιος οὐκ ἐκκαύσει σε, καὶ ἡ σελήνη τὴν νύκτα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.
					\item[NIV] the sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
					\item[NRSV] The sun shall not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 121:7} % *PSALMS-121-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-121-7}

			The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָרְךָ֥ מִכָּל־רָ֑ע יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος φυλάξει σε ἀπὸ παντὸς κακοῦ, φυλάξαι τὴν ψυχήν σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul.
					\item[NIV] The LORD will keep you from all harm— he will watch over your life;
					\item[NRSV] The LORD will keep you from all evil; he will keep your life.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 121:8} % *PSALMS-121-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-121-8}

			The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה יִשְׁמָר־צֵאתְךָ֥ וּבוֹאֶ֑ךָ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος φυλάξει τὴν εἴσοδόν σου καὶ τὴν ἔξοδόν σου ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.
					\item[NIV] the LORD will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in from this time on and forevermore.
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 122} % *PSALMS-122
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-122}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 122:1} % *PSALMS-122-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-122-1}

			I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שָׂ֭מַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֑י בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה נֵלֵֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν· τῷ Δαυείδ. Εὐφράνθην ἐπὶ τοῖς εἰρηκόσιν μοι Εἰς οἶκον Κυρίου πορευσόμεθα·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song of Ascents; of David. I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go unto the house of Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. Of David. I rejoiced with those who said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
					\item[NRSV] I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD!”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 122:2} % *PSALMS-122-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-122-2}

			Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עֹ֭מְדוֹת הָי֣וּ רַגְלֵ֑ינוּ בִּ֝שְׁעָרַ֗יִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἑστῶτες ἦσαν οἱ πόδες ἡμῶν ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς Ἰερουσαλήμ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Our feet are standing Within thy gates, O Jerusalem,
					\item[NIV] Our feet are standing in your gates, Jerusalem.
					\item[NRSV] Our feet are standing within your gates, O Jerusalem.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 122:3} % *PSALMS-122-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-122-3}

			Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם הַבְּנוּיָ֑ה כְּ֝עִ֗יר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־לָּ֥הּ יַחְדָּֽו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἰερουσαλὴμ οἰκοδομουμένη ὡς πόλις ἧς ἡ μετοχὴ αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jerusalem, that art builded As a city that is compact together;
					\item[NIV] Jerusalem is built like a city that is closely compacted together.
					\item[NRSV] Jerusalem—built as a city that is bound firmly together.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 122:4} % *PSALMS-122-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-122-4}

			Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שֶׁשָּׁ֨ם עָל֪וּ שְׁבָטִ֡ים שִׁבְטֵי־יָ֭הּ עֵד֣וּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ֝הֹד֗וֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκεῖ γὰρ ἀνέβησαν αἱ φυλαὶ Κυρίου, μαρτύριον τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, τοῦ ἐξομολογήσασθαι τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah, For an ordinance for Israel, To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] That is where the tribes go up— the tribes of the LORD— to praise the name of the LORD according to the statute given to Israel.
					\item[NRSV] To it the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as was decreed for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 122:5} % *PSALMS-122-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-122-5}

			For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י שָׁ֨מָּה ׀ יָשְׁב֣וּ כִסְא֣וֹת לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֝סְא֗וֹת לְבֵ֣ית דָּוִֽיד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐκάθισαν θρόνοι εἰς κρίσιν, θρόνοι ἐπὶ οἶκον Δαυείδ,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For there are set thrones for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.
					\item[NIV] There stand the thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
					\item[NRSV] For there the thrones for judgment were set up, the thrones of the house of David.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 122:6} % *PSALMS-122-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-122-6}

			Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שַׁ֭אֲלוּ שְׁל֣וֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם יִ֝שְׁלָ֗יוּ אֹהֲבָֽיִךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ εὐθηνία τοῖς ἀγαπῶσίν σε· ἐρωτήσατε δὴ τὰ εἰς εἰρήνην τῇ Ἰερουσαλήμ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: They shall prosper that love thee.
					\item[NIV] Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you be secure.
					\item[NRSV] Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May they prosper who love you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 122:7} % *PSALMS-122-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-122-7}

			Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהִֽי־שָׁל֥וֹם בְּחֵילֵ֑ךְ שַׁ֝לְוָ֗ה בְּאַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{γενέσθω δὴ εἰρήνη σου ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου, καὶ εὐθηνία ἐν τοῖς πυργοβάρεσίν σου,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Peace be within thy walls, And prosperity within thy palaces.
					\item[NIV] May there be peace within your walls and security within your citadels.”
					\item[NRSV] Peace be within your walls, and security within your towers.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 122:8} % *PSALMS-122-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-122-8}

			For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְ֭מַעַן אַחַ֣י וְרֵעָ֑י אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּ֖א שָׁל֣וֹם בָּֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕνεκα τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου καὶ τῶν πλησίον μου. ἐλάλουν δὲ εἰρήνην περὶ σοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
					\item[NIV] For the sake of my family and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
					\item[NRSV] For the sake of my relatives and friends I will say, “Peace be within you.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 122:9} % *PSALMS-122-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-122-9}

			Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְ֭מַעַן בֵּית־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁ֖ה ט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕνεκα τοῦ οἴκου Κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐξεζήτησά σοι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good.
					\item[NIV] For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
					\item[NRSV] For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 123} % *PSALMS-123
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-123}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 123:1} % *PSALMS-123-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-123-1}

			Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אֵ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־עֵינַ֑י הַ֝יֹּשְׁבִ֗י בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Πρὸς σὲ ἦρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου, τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song of Ascents. Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that sittest in the heavens.
					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, to you who sit enthroned in heaven.
					\item[NRSV] To you I lift up my eyes, O you who are enthroned in the heavens!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 123:2} % *PSALMS-123-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-123-2}

			Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִנֵּ֨ה כְעֵינֵ֪י עֲבָדִ֡ים אֶל־יַ֤ד אֲ‍ֽדוֹנֵיהֶ֗ם כְּעֵינֵ֣י שִׁפְחָה֮ אֶל־יַ֪ד גְּבִ֫רְתָּ֥הּ כֵּ֣ן עֵ֭ינֵינוּ אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ עַ֝֗ד שֶׁיְּחָנֵּֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἰδοὺ ὡς ὀφθαλμοὶ δούλων εἰς χεῖρας τῶν κυρίων αὐτῶν, ὡς ὀφθαλμοὶ παιδίσκης εἰς χεῖρας τῆς κυρίας αὐτῆς, οὕτως οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν πρὸς Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν, ἕως οὗ οἰκτειρῆσαι ἡμᾶς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maid unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes look unto Jehovah our God, Until he have mercy upon us.
					\item[NIV] As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a female slave look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, till he shows us his mercy.
					\item[NRSV] As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, until he has mercy upon us.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 123:3} % *PSALMS-123-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-123-3}

			Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חָנֵּ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑נוּ כִּֽי־רַ֝֗ב שָׂבַ֥עְנוּ בֽוּז׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, Κύριε, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, ὅτι ἐπὶ πολὺ ἐπληθύνθημεν ἐξουδενώσεως·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
					\item[NIV] Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured no end of contempt.
					\item[NRSV] Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us, for we have had more than enough of contempt.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 123:4} % *PSALMS-123-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-123-4}

			Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רַבַּת֮ שָֽׂבְעָה־לָּ֪הּ נַ֫פְשֵׁ֥נוּ הַלַּ֥עַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים הַ֝בּ֗וּז לִגְאֵ֥יוֹנִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπὶ πλεῖον ἐπληθύνθη ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν· τὸ ὄνειδος τοῖς εὐθηνοῦσιν καὶ ἡ ἐξουδένωσις τοῖς ὑπερηφάνοις.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud.
					\item[NIV] We have endured no end of ridicule from the arrogant, of contempt from the proud.
					\item[NRSV] Our soul has had more than its fill of the scorn of those who are at ease, of the contempt of the proud.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 124} % *PSALMS-124
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-124}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 124:1} % *PSALMS-124-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-124-1}

			If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ יֹֽאמַר־נָ֝א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν· τῷ Δαυείδ. Εἰ μὴ ὅτι Κύριος ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν, εἰπάτω δὴ Ἰσραήλ,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel say—
					\item[NRSV] If it had not been the LORD who was on our side —let Israel now say—

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-124-2}

			If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה שֶׁהָ֣יָה לָ֑נוּ בְּק֖וּם עָלֵ֣ינוּ אָדָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰ μὴ ὅτι Κύριος ἦν ἐν ἡμῖν, ἐν τῷ ἐπαναστῆναι ἀνθρώπους ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς,}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] if the LORD had not been on our side when people attacked us,
					\item[NRSV] if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when our enemies attacked us,

			Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲ֭זַי חַיִּ֣ים בְּלָע֑וּנוּ בַּחֲר֖וֹת אַפָּ֣ם בָּֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄρα ζῶντας ἂν κατέπιον ἡμᾶς, ἐν τῷ ὀργισθῆναι τὸν θυμὸν αὐτῶν ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς.}

					\item[NIV] they would have swallowed us alive when their anger flared against us;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲ֭זַי הַמַּ֣יִם שְׁטָפ֑וּנוּ נַ֗֜חְלָה עָבַ֥ר עַל־נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄρα τὸ ὕδωρ κατεπόντισεν ἡμᾶς, χείμαρρον διῆλθεν ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν·}

		% % ---

			Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲ֭זַי עָבַ֣ר עַל־נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ הַ֝מַּ֗יִם הַזֵּֽידוֹנִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄρα διῆλθεν ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ἀνυπόστατον.}

			Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה שֶׁלֹּ֥א נְתָנָ֥נוּ טֶ֝֗רֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογητὸς Κύριος ὃς οὐκ ἔδωκεν ἡμᾶς εἰς θήραν τοῖς ὀδοῦσιν αὐτῶν.}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Praise be to the LORD, who has not let us be torn by their teeth.
					\item[NRSV] Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-124-7}

			Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נַפְשֵׁ֗נוּ כְּצִפּ֥וֹר נִמְלְטָה֮ מִפַּ֪ח י֫וֹקְשִׁ֥ים הַפַּ֥ח נִשְׁבָּ֗ר וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ נִמְלָֽטְנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν ὡς στρουθίον ἐρρύσθη ἐκ τῆς παγίδος τῶν θηρευόντων· ἡ παγὶς συνετρίβη, καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐρύσθημεν.}

			Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עֶ֭זְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{βοήθεια ἡμῶν ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου τοῦ ποιήσαντος τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν.}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 125} % *PSALMS-125
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-125}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 125:1} % *PSALMS-125-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-125-1}

			They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים בַּיהוָ֑ה כְּֽהַר־צִיּ֥וֹן לֹא־יִ֝מּ֗וֹט לְעוֹלָ֥ם יֵשֵֽׁב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Οἱ πεποιθότες ἐπὶ Κύριον ὡς ὄρος Σιών· οὐ σαλευθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὁ κατοικῶν Ἰερουσαλήμ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song of Ascents. They that trust in Jehovah Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.
					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.
					\item[NRSV] Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abides forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 125:2} % *PSALMS-125-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-125-2}

			As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָרִים֮ סָבִ֪יב לָ֥הּ וַ֭יהוָה סָבִ֣יב לְעַמּ֑וֹ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὄρη κύκλῳ αὐτῆς, καὶ Κύριος κύκλῳ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So Jehovah is round about his people From this time forth and for evermore.
					\item[NIV] As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people both now and forevermore.
					\item[NRSV] As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people, from this time on and forevermore.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 125:3} % *PSALMS-125-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-125-3}

			For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י לֹ֪א יָנ֡וּחַ שֵׁ֤בֶט הָרֶ֗שַׁע עַל֮ גּוֹרַ֪ל הַֽצַּדִּ֫יקִ֥ים לְמַ֡עַן לֹא־יִשְׁלְח֖וּ הַצַּדִּיקִ֨ים בְּעַוְלָ֬תָה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐκ ἀφήσει τὴν ῥάβδον τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν ἐπὶ τὸν κλῆρον τῶν δικαίων, ὅπως ἂν μὴ ἐκτείνωσιν οἱ δίκαιοι ἐν ἀνομίᾳ χεῖρας αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.
					\item[NIV] The scepter of the wicked will not remain over the land allotted to the righteous, for then the righteous might use their hands to do evil.
					\item[NRSV] For the scepter of wickedness shall not rest on the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous might not stretch out their hands to do wrong.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 125:4} % *PSALMS-125-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-125-4}

			Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֵיטִ֣יבָה יְ֭הוָה לַטּוֹבִ֑ים וְ֝לִֽישָׁרִ֗ים בְּלִבּוֹתָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀγάθυνον, Κύριε, τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς καὶ τοῖς εὐθέσι τῇ καρδίᾳ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Do good, O Jehovah, unto those that are good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.
					\item[NIV] LORD, do good to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.
					\item[NRSV] Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to those who are upright in their hearts.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 125:5} % *PSALMS-125-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-125-5}

			As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְהַמַּטִּ֤ים עַֽקַלְקַלּוֹתָ֗ם יוֹלִיכֵ֣ם יְ֭הוָה אֶת־פֹּעֲלֵ֣י הָאָ֑וֶן שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοὺς δὲ ἐκκλίνοντας εἰς τὰς στραγγαλιὰς ἀπάξει Κύριος μετὰ τῶν ἐργαζομένων τὴν ἀνομίαν. εἰρήνη ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραήλ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.
					\item[NIV] But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be on Israel.
					\item[NRSV] But those who turn aside to their own crooked ways the LORD will lead away with evildoers. Peace be upon Israel!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 126} % *PSALMS-126
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-126}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 126:1} % *PSALMS-126-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-126-1}

			When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה אֶת־שִׁיבַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הָ֝יִ֗ינוּ כְּחֹלְמִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Ἐν τῷ ἐπιστρέψαι Κύριον τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν Σιὼν ἐγενήθημεν ὡς παρακεκλημένοι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song of Ascents. When Jehovah brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.
					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dreamed.
					\item[NRSV] When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dream.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 126:2} % *PSALMS-126-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-126-2}

			Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָ֤ז יִמָּלֵ֪א שְׂח֡וֹק פִּינוּ֮ וּלְשׁוֹנֵ֪נוּ רִ֫נָּ֥ה אָ֭ז יֹאמְר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם הִגְדִּ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִם־אֵֽלֶּה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τότε ἐπλήσθη χαρᾶς τὸ στόμα ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα ἡμῶν ἀγαλλιάσεως· τότε ἐροῦσιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν Ἐμεγάλυνεν Κύριος τοῦ ποιῆσαι μετ᾽ αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Then was our mouth filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing: Then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.
					\item[NIV] Our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
					\item[NRSV] Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with shouts of joy; then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 126:3} % *PSALMS-126-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-126-3}

			The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִגְדִּ֣יל יְ֭הוָה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּ֗נוּ הָיִ֥ינוּ שְׂמֵחִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐμεγάλυνεν Κύριος τοῦ ποιῆσαι μεθ᾽ ἡμῶν, ἐγενήθημεν εὐφραινόμενοι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah hath done great things for us, Whereof we are glad.
					\item[NIV] The LORD has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD has done great things for us, and we rejoiced.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 126:4} % *PSALMS-126-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-126-4}

			Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה שְׁבִיתֵ֑נוּ כַּאֲפִיקִ֥ים בַּנֶּֽגֶב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπίστρεψον, Κύριε, τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν ἡμῶν ὡς ὁ χειμάρρους ἐν τῷ νότῳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah, As the streams in the South.
					\item[NIV] Restore our fortunes, LORD, like streams in the Negev.
					\item[NRSV] Restore our fortunes, O LORD, like the watercourses in the Negeb.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 126:5} % *PSALMS-126-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-126-5}

			They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַזֹּרְעִ֥ים בְּדִמְעָ֗ה בְּרִנָּ֥ה יִקְצֹֽרוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οἱ σπείροντες ἐν δάκρυσιν ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει θεριοῦσιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
					\item[NIV] Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.
					\item[NRSV] May those who sow in tears reap with shouts of joy.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 126:6} % *PSALMS-126-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-126-6}

			He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הָ֘ל֤וֹךְ יֵלֵ֨ךְ ׀ וּבָכֹה֮ נֹשֵׂ֪א מֶֽשֶׁךְ־הַ֫זָּ֥רַע בֹּֽ֬א־יָב֥וֹא בְרִנָּ֑ה נֹ֝שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πορευόμενοι ἐπορεύοντο, καὶ ἔκλαιον αἴροντες τὰ σπέρματα αὐτῶν· ἐρχόμενοι δὲ ἥξουσιν ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει αἴροντες τὰ δράγματα αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves with him.
					\item[NIV] Those who go out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with them.
					\item[NRSV] Those who go out weeping, bearing the seed for sowing, shall come home with shouts of joy, carrying their sheaves.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 127} % *PSALMS-127
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-127}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 127:1} % *PSALMS-127-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-127-1}

			Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לִשְׁלֹ֫מֹ֥ה אִם־יְהוָ֤ה ׀ לֹא־יִבְנֶ֬ה בַ֗יִת שָׁ֤וְא ׀ עָמְל֣וּ בוֹנָ֣יו בּ֑וֹ אִם־יְהוָ֥ה לֹֽא־יִשְׁמָר־עִ֝֗יר שָׁ֤וְא ׀ שָׁקַ֬ד שׁוֹמֵֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Ἐὰν μὴ Κύριος οἰκοδομήσῃ οἶκον, εἰς μάτην ἐκοπίασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες αὐτόν· ἐὰν μὴ Κύριος φυλάξῃ πόλιν, εἰς μάτην ἠγρύπνησεν ὁ φυλάσσων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song of Ascents; of Solomon. Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.
					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, the builders labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the guards stand watch in vain.
					\item[NRSV] Unless the LORD builds the house, those who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD guards the city, the guard keeps watch in vain.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 127:2} % *PSALMS-127-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-127-2}

			It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁ֤וְא לָכֶ֨ם ׀ מַשְׁכִּ֪ימֵי ק֡וּם מְאַֽחֲרֵי־שֶׁ֗בֶת אֹ֭כְלֵי לֶ֣חֶם הָעֲצָבִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן יִתֵּ֖ן לִֽידִיד֣וֹ שֵׁנָֽא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰς μάτην ἐστὶν ὑμῖν τοῦ ὀρθρίζειν, ἐγείρεσθαι μετὰ τὸ καθῆσθαι, οἱ ἔσθοντες ἄρτον ὀδύνης, ὅταν δῷ τοῖς ἀγαπητοῖς αὐτοῦ ὕπνον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] It is vain for you to rise up early, To take rest late, To eat the bread of toil; For so he giveth unto his beloved sleep.
					\item[NIV] In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat— for he grants sleep to those he loves.
					\item[NRSV] It is in vain that you rise up early and go late to rest, eating the bread of anxious toil; for he gives sleep to his beloved.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 127:3} % *PSALMS-127-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-127-3}

			Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִנֵּ֤ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה בָּנִ֑ים שָׂ֝כָ֗ר פְּרִ֣י הַבָּֽטֶן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἰδοὺ ἡ κληρονομία Κυρίου υἱοί, ὁ μισθὸς τοῦ καρποῦ τῆς γαστρὸς αὐτῆς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; And the fruit of the womb is his reward.
					\item[NIV] Children are a heritage from the LORD, offspring a reward from him.
					\item[NRSV] Sons are indeed a heritage from the LORD, the fruit of the womb a reward.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 127:4} % *PSALMS-127-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-127-4}

			As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כְּחִצִּ֥ים בְּיַד־גִּבּ֑וֹר כֵּ֝֗ן בְּנֵ֣י הַנְּעוּרִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡσεὶ βέλη ἐν χειρὶ δυνατοῦ, οὕτως οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἐκτετιναγμένων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.
					\item[NIV] Like arrows in the hands of a warrior are children born in one’s youth.
					\item[NRSV] Like arrows in the hand of a warrior are the sons of one’s youth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 127:5} % *PSALMS-127-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-127-5}

			Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַשְׁרֵ֤י הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִלֵּ֥א אֶת־אַשְׁפָּת֗וֹ מֵ֫הֶ֥ם לֹֽא־יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־יְדַבְּר֖וּ אֶת־אוֹיְבִ֣ים בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μακάριος ὃς πληρώσει τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν αὐτοῦ ἐξ αὐτῶν· οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται, ὅταν λαλῶσι τοῖς ἐχθροῖς αὐτῶν ἐν πύλῃ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.
					\item[NIV] Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. They will not be put to shame when they contend with their opponents in court.
					\item[NRSV] Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. He shall not be put to shame when he speaks with his enemies in the gate.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 128} % *PSALMS-128
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-128}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 128:1} % *PSALMS-128-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-128-1}

			Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת אַ֭שְׁרֵי כָּל־יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה הַ֝הֹלֵ֗ךְ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Μακάριοι πάντες οἱ φοβούμενοι τὸν κύριον, οἱ πορευόμενοι ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song of Ascents. Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, That walketh in his ways.
					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in obedience to him.
					\item[NRSV] Happy is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 128:2} % *PSALMS-128-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-128-2}

			For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְגִ֣יעַ כַּ֭פֶּיךָ כִּ֣י תֹאכֵ֑ל אַ֝שְׁרֶ֗יךָ וְט֣וֹב לָֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοὺς καρποὺς τῶν πόνων σου φάγεσαι, μακάριος εἶ καὶ καλῶς σοι ἔσται.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
					\item[NIV] You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.
					\item[NRSV] You shall eat the fruit of the labor of your hands; you shall be happy, and it shall go well with you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 128:3} % *PSALMS-128-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-128-3}

			Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֶשְׁתְּךָ֤ ׀ כְּגֶ֥פֶן פֹּרִיָּה֮ בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֪י בֵ֫יתֶ֥ךָ בָּ֭נֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵ֣י זֵיתִ֑ים סָ֝בִ֗יב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡ γυνή σου ὡς ἄμπελος εὐθηνοῦσα ἐν τοῖς κλίτεσι τῆς οἰκίας σου· οἱ υἱοί σου ὡς νεόφυτα ἐλαιῶν κύκλῳ τῆς τραπέζης σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, Round about thy table.
					\item[NIV] Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.
					\item[NRSV] Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 128:4} % *PSALMS-128-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-128-4}

			Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הִנֵּ֣ה כִי־כֵ֭ן יְבֹ֥רַךְ גָּ֗בֶר יְרֵ֣א יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἰδοὺ οὕτως εὐλογηθήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ φοβούμενος τὸν κύριον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Behold, thus shall the man be blessed That feareth Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Yes, this will be the blessing for the man who fears the LORD.

			The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογήσαι σε Κύριος ἐκ Σιών, καὶ ἴδοις τὰ ἀγαθὰ Ἰερουσαλὴμ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου,}

					\item[BHS] \he{וּרְאֵֽה־בָנִ֥ים לְבָנֶ֑יךָ שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἴδοις υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν σου. εἰρήνη ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραήλ.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Πλεονάκις ἐπολέμησάν με ἐκ νεότητός μου, εἰπάτω δὴ Ἰσραήλ·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] “Often have they attacked me from my youth” —let Israel now say—

					\item[LXX] \gr{πλεονάκις ἐπολέμησάν με ἐκ νεότητός μου, καὶ γὰρ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησάν μοι.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπὶ τοῦ νώτου μου ἐτέκταινον οἱ ἁμαρτωλοί, ἐμάκρυναν τὴν ἀνομίαν αὐτῶν·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰσχυνθήτωσαν καὶ ἀποστραφήτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω πάντες οἱ μισοῦντες Σιών·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{γενηθήτωσαν ὡς χόρτος δωμάτων, ὃς πρὸ τοῦ ἐκσπασθῆναι ἐξηράνθη·}

			\label{PSALMS-130-1}

			Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֑וֹת מִמַּעֲמַקִּ֖ים קְרָאתִ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Ἐκ βαθέων ἐκέκραξά σε, Κύριε·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to you, LORD;
					\item[NRSV] Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

			\label{PSALMS-130-2}

			Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲדֹנָי֮ שִׁמְעָ֪ה בְק֫וֹלִ֥י תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה אָ֭זְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לְ֝ק֗וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, εἰσάκουσον τῆς φωνῆς μου· γενηθήτω τὰ ὦτά σου προσέχοντα εἰς τὴν φωνὴν τῆς δεήσεώς μου.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to my cry for mercy.
					\item[NRSV] Lord, hear my voice! Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications!

			If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

					\item[BHS] \he{אִם־עֲוֺנ֥וֹת תִּשְׁמָר־יָ֑הּ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐὰν ἀνομίας παρατηρήσῃ, Κύριε, Κύριε, τίς ὑποστήσηται;}

					% % \item[AB ]

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
					\item[NRSV] If you, O LORD, should mark iniquities, Lord, who could stand?

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-130-4}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι παρὰ σοὶ ὁ ἱλασμός ἐστιν. ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός σου}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὑπέμεινα, Κύριε· ὑπέμεινεν ἡ ψυχή μου εἰς τὸν νόμον αὐτοῦ.}

					\item[BHS] \he{נַפְשִׁ֥י לַֽאדֹנָ֑י מִשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים לַ֝בֹּ֗קֶר שֹׁמְרִ֥ים לַבֹּֽקֶר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἤλπισεν ἡ ψυχή μου ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον ἀπὸ φυλακῆς πρωίας μέχρι νυκτός·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					% % \item[OTXX*]

			Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

			\begin{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι παρὰ τῷ κυρίῳ τὸ ἔλεος, καὶ πολλὴ παρ᾽ αὐτῷ λύτρωσις,}

					\item[NRSV] O Israel, hope in the LORD! For with the LORD there is steadfast love, and with him is great power to redeem.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 131} % *PSALMS-131
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-131}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 131:1} % *PSALMS-131-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-131-1}

			Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֤ה ׀ לֹא־גָבַ֣הּ לִ֭בִּי וְלֹא־רָמ֣וּ עֵינַ֑י וְלֹֽא־הִלַּ֓כְתִּי ׀ בִּגְדֹל֖וֹת וּבְנִפְלָא֣וֹת מִמֶּֽנִּי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν· τῷ Δαυείδ. Κύριε, οὐχ ὑψώθη μου ἡ καρδία, οὐδὲ ἐμετεωρίσθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου· οὐδὲ ἐπορεύθην ἐν μεγάλοις οὐδὲ ἐν θαυμασίοις ὑπὲρ ἐμέ,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song of Ascents; of David. Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; Neither do I exercise myself in great matters, Or in things too wonderful for me.
					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. Of David. My heart is not proud, LORD, my eyes are not haughty; I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, my heart is not lifted up, my eyes are not raised too high; I do not occupy myself with things too great and too marvelous for me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 131:2} % *PSALMS-131-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-131-2}

			Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אִם־לֹ֤א שִׁוִּ֨יתִי ׀ וְדוֹמַ֗מְתִּי נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּ֭גָמֻל עֲלֵ֣י אִמּ֑וֹ כַּגָּמֻ֖ל עָלַ֣י נַפְשִֽׁי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εἰ μὴ ἐταπεινοφρόνουν. καὶ ὕψωσα τὴν ψυχήν μου, ὡς τὸ ἀπογεγαλακτισμένον ἐπὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ, ἕως ἀνταποδώσεις ἐπὶ ψυχήν μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child with his mother, Like a weaned child is my soul within me.
					\item[NIV] But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child I am content.
					\item[NRSV] But I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; my soul is like the weaned child that is with me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-131-3}

			Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַחֵ֣ל יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐλπισάτω Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]

					% % \item[NETS]

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Israel, put your hope in the LORD both now and forevermore.

			The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נִשְׁבַּֽע־יְהוָ֨ה ׀ לְדָוִ֡ד אֱמֶת֮ לֹֽא־יָשׁ֪וּב מִ֫מֶּ֥נָּה מִפְּרִ֥י בִטְנְךָ֑ אָ֝שִׁ֗ית לְכִסֵּא־לָֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὤμοσεν Κύριος τῷ Δαυεὶδ ἀλήθειαν, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀθετήσει αὐτήν Ἐκ καρποῦ τῆς κοιλίας σου θήσομαι ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth; He will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
					\item[NIV] The LORD swore an oath to David, a sure oath he will not revoke: “One of your own descendants I will place on your throne.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD swore to David a sure oath from which he will not turn back: “One of the sons of your body I will set on your throne.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 132:12} % *PSALMS-132-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-132-12}

			If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אִֽם־יִשְׁמְר֬וּ בָנֶ֨יךָ ׀ בְּרִיתִי֮ וְעֵדֹתִ֥י ז֗וֹ אֲלַ֫מְּדֵ֥ם גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם עֲדֵי־עַ֑ד יֵ֝שְׁב֗וּ לְכִסֵּא־לָֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐὰν φυλάξωνται οἱ υἱοί σου τὴν διαθήκην μου, καὶ τὰ μαρτύριά μου ταῦτα ἃ διδάξω αὐτούς, καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ἕως αἰῶνος καθιοῦνται ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] If thy children will keep my covenant And my testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.
					\item[NIV] If your sons keep my covenant and the statutes I teach them, then their sons will sit on your throne for ever and ever.”
					\item[NRSV] If your sons keep my covenant and my decrees that I shall teach them, their sons also, forevermore, shall sit on your throne.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-132-13}

			For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־בָחַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה בְּצִיּ֑וֹן אִ֝וָּ֗הּ לְמוֹשָׁ֥ב לֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐξελέξατο Κύριος τὴν Σιών, ᾑρετίσατο αὐτὴν εἰς κατοικίαν ἑαυτῷ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] For the LORD has chosen Zion, he has desired it for his dwelling, saying,
					\item[NRSV] For the LORD has chosen Zion; he has desired it for his habitation:

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

			This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זֹאת־מְנוּחָתִ֥י עֲדֵי־עַ֑ד פֹּֽה־אֵ֝שֵׁ֗ב כִּ֣י אִוִּתִֽיהָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αὕτη ἡ κατάπαυσίς μου εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος· ὧδε κατοικήσω, ὅτι ᾑρετισάμην αὐτήν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{צֵ֭ידָהּ בָּרֵ֣ךְ אֲבָרֵ֑ךְ אֶ֝בְיוֹנֶ֗יהָ אַשְׂבִּ֥יעַֽ לָֽחֶם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὴν χήραν αὐτῆς εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσω, τοὺς πτωχοὺς αὐτῆς χορτάσω ἄρτων·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] I will bless her with abundant provisions; her poor I will satisfy with food.

					\item[LXX] \gr{τοὺς ἱερεῖς αὐτῆς ἐνδύσω σωτηρίαν, καὶ οἱ ὅσιοι αὐτῆς ἀγαλλιάσει ἀγαλλιάσονται.}

					\item[NIV] I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her faithful people will ever sing for joy.
					\item[NRSV] Its priests I will clothe with salvation, and its faithful will shout for joy.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁ֤ם אַצְמִ֣יחַ קֶ֣רֶן לְדָוִ֑ד עָרַ֥כְתִּי נֵ֝֗ר לִמְשִׁיחִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκεῖ ἐξανατελῶ κέρας τῷ Δαυείδ, ἡτοίμασα λύχνον τῷ χριστῷ σου·}

					\item[NIV] “Here I will make a horn grow for David and set up a lamp for my anointed one.
					\item[NRSV] There I will cause a horn to sprout up for David; I have prepared a lamp for my anointed one.

	\subsubsection{Psalms 133} % *PSALMS-133
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-133}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 133:1} % *PSALMS-133-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-133-1}

			Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הִנֵּ֣ה מַה־טּ֭וֹב וּמַה־נָּעִ֑ים שֶׁ֖בֶת אַחִ֣ים גַּם־יָֽחַד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν· τῷ Δαυείδ. Ἰδοὺ δὴ τί καλὸν ἢ τί τερπνόν, ἢ τὸ κατοικεῖν ἀδελφοὺς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song of Ascents; of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!
					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. Of David. How good and pleasant it is when God’s people live together in unity!
					\item[NRSV] How very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 133:2} % *PSALMS-133-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-133-2}

			It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כַּשֶּׁ֤מֶן הַטּ֨וֹב ׀ עַל־הָרֹ֗אשׁ יֹרֵ֗ד עַֽל־הַזָּקָ֥ן זְקַֽן־אַהֲרֹ֑ן שֶׁ֝יֹּרֵ֗ד עַל־פִּ֥י מִדּוֹתָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡς μύρον ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν τὸ καταβαῖνον ἐπὶ πώγωνα, τὸν πώγωνα τὸν Ἀαρών, τὸ καταβαῖνον ἐπὶ τὴν ᾤαν τοῦ ἐνδύματος αὐτοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] It is like the precious oil upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, Even Aaron's beard; That came down upon the skirt of his garments;
					\item[NIV] It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down on the beard, running down on Aaron’s beard, down on the collar of his robe.
					\item[NRSV] It is like the precious oil on the head, running down upon the beard, on the beard of Aaron, running down over the collar of his robes.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 133:3} % *PSALMS-133-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-133-3}

			As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כְּטַל־חֶרְמ֗וֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד֮ עַל־הַרְרֵ֪י צִ֫יּ֥וֹן כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם ׀ צִוָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָ֑ה חַ֝יִּ֗ים עַד־הָעוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡς δρόσος Ἁερμὼν ἡ καταβαίνουσα ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη Σιών· ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τὴν εὐλογίαν καὶ ζωὴν ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion: For there Jehovah commanded the blessing, Even life for evermore.
					\item[NIV] It is as if the dew of Hermon were falling on Mount Zion. For there the LORD bestows his blessing, even life forevermore.
					\item[NRSV] It is like the dew of Hermon, which falls on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD ordained his blessing, life forevermore.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 134} % *PSALMS-134
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-134}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 134:1} % *PSALMS-134-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-134-1}

			Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הִנֵּ֤ה ׀ בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה כָּל־עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הָעֹמְדִ֥ים בְּבֵית־יְ֝הוָ֗ה בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ᾨδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Ἰδοὺ δὴ εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον, πάντες οἱ δοῦλοι Κυρίου, οἱ ἑστῶτες ἐν αὐλαῖς οἴκου θεοῦ ἡμῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Song of Ascents. Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] A song of ascents. Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who minister by night in the house of the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the house of the LORD!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 134:2} % *PSALMS-134-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-134-2}

			Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׂאֽוּ־יְדֵכֶ֥ם קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּ֝בָרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν ταῖς νυξὶν ἐπάρατε χεῖρας ὑμῶν εἰς τὰ ἅγια, καὶ εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Lift up your hands in the sanctuary and praise the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Lift up your hands to the holy place, and bless the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 134:3} % *PSALMS-134-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-134-3}

			The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְבָרֶכְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐλογήσει σε Κύριος ἐκ Σιών, ὁ ποιήσας τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.
					\item[NIV] May the LORD bless you from Zion, he who is the Maker of heaven and earth.
					\item[NRSV] May the LORD, maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 135} % *PSALMS-135
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-135}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 135:1} % *PSALMS-135-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-135-1}

			Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ הַֽ֭לְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Αἰνεῖτε τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου, αἰνεῖτε δοῦλοι Κύριον,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὦτα ἔχουσιν καὶ οὐκ ἐνωτισθήσονται, οὐδὲ γάρ ἐστιν πνεῦμα ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅμοιοι αὐτοῖς γένοιντο πάντες οἱ ποιοῦντες αὐτὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ πεποιθότες ἐν αὐτοῖς.}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 136} % *PSALMS-136
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-136}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 136:1} % *PSALMS-136-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-136-1}

			O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ, ὅτι χρηστός, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
					\item[NIV] Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good. His love endures forever.
					\item[NRSV] O give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

			\label{PSALMS-136-2}

					\item[BHS] \he{ה֭וֹדוּ לֵֽאלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ θεῷ τῶν θεῶν, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Oh give thanks unto the God of gods; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
					\item[NIV] Give thanks to the God of gods. His love endures forever.
					\item[NRSV] O give thanks to the God of gods, for his steadfast love endures forever.

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ τῶν κυρίων, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{τῷ ποιοῦντι θαυμάσια μεγάλα μόνῳ, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{τῷ στερεώσαντι τὴν γῆν ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ, ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ·}

			\begin{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 137} % *PSALMS-137
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-137}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 137:1} % *PSALMS-137-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-137-1}

			By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַ֥ל נַהֲר֨וֹת ׀ בָּבֶ֗ל שָׁ֣ם יָ֭שַׁבְנוּ גַּם־בָּכִ֑ינוּ בְּ֝זָכְרֵ֗נוּ אֶת־צִיּֽוֹן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τῷ Δαυείδ Ἐπὶ τῶν ποταμῶν Βαβυλῶνος ἐκεῖ ἐκαθίσαμεν, καὶ ἐκλαύσαμεν ἐν τῷ μνησθῆναι ἡμᾶς τῆς Σιών·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.
					\item[NIV] By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
					\item[NRSV] By the rivers of Babylon— there we sat down and there we wept when we remembered Zion.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 137:2} % *PSALMS-137-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-137-2}

			We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עַֽל־עֲרָבִ֥ים בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ תָּ֝לִ֗ינוּ כִּנֹּרוֹתֵֽינוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐπὶ ταῖς ἰτέαις ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ἐκρεμάσαμεν τὰ ὄργανα ἡμῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] There on the poplars we hung our harps,

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 137:3} % *PSALMS-137-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-137-3}

			For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם שְֽׁאֵל֪וּנוּ שׁוֹבֵ֡ינוּ דִּבְרֵי־שִׁ֭יר וְתוֹלָלֵ֣ינוּ שִׂמְחָ֑ה שִׁ֥ירוּ לָ֝֗נוּ מִשִּׁ֥יר צִיּֽוֹן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἠρώτησαν ἡμᾶς οἱ αἰχμαλωτεύσαντες ἡμᾶς λόγους ᾠδῶν, καὶ οἱ ἀπαγαγόντες ἡμᾶς Ὑμνήσατε ἡμῖν ἐκ τῶν ᾠδῶν Σιών.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For there they that led us captive required of us songs, And they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
					\item[NIV] for there our captors asked us for songs, our tormentors demanded songs of joy; they said, “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
					\item[NRSV] For there our captors asked us for songs, and our tormentors asked for mirth, saying, “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 137:4} % *PSALMS-137-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-137-4}

			How shall we sing the LORD's song in a strange land?

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֵ֗יךְ נָשִׁ֥יר אֶת־שִׁיר־יְהוָ֑ה עַ֝֗ל אַדְמַ֥ת נֵכָֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πῶς ᾄσωμεν τὴν ᾠδὴν Κυρίου ἐπὶ γῆς ἀλλοτρίας;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] How shall we sing Jehovah's song In a foreign land?
					\item[NIV] How can we sing the songs of the LORD while in a foreign land?
					\item[NRSV] How could we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 137:5} % *PSALMS-137-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-137-5}

			If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אִֽם־אֶשְׁכָּחֵ֥ךְ יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח יְמִינִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐὰν ἐπιλάθωμαί σου, Ἰερουσαλήμ, ἐπιλησθείη ἡ δεξιά μου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget her skill.
					\item[NIV] If I forget you, Jerusalem, may my right hand forget its skill.
					\item[NRSV] If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand wither!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 137:6} % *PSALMS-137-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-137-6}

			If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תִּדְבַּ֥ק־לְשׁוֹנִ֨י ׀ לְחִכִּי֮ אִם־לֹ֪א אֶ֫זְכְּרֵ֥כִי אִם־לֹ֣א אַ֭עֲלֶה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֑ם עַ֝֗ל רֹ֣אשׁ שִׂמְחָתִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κολληθείη ἡ γλῶσσά μου τῷ λάρυγγί μου, ἐὰν μή σου μνησθῶ, ἐὰν μὴ προανατάξωμαι τὴν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐν ἀρχῇ τῆς εὐφροσύνης μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I prefer not Jerusalem Above my chief joy.
					\item[NIV] May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not consider Jerusalem my highest joy.
					\item[NRSV] Let my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth, if I do not remember you, if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 137:7} % *PSALMS-137-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-137-7}

			Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זְכֹ֤ר יְהוָ֨ה ׀ לִבְנֵ֬י אֱד֗וֹם אֵת֮ י֤וֹם יְֽרוּשָׁ֫לִָ֥ם הָ֭אֹ֣מְרִים עָ֤רוּ ׀ עָ֑רוּ עַ֝֗ד הַיְס֥וֹד בָּֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μνήσθητι, Κύριε, τῶν υἱῶν Ἐδὼμ τὴν ἡμέραν Ἰερουσαλήμ, τῶν λεγόντων Ἐκκενοῦτε, ἐκκενοῦτε, ἕως ὁ θεμέλιος ἐν αὐτῇ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said, Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.
					\item[NIV] Remember, LORD, what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. “Tear it down,” they cried, “tear it down to its foundations!”
					\item[NRSV] Remember, O LORD, against the Edomites the day of Jerusalem’s fall, how they said, “Tear it down! Tear it down! Down to its foundations!”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 137:8} % *PSALMS-137-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-137-8}

			O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בַּת־בָּבֶ֗ל הַשְּׁד֫וּדָ֥ה אַשְׁרֵ֥י שֶׁיְשַׁלֶּם־לָ֑ךְ אֶת־גְּ֝מוּלֵ֗ךְ שֶׁגָּמַ֥לְתְּ לָֽנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{θυγάτηρ Βαβυλῶνος ἡ ταλαίπωρος, μακάριος ὃς ἀνταποδώσει σοι τὸ ἀνταπόδομά σου ὃ ἀνταπέδωκας ἡμῖν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed, Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee As thou hast served us.
					\item[NIV] Daughter Babylon, doomed to destruction, happy is the one who repays you according to what you have done to us.
					\item[NRSV] O daughter Babylon, you devastator! Happy shall they be who pay you back what you have done to us!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 137:9} % *PSALMS-137-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-137-9}

			Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַשְׁרֵ֤י ׀ שֶׁיֹּאחֵ֓ז וְנִפֵּ֬ץ אֶֽת־עֹ֝לָלַ֗יִךְ אֶל־הַסָּֽלַע׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μακάριος ὃς κρατήσει καὶ ἐδαφιεῖ τὰ νήπιά σου πρὸς τὴν πέτραν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock.
					\item[NIV] Happy is the one who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
					\item[NRSV] Happy shall they be who take your little ones and dash them against the rock!

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
