	\subsubsection{Psalms 138} % *PSALMS-138
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-138}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 138:1} % *PSALMS-138-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-138-1}

			I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ אוֹדְךָ֥ בְכָל־לִבִּ֑י נֶ֖גֶד אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲזַמְּרֶֽךָּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τῷ Δαυείδ. Ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι, Κύριε, ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ μου, ὅτι ἤκουσας τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου· καὶ ἐναντίον ἀγγέλων ψαλῶ σοι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. I will give thee thanks with my whole heart: Before the gods will I sing praises unto thee.
					\item[NIV] Of David. I will praise you, LORD, with all my heart; before the “gods” I will sing your praise.
					\item[NRSV] I give you thanks, O LORD, with my whole heart; before the gods I sing your praise;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 138:2} % *PSALMS-138-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-138-2}

			I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־הֵיכַ֪ל קָדְשְׁךָ֡ וְא֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ֥ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל־כָּל־שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{προσκυνήσω πρὸς ναὸν ἅγιόν σου, καὶ ἐξομολογήσομαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐπὶ τῷ ἐλέει σου καὶ τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου, ὅτι ἐμεγάλυνας ἐπὶ πᾶν ὄνομα τὸ ἅγιόν σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will worship toward thy holy temple, And give thanks unto thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: For thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
					\item[NIV] I will bow down toward your holy temple and will praise your name for your unfailing love and your faithfulness, for you have so exalted your solemn decree that it surpasses your fame.
					\item[NRSV] I bow down toward your holy temple and give thanks to your name for your steadfast love and your faithfulness; for you have exalted your name and your word above everything.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 138:3} % *PSALMS-138-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-138-3}

			In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֑נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖נִי בְנַפְשִׁ֣י עֹֽז׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλέσωμαι, ταχὺ ἐπάκουσόν μου· πολυωρήσεις με ἐν ψυχῇ μου ἐν δυνάμει πολλῇ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] In the day that I called thou answeredst me, Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.
					\item[NIV] When I called, you answered me; you greatly emboldened me.
					\item[NRSV] On the day I called, you answered me, you increased my strength of soul.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 138:4} % *PSALMS-138-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-138-4}

			All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξομολογησάσθωσάν σοι, Κύριε, πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς, ὅτι ἤκουσαν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός σου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah, For they have heard the words of thy mouth.
					\item[NIV] May all the kings of the earth praise you, LORD, when they hear what you have decreed.
					\item[NRSV] All the kings of the earth shall praise you, O LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 138:5} % *PSALMS-138-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-138-5}

			Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְ֭יָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י גָ֝ד֗וֹל כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ᾀσάτωσαν ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς Κυρίου, ὅτι ἡ δόξα Κυρίου μεγάλη·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah; For great is the glory of Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] May they sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
					\item[NRSV] They shall sing of the ways of the LORD, for great is the glory of the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 138:6} % *PSALMS-138-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-138-6}

			Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּי־רָ֣ם יְ֭הוָה וְשָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝גָבֹ֗הַּ מִמֶּרְחָ֥ק יְיֵדָֽע׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι ὑψηλὸς Κύριος, καὶ τὰ ταπεινὰ ἐφορᾷ, καὶ τὰ ὑψηλὰ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν γινώσκει.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly; But the haughty he knoweth from afar.
					\item[NIV] Though the LORD is exalted, he looks kindly on the lowly; though lofty, he sees them from afar.
					\item[NRSV] For though the LORD is high, he regards the lowly; but the haughty he perceives from far away.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 138:7} % *PSALMS-138-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-138-7}

			Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אִם־אֵלֵ֤ךְ ׀ בְּקֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַי תִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וְת֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐὰν πορευθῶ ἐν μέσῳ θλίψεως, ζήσεις με· ἐπ᾽ ὀργὴν ἐχθρῶν ἐξέτεινας χεῖράς μου, καὶ ἔσωσέν με ἡ δεξιά σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me; Thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And thy right hand will save me.
					\item[NIV] Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my life. You stretch out your hand against the anger of my foes; with your right hand you save me.
					\item[NRSV] Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve me against the wrath of my enemies; you stretch out your hand, and your right hand delivers me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 138:8} % *PSALMS-138-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-138-8}

			The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֪ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אַל־תֶּֽרֶף׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, ἀνταποδώσεις ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ· Κύριε, τὸ ἔλεός σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, Κύριε, τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου μὴ παρῇς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, endureth for ever; Forsake not the works of thine own hands.
					\item[NIV] The LORD will vindicate me; your love, LORD, endures forever— do not abandon the works of your hands.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD will fulfill his purpose for me; your steadfast love, O LORD, endures forever. Do not forsake the work of your hands.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר יְהוָ֥ה חֲ֝קַרְתַּ֗נִי וַתֵּדָֽע׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Εἰς τὸ τέλος· ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ. Κύριε, ἐδοκίμασάς με καὶ ἔγνως με·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known me.
					\item[NIV] For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. You have searched me, LORD, and you know me.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, you have searched me and known me.

					\item[BHS] \he{אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּ֣י וְקוּמִ֑י בַּ֥נְתָּה לְ֝רֵעִ֗י מֵרָחֽוֹק׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{σὺ ἔγνως τὴν καθέδραν μου καὶ τὴν ἔγερσίν μου, σὺ συνῆκας πάντας τοὺς διαλογισμούς μου ἀπὸ μακρόθεν·}

					\item[LXX] \gr{τὴν τρίβον μου καὶ τὴν σχοῖνόν μου ἐξιχνίασας, καὶ πάσας τὰς ὁδούς μου πρόιδες,}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν λόγος ἄδικος ἐν γλώσσῃ μου· ἰδού, Κύριε, σὺ ἔγνως πάντα}

					\item[LXX] \gr{τὰ ἔσχατα καὶ τὰ ἀρχαῖα· σὺ ἔπλασάς με καὶ ἔθηκας ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ τὴν χεῖρά σου.}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וָ֭אֹמַר אַךְ־חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה א֣וֹר בַּעֲדֵֽנִי׃}

					\item[BHS] \he{גַּם־חֹשֶׁךְ֮ לֹֽא־יַחְשִׁ֪יךְ מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָ וְ֭לַיְלָה כַּיּ֣וֹם יָאִ֑יר כַּ֝חֲשֵׁיכָ֗ה כָּאוֹרָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡς τὸ σκότος αὐτῆς, οὕτως καὶ τὸ φῶς αὐτῆς.}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה קָנִ֣יתָ כִלְיֹתָ֑י תְּ֝סֻכֵּ֗נִי בְּבֶ֣טֶן אִמִּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι σὺ ἐκτήσω τοὺς νεφρούς μου, Κύριε, ἀντελάβου μου ἐκ γαστρὸς μητρός μου.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι, ὅτι φοβερῶς ἐθαυμαστώθης· θαυμάσια τὰ ἔργα σου, καὶ ἡ ψυχή μου γινώσκει σφόδρα.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{οὐκ ἐκρύβη τὸ ὀστοῦν μου ἀπὸ σοῦ ὃ ἐποίησας ἐν κρυφῇ, καὶ ἡ ὑπόστασίς μου ἐν τοῖς κατωτάτω τῆς γῆς·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					\item[LXX] \gr{εἶπα τῷ κυρίῳ Θεός μου εἶ σύ· ἐνώτισαι, Κύριε, τὴν φωνὴν τῆς δεήσεώς μου.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, LORD, my cry for mercy.
					\item[NRSV] I say to the LORD, “You are my God; give ear, O LORD, to the voice of my supplications.”

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-140-7}

			O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭יהוָה אֵ֣לִי אָ֑תָּה הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε κύριε, δύναμις τῆς σωτηρίας μου, ἐπεσκίασας ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλήν μου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πολέμου.}

					\item[NIV] Sovereign LORD, my strong deliverer, you shield my head in the day of battle.
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, my Lord, my strong deliverer, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

		% % ---

			Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי עֹ֣ז יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י סַכֹּ֥תָה לְ֝רֹאשִׁ֗י בְּי֣וֹם נָֽשֶׁק׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ παραδῷς με, Κύριε, ἀπὸ τῆς ἐπιθυμίας μου ἁμαρτωλῷ· διελογίσαντο κατ᾽ ἐμοῦ, μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με, μή ποτε ὑψωθῶσιν. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Do not grant the wicked their desires, LORD; do not let their plans succeed.
					\item[NRSV] Do not grant, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not further their evil plot. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-140-9}

			As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֭הוָה מַאֲוַיֵּ֣י רָשָׁ֑ע זְמָמ֥וֹ אַל־תָּ֝פֵ֗ק יָר֥וּמוּ סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῦ κυκλώματος αὐτῶν, κόπος τῶν χειλέων αὐτῶν καλύψει αὐτούς.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
					\item[NIV] Those who surround me proudly rear their heads; may the mischief of their lips engulf them.
					\item[NRSV] Those who surround me lift up their heads; let the mischief of their lips overwhelm them!

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-140-10}

			Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רֹ֥אשׁ מְסִבָּ֑י עֲמַ֖ל שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ יְכַסֵּֽמוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πεσοῦνται ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς ἄνθρακες πυρὸς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, καὶ καταβαλεῖς αὐτούς. ἐν ταλαιπωρίαις οὐ μὴ ὑποστῶσιν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.
					\item[NIV] May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, never to rise.
					\item[NRSV] Let burning coals fall on them! Let them be flung into pits, no more to rise!

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---

			Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִמּ֥וֹטוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם גֶּֽחָ֫לִ֥ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יַפִּלֵ֑ם בְּ֝מַהֲמֹר֗וֹת בַּֽל־יָקֽוּמוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄνδρα ἄδικον κακὰ θηρεύσει εἰς καταφθοράν.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth: Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
					\item[NIV] May slanderers not be established in the land; may disaster hunt down the violent.
					\item[NRSV] Do not let the slanderer be established in the land; let evil speedily hunt down the violent!

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-140-12}

			I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אִ֥ישׁ לָשׁוֹן֮ בַּל־יִכּ֪וֹן בָּ֫אָ֥רֶץ אִישׁ־חָמָ֥ס רָ֑ע יְ֝צוּדֶ֗נּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹֽת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔγνων ὅτι ποιήσει Κύριος τὴν κρίσιν τοῦ πτωχοῦ καὶ τὴν δίκην τῶν πενήτων.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]

					\item[NIV] I know that the LORD secures justice for the poor and upholds the cause of the needy.
					\item[NRSV] I know that the LORD maintains the cause of the needy, and executes justice for the poor.
					% % \item[OTX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{πλὴν δίκαιοι ἐξομολογήσονται τῷ ὀνόματί σου, καὶ κατοικήσουσιν εὐθεῖς ἐν τῷ προσώπῳ σου.}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 141} % *PSALMS-141
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-141}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 141:1} % *PSALMS-141-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-141-1}

			Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֣ה קְ֭רָאתִיךָ ח֣וּשָׁה לִּ֑י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה ק֝וֹלִ֗י בְּקָרְאִי־לָֽךְ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ. Κύριε, πρὸς σὲ ἐκέκραξα, εἰσάκουσόν μου· πρόσχες τῇ φωνῇ τῆς δεήσεώς μου ἐν τῷ κεκραγέναι με πρὸς σέ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Jehovah, I have called upon thee; make haste unto me: Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.
					\item[NIV] A psalm of David. I call to you, LORD, come quickly to me; hear me when I call to you.
					\item[NRSV] I call upon you, O LORD; come quickly to me; give ear to my voice when I call to you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 141:2} % *PSALMS-141-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-141-2}

			Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תִּכּ֤וֹן תְּפִלָּתִ֣י קְטֹ֣רֶת לְפָנֶ֑יךָ מַֽשְׂאַ֥ת כַּ֝פַּ֗י מִנְחַת־עָֽרֶב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κατευθυνθήτω ἡ προσευχή μου ὡς θυμίαμα ἐνώπιόν σου, ἔπαρσις τῶν χειρῶν μου θυσία ἑσπερινή.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee; The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
					\item[NIV] May my prayer be set before you like incense; may the lifting up of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.
					\item[NRSV] Let my prayer be counted as incense before you, and the lifting up of my hands as an evening sacrifice.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 141:3} % *PSALMS-141-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-141-3}

			Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שִׁיתָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה שָׁמְרָ֣ה לְפִ֑י נִ֝צְּרָ֗ה עַל־דַּ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{θοῦ, Κύριε, φυλακὴν τῷ στόματί μου, καὶ θύραν περιοχῆς περὶ τὰ χείλη μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; Keep the door of my lips.
					\item[NIV] Set a guard over my mouth, LORD; keep watch over the door of my lips.
					\item[NRSV] Set a guard over my mouth, O LORD; keep watch over the door of my lips.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 141:4} % *PSALMS-141-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-141-4}

			Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַל־תַּט־לִבִּ֨י לְדָבָ֪ר ׀ רָ֡ע לְהִתְע֘וֹלֵ֤ל עֲלִל֨וֹת ׀ בְּרֶ֗שַׁע אֶת־אִישִׁ֥ים פֹּֽעֲלֵי־אָ֑וֶן וּבַל־אֶ֝לְחַ֗ם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ ἐκκλίνῃς τὴν καρδίαν μου εἰς λόγους πονηρίας, τοῦ προφασίζεσθαι προφάσεις ἐν ἁμαρτίαις, σὺν ἀνθρώποις ἐργαζομένοις ἀνομίαν, καὶ οὐ μὴ συνδοιάσω μετὰ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To practise deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity: And let me not eat of their dainties.
					\item[NIV] Do not let my heart be drawn to what is evil so that I take part in wicked deeds along with those who are evildoers; do not let me eat their delicacies.
					\item[NRSV] Do not turn my heart to any evil, to busy myself with wicked deeds in company with those who work iniquity; do not let me eat of their delicacies.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 141:5} % *PSALMS-141-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-141-5}

			Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יֶֽהֶלְמֵֽנִי־צַדִּ֨יק ׀ חֶ֡סֶד וְֽיוֹכִיחֵ֗נִי שֶׁ֣מֶן רֹ֭אשׁ אַל־יָנִ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י כִּי־ע֥וֹד וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{παιδεύσει με δίκαιος ἐν ἐλέει καὶ ἐλέγξει με, ἔλαιον δὲ ἁμαρτωλοῦ μὴ λιπανάτω τὴν κεφαλὴν μου· ὅτι ἔτι καὶ ἔτι ἡ προσευχή μου ἐν ταῖς εὐδοκίαις αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the righteous smite me, it shall be a kindness; And let him reprove me, it shall be as oil upon the head; Let not my head refuse it: For even in their wickedness shall my prayer continue.
					\item[NIV] Let a righteous man strike me—that is a kindness; let him rebuke me—that is oil on my head. My head will not refuse it, for my prayer will still be against the deeds of evildoers.
					\item[NRSV] Let the righteous strike me; let the faithful correct me. Never let the oil of the wicked anoint my head, for my prayer is continually against their wicked deeds.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 141:6} % *PSALMS-141-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-141-6}

			When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{נִשְׁמְט֣וּ בִֽידֵי־סֶ֭לַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶ֑ם וְשָׁמְע֥וּ אֲ֝מָרַ֗י כִּ֣י נָעֵֽמוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κατεπόθησαν ἐχόμενα πέτρας οἱ κραταιοὶ αὐτῶν· ἀκούσονται τὰ ῥήματά μου, ὅτι ἠδυνήθησαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
					\item[NIV] Their rulers will be thrown down from the cliffs, and the wicked will learn that my words were well spoken.
					\item[NRSV] When they are given over to those who shall condemn them, then they shall learn that my words were pleasant.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 141:7} % *PSALMS-141-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-141-7}

			Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כְּמ֤וֹ פֹלֵ֣חַ וּבֹקֵ֣עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ נִפְזְר֥וּ עֲ֝צָמֵ֗ינוּ לְפִ֣י שְׁאֽוֹל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὡσεὶ πάχος γῆς διερράγη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, διεσκορπίσθη τὰ ὀστᾶ ἡμῶν παρὰ τὸν ᾅδην.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth, Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
					\item[NIV] They will say, “As one plows and breaks up the earth, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave.”
					\item[NRSV] Like a rock that one breaks apart and shatters on the land, so shall their bones be strewn at the mouth of Sheol.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 141:8} % *PSALMS-141-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-141-8}

			But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֤י אֵלֶ֨יךָ ׀ יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣י עֵינָ֑י בְּכָ֥ה חָ֝סִ֗יתִי אַל־תְּעַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι πρὸς σέ, Κύριε κύριε, οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου, ἐπὶ σὲ ἤλπισα, μὴ ἀντανέλῃς τὴν ψυχήν μου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord: In thee do I take refuge; leave not my soul destitute.
					\item[NIV] But my eyes are fixed on you, Sovereign LORD; in you I take refuge—do not give me over to death.
					\item[NRSV] But my eyes are turned toward you, O GOD, my Lord; in you I seek refuge; do not leave me defenseless.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 141:9} % *PSALMS-141-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-141-9}

			Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שָׁמְרֵ֗נִי מִ֣ידֵי פַ֭ח יָ֣קְשׁוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מֹקְשׁ֗וֹת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{φύλαξόν με ἀπὸ παγίδος ἧς συνεστήσαντό μοι, καὶ ἀπὸ σκανδάλων τῶν ἐργαζομένων τὴν ἀνομίαν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.
					\item[NIV] Keep me safe from the traps set by evildoers, from the snares they have laid for me.
					\item[NRSV] Keep me from the trap that they have laid for me, and from the snares of evildoers.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 141:10} % *PSALMS-141-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-141-10}

			Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִפְּל֣וּ בְמַכְמֹרָ֣יו רְשָׁעִ֑ים יַ֥חַד אָ֝נֹכִ֗י עַֽד־אֶעֱבֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πεσοῦνται ἐν ἀμφιβλήστρῳ αὐτοῦ ἁμαρτωλοί· κατὰ μόνας εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ἕως οὗ ἂν παρέλθω.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst that I withal escape.
					\item[NIV] Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
					\item[NRSV] Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I alone escape.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 142} % *PSALMS-142
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-142}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 142:1} % *PSALMS-142-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-142-1}

			I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְדָוִ֑ד בִּהְיוֹת֖וֹ בַמְּעָרָ֣ה תְפִלָּֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Φωνῇ μου πρὸς Κύριον ἐκέκραξα, φωνῇ μου πρὸς Κύριον ἐδεήθην.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Maschil of David, when he was in the cave; a Prayer. I cry with my voice unto Jehovah; With my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.
					\item[NIV] A maskil of David. When he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift up my voice to the LORD for mercy.
					\item[NRSV] With my voice I cry to the LORD; with my voice I make supplication to the LORD.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 142:2} % *PSALMS-142-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-142-2}

			I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐκχεῶ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ τὴν δέησίν μου, τὴν θλίψιν μου ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἀπαγγελῶ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I pour out my complaint before him; I show before him my trouble.
					\item[NIV] I pour out before him my complaint; before him I tell my trouble.
					\item[NRSV] I pour out my complaint before him; I tell my trouble before him.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 142:3} % *PSALMS-142-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-142-3}

			When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐν τῷ ἐκλείπειν ἐξ ἐμοῦ τὸ πνεῦμά μου, καὶ σὺ ἔγνως τὰς τρίβους μου· ἐν ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ ἐπορευόμην ἔκρυψάν μοι παγίδα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.
					\item[NIV] When my spirit grows faint within me, it is you who watch over my way. In the path where I walk people have hidden a snare for me.
					\item[NRSV] When my spirit is faint, you know my way. In the path where I walk they have hidden a trap for me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 142:4} % *PSALMS-142-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-142-4}

			I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י ׀ רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{κατενόουν εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ καὶ ἐπέβλεπον, ὅτι οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἐπιγινώσκων με· ἀπώλετο φυγὴ ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἐκζητῶν τὴν ψυχήν μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Look on my right hand, and see; For there is no man that knoweth me: Refuge hath failed me; No man careth for my soul.
					\item[NIV] Look and see, there is no one at my right hand; no one is concerned for me. I have no refuge; no one cares for my life.
					\item[NRSV] Look on my right hand and see— there is no one who takes notice of me; no refuge remains to me; no one cares for me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 142:5} % *PSALMS-142-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-142-5}

			I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַבֵּ֤יט יָמִ֨ין ׀ וּרְאֵה֮ וְאֵֽין־לִ֪י מַ֫כִּ֥יר אָבַ֣ד מָנ֣וֹס מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֵ֖ין דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πρὸς σέ, Κύριε, ἐκέκραξα, καὶ εἶπα Σὺ εἶ ἡ ἐλπίς μου, μερίς μου ἐν γῇ ζώντων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I cried unto thee, O Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.
					\item[NIV] I cry to you, LORD; I say, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
					\item[NRSV] I cry to you, O LORD; I say, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 142:6} % *PSALMS-142-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-142-6}

			Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זָעַ֥קְתִּי אֵלֶ֗יךָ יְה֫וָ֥ה אָ֭מַרְתִּי אַתָּ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י חֶ֝לְקִ֗י בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πρόσχες πρὸς τὴν δέησίν μου, ὅτι ἐταπεινώθην σφόδρα· ῥῦσαί με ἐκ τῶν καταδιωκόντων με, ὅτι ἐκραταιώθησαν ὑπὲρ ἐμέ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low: Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are stronger than I.
					\item[NIV] Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need; rescue me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.
					\item[NRSV] Give heed to my cry, for I am brought very low. Save me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 142:7} % *PSALMS-142-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-142-7}

			Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה ׀ אֶֽל־רִנָּתִי֮ כִּֽי־דַלּ֪וֹתִ֫י מְאֹ֥ד הַצִּילֵ֥נִי מֵרֹדְפַ֑י כִּ֖י אָמְצ֣וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξάγαγε ἐκ φυλακῆς τὴν ψυχήν μου, τοῦ ἐξομολογήσασθαι τῷ ὀνόματί σου, Κύριε· ἐμὲ ὑπομενοῦσιν δίκαιοι ἕως οὗ ἀνταποδῷς μοι.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto thy name: The righteous shall compass me about; For thou wilt deal bountifully with me.
					\item[NIV] Set me free from my prison, that I may praise your name. Then the righteous will gather about me because of your goodness to me.
					\item[NRSV] Bring me out of prison, so that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will deal bountifully with me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 143} % *PSALMS-143
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-143}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 143:1} % *PSALMS-143-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-1}

			Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְהוָ֤ה ׀ שְׁמַ֬ע תְּפִלָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה אֶל־תַּחֲנוּנַ֑י בֶּאֱמֻנָתְךָ֥ עֲ֝נֵ֗נִי בְּצִדְקָתֶֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ, ὅτε αὐτὸν ὁ υἱὸς καταδιώκει. Κύριε, εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου, ἐνώτισαι τὴν δέησίν μου ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου, ἐπάκουσόν μου ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications: In thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
					\item[NIV] A psalm of David. LORD, hear my prayer, listen to my cry for mercy; in your faithfulness and righteousness come to my relief.
					\item[NRSV] Hear my prayer, O LORD; give ear to my supplications in your faithfulness; answer me in your righteousness.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 143:2} % *PSALMS-143-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-2}

			And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וְאַל־תָּב֣וֹא בְ֭מִשְׁפָּט אֶת־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־יִצְדַּ֖ק לְפָנֶ֣יךָ כָל־חָֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ μὴ εἰσέλθῃς εἰς κρίσιν μετὰ τοῦ δούλου σου, ὅτι οὐ δικαιωθήσεται ἐνώπιόν σου πᾶς ζῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And enter not into judgment with thy servant; For in thy sight no man living is righteous.
					\item[NIV] Do not bring your servant into judgment, for no one living is righteous before you.
					\item[NRSV] Do not enter into judgment with your servant, for no one living is righteous before you.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 143:3} % *PSALMS-143-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-3}

			For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּ֥י רָ֘דַ֤ף אוֹיֵ֨ב ׀ נַפְשִׁ֗י דִּכָּ֣א לָ֭אָרֶץ חַיָּתִ֑י הוֹשִׁיבַ֥נִי בְ֝מַחֲשַׁכִּ֗ים כְּמֵתֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐταπείνωσεν εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ζωήν μου· ἐκάθισέν με ἐν σκοτεινοῖς ὡς νεκροὺς αἰῶνος·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath smitten my life down to the ground: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.
					\item[NIV] The enemy pursues me, he crushes me to the ground; he makes me dwell in the darkness like those long dead.
					\item[NRSV] For the enemy has pursued me, crushing my life to the ground, making me sit in darkness like those long dead.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 143:4} % *PSALMS-143-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-4}

			Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַתִּתְעַטֵּ֣ף עָלַ֣י רוּחִ֑י בְּ֝תוֹכִ֗י יִשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם לִבִּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἠκηδίασεν ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ τὸ πνεῦμά μου, ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐταράχθη ἡ καρδία μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is desolate.
					\item[NIV] So my spirit grows faint within me; my heart within me is dismayed.
					\item[NRSV] Therefore my spirit faints within me; my heart within me is appalled.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 143:5} % *PSALMS-143-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-5}

			I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי יָמִ֨ים ׀ מִקֶּ֗דֶם הָגִ֥יתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶ֑ךָ בְּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵֽחַ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐμνήσθην ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων, καὶ ἐμελέτησα ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις σου, ἐν ποιήμασιν τῶν χειρῶν σου ἐμελέτων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy doings; I muse on the work of thy hands.
					\item[NIV] I remember the days of long ago; I meditate on all your works and consider what your hands have done.
					\item[NRSV] I remember the days of old, I think about all your deeds, I meditate on the works of your hands.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 143:6} % *PSALMS-143-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-6}

			I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{פֵּרַ֣שְׂתִּי יָדַ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ נַפְשִׁ֓י ׀ כְּאֶֽרֶץ־עֲיֵפָ֖ה לְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{διεπέτασα τὰς χεῖράς μου πρὸς σέ, ἡ ψυχή μου ὡς γῆ ἄνυδρός σοι. διάψαλμα.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I spread forth my hands unto thee: My soul thirsteth after thee, as a weary land. [Selah
					\item[NIV] I spread out my hands to you; I thirst for you like a parched land.
					\item[NRSV] I stretch out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like a parched land. Selah
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 143:7} % *PSALMS-143-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-7}

			Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מַ֘הֵ֤ר עֲנֵ֨נִי ׀ יְהוָה֮ כָּלְתָ֪ה ר֫וּחִ֥י אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֣ר פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ταχὺ εἰσάκουσόν μου, Κύριε, ἐξέλιπεν τὸ πνεῦμά μου· μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ, καὶ ὁμοιωθήσομαι τοῖς καταβαίνουσιν εἰς λάκκον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth: Hide not thy face from me, Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.
					\item[NIV] Answer me quickly, LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me or I will be like those who go down to the pit.
					\item[NRSV] Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me, or I shall be like those who go down to the Pit.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 143:8} % *PSALMS-143-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-8}

			Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַשְׁמִ֘יעֵ֤נִי בַבֹּ֨קֶר ׀ חַסְדֶּךָ֮ כִּֽי־בְךָ֪ בָ֫טָ֥חְתִּי הוֹדִיעֵ֗נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ־ז֥וּ אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־אֵ֝לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֥אתִי נַפְשִֽׁי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀκουστὸν ποίησόν μοι τὸ πρωὶ τὸ ἔλεός σου, ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ ἤλπισα· γνώρισόν μοι, Κύριε, ὁδὸν ἐν ᾗ πορεύσομαι, ὅτι πρὸς σὲ ἦρα τὴν ψυχήν μου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.
					\item[NIV] Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love, for I have put my trust in you. Show me the way I should go, for to you I entrust my life.
					\item[NRSV] Let me hear of your steadfast love in the morning, for in you I put my trust. Teach me the way I should go, for to you I lift up my soul.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 143:9} % *PSALMS-143-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-9}

			Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַצִּילֵ֖נִי מֵאֹיְבַ֥י ׀ יְהוָ֗ה אֵלֶ֥יךָ כִסִּֽתִי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξελοῦ με ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου, Κύριε, ὅτι πρὸς σὲ κατέφυγον.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
					\item[NIV] Rescue me from my enemies, LORD, for I hide myself in you.
					\item[NRSV] Save me, O LORD, from my enemies; I have fled to you for refuge.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 143:10} % *PSALMS-143-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-10}

			Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַמְּדֵ֤נִי ׀ לַֽעֲשׂ֣וֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ֮ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֪ה אֱל֫וֹהָ֥י רוּחֲךָ֥ טוֹבָ֑ה תַּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִישֽׁוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{δίδαξόν με τοῦ ποιεῖν τὸ θέλημά σου, ὅτι θεός μου εἶ σύ· τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ ἅγιον ὁδηγήσει με ἐν τῇ εὐθείᾳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Teach me to do thy will; For thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; Lead me in the land of uprightness.
					\item[NIV] Teach me to do your will, for you are my God; may your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
					\item[NRSV] Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Let your good spirit lead me on a level path.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 143:11} % *PSALMS-143-11
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-11}

			Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה תְּחַיֵּ֑נִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֓ ׀ תוֹצִ֖יא מִצָּרָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἕνεκα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου, Κύριε, ζήσεις με ἐν τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ σου, ἐξάξεις ἐκ θλίψεως τὴν ψυχήν μου·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name's sake: In thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
					\item[NIV] For your name’s sake, LORD, preserve my life; in your righteousness, bring me out of trouble.
					\item[NRSV] For your name’s sake, O LORD, preserve my life. In your righteousness bring me out of trouble.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 143:12} % *PSALMS-143-12
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-143-12}

			And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וּֽבְחַסְדְּךָ֮ תַּצְמִ֪ית אֹ֫יְבָ֥י וְֽ֭הַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל־צֹרֲרֵ֣י נַפְשִׁ֑י כִּ֝֗י אֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐλέει σου ἐξολεθρεύσεις τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου, καὶ ἀπολεῖς πάντας τοὺς θλίβοντας τὴν ψυχήν μου· ὅτι δοῦλός σού εἰμι ἐγώ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that afflict my soul; For I am thy servant.
					\item[NIV] In your unfailing love, silence my enemies; destroy all my foes, for I am your servant.
					\item[NRSV] In your steadfast love cut off my enemies, and destroy all my adversaries, for I am your servant.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 144} % *PSALMS-144
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-144}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 144:1} % *PSALMS-144-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-144-1}

			Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ צוּרִ֗י הַֽמְלַמֵּ֣ד יָדַ֣י לַקְרָ֑ב אֶ֝צְבְּעוֹתַ֗י לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Τῷ Δαυείδ, πρὸς τὸν Γολιάδ. Εὐλογητὸς Κύριος ὁ θεός μου, ὁ διδάσκων τὰς χεῖράς μου εἰς παράταξιν, τοὺς δακτύλους μου εἰς πόλεμον·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of David. Blessed be Jehovah my rock, Who teacheth my hands to war, And my fingers to fight:
					\item[NIV] Of David. Praise be to the LORD my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.
					\item[NRSV] Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands for war, and my fingers for battle;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 144:2} % *PSALMS-144-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-144-2}

			My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{חַסְדִּ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִי֮ מִשְׂגַּבִּ֪י וּֽמְפַלְטִ֫י לִ֥י מָ֭גִנִּי וּב֣וֹ חָסִ֑יתִי הָרוֹדֵ֖ד עַמִּ֣י תַחְתָּֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔλεός μου καὶ καταφυγή μου, ἀντιλήμπτωρ μου καὶ ῥύστης μου, ὑπερασπιστής μου καὶ ἐπ᾽ αὐτῷ ἤλπισα. ὁ ὑποτάσσων τὸν λαόν μου ὑπ᾽ ἐμέ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and he in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.
					\item[NIV] He is my loving God and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
					\item[NRSV] my rock and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues the peoples under me.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 144:3} % *PSALMS-144-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-144-3}

			LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְֽהוָ֗ה מָה־אָ֭דָם וַתֵּדָעֵ֑הוּ בֶּן־אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ וַֽתְּחַשְּׁבֵֽהוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὅτι ἐγνώσθης αὐτῷ, ἢ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ὅτι λογίζῃ αὐτόν;}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?
					\item[NIV] LORD, what are human beings that you care for them, mere mortals that you think of them?
					\item[NRSV] O LORD, what are human beings that you regard them, or mortals that you think of them?
					% % \item[OTX*]

					% % \item[OTXXX*]

					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-144-4}

			Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

					\item[BHS] \he{אָ֭דָם לַהֶ֣בֶל דָּמָ֑ה יָ֝מָ֗יו כְּצֵ֣ל עוֹבֵֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄνθρωπος ματαιότητι ὡμοιώθη, αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ σκιὰ παράγουσιν.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Man is like to vanity: His days are as a shadow that passeth away.
					\item[NIV] They are like a breath; their days are like a fleeting shadow.
					\item[NRSV] They are like a breath; their days are like a passing shadow.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-144-5}

			Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְ֭הוָה הַט־שָׁמֶ֣יךָ וְתֵרֵ֑ד גַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριε, κλῖνον οὐρανούς σου καὶ κατάβηθι, ἅψαι τῶν ὀρέων καὶ καπνισθήσονται·}

					% % \item[AB ]

			Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּר֣וֹק בָּ֭רָק וּתְפִיצֵ֑ם שְׁלַ֥ח חִ֝צֶּ֗יךָ וּתְהֻמֵּֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἄστραψον ἀστραπὴν καὶ σκορπιεῖς αὐτούς, ἐξαπόστειλον τὰ βέλη σου καὶ συνταράξεις αὐτούς.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] Make the lightning flash and scatter them; send out your arrows and rout them.

		\paragraph{Psalms 144:7} % *PSALMS-144-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-144-7}

			Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{שְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶ֗יךָ מִמָּ֫ר֥וֹם פְּצֵ֣נִי וְ֭הַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים מִ֝יַּ֗ד בְּנֵ֣י נֵכָֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξαπόστειλον τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐξ ὕψους, ἐξελοῦ με καὶ ῥῦσαί με ἐξ ὑδάτων πολλῶν, ἐκ χειρὸς υἱῶν ἀλλοτρίων,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Stretch forth thy hand from above; Rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, Out of the hand of aliens;
					\item[NIV] Reach down your hand from on high; deliver me and rescue me from the mighty waters, from the hands of foreigners
					\item[NRSV] Stretch out your hand from on high; set me free and rescue me from the mighty waters, from the hand of aliens,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὧν τὸ στόμα ἐλάλησεν ματαιότητα, καὶ ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτῶν δεξιὰ ἀδικίας.}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.
					\item[NRSV] whose mouths speak lies, and whose right hands are false.
					% % \item[OTX*]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ θεός, ᾠδὴν καινὴν ᾄσομαί σοι, ἐν ψαλτηρίῳ δεκαχόρδῳ ψαλῶ σοι,}

					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
					\item[NIV] I will sing a new song to you, my God; on the ten-stringed lyre I will make music to you,
					\item[NRSV] I will sing a new song to you, O God; upon a ten-stringed harp I will play to you,

					\item[LXX] \gr{τῷ διδόντι τὴν σωτηρίαν τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν, τῷ λυτρουμένῳ Δαυεὶδ τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ. ἐκ ῥομφαίας πονηρᾶς}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ῥῦσαί με, καὶ ἐξελοῦ με ἐκ χειρὸς υἱῶν ἀλλοτρίων, ὧν τὸ στόμα ἐλάλησεν ματαιότητα, καὶ ἡ δεξιὰ αὐτῶν δεξιὰ ἀδικίας·}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-144-12}

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּנֵ֨ינוּ ׀ כִּנְטִעִים֮ מְגֻדָּלִ֪ים בִּֽנְעוּרֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּנוֹתֵ֥ינוּ כְזָוִיֹּ֑ת מְ֝חֻטָּב֗וֹת תַּבְנִ֥ית הֵיכָֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὧν οἱ υἱοὶ ὡς νεόφυτα ἡδρυμμένα ἐν τῇ νεότητι αὐτῶν, αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῶν κεκαλλωπισμέναι, περικεκοσμημέναι ὡς ὁμοίωμα ναοῦ·}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Then our sons in their youth will be like well-nurtured plants, and our daughters will be like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
					\item[NRSV] May our sons in their youth be like plants full grown, our daughters like corner pillars, cut for the building of a palace.

					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 144:13} % *PSALMS-144-13
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-144-13}

			That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מְזָוֵ֣ינוּ מְלֵאִים֮ מְפִיקִ֥ים מִזַּ֗ן אֶ֫ל־זַ֥ן צֹאונֵ֣נוּ מַ֭אֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּב֗וֹת בְּחוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὰ ταμεῖα αὐτῶν πλήρη, ἐξερευγόμενα ἐκ τούτου εἰς τοῦτο· τὰ πρόβατα αὐτῶν πολύτοκα, πληθύνοντα ἐν ταῖς ἐξόδοις αὐτῶν,}

					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] When our garners are full, affording all manner of store, And our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our fields;
					\item[NIV] Our barns will be filled with every kind of provision. Our sheep will increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields;
					\item[NRSV] May our barns be filled, with produce of every kind; may our sheep increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-144-14}

			That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַלּוּפֵ֗ינוּ מְֽסֻבָּ֫לִ֥ים אֵֽין־פֶּ֭רֶץ וְאֵ֣ין יוֹצֵ֑את וְאֵ֥ין צְ֝וָחָ֗ה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵֽינוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οἱ βόες αὐτῶν παχεῖς· οὐκ ἔστιν κατάπτωμα φραγμοῦ οὐδὲ διέξοδος οὐδὲ κραυγὴ ἐν ταῖς ἐπαύλεσιν αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] our oxen will draw heavy loads. There will be no breaching of walls, no going into captivity, no cry of distress in our streets.
					\item[NRSV] and may our cattle be heavy with young. May there be no breach in the walls, no exile, and no cry of distress in our streets.

					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-144-15}

			Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם שֶׁכָּ֣כָה לּ֑וֹ אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הָ֝עָ֗ם שֶׁיֲהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐμακάρισαν τὸν λαὸν ᾧ ταῦτά ἐστιν, μακάριος ὁ λαὸς οὗ Κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτοῦ.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NIV] Blessed is the people of whom this is true; blessed is the people whose God is the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Happy are the people to whom such blessings fall; happy are the people whose God is the LORD.

	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-145}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 145:1} % *PSALMS-145-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-145-1}

			I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Αἴνεσις τοῦ Δαυείδ. Ὑψώσω σε, ὁ θεός μου ὁ βασιλεύς μου, καὶ εὐλογήσω τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] A Psalm of praise; of David I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
					\item[NIV] A psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt you, my God the King; I will praise your name for ever and ever.
					\item[NRSV] I will extol you, my God and King, and bless your name forever and ever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 145:2} % *PSALMS-145-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-145-2}

			Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בְּכָל־י֥וֹם אֲבָרֲכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καθ᾽ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν εὐλογήσω σε, καὶ αἰνέσω τὸ ὄνομά σου.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
					\item[NIV] Every day I will praise you and extol your name for ever and ever.
					\item[NRSV] Every day I will bless you, and praise your name forever and ever.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 145:3} % *PSALMS-145-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-145-3}

			Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μέγας ὁ κύριος καὶ αἰνετὸς σφόδρα, καὶ τῆς μεγαλωσύνης αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν πέρας.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable.
					\item[NIV] Great is the LORD and most worthy of praise; his greatness no one can fathom.
					\item[NRSV] Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; his greatness is unsearchable.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 145:4} % *PSALMS-145-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-145-4}

			One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{דּ֣וֹר לְ֭דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{γενεὰ καὶ γενεὰ ἐπαινέσει τὰ ἔργα σου, καὶ τὴν δύναμίν σου ἀπαγγελοῦσιν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] One generation shall laud thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts.
					\item[NIV] One generation commends your works to another; they tell of your mighty acts.
					\item[NRSV] One generation shall laud your works to another, and shall declare your mighty acts.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

			\label{PSALMS-145-5}

			I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הֲ֭דַר כְּב֣וֹד הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ τὴν μεγαλοπρέπειαν τῆς δόξης τῆς ἁγιωσύνης σου λαλήσουσιν, καὶ τὰ θαυμάσιά σου διηγήσονται·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Of the glorious majesty of thine honor, And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.
					\item[NIV] They speak of the glorious splendor of your majesty— and I will meditate on your wonderful works.
					\item[NRSV] On the glorious splendor of your majesty, and on your wondrous works, I will meditate.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-145-6}

			And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וֶעֱז֣וּז נוֹרְאֹתֶ֣יךָ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְדוּלָּתְךָ֥ אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ τὴν δύναμιν τῶν φοβερῶν σου ἐροῦσιν, καὶ τὴν μεγαλωσύνην σου, διηγήσομαι αὐτήν, καὶ τὴν δυναστείαν σου λαλήσουσιν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 146:1} % *PSALMS-146-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-146-1}

			Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽלְלוּ־יָ֡הּ הַלְלִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά· Ἁγγαίου καὶ Ζαχαρίου. Αἴνει, ἡ ψυχή μου, τὸν κύριον·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise ye Jehovah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD, my soul.
					\item[NRSV] Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, O my soul!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 146:2} % *PSALMS-146-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-146-2}

			While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אֲהַלְלָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵֽאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνέσω Κύριον ἐν ζωῇ μου, ψαλῶ τῷ θεῷ μου ἕως ὑπάρχω.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] While I live will I praise Jehovah: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
					\item[NIV] I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.
					\item[NRSV] I will praise the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praises to my God all my life long.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 146:3} % *PSALMS-146-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-146-3}

			Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַל־תִּבְטְח֥וּ בִנְדִיבִ֑ים בְּבֶן־אָדָ֓ם ׀ שֶׁ֤אֵֽין ל֥וֹ תְשׁוּעָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μὴ πεποίθατε ἐπ᾽ ἄρχοντας καὶ ἐφ᾽ υἱοὺς ἀνθρώπων, οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν σωτηρία·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
					\item[NIV] Do not put your trust in princes, in human beings, who cannot save.
					\item[NRSV] Do not put your trust in princes, in mortals, in whom there is no help.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 146:4} % *PSALMS-146-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-146-4}

			His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{תֵּצֵ֣א ר֭וּחוֹ יָשֻׁ֣ב לְאַדְמָת֑וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַ֝ה֗וּא אָבְד֥וּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἐξελεύσεται τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπιστρέψει εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ· ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἀπολοῦνται πάντες οἱ διαλογισμοὶ αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; In that very day his thoughts perish.
					\item[NIV] When their spirit departs, they return to the ground; on that very day their plans come to nothing.
					\item[NRSV] When their breath departs, they return to the earth; on that very day their plans perish.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		\paragraph{Psalms 146:5} % *PSALMS-146-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-146-5}

			Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{אַשְׁרֵ֗י שֶׁ֤אֵ֣ל יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּעֶזְר֑וֹ שִׂ֝בְר֗וֹ עַל־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μακάριος οὗ ὁ θεὸς Ἰακὼβ βοηθός, ἡ ἐλπὶς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Κύριον τὸν θεὸν αὐτοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God:
					\item[NIV] Blessed are those whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD their God.
					\item[NRSV] Happy are those whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD their God,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 146:6} % *PSALMS-146-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-146-6}

			Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עֹשֶׂ֤ה ׀ שָׁ֘מַ֤יִם וָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־הַיָּ֥ם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֑ם הַשֹּׁמֵ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת לְעוֹלָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τὸν ποιήσαντα τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν, τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς· τὸν φυλάσσοντα ἀλήθειαν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;
					\item[NIV] He is the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them— he remains faithful forever.
					\item[NRSV] who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps faith forever;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 146:7} % *PSALMS-146-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-146-7}

			Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{עֹשֶׂ֤ה מִשְׁפָּ֨ט ׀ לָעֲשׁוּקִ֗ים נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לָרְעֵבִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַתִּ֥יר אֲסוּרִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ποιοῦντα κρίμα τοῖς ἀδικουμένοις, διδόντα τροφὴν τοῖς πεινῶσιν. Κύριος λύει πεπεδημένους·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth food to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;
					\item[NIV] He upholds the cause of the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets prisoners free,
					\item[NRSV] who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free;
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 146:8} % *PSALMS-146-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-146-8}

			The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֤ה ׀ פֹּ֘קֵ֤חַ עִוְרִ֗ים יְ֭הוָה זֹקֵ֣ף כְּפוּפִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֹהֵ֥ב צַדִּיקִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος ἀνορθοῖ κατερραγμένους· Κύριος σοφοῖ τυφλούς· Κύριος ἀγαπᾷ δικαίους·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah openeth the eyes of the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;
					\item[NIV] the LORD gives sight to the blind, the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
					\item[NRSV] the LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD lifts up those who are bowed down; the LORD loves the righteous.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 146:9} % *PSALMS-146-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-146-9}

			The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהוָ֤ה ׀ שֹׁ֘מֵ֤ר אֶת־גֵּרִ֗ים יָת֣וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֣ה יְעוֹדֵ֑ד וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יְעַוֵּֽת׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Κύριος φυλάσσει τοὺς προσηλύτους, ὀρφανὸν καὶ χήραν ἀναλήμψεται, καὶ ὁδὸν ἁμαρτωλῶν ἀφανιεῖ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah preserveth the sojourners; He upholdeth the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
					\item[NIV] The LORD watches over the foreigner and sustains the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD watches over the strangers; he upholds the orphan and the widow, but the way of the wicked he brings to ruin.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 146:10} % *PSALMS-146-10
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-146-10}

			The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהוָ֨ה ׀ לְעוֹלָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִ֭יּוֹן לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{βασιλεύσει Κύριος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ὁ θεός σου, Σιών, εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD will reign forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the LORD!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 147} % *PSALMS-147
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-147}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 147:1} % *PSALMS-147-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-147-1}

			Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ כִּי־ט֭וֹב זַמְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־נָ֝עִים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Ἁγγαίου καὶ Ζαχαρίου. Αἰνεῖτε τὸν κύριον, ὅτι ἀγαθὸν ψαλμός· τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν ἡδυνθείη αἴνεσις·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise ye Jehovah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is comely.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD. How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and fitting to praise him!
					\item[NRSV] Praise the LORD! How good it is to sing praises to our God; for he is gracious, and a song of praise is fitting.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 147:2} % *PSALMS-147-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-147-2}

			The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{בּוֹנֵ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה נִדְחֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל יְכַנֵּֽס׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{οἰκοδομῶν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ὁ κύριος, καὶ τὰς διασπορὰς τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἐπισυνάξει·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem; He gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
					\item[NIV] The LORD builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the exiles of Israel.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the outcasts of Israel.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 147:3} % *PSALMS-147-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-147-3}

			He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הָ֭רֹפֵא לִשְׁב֣וּרֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝מְחַבֵּ֗שׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ ἰώμενος τοὺς συντετριμμένους τὴν καρδίαν, καὶ δεσμεύων τὰ συντρίμματα αὐτῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.
					\item[NIV] He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
					\item[NRSV] He heals the brokenhearted, and binds up their wounds.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 147:4} % *PSALMS-147-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-147-4}

			He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מוֹנֶ֣ה מִ֭סְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִ֑ים לְ֝כֻלָּ֗ם שֵׁמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὁ ἀριθμῶν πλήθη ἄστρων, καὶ πᾶσιν αὐτοῖς ὀνόματα καλῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] He counteth the number of the stars; He calleth them all by their names.
					\item[NIV] He determines the number of the stars and calls them each by name.
					\item[NRSV] He determines the number of the stars; he gives to all of them their names.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 147:5} % *PSALMS-147-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-147-5}

			Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{גָּד֣וֹל אֲדוֹנֵ֣ינוּ וְרַב־כֹּ֑חַ לִ֝תְבוּנָת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{μέγας ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν, καὶ μεγάλη ἡ ἰσχὺς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τῆς συνέσεως αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.
					\item[NIV] Great is our Lord and mighty in power; his understanding has no limit.
					\item[NRSV] Great is our Lord, and abundant in power; his understanding is beyond measure.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 147:6} % *PSALMS-147-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-147-6}

			The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{מְעוֹדֵ֣ד עֲנָוִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה מַשְׁפִּ֖יל רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֲדֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ἀναλαμβάνων πρᾳεῖς ὁ κύριος, ταπεινῶν δὲ ἁμαρτωλοὺς ἕως τῆς γῆς.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Jehovah upholdeth the meek: He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.
					\item[NIV] The LORD sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground.
					\item[NRSV] The LORD lifts up the downtrodden; he casts the wicked to the ground.
					% % \item[OTX*]

	\subsubsection{Psalms 148} % *PSALMS-148
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-148}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 148:1} % *PSALMS-148-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-148-1}

			Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֑יִם הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά· Ἁγγαίου καὶ Ζαχαρίου. Αἰνεῖτε τὸν κύριον ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens: Praise him in the heights.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise him in the heights above.
					\item[NRSV] Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise him in the heights!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 148:2} % *PSALMS-148-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-148-2}

			Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽלְל֥וּהוּ כָל־מַלְאָכָ֑יו הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ צְבָאָֽיו׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν, πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ· αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν, πᾶσαι αἱ δυνάμεις αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise ye him, all his angels: Praise ye him, all his host.

					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν, ἥλιος καὶ σελήνη· αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν, πάντα τὰ ἄστρα καὶ τὸ φῶς.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεῖτε αὐτόν, οἱ οὐρανοὶ τῶν οὐρανῶν, καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ὑπεράνω τῶν οὐρανῶν.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου· ὅτι αὐτὸς εἶπεν καὶ ἐγενήθησαν, αὐτὸς ἐνετείλατο καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν.}

					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[LXX] \gr{ἔστησεν αὐτὰ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τοῦ αἰῶνος· πρόσταγμα ἔθετο, καὶ οὐ παρελεύσεται.}

					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεῖτε τὸν κύριον ἐκ τῆς γῆς, δράκοντες καὶ πᾶσαι ἄβυσσοι·}
