					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]

					% % \item[OTR2]

					\item[NRSV] Praise the LORD from the earth, you sea monsters and all deeps,

					\item[LXX] \gr{νεανίσκοι καὶ παρθένοι, πρεσβῦται μετὰ νεωτέρων·}

		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-148-13}

			Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהַלְל֤וּ ׀ אֶת־שֵׁ֬ם יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־נִשְׂגָּ֣ב שְׁמ֣וֹ לְבַדּ֑וֹ ה֝וֹד֗וֹ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου, ὅτι ὑψώθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ μόνου, ἡ ἐξομολόγησις αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ γῆς καὶ οὐρανοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
					\item[NIV] Let them praise the name of the LORD, for his name alone is exalted; his splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
					\item[NRSV] Let them praise the name of the LORD, for his name alone is exalted; his glory is above earth and heaven.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]

		\paragraph{Psalms 148:14} % *PSALMS-148-14
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-148-14}

			He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{וַיָּ֤רֶם קֶ֨רֶן ׀ לְעַמּ֡וֹ תְּהִלָּ֤ה לְֽכָל־חֲסִידָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֣י יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל עַֽם־קְרֹב֗וֹ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καὶ ὑψώσει κέρας λαοῦ αὐτοῦ, τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ, λαῷ ἐγγίζοντι αὐτῷ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] And he has raised up for his people a horn, the praise of all his faithful servants, of Israel, the people close to his heart. Praise the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] He has raised up a horn for his people, praise for all his faithful, for the people of Israel who are close to him. Praise the LORD!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

	\subsubsection{Psalms 149} % *PSALMS-149
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-149}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 149:1} % *PSALMS-149-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-149-1}

			Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. ᾌσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ᾆσμα καινόν, ἡ αἴνεσις αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ ὁσίων.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise ye Jehovah. Sing unto Jehovah a new song, And his praise in the assembly of the saints.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD. Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of his faithful people.
					\item[NRSV] Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the faithful.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 149:2} % *PSALMS-149-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-149-2}

			Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יִשְׂמַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּעֹשָׂ֑יו בְּנֵֽי־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן יָגִ֥ילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{εὐφρανθήτω Ἰσραὴλ ἐπὶ τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτόν, καὶ υἱοὶ Σειὼν ἀγαλλιάσθωσαν ἐπὶ τῷ βασιλεῖ αὐτῶν·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
					\item[NIV] Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the people of Zion be glad in their King.
					\item[NRSV] Let Israel be glad in its Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 149:3} % *PSALMS-149-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-149-3}

			Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣וֹ בְמָח֑וֹל בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנּ֗וֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεσάτωσαν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐν χορῷ, ἐν τυμπάνῳ καὶ ψαλτηρίῳ ψαλάτωσαν αὐτῷ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let them praise his name in the dance: Let them sing praises unto him with timbrel and harp.
					\item[NIV] Let them praise his name with dancing and make music to him with timbrel and harp.
					\item[NRSV] Let them praise his name with dancing, making melody to him with tambourine and lyre.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 149:4} % *PSALMS-149-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-149-4}

			For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כִּֽי־רוֹצֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{ὅτι εὐδοκεῖ Κύριος ἐν λαῷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὑψώσει πρᾳεῖς ἐν σωτηρίᾳ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.
					\item[NIV] For the LORD takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with victory.
					\item[NRSV] For the LORD takes pleasure in his people; he adorns the humble with victory.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 149:5} % *PSALMS-149-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-149-5}

			Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{יַעְלְז֣וּ חֲסִידִ֣ים בְּכָב֑וֹד יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{καυχήσονται ὅσιοι ἐν δόξῃ, καὶ ἀγαλλιάσονται ἐπὶ τῶν κοιτῶν αὐτῶν.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the saints exult in glory: Let them sing for joy upon their beds.
					\item[NIV] Let his faithful people rejoice in this honor and sing for joy on their beds.
					\item[NRSV] Let the faithful exult in glory; let them sing for joy on their couches.
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 149:6} % *PSALMS-149-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-149-6}

			Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{רוֹמְמ֣וֹת אֵ֭ל בִּגְרוֹנָ֑ם וְחֶ֖רֶב פִּֽיפִיּ֣וֹת בְּיָדָֽם׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἱ ὑψώσεις τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν λάρυγγι αὐτῶν, καὶ ῥομφαῖαι δίστομοι ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;
					\item[NIV] May the praise of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands,
					\item[NRSV] Let the high praises of God be in their throats and two-edged swords in their hands,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 149:7} % *PSALMS-149-7
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-149-7}

			To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת נְ֭קָמָה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹכֵחֹ֗ת בַּל־אֻמִּֽים׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἐκδίκησιν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ἐλεγμοὺς ἐν τοῖς λαοῖς,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] To execute vengeance upon the nations, And punishments upon the peoples;
					\item[NIV] to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
					\item[NRSV] to execute vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 149:8} % *PSALMS-149-8
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-149-8}

			To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לֶאְסֹ֣ר מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם בְּזִקִּ֑ים וְ֝נִכְבְּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּכַבְלֵ֥י בַרְזֶֽל׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῦ δῆσαι τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν ἐν πέδαις καὶ τοὺς ἐνδόξους αὐτῶν ἐν χειροπέδαις σιδηραῖς,}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;
					\item[NIV] to bind their kings with fetters, their nobles with shackles of iron,
					\item[NRSV] to bind their kings with fetters and their nobles with chains of iron,
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 149:9} % *PSALMS-149-9
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-149-9}

			To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת בָּהֶ֨ם ׀ מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב הָדָ֣ר ה֭וּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָ֗יו הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἐν αὐτοῖς κρίμα ἔνγραπτον· δόξα αὕτη ἐστὶν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁσίοις αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] To execute upon them the judgment written: This honor have all his saints. Praise ye Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] to carry out the sentence written against them— this is the glory of all his faithful people. Praise the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] to execute on them the judgment decreed. This is glory for all his faithful ones. Praise the LORD!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
	% -----
	\subsubsection{Psalms 150} % *PSALMS-150
	% -----
		\label{PSALMS-150}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 150:1} % *PSALMS-150-1
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-150-1}

			Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ ׀ הַֽלְלוּ־אֵ֥ל בְּקָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{Ἁλληλουιά. Αἰνεῖτε τὸν θεὸν ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν στερεώματι δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise ye Jehovah. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.
					\item[NIV] Praise the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens.
					\item[NRSV] Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty firmament!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 150:2} % *PSALMS-150-2
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-150-2}

			Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽלְל֥וּהוּ בִגְבוּרֹתָ֑יו הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כְּרֹ֣ב גֻּדְלֽוֹ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐπὶ ταῖς δυναστείαις αὐτοῦ, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῆς μεγαλωσύνης αὐτοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise him for his mighty acts: Praise him according to his excellent greatness.
					\item[NIV] Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness.
					\item[NRSV] Praise him for his mighty deeds; praise him according to his surpassing greatness!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 150:3} % *PSALMS-150-3
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-150-3}

			Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֵ֣קַע שׁוֹפָ֑ר הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּנֵ֣בֶל וְכִנּֽוֹר׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν ἤχῳ σάλπιγγος, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν ψαλτηρίῳ καὶ κιθάρᾳ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise him with trumpet sound: Praise him with psaltery and harp.
					\item[NIV] Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet, praise him with the harp and lyre,
					\item[NRSV] Praise him with trumpet sound; praise him with lute and harp!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 150:4} % *PSALMS-150-4
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-150-4}

			Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְתֹ֣ף וּמָח֑וֹל הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּמִנִּ֥ים וְעוּגָֽב׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν τυμπάνῳ καὶ χορῷ, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν χορδαῖς καὶ ὀργάνῳ·}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise him with timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.
					\item[NIV] praise him with timbrel and dancing, praise him with the strings and pipe,
					\item[NRSV] Praise him with tambourine and dance; praise him with strings and pipe!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 150:5} % *PSALMS-150-5
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-150-5}

			Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{הַֽלְל֥וּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־שָׁ֑מַע הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּֽצִלְצְלֵ֥י תְרוּעָֽה׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν κυμβάλοις εὐήχοις, αἰνεῖτε αὐτὸν ἐν κυμβάλοις ἀλαλαγμοῦ.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Praise him with loud cymbals: Praise him with high sounding cymbals.
					\item[NIV] praise him with the clash of cymbals, praise him with resounding cymbals.
					\item[NRSV] Praise him with clanging cymbals; praise him with loud clashing cymbals!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}

		% % ---
		\paragraph{Psalms 150:6} % *PSALMS-150-6
		% % ---
			\label{PSALMS-150-6}

			Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

			\begin{versebox}
					\item[BHS] \he{כֹּ֣ל הַ֭נְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּ֥ל יָ֗הּ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃}
					\item[LXX] \gr{πᾶσα πνοὴ αἰνεσάτω τὸν κύριον. ἁλληλουιά.}
					% % \item[BSV]
					% % \item[AB ]
					% % \item[NETS]
					% % \item[OTR1]
					% % \item[OTR2]
					\item[ASV] Let everything that hath breath Praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.
					\item[NIV] Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD.
					\item[NRSV] Let everything that breathes praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!
					% % \item[OTX*]
					% % \item[OTXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXX*]
					% % \item[OTXXXXXX*]
			\end{versebox}
